  const anchorCoordsRef = useRef<LiveGpsCoords | null>(null);
  const lastHeartbeatSent = useRef<number>(0);

  const currentUser = user as Record<string, any> | null;
  const displayName =
    currentUser?.full_name ||
    `${currentUser?.first_name || ''} ${currentUser?.last_name || ''}`.trim() ||
    currentUser?.faculty_name ||
    currentUser?.username ||
    '';

  const employeeId =
    currentUser?.employee_id ||
    currentUser?.faculty_id ||
    dtrData?.employee_id ||
    currentUser?.username ||
    '';

  const schoolName =
    schoolProfile?.school_name ||
    currentUser?.school_name ||
    geofenceConfig?.name ||
    'AttendSure';

  const schoolSubHeader = [
    schoolProfile?.school_id ? `School ID: ${schoolProfile.school_id}` : '',
    schoolProfile?.division || '',
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(' • ');

  const greetingText = useMemo(() => getGreeting(), []);

  const resolveSafePhotoUrl = useCallback((path: string | null | undefined, base: string): string | null => {
    if (!path || typeof path !== 'string') return null;
    const trimmed = path.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return null;
    const candidate =
      trimmed.startsWith('http://') || trimmed.startsWith('https://') || trimmed.startsWith('data:')
        ? trimmed
        : base
        ? `${base.replace(/\/+$/, '')}${trimmed.startsWith('/') ? trimmed : `/${trimmed}`}`
        : '';
    return isSafeUrl(candidate) ? candidate : null;
  }, []);

  const rawUserPhoto =
    currentUser?.photo_url ||
    currentUser?.photo ||
    currentUser?.avatar_url ||
    currentUser?.avatar ||
    null;
  const resolvedUserPhoto = resolveSafePhotoUrl(rawUserPhoto, serverBase);

  const rawLogoPath = schoolProfile?.school_logo || schoolProfile?.left_logo || null;
  const resolvedLogoUri = resolveSafePhotoUrl(rawLogoPath, serverBase);

  useEffect(() => {
    setAvatarFailed(false);
  }, [resolvedUserPhoto]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setLogoFailed(false);
  }, [resolvedLogoUri]);

  useEffect(() => {
    startPassivePresenceTracking().catch(() => {});
  }, [currentUser?.username, currentUser?.id]);

  const applyStationaryFilter = useCallback((raw: LiveGpsCoords): LiveGpsCoords => {
    const anchor = anchorCoordsRef.current;
    if (!anchor) {
      anchorCoordsRef.current = raw;
      return raw;
    }

    const displacement = calculateDistanceMeters(
      anchor.latitude,
      anchor.longitude,
      raw.latitude,
      raw.longitude
    );

    if (displacement < 6) {
      return {
        latitude: anchor.latitude,
        longitude: anchor.longitude,
        accuracy: raw.accuracy ?? anchor.accuracy,
        mocked: raw.mocked,
        timestamp: raw.timestamp,
      };
    }

    anchorCoordsRef.current = raw;
    return raw;
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let watcherSubscription: Location.LocationSubscription | null = null;
    let heartbeatIntervalTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
    let isSubscribed = true;

    const transmitHeartbeat = async (coords: LiveGpsCoords) => {
      try {
        await sendLiveHeartbeat(coords);
        if (isSubscribed) {
          setIsOnline(true);
          setGpsError(null);
        }
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        if (!isSubscribed) return;
        const msg = getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not verify your campus location right now.');
        const lower = msg.toLowerCase();
        if (lower.includes('lock') || lower.includes('mismatch') || lower.includes('permission') || lower.includes('mock')) {
          setGpsError(msg);
          setIsOnline(false);
        }
      }
    };

    const startLiveGpsTracking = async () => {
      try {
        const { status } = await Location.requestForegroundPermissionsAsync();
        if (!isSubscribed) return;
        if (status !== 'granted') {
          setGpsError('Location access is needed for attendance check-in.');
          return;
        }

        const isGpsActive = await Location.hasServicesEnabledAsync();
        if (!isSubscribed) return;
        if (!isGpsActive) {
          setGpsError('Phone GPS is turned off.');
          return;
        }

        setGpsError(null);

        const initial = await Location.getCurrentPositionAsync({
          accuracy: Location.Accuracy.High,
        });
        if (!isSubscribed) return;

        if (initial) {
          const rawCoords: LiveGpsCoords = {
            latitude: initial.coords.latitude,
            longitude: initial.coords.longitude,
            accuracy: initial.coords.accuracy,
            mocked: Boolean(initial.mocked),
            timestamp: format12HourTime(new Date()),
          };

          const stabilized = applyStationaryFilter(rawCoords);
          setLiveCoords(stabilized);

          lastHeartbeatSent.current = Date.now();
          void transmitHeartbeat(stabilized);
        }

        if (!isSubscribed) return;
        const sub = await Location.watchPositionAsync(
          {
            accuracy: Location.Accuracy.High,
            timeInterval: 5000,
            distanceInterval: 3,
          },
          (position) => {
            if (!isSubscribed) return;

            const rawCoords: LiveGpsCoords = {
              latitude: position.coords.latitude,
              longitude: position.coords.longitude,
              accuracy: position.coords.accuracy,
              mocked: Boolean(position.mocked),
              timestamp: format12HourTime(new Date()),
            };

            const stabilized = applyStationaryFilter(rawCoords);
            setLiveCoords(stabilized);
            setGpsError(null);

            const now = Date.now();
            if (now - lastHeartbeatSent.current >= 60000) {
              lastHeartbeatSent.current = now;
              void transmitHeartbeat(stabilized);
            }
          }
        );

        // Clean up immediately if unmounted while awaiting watchPositionAsync
        if (!isSubscribed) {
          sub.remove();
          return;
        }
        watcherSubscription = sub;

        heartbeatIntervalTimer = setInterval(async () => {
          if (!isSubscribed) return;
          const now = Date.now();
          if (now - lastHeartbeatSent.current < 60000) return;

          try {
            const freshLoc = await Location.getCurrentPositionAsync({
              accuracy: Location.Accuracy.High,
            });
            if (!isSubscribed) return;
            const rawCoords: LiveGpsCoords = {
              latitude: freshLoc.coords.latitude,
              longitude: freshLoc.coords.longitude,
              accuracy: freshLoc.coords.accuracy,
              mocked: Boolean(freshLoc.mocked),
              timestamp: format12HourTime(new Date()),
            };
            const stabilized = applyStationaryFilter(rawCoords);
            setLiveCoords(stabilized);
            lastHeartbeatSent.current = now;
            void transmitHeartbeat(stabilized);
          } catch {
            if (!isSubscribed) return;
            if (anchorCoordsRef.current) {
              lastHeartbeatSent.current = now;
              const updated = {
                ...anchorCoordsRef.current,
                timestamp: format12HourTime(new Date()),
              };
              setLiveCoords(updated);
              void transmitHeartbeat(updated);
            }
          }
        }, 30000);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        if (isSubscribed) {
          setGpsError(getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Searching for GPS signal...'));
        }
      }
    };

    void startLiveGpsTracking();

    return () => {
      isSubscribed = false;
      if (watcherSubscription) {
        watcherSubscription.remove();
        watcherSubscription = null;
      }
      if (heartbeatIntervalTimer) {
        clearInterval(heartbeatIntervalTimer);
        heartbeatIntervalTimer = null;
      }
    };
  }, [currentUser?.username, currentUser?.id, applyStationaryFilter]);

  const campusCenter = useMemo(() => {
    const lat = geofenceConfig?.latitude ?? schoolProfile?.latitude ?? null;
    const lng = geofenceConfig?.longitude ?? schoolProfile?.longitude ?? null;
    const radius = geofenceConfig?.radius_meters ?? schoolProfile?.geofence_radius_meters ?? null;
    return { lat, lng, radius };
  }, [geofenceConfig, schoolProfile]);

  const liveDistanceMeters = useMemo(() => {
    if (!liveCoords || campusCenter.lat === null || campusCenter.lng === null) {
      return null;
    }
    return calculateDistanceMeters(
      liveCoords.latitude,
      liveCoords.longitude,
      campusCenter.lat,
      campusCenter.lng
    );
  }, [liveCoords, campusCenter]);

  const isInsideCampusPerimeter = useMemo(() => {
    if (liveDistanceMeters === null || campusCenter.radius === null) return null;
    return liveDistanceMeters <= campusCenter.radius;
  }, [liveDistanceMeters, campusCenter.radius]);

  const todayStr = getLocalTodayStr();
  const todayDtrRow: DtrDayRow | null =
    dtrData?.rows?.find((r) => r.date_str === todayStr) || null;

  const hasCheckedInToday = Boolean(todayDtrRow?.am_arrival || todayDtrRow?.pm_arrival);
  const hasCheckedOutToday = Boolean(
    (todayDtrRow?.pm_departure && todayDtrRow.pm_departure !== '') ||
      (todayDtrRow?.am_departure && !todayDtrRow?.pm_arrival)
  );
  const isOfficiallyOnDuty = hasCheckedInToday && !hasCheckedOutToday;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isInsideCampusPerimeter === false && isOfficiallyOnDuty && campusCenter.radius !== null) {
      const accuracyMargin = liveCoords?.accuracy || 0;
      const excessDistance = (liveDistanceMeters || 0) - campusCenter.radius;

      if (excessDistance <= accuracyMargin) {
        return;
      }

      const now = Date.now();
      if (!campusAlertAcknowledged || now - lastCampusAlertTimestamp.current > 300000) {
        setShowCampusAlertModal(true);
        lastCampusAlertTimestamp.current = now;
        if (Platform.OS !== 'web') {
          Vibration.vibrate([0, 150, 100, 150]);
        }
      }
    } else if (isInsideCampusPerimeter === true) {
      setShowCampusAlertModal(false);
      setCampusAlertAcknowledged(false);
    }
  }, [
    isInsideCampusPerimeter,
    isOfficiallyOnDuty,
    liveDistanceMeters,
    liveCoords,
    campusCenter.radius,
    campusAlertAcknowledged,
  ]);

  const handleDismissCampusAlert = () => {
    setShowCampusAlertModal(false);
    setCampusAlertAcknowledged(true);
  };

  const loadCachedData = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const results = await Promise.allSettled([
        AsyncStorage.getItem('attendsure_cached_school'),
        AsyncStorage.getItem('attendsure_cached_sections'),
        AsyncStorage.getItem('attendsure_cached_dtr'),
        AsyncStorage.getItem('attendsure_cached_geofence'),
        getServerBaseUrl(),
      ]);

      if (!isMounted.current) return;

      const [schoolRes, sectionsRes, dtrRes, geoRes, baseRes] = results;
      if (schoolRes.status === 'fulfilled' && schoolRes.value) {
        setSchoolProfile(JSON.parse(schoolRes.value));
      }
      if (sectionsRes.status === 'fulfilled' && sectionsRes.value) {
        setSections(JSON.parse(sectionsRes.value));
      }
      if (dtrRes.status === 'fulfilled' && dtrRes.value) {
        setDtrData(JSON.parse(dtrRes.value));
      }
      if (geoRes.status === 'fulfilled' && geoRes.value) {
        setGeofenceConfig(JSON.parse(geoRes.value));
      }
      if (baseRes.status === 'fulfilled' && baseRes.value) {
        setServerBase(baseRes.value);
      }
    } catch {}
  }, []);

  const normalizeClasses = (rawList: any[]): SectionItem[] =>
    rawList.map((item: any, idx: number) => ({
      schedule_id: item.schedule_id || item.id || idx + 1,
      section_id: item.section_id || item.section?.id || item.id || 0,
      section_name: item.section_name || item.section?.name || item.name || '',
      subject_name: item.subject_name || item.subject?.name || item.subject_title || '',
      subject_code: item.subject_code || item.subject?.code || '',
      room: item.room || item.room_number || item.room?.name || '',
      start_time: typeof item.start_time === 'string' ? item.start_time : '',
      end_time: typeof item.end_time === 'string' ? item.end_time : '',
      total_students: Array.isArray(item.students)
        ? item.students.length
        : Number(item.total_students) || 0,
      students: Array.isArray(item.students) ? item.students : [],
    }));

  const flushOfflineRecords = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      if (isMounted.current) setIsSyncingQueue(true);
      const res = await syncOfflineQueue();
      const updatedCount = await getUnsyncedCount();
      if (isMounted.current) {
        setOfflineCount(updatedCount);
        if (res.synced > 0) {
          setIsOnline(true);
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Keep unsynced count intact until next retry
    } finally {
      if (isMounted.current) setIsSyncingQueue(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const loadAllDynamicData = useCallback(async () => {
    abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    abortControllerRef.current = controller;

    const todayDate = getLocalTodayStr();
    const now = new Date();

    const [classListRes, schoolRes, dtrRes, geofenceRes, calendarRes] =
      await Promise.allSettled([
        apiClient
          .get('classroom/assigned/', { signal: controller.signal, timeout: 5000 })
          .catch((err: unknown) => {
            if (isCanceledError(err) || controller.signal.aborted) {
              throw err;
            }
            return apiClient.get('sections/', { signal: controller.signal, timeout: 5000 });
          }),
        apiClient.get('settings/school/', { signal: controller.signal, timeout: 5000 }),
        apiClient.get(
          `reports/dtr/?month=${now.getMonth() + 1}&year=${now.getFullYear()}`,
          { signal: controller.signal, timeout: 5000 }
        ),
        apiClient.get('geofence/', { signal: controller.signal, timeout: 5000 }),
        apiClient.get('calendar/exceptions/', { signal: controller.signal, timeout: 5000 }),
      ]);

    if (!isMounted.current || controller.signal.aborted) return;

    let anySuccess = false;

    if (classListRes.status === 'fulfilled' && classListRes.value?.data) {
      anySuccess = true;
      const rawPayload = classListRes.value.data;
      const rawList = Array.isArray(rawPayload)
        ? rawPayload
        : Array.isArray(rawPayload?.results)
        ? rawPayload.results
        : [];
      const normalized = normalizeClasses(rawList);
      setSections(normalized);
      AsyncStorage.setItem('attendsure_cached_sections', JSON.stringify(normalized)).catch(
        () => {}
      );
    }

    if (schoolRes.status === 'fulfilled' && schoolRes.value?.data) {
      anySuccess = true;
      setSchoolProfile(schoolRes.value.data);
      AsyncStorage.setItem(
        'attendsure_cached_school',
        JSON.stringify(schoolRes.value.data)
      ).catch(() => {});
    }

    if (dtrRes.status === 'fulfilled' && dtrRes.value?.data) {
      anySuccess = true;
      setDtrData(dtrRes.value.data);
      AsyncStorage.setItem('attendsure_cached_dtr', JSON.stringify(dtrRes.value.data)).catch(
        () => {}
      );
    }

    if (geofenceRes.status === 'fulfilled' && geofenceRes.value?.data) {
      anySuccess = true;
      setGeofenceConfig(geofenceRes.value.data);
      AsyncStorage.setItem(
        'attendsure_cached_geofence',
        JSON.stringify(geofenceRes.value.data)
      ).catch(() => {});
    }

    if (calendarRes.status === 'fulfilled' && calendarRes.value?.data) {
      anySuccess = true;
      const calPayload = calendarRes.value.data;
      const list: CalendarOverrideItem[] = Array.isArray(calPayload)
        ? calPayload
        : Array.isArray(calPayload?.results)
        ? calPayload.results
        : [];
      if (typeof calPayload?.weekend_rest_enabled === 'boolean') {
        setWeekendRestEnabled(calPayload.weekend_rest_enabled);
      }
      const matched = list.find((item) => item.date === todayDate) || null;
      setTodayOverride(matched);
    }

    setIsOnline(anySuccess);

    const count = await getUnsyncedCount();
    if (!isMounted.current || controller.signal.aborted) return;

    setOfflineCount(count);
    if (count > 0) {
      void flushOfflineRecords();
    }

    setLastSyncTime(format12HourTime(new Date()));
  }, [flushOfflineRecords]);

  const onRefresh = useCallback(async () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    await Promise.allSettled([loadAllDynamicData(), flushOfflineRecords(), refreshUser()]);
    if (isMounted.current) setRefreshing(false);
  }, [loadAllDynamicData, flushOfflineRecords, refreshUser]);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMounted.current = true;
    void loadCachedData().then(() => {
      if (isMounted.current) {
        void loadAllDynamicData();
      }
    });
    void refreshUser();

    return () => {
      isMounted.current = false;
      abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [loadCachedData, loadAllDynamicData, refreshUser]);

  const safeSections = Array.isArray(sections) ? sections : [];

  let totalStudentsEnrolled = 0;
  let totalPresent = 0;
  let totalLate = 0;
  let totalAbsent = 0;
  let totalNeedsReview = 0;

  // Deduplicate students across periods so daily totals are never double-counted
  const uniqueStudentsMap = new Map<string, StudentItem>();
  const statusPriority: Record<string, number> = {
    PRESENT: 5,
    LATE: 4,
    TARDY: 4,
    CUTTING: 3,
    UNVERIFIED: 2,
    ABSENT: 1,
    UNSCANNED: 0,
  };

  safeSections.forEach((sec) => {
    const students = Array.isArray(sec?.students) ? sec.students : [];
    students.forEach((st) => {
      const key = String(st?.id ?? st?.lrn ?? st?.full_name ?? '');
      if (!key) return;
      const existing = uniqueStudentsMap.get(key);
      if (!existing) {
        uniqueStudentsMap.set(key, st);
      } else {
        const prevScore =
          statusPriority[String(existing.attendance_status || 'UNSCANNED').toUpperCase()] ?? 0;
        const nextScore =
          statusPriority[String(st.attendance_status || 'UNSCANNED').toUpperCase()] ?? 0;
        if (nextScore > prevScore) {
          uniqueStudentsMap.set(key, st);
        }
      }
    });
  });

  const uniqueStudents = Array.from(uniqueStudentsMap.values());
  totalStudentsEnrolled = uniqueStudents.length;

  uniqueStudents.forEach((st) => {
    const status = String(st?.attendance_status || 'UNSCANNED').toUpperCase();
    if (status === 'PRESENT') {
      totalPresent += 1;
    } else if (status === 'LATE' || status === 'TARDY') {
      totalLate += 1;
    } else if (status === 'ABSENT') {
      totalAbsent += 1;
    } else if (status === 'CUTTING' || status === 'UNVERIFIED') {
      totalNeedsReview += 1;
    }
  });

  const totalAttended = totalPresent + totalLate;
  const overallRate =
    totalStudentsEnrolled > 0
      ? Math.round((totalAttended / totalStudentsEnrolled) * 100)
      : 0;

  const isWeekendToday = [0, 6].includes(new Date().getDay());

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safeContainer} edges={['top', 'left', 'right']}>
      <StatusBar style={isDark ? 'light' : 'dark'} />

      {/* Campus Boundary Notice Modal */}
      <Modal
        visible={showCampusAlertModal}
        transparent
        animationType="fade"
        onRequestClose={handleDismissCampusAlert}
      >
        <View style={styles.modalOverlay}>
          <View style={styles.modalCard}>
            <View style={styles.modalIconWrap}>
              <Ionicons name="location-outline" size={32} color={palette.primary} />
            </View>

            <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Outside School Area</Text>
            <Text style={styles.modalSubtitle}>
              You are signed in on duty, but your phone is currently outside the school boundary.
            </Text>

            <View style={styles.modalMetricsBox}>
              <View style={styles.modalMetricCol}>
                <Text style={styles.modalMetricLabel}>CURRENT DISTANCE</Text>
                <Text style={styles.modalMetricVal}>
                  {liveDistanceMeters !== null ? formatDistance(liveDistanceMeters) : '—'}
                </Text>
              </View>
              <View style={styles.modalMetricDivider} />
              <View style={styles.modalMetricCol}>
                <Text style={styles.modalMetricLabel}>ALLOWED BOUNDARY</Text>
                <Text style={styles.modalMetricVal}>
                  {campusCenter.radius !== null ? `${campusCenter.radius}m` : '—'}
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>

            <Text style={styles.modalExplanation}>
              If you are on official school business, let your department head know. Otherwise,
              please return to campus grounds to verify your attendance.
            </Text>

            <TouchableOpacity
              style={styles.modalConfirmBtn}
              onPress={handleDismissCampusAlert}
              activeOpacity={0.85}
            >
              <Ionicons name="checkmark-outline" size={16} color={palette.onPrimary} />
              <Text style={styles.modalConfirmBtnText}>I Understand</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>

      {/* Top Header */}
      <View style={styles.topHeader}>
        <View style={styles.brandGroup}>
          {resolvedLogoUri && !logoFailed ? (
            <Image
              source={{ uri: resolvedLogoUri }}
              style={styles.schoolLogo}
              contentFit="contain"
              onError={() => setLogoFailed(true)}
            />
          ) : (
            <AttendSureLogo size={34} />
          )}
          <View style={styles.brandTextGroup}>
            <Text style={styles.schoolTitle} numberOfLines={1}>
              {schoolName}
            </Text>
            {schoolSubHeader ? (
              <View style={styles.subBrandRow}>
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.activeDot,
                    { backgroundColor: isOnline ? palette.success : palette.textMuted },
                  ]}
                />
                <Text style={styles.schoolSubText} numberOfLines={1}>
                  {schoolSubHeader}
                </Text>
              </View>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        </View>

        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.refreshButton}
          onPress={() => void onRefresh()}
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          accessibilityLabel="Refresh records"
        >
          <Ionicons name="sync-outline" size={16} color={palette.primary} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <ScrollView
        style={styles.scrollArea}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={() => void onRefresh()}
            colors={[palette.primary]}
            tintColor={palette.primary}
          />
        }
      >
        {/* Mock Location Notice */}
        {liveCoords?.mocked && (
          <View style={styles.locationNoticeCard}>
            <Ionicons name="alert-circle-outline" size={18} color={palette.danger} />
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <Text style={styles.locationNoticeTitle}>Fake GPS Detected</Text>
              <Text style={styles.locationNoticeBody}>
                A mock location app is active. Please turn off fake GPS in your phone settings so
                your attendance logs stay valid.
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>
        )}

        {/* 1. Welcome Banner Card */}
        <View style={styles.welcomeCard}>
          <View style={styles.welcomeHeader}>
            <View style={{ flex: 1, marginRight: 10 }}>
              <Text style={styles.welcomeSub}>{greetingText},</Text>
              <Text style={styles.welcomeTitle} numberOfLines={1}>
                {displayName || 'Faculty Member'}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.avatarBox}>
              {resolvedUserPhoto && !avatarFailed ? (
                <Image
                  source={{ uri: resolvedUserPhoto }}
                  style={styles.avatarImg}
                  contentFit="cover"
                  onError={() => setAvatarFailed(true)}
                />
              ) : (
                <Ionicons name="person" size={22} color={palette.primary} />
              )}
            </View>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.progressContainer}>
            <View style={styles.progressTopRow}>
              <Text style={styles.progressBadgeText}>
                {employeeId ? `ID: ${employeeId}` : 'Faculty'}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.progressPercent}>{overallRate}% Attendance Today</Text>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.progressBarTrack}>
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.progressBarFill,
                  { width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(5, overallRate))}%` },
                ]}
              />
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* 2. Primary Classroom Summary Card */}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.primaryStatusCard}
          onPress={() => onNavigate?.('class_list')}
          activeOpacity={0.9}
        >
          <View style={styles.statusTopRow}>
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <Text style={styles.statusCardEyebrow}>TODAY&apos;S CLASS SUMMARY</Text>
              <Text style={styles.statusCardTitle}>
                {totalPresent} of {totalStudentsEnrolled} Students Present
              </Text>
            </View>
            <Ionicons name="chevron-forward" size={18} color={palette.onPrimary} />
          </View>
          <View style={styles.statusFooterRow}>
            <View style={styles.statusPill}>
              <Text style={styles.statusPillText}>Needs Review: {totalNeedsReview}</Text>
            </View>
            <View style={[styles.statusPill, { backgroundColor: palette.headerSurface }]}>
              <Text style={styles.statusPillText}>
                Campus GPS: {isInsideCampusPerimeter ? 'On Campus' : 'Away'}
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        {/* 3. Quick Actions Grid */}
        <Text style={styles.sectionHeader}>Quick Actions</Text>
        <View style={styles.gridContainer}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.gridCard}
            onPress={() => onNavigate?.('scanner')}
            activeOpacity={0.8}
          >
            <View style={[styles.gridIconBox, { backgroundColor: palette.warningLight }]}>
              <Ionicons name="scan-outline" size={20} color={palette.warning} />
            </View>
            <Text style={styles.gridCardTitle}>Face Check-In</Text>
            <Text style={styles.gridCardSub}>Face &amp; Campus GPS</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.gridCard}
            onPress={() => onNavigate?.('gate_pass')}
            activeOpacity={0.8}
          >
            <View style={[styles.gridIconBox, { backgroundColor: palette.infoLight }]}>
              <Ionicons name="ticket-outline" size={20} color={palette.info} />
            </View>
            <Text style={styles.gridCardTitle}>Exit Passes</Text>
            <Text style={styles.gridCardSub}>Student &amp; Travel Permits</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.gridCard}
            onPress={() => onNavigate?.('class_list')}
            activeOpacity={0.8}
          >
            <View style={[styles.gridIconBox, { backgroundColor: palette.primarySoft }]}>
              <Ionicons name="people-outline" size={20} color={palette.primary} />
            </View>
            <Text style={styles.gridCardTitle}>Class List</Text>
            <Text style={styles.gridCardSub}>Enrolled Students</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.gridCard}
            onPress={() => onNavigate?.('chat')}
            activeOpacity={0.8}
          >
            <View style={[styles.gridIconBox, { backgroundColor: palette.successLight }]}>
              <Ionicons name="notifications-outline" size={20} color={palette.success} />
            </View>
            <Text style={styles.gridCardTitle}>Parent Alerts</Text>
            <Text style={styles.gridCardSub}>Push Updates &amp; Chat</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {/* 4. More Tools Card */}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.moreToolsCard}
          onPress={() => onNavigate?.('menu')}
          activeOpacity={0.85}
        >
          <View style={styles.moreToolsLeft}>
            <View style={styles.moreToolsIconBox}>
              <Ionicons name="grid-outline" size={20} color={palette.primary} />
            </View>
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <Text style={styles.moreToolsTitle}>More School Tools</Text>
              <Text style={styles.moreToolsSub}>
                Daily Time Record, Calendar, School Reports &amp; Settings
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>
          <Ionicons name="chevron-forward" size={18} color={palette.textMuted} />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        {/* School Campus Location Card */}
        <View style={styles.campusLocationCard}>
          <View style={styles.campusCardHeader}>
            <View style={styles.campusHeaderLeft}>
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.pulseDot,
                  {
                    backgroundColor:
                      isInsideCampusPerimeter === true
                        ? palette.success
                        : isInsideCampusPerimeter === false
                        ? palette.warning
                        : palette.textMuted,
                  },
                ]}
              />
              <Text style={styles.campusHeaderLabel}>SCHOOL CAMPUS LOCATION</Text>
            </View>

            {liveCoords?.timestamp ? (
              <View style={styles.timestampBadge}>
                <Ionicons name="time-outline" size={11} color={palette.textMuted} />
                <Text style={styles.timestampBadgeText}>{liveCoords.timestamp}</Text>
              </View>
            ) : null}
          </View>

          <View style={styles.campusMainContent}>
            {liveDistanceMeters !== null ? (
              <>
                <View style={styles.distanceValueRow}>
                  <Text style={styles.distanceMetricBig}>
                    {formatDistance(liveDistanceMeters)}
                  </Text>
                  <Text style={styles.distanceMetricSub}>from school grounds</Text>
                </View>

                <View style={styles.perimeterBadgeRow}>
                  <View
                    style={[
                      styles.perimeterBadge,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: isInsideCampusPerimeter
                          ? palette.successLight
                          : palette.warningLight,
                        borderColor: isInsideCampusPerimeter ? palette.success : palette.warning,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <Ionicons
                      name={
                        isInsideCampusPerimeter ? 'checkmark-circle' : 'navigate-circle-outline'
                      }
                      size={13}
                      color={isInsideCampusPerimeter ? palette.success : palette.warning}
                    />
                    <Text
                      style={[
                        styles.perimeterBadgeText,
                        { color: isInsideCampusPerimeter ? palette.success : palette.warning },
                      ]}
                    >
                      {isInsideCampusPerimeter ? 'INSIDE SCHOOL GROUNDS' : 'OUTSIDE SCHOOL GROUNDS'}
                    </Text>
                  </View>

                  <Text style={styles.perimeterRadiusMeta}>
                    {campusCenter.radius !== null
                      ? `Allowed area: ${campusCenter.radius}m`
                      : 'Boundary not set'}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              </>
            ) : (
              <View style={styles.acquiringFixBox}>
                <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.primary} />
                <Text style={styles.acquiringFixText}>
                  {gpsError || 'Finding GPS location...'}
                </Text>
              </View>
            )}
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Offline Queue Banner */}
        {offlineCount > 0 && (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.offlineBufferBanner}
            onPress={() => void flushOfflineRecords()}
            disabled={isSyncingQueue}
            activeOpacity={0.8}
          >
            <View style={styles.offlineBannerLeft}>
              <Ionicons
                name={isSyncingQueue ? 'sync-outline' : 'cloud-upload-outline'}
                size={18}
                color={palette.warning}
              />
              <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <Text style={styles.offlineBufferTitle}>
                  {offlineCount} {offlineCount === 1 ? 'record' : 'records'} saved on phone
                </Text>
                <Text style={styles.offlineBufferSubtitle}>
                  {isSyncingQueue
                    ? 'Uploading to school server now...'
                    : isOnline
                    ? 'Tap here to upload now'
                    : 'Will upload when internet connects'}
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>
            {isSyncingQueue ? (
              <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.warning} />
            ) : (
              <View style={styles.syncNowBtn}>
                <Text style={styles.syncNowBtnText}>Upload Now</Text>
              </View>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}

        {/* Calendar Holiday Banner */}
        {todayOverride ? (
          <View style={styles.calendarBanner}>
            <Ionicons name="calendar-outline" size={16} color={palette.primary} />
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <Text style={styles.calendarBannerTitle}>
                {todayOverride.type}: {todayOverride.date}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.calendarBannerReason}>{todayOverride.reason}</Text>
            </View>
          </View>
        ) : isWeekendToday && weekendRestEnabled ? (
          <View
            style={[
              styles.calendarBanner,
              { backgroundColor: palette.successLight, borderColor: palette.success },
            ]}
          >
            <Ionicons name="partly-sunny-outline" size={16} color={palette.success} />
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <Text style={[styles.calendarBannerTitle, { color: palette.success }]}>
                Weekend Rest Day
              </Text>
              <Text style={[styles.calendarBannerReason, { color: palette.textPrimary }]}>
                Attendance logging is optional on scheduled rest days.
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {/* DTR Summary Card */}
        {dtrData && (
          <>
            <View style={styles.sectionHeaderRow}>
              <Text style={styles.sectionHeaderTitle}>
                Daily Time Record ({dtrData.month} {dtrData.year})
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.sectionHeaderSub}>{dtrData.days_present} Days Logged</Text>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.dtrSummaryCard}>
              <View style={styles.dtrGrid}>
                <View style={styles.dtrSlot}>
                  <Text style={styles.dtrSlotLabel}>AM IN</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.dtrSlotTime}>{todayDtrRow?.am_arrival || '--:--'}</Text>
                </View>
                <View style={styles.dtrSlot}>
                  <Text style={styles.dtrSlotLabel}>AM OUT</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.dtrSlotTime}>{todayDtrRow?.am_departure || '--:--'}</Text>
                </View>
                <View style={styles.dtrSlot}>
                  <Text style={styles.dtrSlotLabel}>PM IN</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.dtrSlotTime}>{todayDtrRow?.pm_arrival || '--:--'}</Text>
                </View>
                <View style={styles.dtrSlot}>
                  <Text style={styles.dtrSlotLabel}>PM OUT</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.dtrSlotTime}>{todayDtrRow?.pm_departure || '--:--'}</Text>
                </View>
              </View>

              <View style={styles.dtrCardFooter}>
                <Text style={styles.dtrFooterMeta}>
                  Undertime: {dtrData.total_undertime_hours}h {dtrData.total_undertime_minutes}m
                </Text>
                <Text
                  style={[
                    styles.dtrApprovalBadge,
                    {
                      color: dtrData.dept_head_approved
                        ? palette.success
                        : dtrData.dtr_submitted
                        ? palette.primary
                        : palette.textMuted,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  {dtrData.dept_head_approved
                    ? 'APPROVED BY DEPT HEAD'
                    : dtrData.dtr_submitted
                    ? 'SENT FOR REVIEW'
                    : 'LOGGING TODAY'}
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>
          </>
        )}

        {/* Attendance Breakdown Tiles */}
        <View style={styles.sectionHeaderRow}>
          <Text style={styles.sectionHeaderTitle}>Student Attendance Today</Text>
          {lastSyncTime ? (
            <Text style={styles.sectionHeaderSub}>Updated {lastSyncTime}</Text>
          ) : null}
        </View>

        <View style={styles.kpiTileGrid}>
          <View style={styles.kpiTile}>
            <View style={[styles.kpiIconWrap, { backgroundColor: palette.successLight }]}>
              <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle-outline" size={15} color={palette.success} />
            </View>
            <Text style={[styles.kpiValueText, { color: palette.success }]}>{totalPresent}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.kpiLabelText}>Present</Text>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.kpiTile}>
            <View style={[styles.kpiIconWrap, { backgroundColor: palette.warningLight }]}>
              <Ionicons name="time-outline" size={15} color={palette.warning} />
            </View>
            <Text style={[styles.kpiValueText, { color: palette.warning }]}>{totalLate}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.kpiLabelText}>Late</Text>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.kpiTile}>
            <View style={[styles.kpiIconWrap, { backgroundColor: palette.dangerLight }]}>
              <Ionicons name="close-circle-outline" size={15} color={palette.danger} />
            </View>
            <Text style={[styles.kpiValueText, { color: palette.danger }]}>{totalAbsent}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.kpiLabelText}>Absent</Text>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.kpiTile}>
            <View style={[styles.kpiIconWrap, { backgroundColor: palette.surfaceSubtle }]}>
              <Ionicons name="eye-outline" size={15} color={palette.textSecondary} />
            </View>
            <Text style={[styles.kpiValueText, { color: palette.textPrimary }]}>
              {totalNeedsReview}
            </Text>
            <Text style={styles.kpiLabelText}>Review</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
};

/**
 * AttendSure Mobile - Daily Time Record (Civil Service Form No. 48)
 * File: mobile/src/screens/DTRScreen.tsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  ScrollView,
  RefreshControl,
  ActivityIndicator,
  TouchableOpacity,
  Alert,
  Share,
  Platform,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useThemeMode } from '../context/ThemeContext';
import {
  getFriendlyErrorMessage,
  type ThemePalette,
} from '../constants/theme';
import DTRReportView, { DTRReportData } from '../components/reports/DTRReportView';

const MONTH_NAMES = [
  'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
  'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December',
];

interface DTRScreenProps {
  facultyId?: string;
}

const isCanceledError = (err: unknown): boolean => {
  const e = err as { code?: string; name?: string };
  return e?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED' || e?.name === 'CanceledError' || e?.name === 'AbortError';
};

const showNotice = (title: string, message: string): void => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.alert(`${title}: ${message}`);
  } else {
    Alert.alert(title, message);
  }
};

export const DTRScreen: React.FC<DTRScreenProps> = ({ facultyId = '' }) => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { palette, fonts } = useThemeMode();
  const styles = useMemo(() => createStyles(palette, fonts), [palette, fonts]);

  const isMounted = useRef<boolean>(true);
  const abortControllerRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const currentUser = user as Record<string, any> | null;
  const userRole = String(currentUser?.role || currentUser?.system_role || 'FACULTY')
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase();
  const isFaculty = userRole === 'FACULTY';

  const now = new Date();
  const [selectedMonth, setSelectedMonth] = useState<number>(now.getMonth() + 1);
  const [selectedYear, setSelectedYear] = useState<number>(now.getFullYear());

  const [dtrData, setDtrData] = useState<DTRReportData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [submittingDtr, setSubmittingDtr] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [exportingDoc, setExportingDoc] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const fetchDTR = useCallback(
    async (silent = false) => {
      abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortControllerRef.current = controller;

      const cleanTargetId = facultyId.trim();
      const endpoint =
        isFaculty && !cleanTargetId
          ? '/reports/dtr/'
          : cleanTargetId
          ? `/reports/dtr/${encodeURIComponent(cleanTargetId)}/`
          : '/reports/dtr/';

      const cacheKey = `attendsure_dtr_${cleanTargetId || 'self'}_${selectedMonth}_${selectedYear}`;

      if (!silent) {
        if (isMounted.current) setLoading(true);
        try {
          const cached = await AsyncStorage.getItem(cacheKey);
          if (cached && isMounted.current && !controller.signal.aborted) {
            setDtrData(JSON.parse(cached));
          }
        } catch {
          // Continue to live fetch
        }
      }

      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<DTRReportData>(endpoint, {
          params: { month: selectedMonth, year: selectedYear },
          signal: controller.signal,
        });

        if (!isMounted.current || controller.signal.aborted) return;

        setDtrData(res.data);
        AsyncStorage.setItem(cacheKey, JSON.stringify(res.data)).catch(() => {});
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        if (isCanceledError(err)) return;
      } finally {
        if (isMounted.current) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [isFaculty, facultyId, selectedMonth, selectedYear]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    isMounted.current = true;
    void fetchDTR(false);

    return () => {
      isMounted.current = false;
      abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchDTR]);

  const onRefresh = useCallback(() => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    void fetchDTR(false);
  }, [fetchDTR]);

  const handleSubmitDtr = async () => {
    if (!dtrData || submittingDtr) return;

    setSubmittingDtr(true);
    try {
      const encodedId = encodeURIComponent(String(dtrData.faculty_id));
      await apiClient.post(`/reports/dtr/${encodedId}/`, {
        action: 'SUBMIT_DTR',
        faculty_id: dtrData.faculty_id,
        month: dtrData.month_number,
        year: dtrData.year,
        regular_days_hours: dtrData.regular_days_hours,
        saturdays_hours: dtrData.saturdays_hours,
      });
      if (!isMounted.current) return;
      showNotice('Submitted', 'Your Daily Time Record has been sent to your Department Head.');
      void fetchDTR(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!isMounted.current) return;
      showNotice(
        'Unable to Submit',
        getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not submit your Daily Time Record right now.')
      );
    } finally {
      if (isMounted.current) setSubmittingDtr(false);
    }
  };

  const handleExport = async () => {
    if (!dtrData || exportingDoc) return;

    if (!dtrData.dept_head_approved) {
      showNotice('Approval Required', 'Department Head approval is needed before exporting.');
      return;
    }

    setExportingDoc(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get('/reports/export/', {
        params: {
          report_type: 'DTR',
          faculty_id: dtrData.faculty_id,
          month: dtrData.month_number,
          year: dtrData.year,
        },
      });

      const title =
        res.data?.title ||
        `CSC_Form_48_${dtrData.faculty_name}_${dtrData.month}_${dtrData.year}`;
      await Share.share({
        title,
        message: `${title}\nCivil Service Form No. 48 verified in AttendSure.`,
      });
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!isMounted.current) return;
      showNotice('Notice', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not export your Daily Time Record.'));
    } finally {
      if (isMounted.current) setExportingDoc(false);
    }
  };

  const isApproved = Boolean(dtrData?.dept_head_approved);

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safeContainer} edges={['top', 'left', 'right']}>
      {/* Top Header */}
      <View style={styles.topBar}>
        <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <Text style={styles.screenTitle}>Daily Time Record</Text>
          <Text style={styles.screenSub}>Civil Service Form No. 48</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 6 }}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[
              styles.btnSec,
              (loading || exportingDoc || !isApproved) && { opacity: 0.6 },
            ]}
            onPress={() => void handleExport()}
            disabled={loading || exportingDoc || !isApproved}
          >
            <Ionicons
              name={isApproved ? 'share-outline' : 'lock-closed-outline'}
              size={15}
              color={isApproved ? palette.primary : palette.textMuted}
            />
            <Text style={[styles.btnSecText, !isApproved && { color: palette.textMuted }]}>
              Export
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.btnPri, loading && { opacity: 0.6 }]}
            onPress={() => void fetchDTR(false)}
            disabled={loading}
            accessibilityLabel="Refresh records"
          >
            {loading ? (
              <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.onPrimary} />
            ) : (
              <Ionicons name="refresh" size={15} color={palette.onPrimary} />
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>

      <ScrollView
        contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            colors={[palette.primary]}
            tintColor={palette.primary}
          />
        }
      >
        {/* Month Selector */}
        <View style={styles.monthPillRow}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.navArrow}
            onPress={() => {
              if (selectedMonth === 1) {
                setSelectedMonth(12);
                setSelectedYear((y) => y - 1);
              } else {
                setSelectedMonth((m) => m - 1);
              }
            }}
            accessibilityLabel="Previous month"
          >
            <Ionicons name="chevron-back" size={18} color={palette.primary} />
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <Text style={styles.monthDisplay}>
            {MONTH_NAMES[selectedMonth - 1]} {selectedYear}
          </Text>

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.navArrow}
            onPress={() => {
              if (selectedMonth === 12) {
                setSelectedMonth(1);
                setSelectedYear((y) => y + 1);
              } else {
                setSelectedMonth((m) => m + 1);
              }
            }}
            accessibilityLabel="Next month"
          >
            <Ionicons name="chevron-forward" size={18} color={palette.primary} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {/* DTR Sheet Component */}
        {loading && !dtrData ? (
          <View style={styles.loadingBox}>
            <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.primary} />
            <Text style={styles.loadingText}>Loading attendance records...</Text>
          </View>
        ) : (
          <DTRReportView
            data={dtrData}
            selectedMonth={selectedMonth}
            selectedYear={selectedYear}
            onMonthChange={(m, y) => {
              setSelectedMonth(m);
              setSelectedYear(y);
            }}
            submitting={submittingDtr}
            onSubmit={handleSubmitDtr}
            onRefreshNeeded={() => void fetchDTR(true)}
          />
        )}
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
};

const createStyles = (palette: ThemePalette, fonts: ReturnType<typeof useThemeMode>['fonts']) =>
  StyleSheet.create({
    safeContainer: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: palette.background },

/**
 * AttendSure Mobile - Exit Permits & Official Travel Passes
 * File: mobile/src/screens/GatePassScreen.tsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  FlatList,
  TouchableOpacity,
  RefreshControl,
  Modal,
  TextInput,
  Alert,
  ActivityIndicator,
  ScrollView,
  Platform,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import QRCode from 'react-native-qrcode-svg';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useThemeMode } from '../context/ThemeContext';
import {
  cleanText,
  getFriendlyErrorMessage,
  type ThemePalette,
} from '../constants/theme';

const PASSES_CACHE_KEY = 'attendsure_cached_exit_passes';

export interface GatePassItem {
  id: number;
  pass_number: string;
  bearer_type: 'STUDENT' | 'FACULTY';
  student?: number | null;
  student_name?: string;
  student_lrn?: string;
  faculty?: number | null;
  faculty_name?: string;
  faculty_emp_id?: string;
  pass_type: string;
  reason: string;
  valid_from: string;
  valid_to: string;
  status: 'PENDING' | 'ACTIVE' | 'USED' | 'DECLINED' | 'EXPIRED';
  attachment_url?: string | null;
  adviser_name?: string;
}

interface GatePassScreenProps {
  onBack?: () => void;
}

const isCanceledError = (err: unknown): boolean => {
  const e = err as { code?: string; name?: string };
  return e?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED' || e?.name === 'CanceledError' || e?.name === 'AbortError';
};

const showNotice = (title: string, message: string): void => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.alert(`${title}: ${message}`);
  } else {
    Alert.alert(title, message);
  }
};

export const GatePassScreen: React.FC<GatePassScreenProps> = ({ onBack }) => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { palette, fonts } = useThemeMode();
  const styles = useMemo(() => createStyles(palette, fonts), [palette, fonts]);

  const userRole = String(user?.role || user?.system_role || 'FACULTY').trim().toUpperCase();
  const isPrincipalOrAdmin = ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD'].includes(userRole);
  const canIssuePass = userRole !== 'PARENT';
  const canConfirmExit = [
    'ADMIN',
    'SUPERADMIN',
    'PRINCIPAL',
    'DEPT_HEAD',
    'FACULTY',
    'ADVISER',
    'STAFF',
    'EMPLOYEE',
  ].includes(userRole);

  const [passes, setPasses] = useState<GatePassItem[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>('ACTIVE');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');

  const [selectedPass, setSelectedPass] = useState<GatePassItem | null>(null);
  const [showIssueModal, setShowIssueModal] = useState(false);
  const [passTarget, setPassTarget] = useState<'STUDENT' | 'FACULTY'>('STUDENT');
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [actionBusy, setActionBusy] = useState(false);

  const [reviewingPass, setReviewingPass] = useState<GatePassItem | null>(null);

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    student_id: '',
    pass_type: 'Medical / Health Emergency',
    reason: '',
    duration_hours: '4',
  });

  const isMountedRef = useRef(true);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const fetchPasses = useCallback(async (silent = false) => {
    abortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    abortRef.current = controller;

    if (!silent) {
      if (isMountedRef.current) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const cached = await AsyncStorage.getItem(PASSES_CACHE_KEY);
        if (cached && isMountedRef.current && !controller.signal.aborted) {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
          if (Array.isArray(parsed)) setPasses(parsed);
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get<{ results?: GatePassItem[] } | GatePassItem[]>(
        'gate-passes/',
        { signal: controller.signal }
      );
      if (!isMountedRef.current || controller.signal.aborted) return;
      const data = res.data;
      const list = Array.isArray(data)
        ? data
        : Array.isArray(data?.results)
        ? data.results
        : [];
      setPasses(list);
      AsyncStorage.setItem(PASSES_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list)).catch(() => {});
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!isMountedRef.current || isCanceledError(err)) return;
      if (!silent) {
        showNotice('Notice', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not load exit passes right now.'));
      }
    } finally {
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMountedRef.current = true;
    void fetchPasses(false);
    return () => {
      isMountedRef.current = false;
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchPasses]);

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    void fetchPasses(true);
  };

  const filteredPasses = useMemo(() => {
    const q = cleanText(searchQuery, 80).toLowerCase();
    return passes.filter((p) => {
      const matchesStatus = statusFilter === 'ALL' || p.status === statusFilter;
      const passNum = (p.pass_number || '').toLowerCase();
      const holder = (p.student_name || p.faculty_name || '').toLowerCase();
      const reason = (p.reason || '').toLowerCase();
      const matchesSearch = !q || passNum.includes(q) || holder.includes(q) || reason.includes(q);
      return matchesStatus && matchesSearch;
    });
  }, [passes, statusFilter, searchQuery]);

  const handleIssueSubmit = async () => {
    let parsedStudentId: number | null = null;
    if (passTarget === 'STUDENT') {
      const cleanStudentId = cleanText(form.student_id, 12);
      if (!cleanStudentId) {
        showNotice('Required', 'Please enter the Student ID Number.');
        return;
      }
      parsedStudentId = Number.parseInt(cleanStudentId, 10);
      if (
        !Number.isFinite(parsedStudentId) ||
        parsedStudentId <= 0 ||
        String(parsedStudentId) !== cleanStudentId
      ) {
        showNotice('Invalid Student ID', 'Please enter a valid numeric Student ID.');
        return;
      }
    }

    const cleanedReason = cleanText(form.reason, 300);
    if (!cleanedReason) {
      showNotice('Required', 'Please enter a valid reason or destination.');
      return;
    }

    const parsedHours = Number.parseInt(cleanText(form.duration_hours, 2), 10);
    const hours = Math.max(1, Math.min(12, Number.isFinite(parsedHours) ? parsedHours : 4));
    const now = new Date();
    const expiry = new Date(now.getTime() + hours * 3600000);

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload: Record<string, string | number> = {
        bearer_type: passTarget,
        pass_type: cleanText(form.pass_type, 80),
        reason: cleanedReason,
        valid_from: now.toISOString(),
        valid_to: expiry.toISOString(),
      };

      if (passTarget === 'STUDENT' && parsedStudentId !== null) {
        payload.student = parsedStudentId;
      }

      await apiClient.post('gate-passes/', payload);
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;

      showNotice(
        'Saved',
        passTarget === 'FACULTY'
          ? 'Your travel pass request was sent to the Principal or School Admin for review.'
          : 'Student exit pass created and school office notified.'
      );

      setShowIssueModal(false);
      setForm({
        student_id: '',
        pass_type: 'Medical / Health Emergency',
        reason: '',
        duration_hours: '4',
      });
      void fetchPasses(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      showNotice(
        'Could Not Submit',
        getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Unable to submit the pass request. Please try again.')
      );
    } finally {
      if (isMountedRef.current) setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleApprovePass = async (pass: GatePassItem) => {
    if (actionBusy) return;
    setActionBusy(true);
    try {
      await apiClient.post(`gate-passes/${encodeURIComponent(String(pass.id))}/approve/`);
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      showNotice('Approved', 'Travel pass approved and now active.');
      setReviewingPass(null);
      void fetchPasses(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      showNotice('Error', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not approve this pass.'));
    } finally {
      if (isMountedRef.current) setActionBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const executeDeclinePass = async (pass: GatePassItem) => {
    if (actionBusy) return;
    setActionBusy(true);
    try {
      await apiClient.post(`gate-passes/${encodeURIComponent(String(pass.id))}/decline/`, {
        reason: 'Declined after document review.',
      });
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      showNotice('Declined', 'Pass request has been marked as declined.');
      setReviewingPass(null);
      void fetchPasses(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      showNotice('Error', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not decline this pass.'));
    } finally {
      if (isMountedRef.current) setActionBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeclinePass = (pass: GatePassItem) => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      if (window.confirm('Decline this travel pass request?')) {
        void executeDeclinePass(pass);
      }
      return;
    }
    Alert.alert('Decline Pass', 'Decline this travel pass request?', [
      { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
      {
        text: 'Confirm Decline',
        style: 'destructive',
        onPress: () => void executeDeclinePass(pass),
      },
    ]);
  };

  const handleConfirmExit = async (pass: GatePassItem) => {
    if (actionBusy) return;
    setActionBusy(true);
    try {
      await apiClient.post(`gate-passes/${encodeURIComponent(String(pass.id))}/mark-used/`);
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      showNotice('Pass Used', 'Departure recorded and pass marked as used.');
      setSelectedPass(null);
      void fetchPasses(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      showNotice('Error', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not update pass status.'));
    } finally {
      if (isMountedRef.current) setActionBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const executeDeletePass = async (pass: GatePassItem) => {
    if (actionBusy) return;
    setActionBusy(true);
    try {
      await apiClient.delete(`gate-passes/${encodeURIComponent(String(pass.id))}/`);
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      setPasses((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== pass.id));
      setSelectedPass(null);
      showNotice('Deleted', `Pass #${pass.pass_number} has been removed.`);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      showNotice('Delete Failed', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not remove this pass.'));
    } finally {
      if (isMountedRef.current) setActionBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeletePass = (pass: GatePassItem) => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      if (window.confirm(`Delete pass #${pass.pass_number}?`)) {
        void executeDeletePass(pass);
      }
      return;
    }
    Alert.alert('Delete Pass', `Permanently delete pass #${pass.pass_number}?`, [
      { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
      { text: 'Delete', style: 'destructive', onPress: () => void executeDeletePass(pass) },
    ]);
  };

  const getStatusStyle = (st: GatePassItem['status']) => {
    if (st === 'ACTIVE') return { bg: palette.successLight, text: palette.success };
    if (st === 'PENDING') return { bg: palette.warningLight, text: palette.warning };
    if (st === 'DECLINED') return { bg: palette.dangerLight, text: palette.danger };
    return { bg: palette.surfaceSubtle, text: palette.textMuted };
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.container} edges={['top']}>
      {/* Header */}
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <View style={styles.headerLeft}>
          {onBack && (

              style={styles.backBtn}

              accessibilityLabel="Go back"

            </TouchableOpacity>
          )}
          <View>
            <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>Exit &amp; Travel Passes</Text>

        {canIssuePass && (

          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}
      </View>

      {/* Search Input */}
      <View style={styles.searchBox}>
        <Ionicons name="search" size={16} color={palette.textMuted} />
        <TextInput
          style={styles.searchInput}
          placeholder="Search pass number, name, or reason..."
          placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
          value={searchQuery}
          onChangeText={setSearchQuery}
          maxLength={80}
        />
        {searchQuery.length > 0 && (
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setSearchQuery('')}>
            <Ionicons name="close-circle" size={16} color={palette.textMuted} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}
      </View>

      {/* Filter Row */}
      <View style={styles.filterRow}>
        <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 6 }}>
          {['ACTIVE', 'PENDING', 'ALL', 'USED', 'DECLINED'].map((st) => {
            const active = statusFilter === st;
            return (
              <TouchableOpacity
                key={st}
                style={[styles.filterChip, active && styles.filterChipActive]}
                onPress={() => setStatusFilter(st)}
              >
                <Text style={[styles.filterChipText, active && styles.filterChipTextActive]}>
                  {st === 'PENDING' ? 'Pending Review' : st}
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            );
          })}
        </ScrollView>
      </View>

      {/* Passes List */}
      {loading && passes.length === 0 ? (
        <View style={styles.centerBox}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.primary} />
          <Text style={styles.centerText}>Loading passes...</Text>
        </View>
      ) : (

          data={filteredPasses}
          keyExtractor={(item) => String(item.id)}

            <RefreshControl

              </Text>

          }
          renderItem={({ item }) => {
            const holderName =
              item.bearer_type === 'STUDENT' ? item.student_name : item.faculty_name;
            const isPending = item.status === 'PENDING';
            const pillColors = getStatusStyle(item.status);

            return (

const isCanceledError = (err: unknown): boolean => {
  const e = err as { code?: string; name?: string };
  return e?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED' || e?.name === 'CanceledError' || e?.name === 'AbortError';
};

export const LoginScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const { login } = useAuth();
  const { palette, fonts, ui, isDark, toggleDarkMode } = useThemeMode();

  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const [school, setSchool] = useState<PublicSchoolBranding | null>(null);
  const [serverBase, setServerBase] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'ONLINE' | 'OFFLINE' | 'CHECKING'>('CHECKING');
  const [logoError, setLogoError] = useState(false);
  const [showServerModal, setShowServerModal] = useState(false);

  const passwordRef = useRef<React.ComponentRef<typeof TextInput> | null>(null);
  const attemptsRef = useRef(0);
  const lockedUntilRef = useRef(0);
  const isMountedRef = useRef(true);
  const probeAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const notify = (title: string, msg: string) => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.alert(`${title}: ${msg}`);
    } else {
      Alert.alert(title, msg);
    }
  };

  const checkServer = useCallback(async (forceReprobe = false) => {
    probeAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    probeAbortRef.current = controller;

    if (isMountedRef.current) setStatus('CHECKING');
    if (forceReprobe) invalidateServerCache();

    let timeoutId: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

    try {
      const cached = await AsyncStorage.getItem(SCHOOL_CACHE_KEY);
      if (cached && isMountedRef.current && !controller.signal.aborted) {
        setSchool(JSON.parse(cached));
      }

      const activeBase = await resolveFastestServer();
      if (!isMountedRef.current || controller.signal.aborted) return;
      setServerBase(activeBase);
      setLogoError(false);

      timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 3500);
      const ping = await fetch(`${activeBase}/api/health/db/`, {
        method: 'GET',
        signal: controller.signal,
      });

      if (!isMountedRef.current || controller.signal.aborted) return;

      if (ping.status >= 200 && ping.status < 400) {
        setStatus('ONLINE');
        try {
          const res = await apiClient.get<PublicSchoolBranding>('school/public-branding/', {
            timeout: 3000,
            signal: controller.signal,
          });
          if (isMountedRef.current && !controller.signal.aborted && res.data) {
            setSchool(res.data);
            setLogoError(false);
            AsyncStorage.setItem(SCHOOL_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(res.data)).catch(() => {});
          }
        } catch {
          // Keep cached school branding if branding endpoint is temporarily unavailable
        }
      } else {
        setStatus('OFFLINE');
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      if (isCanceledError(err) && probeAbortRef.current !== controller) return;
      setStatus('OFFLINE');
    } finally {
      if (timeoutId !== null) {
        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMountedRef.current = true;
    void checkServer(false);
    return () => {
      isMountedRef.current = false;
      probeAbortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [checkServer]);

  const handleSignIn = async () => {
    if (Date.now() < lockedUntilRef.current) {
      const waitSec = Math.ceil((lockedUntilRef.current - Date.now()) / 1000);
      return notify('Please Wait', `Too many unsuccessful tries. Wait ${waitSec} seconds before trying again.`);
    }

    const userClean = cleanText(username, 150);
    const passClean = password.replace(/[\r\n\t]/g, '').trim();

    if (!userClean || !passClean) {
      return notify('Missing Information', 'Please enter your username and password.');
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await login(userClean, passClean);
      attemptsRef.current = 0;
      startPassivePresenceTracking().catch(() => {});
      registerPushTokenWithBackend().catch(() => {});
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      attemptsRef.current += 1;
      if (attemptsRef.current >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
        lockedUntilRef.current = Date.now() + LOCKOUT_MS;
      }
      const anyErr = err as { response?: unknown };
      const msg = !anyErr?.response
        ? 'Cannot reach the school server. Tap the settings icon at the top right to check the server address.'
        : getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Incorrect username or password. Please try again.');
      notify('Sign In Failed', msg);
    } finally {
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const rawLogo = school?.school_logo || school?.left_logo || null;
  const candidateLogoUrl = rawLogo
    ? rawLogo.startsWith('http://') || rawLogo.startsWith('https://') || rawLogo.startsWith('data:')
      ? rawLogo
      : serverBase
      ? `${serverBase.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/${rawLogo.replace(/^\/+/, '')}`
      : null
    : null;
  const safeLogoUrl = isSafeUrl(candidateLogoUrl) ? candidateLogoUrl : null;

  const schoolMetaLine = [
    school?.school_id ? `School ID: ${cleanText(school.school_id, 40)}` : '',
    school?.division ? cleanText(school.division, 80) : '',
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(' • ');

  const statusColor =
    status === 'ONLINE' ? palette.success : status === 'OFFLINE' ? palette.danger : palette.warning;
  const statusBg =
    status === 'ONLINE'
      ? palette.successLight
      : status === 'OFFLINE'
      ? palette.dangerLight
      : palette.warningLight;

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={ui.screen}>
      <StatusBar style={isDark ? 'light' : 'dark'} />
      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={{ flex: 1 }}
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
      >
        <ScrollView
          contentContainerStyle={{ flexGrow: 1, padding: 20, justifyContent: 'space-between' }}
          keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
        >
          {/* Top Action Bar */}
          <View style={[ui.rowBetween, { marginBottom: 12 }]}>
            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={toggleDarkMode}
              style={{
                width: 40,
                height: 40,
                borderRadius: 20,
                backgroundColor: palette.surface,
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderColor: palette.border,
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
              }}
              accessibilityLabel="Switch color mode"
            >
              <Ionicons
                name={isDark ? 'sunny-outline' : 'moon-outline'}
                size={18}
                color={palette.primary}
              />
            </TouchableOpacity>

            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={() => void checkServer(true)}
              style={[
                ui.badge,
                ui.rowCenter,
                {
                  backgroundColor: statusBg,
                  paddingHorizontal: 12,
                  paddingVertical: 6,
                  borderRadius: 20,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <View
                style={{ width: 7, height: 7, borderRadius: 4, backgroundColor: statusColor }}
              />
              <Text
                style={{
                  fontSize: fonts.xxs,
                  fontWeight: fonts.weight.extrabold,
                  color: statusColor,
                }}
              >
                {status === 'ONLINE'
                  ? 'SERVER ONLINE'
                  : status === 'OFFLINE'
                  ? 'OFFLINE • TAP TO RETRY'
                  : 'CONNECTING...'}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>

            <TouchableOpacity

            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>

          {/* Center Brand + Sign-In Card */}
          <View style={{ marginVertical: 8 }}>
            <View style={{ alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 20 }}>
              <View
                style={{
                  width: 92,
