r"""
AttendSure - PostgreSQL Health, Latency & Domain Table Counter
Run: python database\check_database.py
"""

import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from _bootstrap import setup_django

setup_django()

from django.db import connection
from apps.accounts.models import AuditLog, TeacherProfile, UserProfile
from apps.attendance.models import ClassAttendance, DailyAttendance, ExitPass
from apps.campus.models import CampusBoundary, TeacherLocationLog
from apps.messaging.models import ChatMessage, Notification
from apps.school.models import ClassPeriod, GradeLevel, Room, SchoolSettings, SchoolYear, Section, Subject
from apps.students.models import Enrollment, Student


def main():
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute("SELECT current_database();")
        db_name = cursor.fetchone()[0]
    latency_ms = max(1, round((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000))

    print("=" * 64)
    print(f"  ATTENDSURE DATABASE HEALTH ({connection.vendor.upper()})")
    print(f"  Database : {db_name} | Latency: {latency_ms} ms")
    print("=" * 64)

    models = [
        ("SchoolSettings", SchoolSettings),
        ("SchoolYear", SchoolYear),
        ("GradeLevel", GradeLevel),
        ("Room", Room),
        ("Section", Section),
        ("Subject", Subject),
        ("ClassPeriod", ClassPeriod),
        ("TeacherProfile", TeacherProfile),
        ("UserProfile", UserProfile),
        ("Student", Student),
        ("Enrollment", Enrollment),
        ("ClassAttendance", ClassAttendance),
        ("DailyAttendance", DailyAttendance),
        ("ExitPass", ExitPass),
        ("CampusBoundary", CampusBoundary),
        ("TeacherLocationLog", TeacherLocationLog),
        ("Notification", Notification),
        ("ChatMessage", ChatMessage),
        ("AuditLog", AuditLog),
    ]
    for label, model in models:
        print(f"  {label:<22} : {model.objects.count():>6} rows  ({model._meta.db_table})")
    print("=" * 64)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    ("students", "Enrollment", "idx_enroll_section_status", ["section", "status"]),

    ("campus", "TeacherLocationLog", "idx_loclog_teacher_time", ["teacher", "recorded_at"]),
    ("messaging", "Notification", "idx_notif_read_created", ["is_read", "created_at"]),
]


def main() -> None:
    created = 0
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        for app_label, model_name, index_name, field_names in INDEX_SPECS:
            try:
                model = apps.get_model(app_label, model_name)
                db_columns = [model._meta.get_field(fname).column for fname in field_names]
            except Exception:
                continue

            table = connection.ops.quote_name(model._meta.db_table)
            idx = connection.ops.quote_name(index_name)
            cols_sql = ", ".join(connection.ops.quote_name(c) for c in db_columns)
            cursor.execute(f"CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS {idx} ON {table} ({cols_sql});")
            print(f"[INDEX READY] {model._meta.db_table} ({', '.join(db_columns)})")
            created += 1

        if connection.vendor == "postgresql":
            cursor.execute("ANALYZE;")
            print("[ANALYZE] Updated PostgreSQL query planner statistics.")

    print(f"\n[OK] Verified {created} composite database indexes.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

r"""
AttendSure - Terminate Stuck Idle PostgreSQL Connections
Run: python database\reset_connections.py
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from _bootstrap import setup_django

setup_django()

from django.db import connection


def main():
    if connection.vendor != "postgresql":
        print(f"Skipped: active engine is {connection.vendor}.")
        return
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute("""
            SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid)
            FROM pg_stat_activity
            WHERE datname = current_database()
              AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()
              AND state = 'idle';
        """)
        terminated = cursor.rowcount
    print(f"[OK] Terminated {terminated} idle PostgreSQL connection(s).")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def sync_sequences():
    if connection.vendor != "postgresql":
        return
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        for model in (SchoolYear, GradeLevel, Room, Section, Subject, ClassPeriod, TeacherProfile, Student, Enrollment):
            tbl = model._meta.db_table
            cursor.execute(f"SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('{tbl}', 'id'), COALESCE(MAX(id), 1)) FROM \"{tbl}\";")

r"""
AttendSure - Physical Profile Avatar Generator (Zero Mock Data)
Ensures every existing Student, TeacherProfile, and UserProfile has a valid JPEG file on disk.
Run: python database\sync_avatars.py
"""

import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from _bootstrap import setup_django

setup_django()

from django.conf import settings
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
from apps.accounts.models import TeacherProfile, UserProfile
from apps.students.models import Student

PALETTES = [
    ("#1e3a8a", "#3b82f6"),
    ("#065f46", "#10b981"),
    ("#0f172a", "#64748b"),
    ("#312e81", "#6366f1"),
]


def draw_avatar(target_path: Path, initials: str, seed_num: int, size: int = 256) -> None:
    target_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    bg, border = PALETTES[seed_num % len(PALETTES)]
    img = Image.new("RGB", (size, size), bg)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    draw.ellipse([(8, 8), (size - 8, size - 8)], fill=bg, outline=border, width=6)

    label = (initials or "AS")[:2].upper()
    font = ImageFont.load_default()
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), label, font=font)
    tw, th = max(1, bbox[2] - bbox[0]), max(1, bbox[3] - bbox[1])

    glyph = Image.new("RGBA", (tw + 4, th + 4), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    ImageDraw.Draw(glyph).text((2, 2), label, fill=(255, 255, 255, 255), font=font)
    scaled = glyph.resize((int(size * 0.42), int(size * 0.42)), Image.Resampling.NEAREST)
    img.paste(scaled, ((size - scaled.width) // 2, (size - scaled.height) // 2), scaled)
    img.save(target_path, "JPEG", quality=88)


def main():
    media_root = Path(settings.MEDIA_ROOT)
    st_fixed = tc_fixed = us_fixed = 0

    for st in Student.objects.only("id", "lrn", "first_name", "last_name", "photo"):
        rel = st.photo.name if (st.photo and st.photo.name) else f"students/std_{st.lrn or st.id}.jpg"
        full = media_root / rel
        if not full.is_file():
            draw_avatar(full, f"{st.first_name[:1]}{st.last_name[:1]}", st.id)
            if not st.photo or st.photo.name != rel:
                Student.objects.filter(pk=st.id).update(photo=rel)
            st_fixed += 1

    for tc in TeacherProfile.objects.only("id", "employee_id", "first_name", "last_name", "photo"):
        rel = tc.photo.name if (tc.photo and tc.photo.name) else f"faculty/fac_{tc.employee_id or tc.id}.jpg"
        full = media_root / rel
        if not full.is_file():
            draw_avatar(full, f"{tc.first_name[:1]}{tc.last_name[:1]}", tc.id)
            if not tc.photo or tc.photo.name != rel:
                TeacherProfile.objects.filter(pk=tc.id).update(photo=rel)
            tc_fixed += 1

    for prof in UserProfile.objects.select_related("user", "teacher"):
        if prof.teacher and prof.teacher.photo:
            continue
        rel = prof.avatar.name if (prof.avatar and prof.avatar.name) else f"avatars/user_{prof.user_id}.jpg"
        full = media_root / rel
        if not full.is_file():
            u = prof.user
            initials = f"{u.first_name[:1]}{u.last_name[:1]}".strip() or u.username[:2]
            draw_avatar(full, initials, prof.user_id)
            if not prof.avatar or prof.avatar.name != rel:
                UserProfile.objects.filter(pk=prof.id).update(avatar=rel)
            us_fixed += 1

    print(f"[OK] Avatars verified -> Students: {st_fixed}, Teachers: {tc_fixed}, Users: {us_fixed} created.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

r"""
AttendSure - System Health, Timetable Conflict & Pure-Software Codebase Auditor
Run: python testing\audit_codebase.py
"""

import re
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from _bootstrap import PROJECT_ROOT, RESULTS_DIR, setup_django

setup_django()

from django.core.management import call_command
from django.db import connection
from django.db.migrations.executor import MigrationExecutor
from django.urls import resolve
from apps.school.models import ClassPeriod

SKIP_DIRS = {
    ".git", "node_modules", ".expo", "dist", "build", "__pycache__",
    "venv", ".venv", "_legacy_backup", "_archived_legacy", "exports", "results", "migrations", "media", "staticfiles",
}
OBSOLETE_REGEX = re.compile(r"\b(sms_outbox|iot_kiosks|rfid_uid|turnstile|gsm_modem)\b", re.IGNORECASE)


def main():
    lines = [
        "=" * 80,
        f"ATTENDSURE SYSTEM & CODEBASE AUDIT ({datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p')})",
        "=" * 80,
    ]

    # 1. Django System & Migration Check
    call_command("check")
    executor = MigrationExecutor(connection)
    pending = executor.migration_plan(executor.loader.graph.leaf_nodes())
    lines.append(f"[PASS] Django check passed | Pending migrations: {len(pending)}")

    # 2. Core Route Resolution
    routes = [
        "/api/v1/health/db/",
        "/api/v1/accounts/login/",
        "/api/v1/school/settings/",
        "/api/v1/students/",
        "/api/v1/attendance/scan/",
        "/api/v1/campus/boundary/",
        "/api/v1/messaging/threads/",
        "/api/v1/reports/sf4/",
        "/api/classroom/class_list/",
        "/api/faculty/dropdown/",
    ]
    for route in routes:
        resolve(route)
    lines.append(f"[PASS] Verified {len(routes)} core v1 and legacy URL routes.")

    # 3. Timetable Double-Booking Check
    periods = list(ClassPeriod.objects.filter(is_active=True).select_related("section", "teacher"))
    conflicts = 0
    for i, p1 in enumerate(periods):
        for p2 in periods[i + 1:]:
            if p1.start_time < p2.end_time and p1.end_time > p2.start_time:
                if p1.teacher_id and p1.teacher_id == p2.teacher_id:
                    conflicts += 1
                if p1.section_id and p1.section_id == p2.section_id:
                    conflicts += 1
    lines.append(f"[{'PASS' if conflicts == 0 else 'WARN'}] Active class periods: {len(periods)} | Schedule conflicts: {conflicts}")

    # 4. Retired Hardware Keyword Scan
    this_file = Path(__file__).resolve()
    hits = []
    for path in PROJECT_ROOT.rglob("*"):
        if not path.is_file() or path.resolve() == this_file or any(p in SKIP_DIRS for p in path.parts):
            continue
        if path.suffix.lower() not in {".py", ".ts", ".tsx"}:
            continue
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
        match = OBSOLETE_REGEX.search(text)
        if match:
            hits.append(f"  - {path.relative_to(PROJECT_ROOT)}: '{match.group(0)}'")

    lines.append(f"[{'PASS' if not hits else 'WARN'}] Retired hardware identifier hits: {len(hits)}")
    lines.extend(hits[:25])
    lines.append("=" * 80)

    report = "\n".join(lines)
    print(report)
    out = RESULTS_DIR / "system_audit.txt"
    out.write_text(report, encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"Saved audit report to: {out}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

r"""
AttendSure - Live Teacher Campus GPS Monitor
Run: python testing\check_campus_gps.py
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from _bootstrap import setup_django

setup_django()

from django.utils import timezone
from common.gps import calculate_distance_meters
from apps.accounts.models import TeacherProfile
from apps.campus.models import TeacherLocationLog
from apps.campus.selectors import get_active_campus_coords


def main():
    c_lat, c_lon, radius, school_name = get_active_campus_coords()
    print("=" * 96)
    print(f"  ATTENDSURE LIVE CAMPUS GPS MONITOR - {school_name.upper()}")
    print(f"  Center: ({c_lat:.6f}, {c_lon:.6f}) | Allowed Radius: {radius}m")
    print("=" * 96)
    print(f"{'TEACHER NAME':<26} | {'EMP ID':<12} | {'DISTANCE':<10} | {'STATUS':<16} | {'LAST RECORDED'}")
    print("-" * 96)

    teachers = list(TeacherProfile.objects.filter(is_active=True).order_by("last_name", "first_name"))
    latest_by_teacher = {}
    for log in TeacherLocationLog.objects.filter(teacher__in=teachers).order_by("teacher_id", "-recorded_at"):
        latest_by_teacher.setdefault(log.teacher_id, log)

    inside = outside = no_ping = 0
    for tc in teachers:
        log = latest_by_teacher.get(tc.id)
        if log:
            dist = calculate_distance_meters(log.latitude, log.longitude, c_lat, c_lon)
            is_in = dist <= radius
            inside += int(is_in)
            outside += int(not is_in)
            dist_s = f"{dist:.1f}m" if dist < 1000 else f"{dist / 1000:.2f}km"
            state = "INSIDE_CAMPUS" if is_in else "OUTSIDE_CAMPUS"
            when = timezone.localtime(log.recorded_at).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %I:%M %p")
        else:
            no_ping += 1
            dist_s, state, when = "--", "NO_CHECK_IN", "No GPS log yet"
        print(f"{tc.full_name[:26]:<26} | {tc.employee_id[:12]:<12} | {dist_s:<10} | {state:<16} | {when}")

    print("-" * 96)
    print(f"Total Active Teachers: {len(teachers)} | Inside: {inside} | Outside: {outside} | No Log: {no_ping}")
    print("=" * 96)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

r"""
AttendSure - Master Diagnostics & Test Runner
Run: python testing\run_all_tests.py
"""

import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from _bootstrap import RESULTS_DIR, SCRIPTS_DIR, ensure_venv_python

ensure_venv_python()

SUITES = [
    SCRIPTS_DIR / "database" / "check_database.py",
    SCRIPTS_DIR / "testing" / "audit_codebase.py",
    SCRIPTS_DIR / "testing" / "check_campus_gps.py",
    SCRIPTS_DIR / "utilities" / "inspect_models.py",
    SCRIPTS_DIR / "testing" / "test_api_cruds.py",
]


def main():
    RESULTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    summary = [
        "=" * 76,
        f"ATTENDSURE DIAGNOSTICS SUMMARY ({datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p')})",
        "=" * 76,
    ]
    failed = 0

    for script in SUITES:
        rel = script.relative_to(SCRIPTS_DIR)
        print(f"[*] Running {rel} ...")
        proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(script)], capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        ok = proc.returncode == 0
        if not ok:
            failed += 1
        status = "PASSED" if ok else f"FAILED ({proc.returncode})"
        log_file = RESULTS_DIR / f"{script.stem}_output.txt"
        log_file.write_text((proc.stdout or "") + "\n" + (proc.stderr or ""), encoding="utf-8")
        line = f"  {str(rel):<35} | {status:<14} | results/{log_file.name}"
        print(line)
        summary.append(line)

    summary.append("=" * 76)
    (RESULTS_DIR / "_summary.txt").write_text("\n".join(summary), encoding="utf-8")

r"""
AttendSure - Live API Concurrency Benchmark (Requires running backend on 127.0.0.1:8000)
Run: python testing\stress_test_api.py
"""

import concurrent.futures
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from _bootstrap import setup_django

setup_django()

import requests
from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from rest_framework.authtoken.models import Token

User = get_user_model()
TARGET_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/reports/dashboard/"


def hit_endpoint(headers: dict) -> tuple[int | str, float]:
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        resp = requests.get(TARGET_URL, headers=headers, timeout=5)
        return resp.status_code, (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0
    except requests.RequestException as exc:
        return f"ERR:{exc.__class__.__name__}", (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0


def main():
    user = User.objects.filter(is_superuser=True, is_active=True).first() or User.objects.first()
    if not user:
        sys.exit("[ERROR] No user found in database.")
    token, _ = Token.objects.get_or_create(user=user)
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Token {token.key}"}

    print(f"Benchmarking 50 parallel requests -> {TARGET_URL} (User: {user.username})")
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=10) as pool:
        results = list(pool.map(lambda _: hit_endpoint(headers), range(50)))

    ok_latencies = [ms for code, ms in results if code == 200]
    avg_ms = round(sum(ok_latencies) / len(ok_latencies), 2) if ok_latencies else 0.0
    print(f"[RESULT] {len(ok_latencies)}/50 HTTP 200 OK | Average Latency: {avg_ms} ms")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

AttendSure - End-to-End Backend CRUD, Security & DepEd Report Verification

class DualLogger:
    def __init__(self, path: Path):
        self.term = sys.stdout
        self.fh = path.open("w", encoding="utf-8")

    def write(self, msg: str):
        self.term.write(msg)
        self.fh.write(msg)

    def flush(self):
        self.term.flush()
        self.fh.flush()

    def close(self):
        self.fh.close()


class ApiSuiteVerifier:
    def __init__(self):
        self.client = APIClient()
        self.results = []
        self.errors = []
        self.tag = uuid.uuid4().hex[:6].upper()

    def _err_text(self, res) -> str:
        data = getattr(res, "data", None)
        if data is not None:
            return str(data)[:300]
        return getattr(res, "content", b"").decode("utf-8", errors="replace")[:300]

    def record(self, cat: str, name: str, ok: bool, detail: str, ms: float, err: str = ""):
        self.results.append({"passed": ok})
        badge = "PASS" if ok else "FAIL"
        print(f"[{badge}] {cat:<14} | {name:<36} | {ms:>6.1f} ms | {detail}")
        if not ok:
            self.errors.append(f"[{cat}] {name} -> {detail} | {err}")

    def call(self, fn, *args, **kwargs):
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        res = fn(*args, **kwargs)
        return res, (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0

    def authenticate_admin(self) -> bool:
        admin = User.objects.filter(is_superuser=True, is_active=True).first()
        if not admin:
            self.record("AUTH", "Superuser Lookup", False, "No active superuser in DB", 0.0)
            return False
        token, _ = Token.objects.get_or_create(user=admin)
        self.client.credentials(HTTP_AUTHORIZATION=f"Token {token.key}", HTTP_HOST="localhost")
        return True

    def crud_cycle(self, label: str, url: str, create_data: dict, patch_data: dict, check_key: str, query: str = ""):
        obj_id = None
        try:
            res, ms = self.call(self.client.post, url, create_data, format="json", HTTP_HOST="localhost")
            ok = res.status_code in (200, 201) and isinstance(getattr(res, "data", None), dict)
            obj_id = res.data.get("id") if ok else None
            self.record("CRUD-CREATE", f"{label} (POST)", bool(obj_id), f"HTTP {res.status_code} ID={obj_id}", ms, "" if obj_id else self._err_text(res))
            if not obj_id:
                return

            detail = f"{url}{obj_id}/"
            res_l, ms_l = self.call(self.client.get, f"{url}{query}", HTTP_HOST="localhost")
            raw_l = getattr(res_l, "data", {})
            items = raw_l.get("results", raw_l) if isinstance(raw_l, dict) else raw_l
            ok_l = res_l.status_code == 200 and isinstance(items, list)
            self.record("CRUD-READ", f"{label} List (GET)", ok_l, f"HTTP {res_l.status_code} Count={len(items) if ok_l else 0}", ms_l, "" if ok_l else self._err_text(res_l))

            res_d, ms_d = self.call(self.client.get, detail, HTTP_HOST="localhost")
            self.record("CRUD-READ", f"{label} Detail (GET)", res_d.status_code == 200, f"HTTP {res_d.status_code}", ms_d, "" if res_d.status_code == 200 else self._err_text(res_d))

            res_u, ms_u = self.call(self.client.patch, detail, patch_data, format="json", HTTP_HOST="localhost")
            got_val = res_u.data.get(check_key) if isinstance(getattr(res_u, "data", None), dict) else None
            ok_u = res_u.status_code == 200 and str(got_val) == str(patch_data[check_key])
            self.record("CRUD-UPDATE", f"{label} (PATCH)", ok_u, f"HTTP {res_u.status_code} {check_key}={got_val}", ms_u, "" if ok_u else self._err_text(res_u))

            res_x, ms_x = self.call(self.client.delete, detail, HTTP_HOST="localhost")
            ok_x = res_x.status_code in (200, 204)
            self.record("CRUD-DELETE", f"{label} (DELETE)", ok_x, f"HTTP {res_x.status_code}", ms_x, "" if ok_x else self._err_text(res_x))
            if ok_x:
                obj_id = None
        finally:
            if obj_id:
                self.client.delete(f"{url}{obj_id}/", HTTP_HOST="localhost")

    def run_all(self):
        for cat, label, path in [
            ("HEALTH", "Database Health (/api/v1/health/db/)", "/api/v1/health/db/"),

            ("DASHBOARD", "Dashboard (/api/v1/reports/dashboard/)", "/api/v1/reports/dashboard/"),
            ("SETTINGS", "School Settings (/api/v1/school/settings/)", "/api/v1/school/settings/"),
            ("AUDIT", "Audit Logs (/api/activity-logs/)", "/api/activity-logs/"),

            ("LEGACY", "Class List (/api/classroom/class_list/)", "/api/classroom/class_list/"),
        ]:
            res, ms = self.call(self.client.get, path, HTTP_HOST="localhost")
            self.record(cat, label, res.status_code == 200, f"HTTP {res.status_code}", ms, "" if res.status_code == 200 else self._err_text(res))

        sy = SchoolYear.objects.filter(is_active=True).first() or SchoolYear.objects.first()
        temp_sy = None
        if not sy:
            temp_sy = SchoolYear.objects.create(
                code=f"SY-{self.tag}",

def main() -> int:
    logger = DualLogger(RESULT_FILE)
    sys.stdout = sys.stderr = logger
    suite = ApiSuiteVerifier()
    code = 0
    try:
        print(f"AttendSure - Full API Verification ({datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p')})")
        print("=" * 90)
        if suite.authenticate_admin():
            suite.run_all()
        else:
            code = 1
    except Exception:
        code = 1
        suite.errors.append(traceback.format_exc())
        print(traceback.format_exc())
    finally:
        passed = sum(1 for r in suite.results if r["passed"])
        total = len(suite.results)
        if passed < total:
            code = 1
        ERROR_FILE.write_text(
            "ZERO ERRORS\n" if not suite.errors else "\n".join(suite.errors),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        print("=" * 90)
        print(f"SUMMARY: {passed}/{total} Passed | {total - passed} Failed")
        print(f"Saved: {RESULT_FILE}")
        sys.stdout = sys.stderr = logger.term
        logger.close()
    return code


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

r"""
AttendSure - Bytecode & Application Cache Cleaner
Run: python utilities\clean_project.py
"""

import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from _bootstrap import BACKEND_DIR, EXPORTS_DIR, PROJECT_ROOT, RESULTS_DIR, SCRIPTS_DIR, setup_django

setup_django()

from django.core.cache import cache

SKIP_ROOTS = {"venv", ".venv", "node_modules", ".git", "_legacy_backup", "_archived_legacy"}


def main():
    removed = 0
    for pycache in PROJECT_ROOT.rglob("__pycache__"):
        if any(part in SKIP_ROOTS for part in pycache.parts):
            continue
        shutil.rmtree(pycache, ignore_errors=True)
        removed += 1

    # Remove stray folders if an older utility created them inside scripts/utilities/
    for stray in (SCRIPTS_DIR / "utilities" / "data", SCRIPTS_DIR / "utilities" / "results"):
        if stray.is_dir():
            shutil.rmtree(stray, ignore_errors=True)

    RESULTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    EXPORTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (BACKEND_DIR / "logs").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    cache.clear()
    print(f"[OK] Removed {removed} __pycache__ folder(s) and cleared Django cache.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def run_cmd(cmd: list[str], cwd: Path) -> None:
    res = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=str(cwd), shell=(sys.platform == "win32"))
    if res.returncode != 0:
        sys.exit(f"[ERROR] Command failed ({res.returncode}): {' '.join(cmd)}")


def main():
    print("=" * 60 + "\n  ATTENDSURE PROJECT UPDATER\n" + "=" * 60)

    dirty = subprocess.getoutput(f'git -C "{PROJECT_ROOT}" status --porcelain').strip()
    if dirty:
        run_cmd(["git", "stash", "push", "-m", "attendsure_update_stash"], PROJECT_ROOT)
    run_cmd(["git", "pull", "origin", "main", "--tags"], PROJECT_ROOT)
    if dirty:
        subprocess.run(["git", "stash", "pop"], cwd=str(PROJECT_ROOT), shell=True)

    run_cmd([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "-r", "requirements.txt", "--quiet"], BACKEND_DIR)
    run_cmd([sys.executable, "manage.py", "migrate"], BACKEND_DIR)
    run_cmd([sys.executable, "manage.py", "check"], BACKEND_DIR)

    for fe_dir in (WEB_DIR, MOBILE_DIR):
        if (fe_dir / "package.json").is_file():
            run_cmd(["npm", "install", "--prefer-offline"], fe_dir)

    print("[SUCCESS] Backend, Web, and Mobile environments are synced and verified.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

r"""
AttendSure - Shared Script Bootstrap & Virtualenv Resolver
File: D:\AttendSure_V3\scripts\_bootstrap.py
"""

import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPTS_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PROJECT_ROOT = SCRIPTS_DIR.parent
BACKEND_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "backend"
WEB_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "web"
MOBILE_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "mobile"
RESULTS_DIR = SCRIPTS_DIR / "results"
EXPORTS_DIR = SCRIPTS_DIR / "exports"


def get_venv_python() -> Path | None:
    candidates = [
        BACKEND_DIR / "venv" / "Scripts" / "python.exe",
        BACKEND_DIR / ".venv" / "Scripts" / "python.exe",
        PROJECT_ROOT / "venv" / "Scripts" / "python.exe",
    ]
    for path in candidates:
        if path.is_file():
            return path
    return None


def ensure_venv_python() -> None:
    """Re-runs the active script inside backend/venv if started with global Python."""
    if os.environ.get("ATTENDSURE_VENV_BOOTSTRAPPED") == "1":
        return
    venv_py = get_venv_python()
    if venv_py and Path(sys.executable).resolve() != venv_py.resolve():
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env["ATTENDSURE_VENV_BOOTSTRAPPED"] = "1"
        result = subprocess.run([str(venv_py), *sys.argv], env=env)
        sys.exit(result.returncode)

    os.environ.pop("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE", None)
    os.environ["DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE"] = "config.settings"

    import django
    django.setup()

r"""
AttendSure - Directory Structure, Path Summary & Source Code Exporter
Location: scripts/export_codes.bat
"""

import argparse
import itertools
import os

IGNORED_DIRS = {
    ".git", ".idea", ".vscode", ".expo", ".next", ".turbo", "__pycache__",

    "package-lock.json", "yarn.lock", "pnpm-lock.yaml", "bun.lockb", "Thumbs.db", ".DS_Store",

BINARY_EXTENSIONS = {

def _safe_rel(path: Path, base: Path) -> str:
    try:
        return str(path.relative_to(base))
    except ValueError:
        return str(path)


def is_ignored_file(path: Path) -> bool:
    if path.name in IGNORED_FILES or path.name.endswith("_codes_export.txt"):
        return True
    if path.suffix.lower() in BINARY_EXTENSIONS:
        return True
    try:
        if path.stat().st_size > MAX_FILE_BYTES:
            return True
        with path.open("rb") as fh:
            return b"\x00" in fh.read(4096)
    except OSError:
        return True


def get_visible_entries(directory: Path, exclude_env: bool = False):
    try:
        raw_entries = list(directory.iterdir())
    except OSError:
        return [], []
    dirs = sorted(
        [d for d in raw_entries if d.is_dir() and d.name not in IGNORED_DIRS],
        key=lambda p: p.name.lower(),
    )
    files = sorted(
        [
            f
            for f in raw_entries
            if f.is_file()
            and not is_ignored_file(f)
            and not (exclude_env and f.name == ".env")
        ],
        key=lambda p: p.name.lower(),
    )
    return dirs, files


def normalize_targets(targets: list[Path]) -> list[Path]:
    resolved_list: list[Path] = []
    seen: set[Path] = set()
    for item in targets:
        rp = item.resolve()
        if rp not in seen:
            seen.add(rp)
            resolved_list.append(rp)

    if PROJECT_ROOT.resolve() in seen:
        return [PROJECT_ROOT.resolve()]

    filtered: list[Path] = []
    for candidate in resolved_list:
        if any(other != candidate and other in candidate.parents for other in resolved_list):
            continue
        filtered.append(candidate)
    return filtered


def collect_multi_tree_and_files(targets: list[Path], exclude_env: bool = False):
    targets = normalize_targets(targets)
    tree_lines: list[str] = [f"{PROJECT_ROOT.name}/"]
    collected_files: list[Path] = []
    seen_files: set[Path] = set()
    folder_stats: dict[str, int] = {}
    folder_count = 0

    def _walk(curr_dir: Path, curr_prefix: str):
        nonlocal folder_count
        dirs, files = get_visible_entries(curr_dir, exclude_env=exclude_env)
        folder_stats[str(curr_dir)] = len(files)
        entries = dirs + files
        for idx, entry in enumerate(entries):
            is_last = idx == len(entries) - 1
            conn = "+-- " if is_last else "|-- "
            if entry.is_dir():
                folder_count += 1
                tree_lines.append(f"{curr_prefix}{conn}{entry.name}/")
                _walk(entry, curr_prefix + ("    " if is_last else "|   "))
            else:
                tree_lines.append(f"{curr_prefix}{conn}{entry.name}")
                if entry not in seen_files:
                    seen_files.add(entry)
                    collected_files.append(entry)

    if len(targets) == 1 and targets[0] == PROJECT_ROOT:
        _walk(PROJECT_ROOT, "")
        return tree_lines, collected_files, folder_stats, folder_count

    for t_idx, target in enumerate(targets):
        is_last_target = t_idx == len(targets) - 1
        top_conn = "+-- " if is_last_target else "|-- "
        next_prefix = "    " if is_last_target else "|   "

        if target.is_file():
            rel_label = _safe_rel(target, PROJECT_ROOT).replace(os.sep, "/")
            tree_lines.append(f"{top_conn}{rel_label}")
            if target not in seen_files and not is_ignored_file(target):
                seen_files.add(target)
                collected_files.append(target)
                folder_stats[str(target.parent)] = folder_stats.get(str(target.parent), 0) + 1
            continue

        folder_count += 1
        if PROJECT_ROOT in target.parents:
            parts = target.relative_to(PROJECT_ROOT).parts
            curr_p = ""
            for p_idx, part in enumerate(parts):
                if p_idx == 0:
                    tree_lines.append(f"{top_conn}{part}/")
                    curr_p = next_prefix
                else:
                    tree_lines.append(f"{curr_p}+-- {part}/")
                    curr_p += "    "
            _walk(target, curr_p)
        else:
            tree_lines.append(f"{top_conn}{target.name}/")
            _walk(target, next_prefix)

    return tree_lines, collected_files, folder_stats, folder_count


def format_size(num_bytes: int) -> str:
    if num_bytes >= 1024 * 1024:
        return f"{num_bytes / (1024 * 1024):.2f} MB"
    if num_bytes >= 1024:
        return f"{num_bytes / 1024:.1f} KB"
    return f"{num_bytes} B"


def _slugify_part(raw: str) -> str:
    cleaned = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "_", raw.lower()).strip("_")
    return cleaned or "target"


def build_export_labels(targets: list[Path]) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    if len(targets) == 1 and targets[0] == PROJECT_ROOT:
        return PROJECT_ROOT.name.upper(), f"{PROJECT_ROOT.name}/ (Full Project)", "full_project"

    title_parts: list[str] = []
    target_labels: list[str] = []
    slug_parts: list[str] = []

    for t in targets:
        rel = _safe_rel(t, PROJECT_ROOT).replace(os.sep, "/")
        title_parts.append(t.name.upper())
        target_labels.append(f"{rel}/" if t.is_dir() else rel)
        slug_parts.append(_slugify_part(rel if PROJECT_ROOT in t.parents else t.stem))

    return " + ".join(title_parts), " + ".join(target_labels), "_".join(slug_parts)


def export_targets(
    targets: list[Path],
    print_codes: bool = False,
    exclude_env: bool = False,
) -> Path:
    clean_targets = normalize_targets(targets)
    tree_lines, files, folder_stats, folder_count = collect_multi_tree_and_files(
        clean_targets, exclude_env=exclude_env
    )
    now_str = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    header_title, target_label, safe_slug = build_export_labels(clean_targets)

    records, total_bytes, total_lines = [], 0, 0
    for fpath in files:
        try:
            raw = fpath.read_bytes()
        except OSError:
            continue
        text = raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        lc = text.count("\n") + (1 if text and not text.endswith("\n") else 0)
        total_bytes += len(raw)
        total_lines += lc
        records.append((fpath, text, lc, len(raw)))

    total_files = len(records)
    pad = max(3, len(str(total_files)))
    sep = "=" * 80

    summary = [
        sep,
        f"ATTENDSURE - {header_title} STRUCTURE & SOURCE CODE EXPORT",
        f"Generated   : {now_str}",
        f"Project Root: {PROJECT_ROOT}",
        f"Target      : {target_label}",
        f"Summary     : {folder_count} Folders, {total_files} Files, {total_lines:,} Lines ({format_size(total_bytes)})",
        sep,
        "",
        sep,
        "SECTION 1: VISUAL DIRECTORY STRUCTURE",
        sep,
        *tree_lines,
        "",
        sep,
        "SECTION 2A: FOLDER SUMMARY",
        sep,
    ]
    for f_dir, cnt in folder_stats.items():
        rel_f = _safe_rel(Path(f_dir), PROJECT_ROOT)
        label = PROJECT_ROOT.name if rel_f == "." else rel_f
        summary.append(f"  {label:<55} ({cnt} file{'s' if cnt != 1 else ''})")

    summary.extend(
        [
            "",
            sep,
            f"SECTION 2B: NUMBERED COMPLETE FILE PATH INDEX (1 to {total_files})",
            sep,
        ]
    )
    for idx, (fp, _, lc, sb) in enumerate(records, start=1):
        summary.append(f"[{idx:0{pad}d}] {fp}  ({lc} lines, {format_size(sb)})")

    summary_text = "\n".join(summary)
    print("\n" + summary_text)

    codes = ["", sep, f"SECTION 3: COMPLETE FILE CODES (1 to {total_files})", sep]
    for idx, (fp, content, lc, sb) in enumerate(records, start=1):
        codes.extend(
            [
                "",
                sep,
                f"FILE [{idx:0{pad}d} of {total_files:0{pad}d}]",
                f"Complete Path : {fp}",
                f"Relative Path : {_safe_rel(fp, PROJECT_ROOT)}",
                f"Metrics       : {lc} lines | {format_size(sb)}",
                sep,
                content.rstrip("\r\n"),
            ]
        )
    codes_text = "\n".join(codes)
    if print_codes:
        print(codes_text)

    EXPORT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out_file = EXPORT_DIR / f"{safe_slug}_codes_export.txt"
    out_file.write_text(summary_text + "\n" + codes_text + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"\n{sep}\n[SAVED] {out_file}\n{sep}")
    return out_file


def export_target(target: Path, print_codes: bool = False, exclude_env: bool = False) -> Path:
    return export_targets([target], print_codes=print_codes, exclude_env=exclude_env)


def build_folder_pairs(subfolders: list[Path]) -> list[tuple[Path, Path]]:
    by_lower = {d.name.lower(): d for d in subfolders}
    ordered_pairs: list[tuple[Path, Path]] = []
    seen_keys: set[frozenset[str]] = set()

    for first_name, second_name in PRIORITY_PAIR_NAMES:
        if first_name in by_lower and second_name in by_lower:
            key = frozenset((first_name, second_name))
            if key not in seen_keys:
                seen_keys.add(key)
                ordered_pairs.append((by_lower[first_name], by_lower[second_name]))

    for d1, d2 in itertools.combinations(subfolders, 2):
        key = frozenset((d1.name.lower(), d2.name.lower()))
        if key not in seen_keys:
            seen_keys.add(key)
            ordered_pairs.append((d1, d2))

    return ordered_pairs


def resolve_target(raw: str) -> Path | None:
    cleaned = raw.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
    if not cleaned:
        return None
    for base in (Path.cwd(), PROJECT_ROOT):
        cand = (base / cleaned).resolve()
        if cand.exists():
            return cand
    cand_abs = Path(cleaned)
    return cand_abs.resolve() if cand_abs.exists() else None


def parse_selection_tokens(
    raw_input: str,
    subfolders: list[Path],
    pairs: list[tuple[Path, Path]],
) -> list[Path] | None:
    tokens = [t.strip() for t in re.split(r"[+,]", raw_input) if t.strip()]
    if not tokens:
        return None

    selected: list[Path] = []
    pair_offset = len(subfolders)

    for tok in tokens:
        if tok.isdigit():
            idx = int(tok)
            if 1 <= idx <= len(subfolders):
                selected.append(subfolders[idx - 1])
                continue
            pair_idx = idx - pair_offset - 1
            if 0 <= pair_idx < len(pairs) and len(tokens) == 1:
                p1, p2 = pairs[pair_idx]
                return [p1, p2]
            return None

        resolved = resolve_target(tok)
        if not resolved:
            for d in subfolders:
                if d.name.lower() == tok.lower().rstrip("/\\"):
                    resolved = d
                    break
        if not resolved:
            return None
        selected.append(resolved)

    return selected if selected else None


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Export directory structure and source code for single folders, folder pairs, or the full project."
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "targets",
        nargs="*",
        help="Folder/file name(s), pair expression (e.g. backend+web), 'all', 'each', or 'pairs'.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("-p", "--print-codes", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--exclude-env", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    subfolders, _ = get_visible_entries(PROJECT_ROOT)
    folder_pairs = build_folder_pairs(subfolders)

    if not args.targets:
        print("\n" + "=" * 64)
        print("  ATTENDSURE CODE EXPORTER")
        print("=" * 64)

        print("  INDIVIDUAL FOLDERS:")
        for i, d in enumerate(subfolders, 1):
            print(f"    [{i}] {d.name}/")

        if folder_pairs:
            print("\n  PAIRED FOLDERS (COMBINED IN ONE FILE):")
            start_num = len(subfolders) + 1
            for offset, (p1, p2) in enumerate(folder_pairs):
                opt_num = start_num + offset
                print(f"    [{opt_num}] {p1.name}/ + {p2.name}/")

        print("\n  ALL & BATCH OPTIONS:")
        print("    [A] ALL        (Full project in one file)")
        print("    [E] EACH       (Every individual folder separately)")
        if folder_pairs:
            print("    [P] ALL PAIRS  (Every 2-folder pair separately)")
        print("\n  Tip: You can also combine any options with '+' (e.g. 1+4 or backend+web)")

        choice = input("\nSelect option, pair number, or path: ").strip()
        if not choice:
            return

        upper_choice = choice.upper()
        if upper_choice in ("A", "ALL"):
            export_targets([PROJECT_ROOT], args.print_codes, args.exclude_env)
        elif upper_choice in ("E", "EACH"):
            for d in subfolders:
                export_targets([d], args.print_codes, args.exclude_env)
        elif upper_choice in ("P", "PAIRS", "ALL PAIRS") and folder_pairs:
            for p1, p2 in folder_pairs:
                export_targets([p1, p2], args.print_codes, args.exclude_env)
        else:
            parsed = parse_selection_tokens(choice, subfolders, folder_pairs)
            if not parsed:
                sys.exit(f"[ERROR] Invalid selection or path not found: {choice}")
            export_targets(parsed, args.print_codes, args.exclude_env)
        return

    joined_arg = "+".join(args.targets).strip()
    key = joined_arg.lower()

    if key == "all":
        export_targets([PROJECT_ROOT], args.print_codes, args.exclude_env)
    elif key == "each":
        for d in subfolders:
            export_targets([d], args.print_codes, args.exclude_env)
    elif key in ("pairs", "all-pairs"):
        for p1, p2 in folder_pairs:
            export_targets([p1, p2], args.print_codes, args.exclude_env)
    else:
        parsed = parse_selection_tokens(joined_arg, subfolders, folder_pairs)
        if not parsed:
            sys.exit(f"[ERROR] Path or folder combination not found: {' '.join(args.targets)}")
        export_targets(parsed, args.print_codes, args.exclude_env)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def map_dynamic_delete(text: str) -> str:
    # AcademicSetupModal dynamic delete helper (`/${endpoint}/${id}/`)
    return text.replace(
        "handleDeleteItem('grade-levels',", "handleDeleteItem('v1/school/grade-levels',"
    ).replace(
        "handleDeleteItem('rooms',", "handleDeleteItem('v1/school/rooms',"
    ).replace(
        "handleDeleteItem('subjects',", "handleDeleteItem('v1/school/subjects',"
    ).replace(
        "handleDeleteItem('sections',", "handleDeleteItem('v1/school/sections',"
    ).replace(
        "handleDeleteItem('schedules',", "handleDeleteItem('v1/school/periods',"
    )


def main() -> None:
    updated_files = 0
    for path in sorted(WEB_SRC.rglob("*.ts*")):
        if path.name == "client.ts" or path.name == "routes.ts":
            continue
        original = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        modified = original
        for old, new in LITERAL_SWAPS:
            modified = modified.replace(old, new)
        modified = map_dynamic_delete(modified)

        if modified != original:
            path.write_text(modified, encoding="utf-8")
            print(f"[MIGRATED -> /v1/] web/src/{path.relative_to(WEB_SRC)}")
            updated_files += 1

    print(f"\n[OK] Standardized {updated_files} web source file(s) to /api/v1/.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

r"""
AttendSure - Web Brand Asset Optimizer
Downscales high-DPI embedded Base64 rasters (including >89MP exports inside techblazer.svg).
"""

import base64
import io
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
VENV_PYTHON = PROJECT_ROOT / "backend" / "venv" / "Scripts" / "python.exe"

if VENV_PYTHON.is_file() and Path(sys.executable).resolve() != VENV_PYTHON.resolve():
    sys.exit(subprocess.call([str(VENV_PYTHON), str(Path(__file__).resolve()), *sys.argv[1:]]))

from PIL import Image  # noqa: E402

Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None  # Allow downscaling high-DPI local Illustrator/Canva exports

ASSETS_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "web" / "src" / "assets"
BACKUP_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "web" / "_archived_legacy" / "original_assets"

DATA_URI_RE = re.compile(
    r"(data:[^;\"'\s]+;base64,)([A-Za-z0-9+/=\s&#0-9;]+)",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)


def _resize_raster_bytes(raw_bytes: bytes, max_dim: int = 256) -> bytes:
    with Image.open(io.BytesIO(raw_bytes)) as img:
        img = img.convert("RGBA")
        img.thumbnail((max_dim, max_dim), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        out = io.BytesIO()
        img.save(out, format="PNG", optimize=True)
        return out.getvalue()


def optimize_svg(svg_path: Path) -> None:
    original_size = svg_path.stat().st_size
    if original_size < 60 * 1024:
        return

    text = svg_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")

    def _replace_match(match: re.Match) -> str:
        raw_b64 = re.sub(r"&#\d+;|&#x[0-9a-fA-F]+;|\s+", "", match.group(2))
        if len(raw_b64) < 16_384:
            return match.group(0)
        try:
            decoded = base64.b64decode(raw_b64 + "===")
            shrunk = _resize_raster_bytes(decoded, max_dim=256)
            if len(shrunk) < len(decoded):
                return f"data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(shrunk).decode('ascii')}"
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"  [NOTICE] Skipped non-image block in {svg_path.name}: {exc}")
        return match.group(0)

    updated = DATA_URI_RE.sub(_replace_match, text)
    if len(updated) < len(text):
        svg_path.write_text(updated, encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"[OPTIMIZED SVG] {svg_path.name}: {original_size // 1024} KB -> {svg_path.stat().st_size // 1024} KB")


def main() -> None:
    if not ASSETS_DIR.is_dir():
        return
    BACKUP_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for asset in ASSETS_DIR.iterdir():
        if not asset.is_file():
            continue
        backup_target = BACKUP_DIR / asset.name
        if not backup_target.exists():
            shutil.copy2(asset, backup_target)
        if asset.suffix.lower() == ".svg":
            optimize_svg(asset)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

r"""
AttendSure - Scripts Folder Organizer
Archives legacy/duplicate scripts into scripts/_archived_legacy/ and creates clean folders.
"""

import shutil
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPTS_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ARCHIVE_DIR = SCRIPTS_DIR / "_archived_legacy"

REQUIRED_DIRS = [
    SCRIPTS_DIR / "database",
    SCRIPTS_DIR / "testing",
    SCRIPTS_DIR / "utilities",
    SCRIPTS_DIR / "exports",
    SCRIPTS_DIR / "results",
]

KEEP_FILES = {
    "_bootstrap.py",
    "organize_scripts.bat",
    "start_all.bat",
    "start_tunnel.bat",
    "export_codes.bat",
    "push_and_sync.ps1",

    "database/sync_avatars.py",

    "testing/check_campus_gps.py",
    "testing/audit_codebase.py",
    "testing/stress_test_api.py",
    "utilities/clean_project.py",
    "utilities/inspect_models.py",
    "utilities/update_project.py",
}

SKIP_ROOT_DIRS = {"_archived_legacy", "exports", "results", "__pycache__"}


def main():
    for folder in REQUIRED_DIRS:
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    moved = 0
    for item in sorted(SCRIPTS_DIR.rglob("*")):
        if not item.is_file():
            continue
        rel_parts = item.relative_to(SCRIPTS_DIR).parts
        if rel_parts[0] in SKIP_ROOT_DIRS:
            continue

        rel_posix = item.relative_to(SCRIPTS_DIR).as_posix()
        if rel_posix not in KEEP_FILES:
            dest = ARCHIVE_DIR / rel_posix
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            if dest.exists():
                dest.unlink()
            shutil.move(str(item), str(dest))
            print(f"[ARCHIVED] {rel_posix} -> _archived_legacy/{rel_posix}")
            moved += 1

    # Remove empty legacy directories such as scripts/data/
    for folder in sorted(SCRIPTS_DIR.rglob("*"), reverse=True):
        if folder.is_dir() and folder.name not in SKIP_ROOT_DIRS and folder not in REQUIRED_DIRS:
            try:
                folder.rmdir()
            except OSError:
                pass

    print(f"\n[OK] Organized scripts/ cleanly ({moved} legacy file(s) archived).")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

interface CacheEntry {
  freshUntil: number;
  staleUntil: number;
  response: AxiosResponse;
}

type CacheListener = (data: unknown) => void;

const responseCache = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
const inflightGetMap = new Map<string, Promise<AxiosResponse>>();
const cacheListeners = new Map<string, Set<CacheListener>>();

// Maps any legacy unversioned path to its canonical /api/v1/ endpoint

const notifyCacheListeners = (key: string, data: unknown): void => {
  const listeners = cacheListeners.get(key);
  if (!listeners) return;
  listeners.forEach((fn) => {
    try {
      fn(data);
    } catch {
      // Isolate listener errors
    }
  });
};

const pruneCacheIfNeeded = (): void => {
  if (responseCache.size <= MAX_CACHE_ENTRIES) return;
  const oldestKey = responseCache.keys().next().value;
  if (oldestKey) responseCache.delete(oldestKey);
};

export const clearApiClientCache = (): void => {
  responseCache.clear();
  inflightGetMap.clear();
};

/**
 * Evicts cached GET entries completely so immediate post-mutation refetches
 * always read fresh database state instead of stale SWR snapshots.
 */
export const invalidateApiCache = (): void => {
  responseCache.clear();
  inflightGetMap.clear();
};

const isLocalOrLanHost = (hostname: string): boolean =>
  hostname === 'localhost' ||
  hostname === '127.0.0.1' ||
  hostname.startsWith('192.168.') ||
  hostname.startsWith('10.') ||
  hostname.startsWith('172.') ||
  hostname.endsWith('.local');

export const resolveBaseUrl = (): string => {
  const envUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL;
  if (envUrl && typeof envUrl === 'string' && envUrl.trim()) {
    return envUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '').replace(/\/api(\/v1)?$/i, '');
  }

  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    const { protocol, hostname, port } = window.location;
    if (port === '80' || port === '443' || port === '5173' || !port) {
      if (
        hostname.includes('attendsure.ph') ||
        hostname.includes('attendsure.com.ph') ||
        hostname.includes('trycloudflare.com')
      ) {
        return `${protocol}//${hostname}`;
      }
    }
    if (isLocalOrLanHost(hostname)) {
      return `${protocol}//${hostname}:8000`;
    }
    return port && port !== '80' && port !== '443'
      ? `${protocol}//${hostname}:${port}`
      : `${protocol}//${hostname}`;
  }

  return 'http://127.0.0.1:8000';
};

export const normalizeApiPath = (rawUrl: string): string => {
  const trimmed = rawUrl.trim();
  if (/^(javascript|vbscript|data):/i.test(trimmed)) {
    throw new Error('Blocked unsafe URL protocol.');
  }
  if (trimmed.startsWith('http://') || trimmed.startsWith('https://')) {
    return trimmed;
  }

  let clean = trimmed
    .replace(/^\/+/, '')
    .replace(/\.\.\//g, '')
    .replace(/^(api\/)+/i, '');

  if (!clean.startsWith('v1/')) {
    const qIdx = clean.indexOf('?');
    const pathPart = qIdx >= 0 ? clean.slice(0, qIdx) : clean;
    const queryPart = qIdx >= 0 ? clean.slice(qIdx) : '';

    let mapped = pathPart;
    for (const [pattern, replacement] of LEGACY_TO_V1_PREFIXES) {
      if (pattern.test(pathPart)) {
        mapped = pathPart.replace(pattern, replacement);
        break;
      }
    }
    clean = (mapped.startsWith('v1/') ? mapped : `v1/${mapped}`) + queryPart;
  }

  return `/api/${clean}`;
};

const serializeParams = (params?: Record<string, unknown>): string => {
  if (!params || typeof params !== 'object') return '';
  const entries = Object.entries(params)
    .filter(([k, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== '' && k !== 'nocache' && k !== '_t' && k !== 'silent')
    .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b));
  return entries.length > 0 ? JSON.stringify(entries) : '';
};

export const buildApiCacheKey = (url: string, params?: Record<string, unknown>): string => {
  const normUrl = normalizeApiPath(url);
  const userScope =
    localStorage.getItem('attendsure_user_id') ||
    localStorage.getItem('attendsure_username') ||
    'guest';
  return `${userScope}:${normUrl}?${serializeParams(params)}`;
};

export function peekApiCache<T = unknown>(url: string, params?: Record<string, unknown>): T | undefined {
  const key = buildApiCacheKey(url, params);
  const hit = responseCache.get(key);
  if (!hit || hit.staleUntil <= Date.now()) return undefined;
  return hit.response.data as T;
}

export const subscribeApiCache = (
  url: string,
  params: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
  listener: CacheListener
): (() => void) => {
  const key = buildApiCacheKey(url, params);
  let set = cacheListeners.get(key);
  if (!set) {
    set = new Set();
    cacheListeners.set(key, set);
  }
  set.add(listener);
  return () => {
    const current = cacheListeners.get(key);
    if (!current) return;
    current.delete(listener);
    if (current.size === 0) cacheListeners.delete(key);
  };
};

const clearStoredAuth = (): void => {
  const keys = [
    'attendsure_access',
    'attendsure_refresh',
    'attendsure_token',
    'auth_token',
    'token',
    'attendsure_username',
    'attendsure_faculty_name',
    'attendsure_role',
    'attendsure_user_id',
    'attendsure_user_photo',
    'attendsure_can_teach',
  ];
  keys.forEach((k) => localStorage.removeItem(k));
  lastWarmupUser = '';
  clearApiClientCache();
};

const apiClient = axios.create({
  timeout: Number(import.meta.env.VITE_API_TIMEOUT_MS) || 10000,
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
});

apiClient.interceptors.request.use(
  (config: InternalAxiosRequestConfig) => {
    config.baseURL = resolveBaseUrl();
    config.url = normalizeApiPath(config.url || '');

    const method = (config.method || 'get').toLowerCase();
    if (method !== 'get') {
      invalidateApiCache();
    }

    if (config.headers && !config.headers.Authorization) {
      const jwtAccess = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_access')?.trim().replace(/[\r\n]/g, '');
      const legacyToken = (
        localStorage.getItem('attendsure_token') ||
        localStorage.getItem('auth_token') ||
        localStorage.getItem('token') ||
        ''
      )
        .trim()
        .replace(/[\r\n]/g, '');

      if (jwtAccess) {
        config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${jwtAccess}`;
      } else if (legacyToken) {
        config.headers.Authorization = `Token ${legacyToken}`;
      }
    }

    return config;
  },
  (error) => Promise.reject(error)
);

let refreshPromise: Promise<string | null> | null = null;

type RetriableConfig = InternalAxiosRequestConfig & {
  _jwtRetried?: boolean;
  _tokenRetried?: boolean;
};

apiClient.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => {
    const method = (response.config.method || 'get').toLowerCase();
    if (method !== 'get') {
      // Clear cache AFTER mutation commits so follow-up GETs never read pre-mutation snapshots
      invalidateApiCache();
    }
    return response;
  },
  async (error: AxiosError) => {
    const originalRequest = error.config as RetriableConfig | undefined;
    const reqUrl = originalRequest?.url || '';
    const isAuthRoute = reqUrl.includes('/login/') || reqUrl.includes('/token/') || reqUrl.includes('/public-branding/');

    if (error.response?.status === 401 && originalRequest && !isAuthRoute) {
      const refreshToken = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_refresh')?.trim();
      if (refreshToken && !originalRequest._jwtRetried) {
        originalRequest._jwtRetried = true;
        if (!refreshPromise) {
          refreshPromise = axios
            .post(`${resolveBaseUrl()}/api/v1/accounts/token/refresh/`, { refresh: refreshToken }, { timeout: 6000 })
            .then((res) => {
              const nextAccess = res.data?.access as string | undefined;
              const nextRefresh = res.data?.refresh as string | undefined;
              if (nextAccess) {
                localStorage.setItem('attendsure_access', nextAccess);
                if (nextRefresh) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_refresh', nextRefresh);
                return nextAccess;
              }
              return null;
            })
            .catch(() => null)
            .finally(() => {
              refreshPromise = null;
            });
        }

        const newAccess = await refreshPromise;
        if (newAccess) {
          originalRequest.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${newAccess}`;
          return apiClient(originalRequest);
        }
      }

      const fallbackToken = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_token')?.trim();
      if (
        fallbackToken &&
        !originalRequest._tokenRetried &&
        String(originalRequest.headers?.Authorization || '').startsWith('Bearer ')
      ) {
        originalRequest._tokenRetried = true;
        localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_access');
        originalRequest.headers.Authorization = `Token ${fallbackToken}`;
        return apiClient(originalRequest);
      }

      clearStoredAuth();
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('attendsure:auth-expired'));
      }
    }

    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

interface GenericAbortSignal {
  readonly aborted: boolean;
  addEventListener?: (type: string, listener: () => void, options?: { once?: boolean }) => void;
  removeEventListener?: (type: string, listener: () => void) => void;
}

const withCallerAbort = <R>(promise: Promise<R>, signal?: GenericAbortSignal): Promise<R> => {
  if (!signal) return promise;
  if (signal.aborted) {
    return Promise.reject(new CanceledError('canceled'));
  }
  return new Promise<R>((resolve, reject) => {
    const onAbort = () => reject(new CanceledError('canceled'));
    signal.addEventListener?.('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    promise.then(
      (val) => {
        signal.removeEventListener?.('abort', onAbort);
        resolve(val);
      },
      (err) => {
        signal.removeEventListener?.('abort', onAbort);
        reject(err);
      }
    );
  });
};

const rawGet = apiClient.get.bind(apiClient);

const fetchAndPopulateCache = <T = unknown, D = unknown>(
  url: string,
  key: string,
  config?: AxiosRequestConfig<D>
): Promise<AxiosResponse<T>> => {
  const existing = inflightGetMap.get(key);
  if (existing) return existing as Promise<AxiosResponse<T>>;

  const sharedConfig: AxiosRequestConfig<D> = { ...(config || {}), signal: undefined };
  const req = rawGet<T, AxiosResponse<T>, D>(url, sharedConfig)
    .then((res) => {
      const now = Date.now();
      pruneCacheIfNeeded();
      responseCache.set(key, {
        freshUntil: now + FRESH_TTL_MS,
        staleUntil: now + STALE_TTL_MS,
        response: res,
      });
      notifyCacheListeners(key, res.data);
      return res;
    })
    .finally(() => {
      inflightGetMap.delete(key);
    });

  inflightGetMap.set(key, req);
  return req;
};

apiClient.get = function swrGet<T = any, R = AxiosResponse<T>, D = any>(
  url: string,
  config?: AxiosRequestConfig<D>
): Promise<R> {
  const paramsObj = (config?.params || undefined) as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
  const forceNetwork = Boolean(paramsObj?._t || paramsObj?.nocache);
  const key = buildApiCacheKey(url, paramsObj);
  const now = Date.now();

  if (!forceNetwork) {
    const hit = responseCache.get(key);
    if (hit && hit.freshUntil > now) {
      return withCallerAbort(Promise.resolve(hit.response as unknown as R), config?.signal as GenericAbortSignal);
    }
    if (hit && hit.staleUntil > now) {
      void fetchAndPopulateCache<T, D>(url, key, config).catch(() => {});
      return withCallerAbort(Promise.resolve(hit.response as unknown as R), config?.signal as GenericAbortSignal);
    }
  }

  return withCallerAbort(
    fetchAndPopulateCache<T, D>(url, key, config) as unknown as Promise<R>,
    config?.signal as GenericAbortSignal
  );
};

export const prefetchApiGet = (url: string, params?: Record<string, unknown>): void => {
  const hasToken = Boolean(localStorage.getItem('attendsure_access') || localStorage.getItem('attendsure_token'));
  if (!hasToken) return;
  const key = buildApiCacheKey(url, params);
  const hit = responseCache.get(key);
  if (hit && hit.freshUntil > Date.now()) return;
  void fetchAndPopulateCache(url, key, { params }).catch(() => {});
};

let lastWarmupUser = '';

export const warmupRoleEndpoints = (role: string, canHandleClasses: boolean): void => {
  const userScope = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_username') || '';
  if (!userScope || lastWarmupUser === userScope) return;
  lastWarmupUser = userScope;

  const upper = role.toUpperCase();
  const isLeader = ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'FACULTY_ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD'].includes(upper);
  const now = new Date();

  const queue: Array<[string, Record<string, unknown>?]> = [
    [API_ROUTES.reports.dashboard, undefined],
    [API_ROUTES.students.metrics, undefined],
    [API_ROUTES.students.list, { page: 1, page_size: 25 }],
    [API_ROUTES.school.sections, { page_size: 300 }],
    [API_ROUTES.school.gradeLevels, { page_size: 200 }],
    [API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses, undefined],
    [API_ROUTES.reports.dtr, { month: now.getMonth() + 1, year: now.getFullYear() }],
    [API_ROUTES.messaging.threads, undefined],
    [API_ROUTES.reports.sdgImpact, undefined],
    [API_ROUTES.reports.dropoutRisk, undefined],
  ];

  if (canHandleClasses || isLeader) {
    queue.push([API_ROUTES.attendance.classes, undefined]);
    queue.push([API_ROUTES.attendance.classes, { summary: 1 }]);
    queue.push([API_ROUTES.attendance.adviserMatrix, undefined]);
  }

  if (isLeader) {
    queue.push([API_ROUTES.accounts.faculty, { page: 1, page_size: 25 }]);
    queue.push([API_ROUTES.accounts.facultyDropdown, undefined]);
    queue.push([API_ROUTES.school.periods, { page_size: 500 }]);
    queue.push([API_ROUTES.campus.boundary, undefined]);
    queue.push([API_ROUTES.school.settings, undefined]);
  }

  if (['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'FACULTY_ADMIN'].includes(upper)) {
    queue.push([API_ROUTES.accounts.users, { page_size: 'ALL' }]);
  }

  queue.forEach(([endpoint, params], index) => {
    setTimeout(() => prefetchApiGet(endpoint, params), 80 + index * 90);
  });
};
export default apiClient;

export const escapeHtml = (raw: unknown): string => {
  return String(raw ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
};

const isSafeUserFacingText = (text: string): boolean => {
  const trimmed = text.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return false;
  if (/<[a-z][\s\S]*>/i.test(trimmed)) return false;
  if (/traceback|exception|file ".*\.py"|syntaxerror|typeerror|integrityerror/i.test(trimmed)) {
    return false;
  }
  return true;
};

export const extractApiError = (err: unknown, fallback = 'Request could not be completed. Please try again.'): string => {
  const anyErr = err as {
    response?: { data?: Record<string, unknown> | string; status?: number };
    message?: string;
  };
  const data = anyErr?.response?.data;
  if (typeof data === 'string' && isSafeUserFacingText(data)) {
    return data.trim().slice(0, 220);
  }
  if (data && typeof data === 'object') {
    for (const key of ['message', 'error', 'detail']) {
      const val = data[key];
      if (typeof val === 'string' && isSafeUserFacingText(val)) {
        return val.trim().slice(0, 220);
      }
    }
    const details = data.details && typeof data.details === 'object' ? (data.details as Record<string, unknown>) : data;
    for (const val of Object.values(details)) {
      if (Array.isArray(val) && typeof val[0] === 'string' && isSafeUserFacingText(val[0])) {
        return val[0].trim().slice(0, 220);
      }
      if (typeof val === 'string' && isSafeUserFacingText(val)) {
        return val.trim().slice(0, 220);
      }
    }
  }
  if (anyErr?.response?.status && anyErr.response.status >= 500) {
    return fallback;
  }
  if (typeof anyErr?.message === 'string' && isSafeUserFacingText(anyErr.message) && !anyErr.message.startsWith('Request failed with status')) {
    return anyErr.message.trim().slice(0, 220);
  }
  return fallback;
};

interface StudentMatrixRow {

type MatrixFilterMode = 'ALL' | 'CUTTING' | 'ABSENT';

const normalizeMatrixRows = (rows: unknown): StudentMatrixRow[] =>
  (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : []).map((row: any) => ({
    ...row,
    campus_status: String(row.campus_status || 'Not Seen Yet'),

      case 'CUTTING':

  };

  if (loading && !refreshing) {
    return (
      <div style={{ padding: 48, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>

                  {row.subjects.map((sub) => (

const pillStyle = (bg: string, color: string): React.CSSProperties => ({

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import apiClient, { clearApiClientCache } from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { useSchool } from '../../context/SchoolContext';

import { AttendSureBrandBadge } from '../branding/BrandAssets';

interface AuthPageProps {
  onAuthSuccess?: (session: UserSession) => void;
  onLoginSuccess?: (session: UserSession) => void;
  onBackToShowcase?: () => void;
}

const ALLOWED_WEB_ROLES = new Set(['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'FACULTY_ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD', 'FACULTY']);

const clearPreviousSessionStorage = (): void => {
  const keys = [
    'attendsure_access',
    'attendsure_refresh',
    'attendsure_token',
    'auth_token',
    'token',
    'attendsure_username',
    'attendsure_faculty_name',
    'attendsure_role',
    'attendsure_user_id',
    'attendsure_user_photo',
    'attendsure_can_teach',
  ];
  keys.forEach((k) => localStorage.removeItem(k));
};

export const AuthPage: React.FC<AuthPageProps> = ({ onAuthSuccess, onLoginSuccess, onBackToShowcase }) => {
  const { school, updateSchoolInstantly, refreshSchool } = useSchool();
  const { mode, setThemeMode, tokens, brand, fonts } = useTheme();

  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [capsLockOn, setCapsLockOn] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [focusedField, setFocusedField] = useState<'username' | 'password' | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [cooldownSeconds, setCooldownSeconds] = useState<number>(0);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loginForm, setLoginForm] = useState<LoginPayload>({ username: '', password: '' });

  const usernameInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const loginAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    usernameInputRef.current?.focus();
    return () => {
      loginAbortRef.current?.abort();
      setLoginForm({ username: '', password: '' });
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (cooldownSeconds <= 0) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setCooldownSeconds((prev) => Math.max(0, prev - 1)), 1000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [cooldownSeconds]);

  const handleKeyEvent = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (typeof e.getModifierState === 'function') {
      setCapsLockOn(e.getModifierState('CapsLock'));
    }
  };

  const handleLoginSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (loading || cooldownSeconds > 0) return;

    const cleanUsername = loginForm.username.replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '').trim().slice(0, 100);
    const rawPassword = loginForm.password.replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/g, '').slice(0, 128);

    if (!cleanUsername || !rawPassword) {
      setErrorMsg('Please enter both your username and password.');
      return;
    }

    loginAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    loginAbortRef.current = controller;

    setErrorMsg(null);
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post(
        API_ROUTES.accounts.login,
        {
          username: cleanUsername,
          password: rawPassword,
        },
        { signal: controller.signal }
      );
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

      const data = res.data || {};
      const userObj = data.user || data;
      const role = String(userObj.role || userObj.system_role || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase();

      if (!ALLOWED_WEB_ROLES.has(role)) {
        clearPreviousSessionStorage();
        clearApiClientCache();
        setLoginForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, password: '' }));
        setErrorMsg(
          'Parent accounts sign in on the AttendSure Mobile App. Please use a faculty or admin account here.'
        );
        return;
      }

      const token = String(data.token || data.access || '').trim();
      const access = String(data.access || '').trim();
      const refresh = String(data.refresh || '').trim();
      const username = String(userObj.username || cleanUsername).trim();
      const facultyName = String(userObj.faculty_name || userObj.full_name || username).trim();
      const userId = Number(userObj.id || userObj.user_id || 0);
      const canTeach = Boolean(
        userObj.can_teach || userObj.is_teaching || Number(userObj.assigned_class_count) > 0 || role === 'FACULTY'
      );
      const rawPhoto = (userObj.photo_url || userObj.photo) as string | null | undefined;
      const safeUserPhoto = isSafeImageUrl(rawPhoto) ? rawPhoto! : null;

      clearPreviousSessionStorage();
      clearApiClientCache();

      if (token) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_token', token);
      if (access) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_access', access);
      if (refresh) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_refresh', refresh);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_username', username);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_faculty_name', facultyName);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_role', role);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_can_teach', String(canTeach));
      if (userId) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_id', String(userId));
      if (safeUserPhoto) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_photo', safeUserPhoto);

      if (userObj.school_name || userObj.school_id) {
        updateSchoolInstantly({
          school_name: String(userObj.school_name || ''),
          school_id: String(userObj.school_id || ''),
          school_logo: isSafeImageUrl(userObj.school_logo) ? userObj.school_logo : school.school_logo,
          left_logo: isSafeImageUrl(userObj.left_logo) ? userObj.left_logo : school.left_logo,
          right_logo: isSafeImageUrl(userObj.right_logo) ? userObj.right_logo : school.right_logo,
        });
      }
      refreshSchool().catch(() => {});

      setLoginForm({ username: '', password: '' });

      const session: UserSession = {
        user_id: userId,
        token,
        username,
        faculty_name: facultyName,
        role,
      };

      onAuthSuccess?.(session);
      onLoginSuccess?.(session);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string; response?: { status?: number } };
      if (
        controller.signal.aborted ||
        anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
        anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
        anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
      ) {
        return;
      }
      const status = anyErr?.response?.status;
      if (status === 429) {
        setCooldownSeconds(30);
      }
      setLoginForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, password: '' }));
      setErrorMsg(extractApiError(err, 'Wrong username or password. Please try again.'));
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
  };

    school.school_id?.trim() && school.school_id !== '55555' && school.school_id !== '000000'
      ? school.school_id.trim()
      : '';

    },
    {
      icon: <Smartphone size={16} color="#6ee7b7" />,
      title: 'Campus GPS Check-In',
      desc: 'Faculty verify arrival via on-device facial recognition and campus GPS.',
    },
    {
      icon: <FileSpreadsheet size={16} color="#fcd34d" />,

    {

      desc: 'Instant arrival, cutting, and exit pass push notices.',
    },

  const themeChoices: { value: ThemeMode; title: string; icon: React.ReactNode }[] = [

/**
 * AttendSure - Theme-Adaptive Brand Emblem Badge
 * File: web/src/components/branding/AttendSureBadge.tsx
 */

import React, { memo, useState } from 'react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { sanitizeText, type ThemeMode } from '../../theme/tokens';
import { BRAND_ASSETS } from './BrandAssets';

export interface AttendSureBadgeProps {
  size?: number;
  animate?: boolean;
  shape?: 'circle' | 'squircle';
  mode?: ThemeMode;
  alt?: string;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

const MIN_BADGE_PX = 16;
const MAX_BADGE_PX = 320;

const clampBadgeSize = (rawSize?: number): number => {
  const parsed = Number(rawSize);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return 96;
  return Math.min(MAX_BADGE_PX, Math.max(MIN_BADGE_PX, Math.round(parsed)));
};

export const AttendSureBadge: React.FC<AttendSureBadgeProps> = memo(
  ({
    size = 96,
    animate = false,
    shape = 'circle',
    mode: overrideMode,
    alt = 'AttendSure',
    className,
    style,
  }) => {
    const { mode: contextMode } = useTheme();
    const [imageFailed, setImageFailed] = useState<boolean>(false);

    const activeMode = overrideMode || contextMode;
    const safeSize = clampBadgeSize(size);
    const iconSize = Math.round(safeSize * 0.62);
    const safeAlt = sanitizeText(alt, 60) || 'AttendSure';
    const radiusValue = shape === 'circle' ? '50%' : `${Math.max(8, Math.round(safeSize * 0.26))}px`;

    const borderColor =
      activeMode === 'dark'
        ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.55)'
        : activeMode === 'high-contrast'
        ? '#002b4d'
        : '#cbd5e1';

    const badgeShadow =
      activeMode === 'dark'
        ? '0 8px 24px -4px rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.35), inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff'
        : activeMode === 'high-contrast'
        ? '0 0 0 1.5px #002b4d'
        : '0 8px 22px -4px rgba(0, 75, 135, 0.16), inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff';

    return (
      <div
        className={className}
        role="img"
        aria-label={safeAlt}
        style={{
          width: `${safeSize}px`,
          height: `${safeSize}px`,
          borderRadius: radiusValue,
          background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #f8fafc 100%)',
          borderWidth: activeMode === 'high-contrast' ? 2 : 1.5,
          borderStyle: 'solid',
          borderColor,
          boxShadow: badgeShadow,
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          animation: animate ? 'attendsure-badge-pulse 2.6s ease-in-out infinite' : 'none',
          flexShrink: 0,
          userSelect: 'none',
          boxSizing: 'border-box',
          ...style,
        }}
      >
        {!imageFailed ? (
          <img
            src={BRAND_ASSETS.attendsureLogo}
            alt={safeAlt}
            width={iconSize}
            height={iconSize}
            decoding="async"
            draggable={false}
            onError={() => setImageFailed(true)}
            style={{
              width: `${iconSize}px`,
              height: `${iconSize}px`,
              objectFit: 'contain',
              display: 'block',
            }}
          />
        ) : (
          <svg
            viewBox="0 0 64 64"
            width={iconSize}
            height={iconSize}
            fill="none"
            aria-hidden="true"
          >
            <path d="M32 8L12 52H22.5L32 30.5L41.5 52H52L32 8Z" fill="#004b87" />
            <rect x="14" y="42" width="36" height="10" rx="3" fill="#0284c7" />
          </svg>
        )}

        {animate && (
          <style>{`
            @keyframes attendsure-badge-pulse {
              0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
              50% { transform: scale(1.035); }
            }
            @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
              div[role="img"] { animation: none !important; }
            }
          `}</style>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }
);

AttendSureBadge.displayName = 'AttendSureBadge';

export default AttendSureBadge;

export interface AttendSureBrandBadgeProps {
