export const AttendSureBrandBadge: React.FC<AttendSureBrandBadgeProps> = ({
  size = 40,
  shape = 'squircle',
  mode = 'light',
  style,
}) => {
  const [imgFailed, setImgFailed] = useState(false);
  const innerSize = Math.round(size * 0.58);

    mode === 'dark'
      ? '0 4px 14px rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.28), inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff'
      : mode === 'high-contrast'
      ? 'none'
      : '0 2px 8px rgba(0, 75, 135, 0.12), inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff';

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        borderRadius: radius,
        background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #f8fafc 100%)',
        borderWidth: mode === 'high-contrast' ? 1.5 : 1,
        borderStyle: 'solid',
        borderColor,
        boxShadow: shadow,
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        flexShrink: 0,
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
        ...style,
      }}
    >
      {!imgFailed ? (

import React, { memo, useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { School } from 'lucide-react';
import { useSchool } from '../../context/SchoolContext';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { isSafeImageUrl, sanitizeText } from '../../theme/tokens';

export interface SchoolTenantBadgeProps {
  showDivision?: boolean;
  showSchoolId?: boolean;
  compact?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

const formatDivisionText = (division?: string, region?: string): string => {
  const cleanDivision = sanitizeText(division || '', 80);
  if (cleanDivision) {
    return /division/i.test(cleanDivision) ? cleanDivision : `Division of ${cleanDivision}`;
  }
  return sanitizeText(region || '', 60);
};

export const SchoolTenantBadge: React.FC<SchoolTenantBadgeProps> = memo(
  ({
    showDivision = true,
    showSchoolId = false,
    compact = false,
    className,
    style,
  }) => {
    const { school, loading } = useSchool();
    const { mode, tokens, brand, fonts } = useTheme();

    const [sealFailed, setSealFailed] = useState<boolean>(false);
    const [fallbackFailed, setFallbackFailed] = useState<boolean>(false);

    const safeSchoolLogo = useMemo(
      () => (isSafeImageUrl(school.school_logo) ? school.school_logo : null),
      [school.school_logo]
    );

    useEffect(() => {
      setSealFailed(false);
    }, [safeSchoolLogo]);

    const schoolName = useMemo(() => {
      const cleaned = sanitizeText(school.school_name || '', 120);
      if (cleaned) return cleaned;
      return loading ? 'Loading school...' : 'School Not Configured';
    }, [school.school_name, loading]);

    const divisionLabel = useMemo(
      () => (showDivision ? formatDivisionText(school.division, school.region) : ''),
      [showDivision, school.division, school.region]
    );

    const validSchoolId = useMemo(() => {
      if (!showSchoolId) return '';
      const rawId = sanitizeText(school.school_id || '', 20);
      return rawId && rawId !== '55555' && rawId !== '000000' ? rawId : '';
    }, [showSchoolId, school.school_id]);

    const activeImageSrc =
      safeSchoolLogo && !sealFailed
        ? safeSchoolLogo
        : !fallbackFailed
        ? BRAND_ASSETS.attendsureLogo
        : null;

    const sealBoxSize = compact ? 22 : 26;
    const sealImgSize = compact ? 16 : 20;

    return (
      <div
        className={className}

          divisionLabel

            : schoolName
        }

          padding: compact ? '4px 11px 4px 6px' : '5px 14px 5px 7px',
          maxWidth: '100%',

          borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
          borderRadius: 9999,

          fontFamily: fonts.sans,

          style={{
            width: sealBoxSize,
            height: sealBoxSize,
            borderRadius: '50%',
            backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderStyle: 'solid',
            borderColor: mode === 'dark' ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45)' : '#e2e8f0',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            overflow: 'hidden',

                display: 'block',

/**

import React, { memo } from 'react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { sanitizeText } from '../../theme/tokens';

export interface TechBlazerSignatureProps {
  size?: number;
  textColor?: string;
  label?: string;
  layout?: 'stacked' | 'inline';
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

const MIN_ICON_PX = 14;
const MAX_ICON_PX = 96;

const clampIconSize = (rawSize?: number): number => {
  const parsed = Number(rawSize);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return 20;
  return Math.min(MAX_ICON_PX, Math.max(MIN_ICON_PX, Math.round(parsed)));
};

const isSafeCssColor = (value?: string): boolean => {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'string') return false;
  const clean = value.trim();
  return (
    /^#([0-9a-fA-F]{3}|[0-9a-fA-F]{6}|[0-9a-fA-F]{8})$/.test(clean) ||
    /^(rgb|rgba|hsl|hsla)\([0-9.,%\s/]+\)$/.test(clean) ||
    /^var\(--[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+(?:\s*,\s*#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8})?\)$/.test(clean)
  );
};

export const TechBlazerSignature: React.FC<TechBlazerSignatureProps> = memo(

    const safeSize = clampIconSize(size);
    const tileSize = Math.round(safeSize * 1.35);
    const wordmarkFontPx = Math.max(11, Math.round(safeSize * 0.88));
    const safeLabel = sanitizeText(label, 24);
    const resolvedTextColor = isSafeCssColor(textColor) ? textColor!.trim() : tokens.textPrimary;

    const tileBorderColor =
      mode === 'dark'
        ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45)'
        : mode === 'high-contrast'
        ? '#002b4d'

    return (
      <div

        aria-label={`${safeLabel ? `${safeLabel} ` : ''}TECHBLAZER`}

          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          gap: layout === 'inline' ? 7 : 4,
          userSelect: 'none',
          boxSizing: 'border-box',
          ...style,
        }}
      >
        {safeLabel && (
          <span
            style={{
              fontFamily: fonts.sans,
              fontSize: '0.72rem',
              color: tokens.textMuted,
              letterSpacing: '0.04em',
              fontWeight: 600,
              textTransform: 'lowercase',
              lineHeight: 1.2,
            }}
          >
            {safeLabel}
          </span>
        )}

        <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7 }}>
          <div
            style={{

/**
 * AttendSure - Fault Isolation Error Boundary
 * File: web/src/components/common/ErrorBoundary.tsx
 *
 * Prevents isolated page issues from crashing the entire web portal.
 */

import React, { Component } from 'react';
import type { ErrorInfo, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle, RefreshCw, Copy, Check, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';

export interface ErrorBoundaryProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  featureName?: string;
  fallback?: ReactNode | ((props: { error: Error; resetError: () => void }) => ReactNode);
  onReset?: () => void;
  onError?: (error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) => void;
  resetKeys?: unknown[];
}

interface State {
  hasError: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
  errorInfo: ErrorInfo | null;
  copied: boolean;
  showDetails: boolean;
}

const IS_DEV = Boolean(import.meta.env.DEV);

export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<ErrorBoundaryProps, State> {
  private copyTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

  public state: State = {
    hasError: false,
    error: null,
    errorInfo: null,
    copied: false,
    showDetails: false,
  };

  public static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): Partial<State> {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  public componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
    this.setState({ errorInfo });
    this.props.onError?.(error, errorInfo);
  }

  public componentDidUpdate(prevProps: ErrorBoundaryProps) {
    if (!this.state.hasError) return;

    if (this.props.resetKeys && prevProps.resetKeys) {
      const hasChanged = this.props.resetKeys.some(
        (key, index) => key !== prevProps.resetKeys?.[index]
      );
      if (hasChanged) {
        this.handleReset();
      }
    }
  }

  public componentWillUnmount() {
    if (this.copyTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.copyTimer);
      this.copyTimer = null;
    }
  }

  private handleReset = () => {
    this.props.onReset?.();
    this.setState({
      hasError: false,
      error: null,
      errorInfo: null,
      copied: false,
      showDetails: false,
    });
  };

  private handleCopyDiagnostic = async () => {
    const lines = [
      `Feature: ${this.props.featureName || 'Application Section'}`,
      `Time: ${new Date().toISOString()}`,
      `Error: ${this.state.error?.name || 'Error'}`,
    ];
    if (IS_DEV) {
      lines.push(`Message: ${this.state.error?.message || ''}`);
      lines.push(`Stack: ${this.state.error?.stack || 'None'}`);
    }
    const errorText = lines.join('\n');

    let success = false;
    if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(errorText);
        success = true;
      } catch {
        success = false;
      }
    }

    if (!success) {
      try {
        const textArea = document.createElement('textarea');
        textArea.value = errorText;
        textArea.style.position = 'fixed';
        textArea.style.left = '-999999px';
        textArea.style.top = '-999999px';
        document.body.appendChild(textArea);
        textArea.focus();
        textArea.select();
        success = document.execCommand('copy');
        textArea.remove();
      } catch {
        success = false;
      }
    }

    if (success) {
      this.setState({ copied: true });
      if (this.copyTimer) clearTimeout(this.copyTimer);
      this.copyTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        this.setState({ copied: false });
        this.copyTimer = null;
      }, 2500);
    }
  };

  public render() {
    if (this.state.hasError && this.state.error) {
      if (typeof this.props.fallback === 'function') {
        return this.props.fallback({
          error: this.state.error,
          resetError: this.handleReset,
        });
      }

      if (this.props.fallback) {
        return this.props.fallback;
      }

      const featureTitle = this.props.featureName || 'Section';

      return (
        <div style={errorContainerStyle}>
          <div style={errorCardStyle}>
            <div style={iconBadgeStyle}>
              <AlertTriangle size={24} color="var(--danger, #dc2626)" />
            </div>

            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', width: '100%' }}>
              <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 6px 0', fontSize: '1.05rem', fontWeight: 800, color: 'var(--text-primary, #0f172a)' }}>
                {featureTitle} Temporarily Unavailable
              </h3>
              <p style={{ margin: '0 0 14px 0', fontSize: '0.82rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary, #64748b)', lineHeight: 1.45 }}>
                A temporary problem occurred while displaying this section. Other AttendSure tabs, classroom QR scanning, and background tasks are still running normally.
              </p>

              {IS_DEV && (
                <div style={debugCodeStyle}>
                  {this.state.error.message || 'Unexpected rendering error.'}
                </div>
              )}

              {IS_DEV && this.state.showDetails && (
                <div style={stackTraceContainerStyle}>
                  <pre style={stackTracePreStyle}>
                    {this.state.error.stack || 'No extended details available.'}
                    {this.state.errorInfo?.componentStack || ''}
                  </pre>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div style={actionsRowStyle}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={this.handleReset}
                style={primaryBtnStyle}
              >
                <RefreshCw size={14} />
                <span>Try Again</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={this.handleCopyDiagnostic}
                style={secondaryBtnStyle}
                title="Copy report reference"
              >
                {this.state.copied ? <Check size={14} color="var(--success, #059669)" /> : <Copy size={14} />}
                <span>{this.state.copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy Details'}</span>
              </button>

              {IS_DEV && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => this.setState((prev) => ({ showDetails: !prev.showDetails }))}
                  style={secondaryBtnStyle}
                >
                  <span>{this.state.showDetails ? 'Hide Details' : 'Details'}</span>
                </button>
              )}

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
                style={secondaryBtnStyle}
                title="Reload the page"
              >
                <RotateCcw size={14} />
                <span>Reload</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

export default ErrorBoundary;

const errorContainerStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  display: 'flex',
  alignItems: 'center',
  justifyContent: 'center',
  width: '100%',
  minHeight: '280px',
  padding: '24px 16px',
  boxSizing: 'border-box',
  backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-app, #f8fafc)',
};

      initialConfigRef.current = snapshot;
      setDraft(snapshot);
      setSetAsDefault(false);
    }
    wasOpenRef.current = isOpen;
  }, [isOpen, currentConfig]);

    (newDraft: PageSetupConfig) => {
      const standardizedDraft: PageSetupConfig = {
        ...newDraft,
        headerRepeat: 'first_page_only',
      };
      setDraft(standardizedDraft);
      onLiveChange?.(standardizedDraft);
    },
    [onLiveChange]
  );

  const handleCancel = useCallback(() => {
    onLiveChange?.(initialConfigRef.current);
    onClose();
  }, [onLiveChange, onClose]);

    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        handleCancel();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, handleCancel]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  };

    updateDraft({ ...draft, layoutMode });
  };

  const handlePaperSizeChange = (paperSize: PaperSizeKey) => {

      },
    });
  };

      ...initialConfigRef.current,

/**
 * AttendSure - Reusable Server Pagination Bar & Safe CSV Exporter
 * File: web/src/components/common/Pagination.tsx
 *
 * Cybersecurity & Stability Hardening:
 * 1. OWASP CSV Formula Injection Defense: Neutralizes cells starting with =, +, -, @, |, \t, \r.
 * 2. Asynchronous Memory Cleanup: Delays URL.revokeObjectURL by 1s to prevent premature download aborts.
 * 3. Strict Numeric Math: shields against NaN / divide-by-zero during rapid page size switching.
 * 4. WCAG Accessible Controls: Adds aria-label descriptors to all buttons and select inputs.
 */

import React, { useId } from 'react';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, ChevronsLeft, ChevronsRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';

/** Safe upper ceiling representing "All" records without exhausting server RAM */
export const ALL_ROWS_SIZE = 10000;

export const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS: number[] = [
  25,
  50,
  100,
  250,
  500,
  1000,
  ALL_ROWS_SIZE,
];

/**
 * Cybersecurity Helper: Sanitizes cell values to prevent CSV Formula / DDE Injection
 * in Microsoft Excel, LibreOffice, and Google Sheets.
 * Blocks: =, +, -, @, |, \t, \r
 */
export const sanitizeCsvCell = (val: string | number | boolean | undefined | null): string => {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '""';
  
  // Escape internal double quotes by doubling them per RFC 4180
  const clean = String(val).replace(/"/g, '""').trim();
  
  // Neutralize formula trigger characters with a leading single quote
  if (/^[=+\-@\t\r|]/.test(clean)) {
    return `"'${clean}"`;
  }
  
  return `"${clean}"`;
};

/**
 * Reusable CSV Downloader for any table module.
 * Embeds UTF-8 BOM (\uFEFF) for proper display of special characters in Excel.
 */
export const exportToCsv = (
  filename: string,
  headers: string[],
  rows: (string | number | boolean | undefined | null)[][]
): boolean => {
  if (!rows || rows.length === 0) return false;

  const csvLines = [
    headers.map((h) => sanitizeCsvCell(h)).join(','),
    ...rows.map((row) => row.map((cell) => sanitizeCsvCell(cell)).join(',')),
  ];

  // UTF-8 BOM prefix ensures correct rendering in Excel
  const csvContent = '\uFEFF' + csvLines.join('\r\n');
  const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = url;
  link.download = filename.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv') ? filename : `${filename}.csv`;
  link.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);

  // Defer revocation by 1 second to ensure browser has completed file stream
  setTimeout(() => {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, 1000);

  return true;
};

}

export const Pagination: React.FC<PaginationProps> = ({

  totalCount,
  pageSize,
  onPageChange,
  onPageSizeChange,
  pageSizeOptions = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS,
  itemLabel = 'records',
  disabled = false,
  className,
  style,
}) => {
  const selectId = useId();
  const { tokens } = useTheme();

  if (totalCount <= 0) return null;

  // Defensive Numeric shields
  const safePageSize = Math.max(1, Number(pageSize) || 25);
  const isAllSelected = safePageSize >= ALL_ROWS_SIZE;
  const safeTotalPages = isAllSelected ? 1 : Math.max(1, Number(totalPages) || 1);
  const safeCurrentPage = isAllSelected
    ? 1
    : Math.min(Math.max(1, Number(currentPage) || 1), safeTotalPages);

  const startRecord = isAllSelected ? 1 : (safeCurrentPage - 1) * safePageSize + 1;
  const endRecord = isAllSelected ? totalCount : Math.min(safeCurrentPage * safePageSize, totalCount);

  const isPrevDisabled = disabled || isAllSelected || safeCurrentPage <= 1;
  const isNextDisabled = disabled || isAllSelected || safeCurrentPage >= safeTotalPages;

  const containerStyle: React.CSSProperties = {

/**
 * AttendSure - Zero-Dependency Local QR Code SVG Generator (ISO/IEC 18004)
 * File: web/src/components/common/QrCodeSvg.tsx
 *
 * Generates standard Byte-mode QR codes (Versions 1-10, Error Correction Level L)
 * completely inside the browser so signed student and faculty QR codes work
 * offline and never transmit sensitive tokens to external third-party servers.
 */

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';

type BlockGroup = readonly [blocks: number, dataCodewords: number, ecCodewords: number];

interface VersionSpec {
  version: number;
  maxBytes: number;
  totalData: number;
  groups: readonly BlockGroup[];
  alignment: readonly number[];
}

const VERSION_SPECS: readonly VersionSpec[] = [
  { version: 1, maxBytes: 17, totalData: 19, groups: [[1, 19, 7]], alignment: [] },
  { version: 2, maxBytes: 32, totalData: 34, groups: [[1, 34, 10]], alignment: [6, 18] },
  { version: 3, maxBytes: 53, totalData: 55, groups: [[1, 55, 15]], alignment: [6, 22] },
  { version: 4, maxBytes: 78, totalData: 80, groups: [[1, 80, 20]], alignment: [6, 26] },
  { version: 5, maxBytes: 106, totalData: 108, groups: [[1, 108, 26]], alignment: [6, 30] },
  { version: 6, maxBytes: 134, totalData: 136, groups: [[2, 68, 18]], alignment: [6, 34] },
  { version: 7, maxBytes: 154, totalData: 156, groups: [[2, 78, 20]], alignment: [6, 22, 38] },
  { version: 8, maxBytes: 192, totalData: 194, groups: [[2, 97, 24]], alignment: [6, 24, 42] },
  { version: 9, maxBytes: 230, totalData: 232, groups: [[2, 116, 30]], alignment: [6, 26, 46] },
  { version: 10, maxBytes: 271, totalData: 274, groups: [[2, 68, 18], [2, 69, 18]], alignment: [6, 28, 50] },
];

const GF_EXP = new Uint8Array(512);
const GF_LOG = new Uint8Array(256);

(() => {
  let x = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 255; i++) {
    GF_EXP[i] = x;
    GF_LOG[x] = i;
    x <<= 1;
    if (x & 0x100) x ^= 0x11d;
  }
  for (let i = 255; i < 512; i++) {
    GF_EXP[i] = GF_EXP[i - 255];
  }
})();

const gfMul = (a: number, b: number): number => {
  if (a === 0 || b === 0) return 0;
  return GF_EXP[GF_LOG[a] + GF_LOG[b]];
};

const rsGeneratorPoly = (degree: number): Uint8Array => {
  let poly = new Uint8Array([1]);
  for (let i = 0; i < degree; i++) {
    const next = new Uint8Array(poly.length + 1);
    const factor = GF_EXP[i];
    for (let j = 0; j < poly.length; j++) {
      next[j] ^= poly[j];
      next[j + 1] ^= gfMul(poly[j], factor);
    }
    poly = next;
  }
  return poly;
};

const rsComputeEc = (data: Uint8Array, ecCount: number): Uint8Array => {
  const gen = rsGeneratorPoly(ecCount);
  const rem = new Uint8Array(ecCount);
  for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
    const factor = data[i] ^ rem[0];
    rem.copyWithin(0, 1);
    rem[ecCount - 1] = 0;
    if (factor !== 0) {
      for (let j = 0; j < ecCount; j++) {
        rem[j] ^= gfMul(gen[j + 1], factor);
      }
    }
  }
  return rem;
};

const computeFormatBits = (mask: number): number => {
  const data = (0b01 << 3) | (mask & 0b111); // ECC Level L = 01
  let rem = data << 10;
  for (let i = 14; i >= 10; i--) {
    if ((rem >> i) & 1) rem ^= 0x537 << (i - 10);
  }
  return ((data << 10) | rem) ^ 0x5412;
};

const computeVersionBits = (version: number): number => {
  let rem = version << 12;
  for (let i = 17; i >= 12; i--) {
    if ((rem >> i) & 1) rem ^= 0x1f25 << (i - 12);
  }
  return (version << 12) | rem;
};

const applyMaskCheck = (mask: number, r: number, c: number): boolean => {
  switch (mask) {
    case 0: return (r + c) % 2 === 0;
    case 1: return r % 2 === 0;
    case 2: return c % 3 === 0;
    case 3: return (r + c) % 3 === 0;
    case 4: return (Math.floor(r / 2) + Math.floor(c / 3)) % 2 === 0;
    case 5: return ((r * c) % 2) + ((r * c) % 3) === 0;
    case 6: return (((r * c) % 2) + ((r * c) % 3)) % 2 === 0;
    default: return (((r + c) % 2) + ((r * c) % 3)) % 2 === 0;
  }
};

const writeFormatBits = (grid: boolean[][], size: number, mask: number) => {
  const bits = computeFormatBits(mask);
  const topLeftCoords: Array<[number, number]> = [
    [8, 0], [8, 1], [8, 2], [8, 3], [8, 4], [8, 5], [8, 7], [8, 8],
    [7, 8], [5, 8], [4, 8], [3, 8], [2, 8], [1, 8], [0, 8],
  ];
  const splitCoords: Array<[number, number]> = [
    [size - 1, 8], [size - 2, 8], [size - 3, 8], [size - 4, 8],
    [size - 5, 8], [size - 6, 8], [size - 7, 8],
    [8, size - 8], [8, size - 7], [8, size - 6], [8, size - 5],
    [8, size - 4], [8, size - 3], [8, size - 2], [8, size - 1],
  ];
  for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
    const dark = Boolean((bits >> (14 - i)) & 1);
    const [r1, c1] = topLeftCoords[i];
    const [r2, c2] = splitCoords[i];
    grid[r1][c1] = dark;
    grid[r2][c2] = dark;
  }
};

const scoreGrid = (grid: boolean[][], size: number): number => {
  let penalty = 0;
  let darkCount = 0;

  for (let r = 0; r < size; r++) {
    let rowRun = 1;
    let colRun = 1;
    for (let c = 0; c < size; c++) {
      if (grid[r][c]) darkCount++;
      if (c > 0) {
        if (grid[r][c] === grid[r][c - 1]) rowRun++;
        else {
          if (rowRun >= 5) penalty += 3 + (rowRun - 5);
          rowRun = 1;
        }
        if (grid[c][r] === grid[c - 1][r]) colRun++;
        else {
          if (colRun >= 5) penalty += 3 + (colRun - 5);
          colRun = 1;
        }
      }
      if (r < size - 1 && c < size - 1) {
        const v = grid[r][c];
        if (v === grid[r][c + 1] && v === grid[r + 1][c] && v === grid[r + 1][c + 1]) {
          penalty += 3;
        }
      }
    }
    if (rowRun >= 5) penalty += 3 + (rowRun - 5);
    if (colRun >= 5) penalty += 3 + (colRun - 5);
  }

  const ratio = (darkCount * 100) / (size * size);
  penalty += Math.floor(Math.abs(ratio - 50) / 5) * 10;
  return penalty;
};

export function generateQrMatrix(rawValue: string): boolean[][] {
  const input = (rawValue || '').trim() || 'ATTENDSURE';
  const encoded = new TextEncoder().encode(input);
  const payloadBytes = encoded.length > 271 ? encoded.slice(0, 271) : encoded;

  const spec =
    VERSION_SPECS.find((s) => payloadBytes.length <= s.maxBytes) ||
    VERSION_SPECS[VERSION_SPECS.length - 1];

  // Build data codeword bit stream (Byte mode 0100)
  const bits: number[] = [];
  const pushBits = (val: number, len: number) => {
    for (let i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--) bits.push((val >> i) & 1);
  };

  pushBits(0b0100, 4);
  pushBits(payloadBytes.length, spec.version >= 10 ? 16 : 8);
  for (let i = 0; i < payloadBytes.length; i++) pushBits(payloadBytes[i], 8);

  const totalDataBits = spec.totalData * 8;
  const termBits = Math.min(4, totalDataBits - bits.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < termBits; i++) bits.push(0);
  while (bits.length % 8 !== 0) bits.push(0);

  const dataBytes = new Uint8Array(spec.totalData);
  let byteIdx = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < bits.length; i += 8) {
    let b = 0;
    for (let j = 0; j < 8; j++) b = (b << 1) | bits[i + j];
    dataBytes[byteIdx++] = b;
  }
  let padToggle = 0;
  while (byteIdx < spec.totalData) {
    dataBytes[byteIdx++] = padToggle === 0 ? 0xec : 0x11;
    padToggle ^= 1;
  }

  // Split blocks & compute Reed-Solomon error correction
  const dataBlocks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  const ecBlocks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let offset = 0;
  for (const [blockCount, dataLen, ecLen] of spec.groups) {
    for (let b = 0; b < blockCount; b++) {
      const slice = dataBytes.slice(offset, offset + dataLen);
      offset += dataLen;
      dataBlocks.push(slice);
      ecBlocks.push(rsComputeEc(slice, ecLen));
    }
  }

  const maxDataLen = Math.max(...dataBlocks.map((b) => b.length));
  const ecLen = ecBlocks[0].length;
  const finalBytes: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < maxDataLen; i++) {
    for (const blk of dataBlocks) {
      if (i < blk.length) finalBytes.push(blk[i]);
    }
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < ecLen; i++) {
    for (const ec of ecBlocks) finalBytes.push(ec[i]);
  }

  const finalBits: boolean[] = [];
  for (const byteVal of finalBytes) {
    for (let i = 7; i >= 0; i--) finalBits.push(Boolean((byteVal >> i) & 1));
  }

  const size = spec.version * 4 + 17;
  const baseGrid: boolean[][] = Array.from({ length: size }, () => Array<boolean>(size).fill(false));
  const isFunc: boolean[][] = Array.from({ length: size }, () => Array<boolean>(size).fill(false));

  const setFunc = (r: number, c: number, dark: boolean) => {
    if (r < 0 || c < 0 || r >= size || c >= size) return;
    baseGrid[r][c] = dark;
    isFunc[r][c] = true;
  };

  // 1. Finder patterns + white separators
  const placeFinder = (top: number, left: number) => {
    for (let dr = -1; dr <= 7; dr++) {
      for (let dc = -1; dc <= 7; dc++) {
        const r = top + dr;
        const c = left + dc;
        if (r < 0 || c < 0 || r >= size || c >= size) continue;
        const inOuter = dr >= 0 && dr <= 6 && dc >= 0 && dc <= 6;
        const onOuterBorder = dr === 0 || dr === 6 || dc === 0 || dc === 6;
        const inCore = dr >= 2 && dr <= 4 && dc >= 2 && dc <= 4;
        setFunc(r, c, inOuter && (onOuterBorder || inCore));
      }
    }
  };
  placeFinder(0, 0);
  placeFinder(0, size - 7);
  placeFinder(size - 7, 0);

  // 2. Alignment patterns
  for (const rCenter of spec.alignment) {
    for (const cCenter of spec.alignment) {
      if (isFunc[rCenter][cCenter]) continue;
      for (let dr = -2; dr <= 2; dr++) {
        for (let dc = -2; dc <= 2; dc++) {
          const dist = Math.max(Math.abs(dr), Math.abs(dc));
          setFunc(rCenter + dr, cCenter + dc, dist === 0 || dist === 2);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // 3. Timing patterns
  for (let i = 8; i < size - 8; i++) {
    const dark = i % 2 === 0;
    if (!isFunc[6][i]) setFunc(6, i, dark);
    if (!isFunc[i][6]) setFunc(i, 6, dark);
  }

  // 4. Always-dark module + format info reservation
  setFunc(4 * spec.version + 9, 8, true);
  for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
    if (!isFunc[8][i]) setFunc(8, i, false);
    if (!isFunc[i][8]) setFunc(i, 8, false);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    setFunc(8, size - 1 - i, false);
    if (i < 7) setFunc(size - 1 - i, 8, false);
  }

  // 5. Version info blocks (v7+)
  if (spec.version >= 7) {
    const vBits = computeVersionBits(spec.version);
    for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
      const dark = Boolean((vBits >> i) & 1);
      const a = Math.floor(i / 3);
      const b = i % 3;
      setFunc(a, size - 11 + b, dark);
      setFunc(size - 11 + b, a, dark);
    }
  }

  // 6. Zig-zag data bit placement
  let bitIdx = 0;
  let upward = true;
  for (let col = size - 1; col >= 1; col -= 2) {
    if (col === 6) col = 5;
    for (let step = 0; step < size; step++) {
      const row = upward ? size - 1 - step : step;
      for (let dc = 0; dc < 2; dc++) {
        const c = col - dc;
        if (!isFunc[row][c]) {
          baseGrid[row][c] = bitIdx < finalBits.length ? finalBits[bitIdx] : false;
          bitIdx++;
        }
      }
    }
    upward = !upward;
  }

  // 7. Pick optimal mask (0..7)
  let bestGrid = baseGrid;
  let bestPenalty = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  for (let mask = 0; mask < 8; mask++) {
    const candidate = baseGrid.map((row, r) =>
      row.map((val, c) => (isFunc[r][c] ? val : applyMaskCheck(mask, r, c) ? !val : val))
    );
    writeFormatBits(candidate, size, mask);
    const penalty = scoreGrid(candidate, size);
    if (penalty < bestPenalty) {
      bestPenalty = penalty;
      bestGrid = candidate;
    }
  }

  return bestGrid;
}

export function buildQrSvgPath(matrix: boolean[][], quietZone = 4): { viewBoxSize: number; path: string } {
  const size = matrix.length;
  const parts: string[] = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < size; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < size; c++) {
      if (matrix[r][c]) {
        parts.push(`M${c + quietZone},${r + quietZone}h1v1h-1z`);
      }
    }
  }
  return { viewBoxSize: size + quietZone * 2, path: parts.join('') };
}

export function buildQrSvgDataUri(value: string, size = 180): string {
  const matrix = generateQrMatrix(value);
  const { viewBoxSize, path } = buildQrSvgPath(matrix, 4);
  const svg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${size}" height="${size}" viewBox="0 0 ${viewBoxSize} ${viewBoxSize}" shape-rendering="crispEdges"><rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="${path}" fill="#0f172a"/></svg>`;
  return `data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}`;
}

export interface QrCodeSvgProps {
  value: string;
  size?: number;
  label?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

export const QrCodeSvg: React.FC<QrCodeSvgProps> = ({
  value,
  size = 180,
  label = 'AttendSure QR code',
  style,
}) => {
  const { viewBoxSize, path } = useMemo(() => {
    const matrix = generateQrMatrix(value);
    return buildQrSvgPath(matrix, 4);
  }, [value]);

  return (
    <svg
      width={size}
      height={size}
      viewBox={`0 0 ${viewBoxSize} ${viewBoxSize}`}
      shapeRendering="crispEdges"
      role="img"
      aria-label={label}
      style={{
        display: 'block',
        backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
        borderRadius: 6,
        ...style,
      }}
    >
      <rect width={viewBoxSize} height={viewBoxSize} fill="#ffffff" />
      <path d={path} fill="#0f172a" />
    </svg>
  );
};

export default QrCodeSvg;

/**
 * AttendSure - Reusable Metric Summary Card
 * Replaces duplicate statistic cards across Faculty, Attendance Logs, and Classes tabs.
 * File: web/src/components/common/StatsCard.tsx
 */

/**
 * AttendSure - Reusable Status Badge
 * Replaces hardcoded status pills for Attendance, Direction, and Account states.
 * File: web/src/components/common/StatusBadge.tsx
 */

import React from 'react';
import { LogIn, LogOut, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, XCircle, Clock } from 'lucide-react';

interface StatusBadgeProps {
  status: string;
  type?: 'DIRECTION' | 'ATTENDANCE' | 'ACTIVE' | 'GENERIC';
}

export const StatusBadge: React.FC<StatusBadgeProps> = ({ status, type = 'GENERIC' }) => {
  const s = String(status || '').toUpperCase();

  let bg = 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.12)';
  let text = 'var(--text-secondary, #64748b)';
  let border = 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.25)';
  let icon: React.ReactNode = null;

  if (type === 'DIRECTION' || s === 'IN' || s === 'OUT') {
    if (s === 'IN') {
      bg = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)';
      text = 'var(--brand-success, #10B981)';
      border = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.28)';
      icon = <LogIn size={11} />;
    } else {
      bg = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)';
      text = 'var(--brand-danger, #EF4444)';
      border = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.28)';
      icon = <LogOut size={11} />;
    }
  } else if (type === 'ACTIVE' || s === 'ACTIVE' || s === 'INACTIVE') {
    if (s === 'ACTIVE') {
      bg = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)';
      text = 'var(--brand-success, #10B981)';
      border = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.28)';
      icon = <CheckCircle2 size={11} />;
    } else {
      bg = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)';
      text = 'var(--brand-danger, #EF4444)';
      border = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.28)';
      icon = <XCircle size={11} />;
    }
  } else if (type === 'ATTENDANCE' || ['PRESENT', 'LATE', 'ABSENT', 'CUTTING'].includes(s)) {
    if (s === 'PRESENT') {
      bg = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)';
      text = 'var(--brand-success, #10B981)';
      border = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.28)';
    } else if (s === 'LATE' || s === 'TARDY') {
      bg = 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12)';
      text = 'var(--brand-warning, #F59E0B)';
      border = 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.28)';
      icon = <Clock size={11} />;
    } else {
      bg = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)';
      text = 'var(--brand-danger, #EF4444)';
      border = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.28)';
      icon = <AlertTriangle size={11} />;
    }
  }

  return (
    <span
      style={{
        display: 'inline-flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: 4,
        padding: '3px 8px',
        borderRadius: 6,
        fontSize: '0.68rem',
        fontWeight: 800,
        backgroundColor: bg,
        color: text,
        border: `1px solid ${border}`,
        letterSpacing: '0.2px',
      }}
    >
      {icon}
      <span>{s}</span>
    </span>
  );
};

export default StatusBadge;

/**
 * AttendSure - Instant-Hydrating School Dashboard
 * File: web/src/components/dashboard/DashboardView.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import apiClient, { peekApiCache, subscribeApiCache } from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { useCompliance } from '../../context/ComplianceContext';
import { StatsCard } from '../common/StatsCard';
import {
  UserCheck,
  UserX,
  Clock,
  Globe,
  Radio,
  RefreshCw,
  Scan,
  TrendingUp,
  Inbox,
  Database,
  Ticket,
  CalendarCheck,
  Send,
  Users,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Bell,
  Sparkles,
  QrCode,
  BookOpen,
} from 'lucide-react';

interface DashboardViewProps {
  isServerOnline?: boolean;
  userRole?: string;
  onStatusChange?: (online: boolean) => void;
  onManualRefresh?: () => void;
  onNavigateTab?: (tab: string, report?: string) => void;
}

interface HourlyBar {
  hour: string;
  count: number;
  height: number;
  is_peak: boolean;
}

interface RecentScanItem {
  person_name: string;
  grade_section: string;
  scan_time: string;
}

interface NoticeItem {
  id: number | string;
  title: string;
  details: string;
}

interface DashboardState {
  total_students: number;
  students_present: number;
  students_absent: number;
  attendance_rate: number;
  faculty_on_duty: number;
  total_faculty: number;
  classroom_scans_today: number;
  active_exit_passes: number;
  push_alerts_today: number;
  mobile_parents_connected: number;
  hourly_scans: HourlyBar[];
  recent_scans: RecentScanItem[];
  notices: NoticeItem[];
}

const EMPTY_DASHBOARD: DashboardState = {
  total_students: 0,
  students_present: 0,
  students_absent: 0,
  attendance_rate: 0,
  faculty_on_duty: 0,
  total_faculty: 0,
  classroom_scans_today: 0,
  active_exit_passes: 0,
  push_alerts_today: 0,
  mobile_parents_connected: 0,
  hourly_scans: [],
  recent_scans: [],
  notices: [],
};

const normalizeDashboardPayload = (d: Record<string, any> | undefined): DashboardState => {
  if (!d) return EMPTY_DASHBOARD;
  const total = Number(d.total_students) || 0;
  const present = Number(d.students_present) || 0;
  const rawHourly = Array.isArray(d.hourly_scans) ? d.hourly_scans : [];
  const maxCount = Math.max(...rawHourly.map((h: any) => Number(h.count) || 0), 1);

  return {
    total_students: total,
    students_present: present,
    students_absent: Number(d.students_absent) || Math.max(0, total - present),
    attendance_rate: total > 0 ? Math.round((present / total) * 100) : Number(d.attendance_rate) || 0,
    faculty_on_duty: Number(d.faculty_on_duty) || 0,
    total_faculty: Number(d.total_faculty) || 0,
    classroom_scans_today: Number(d.classroom_scans_today ?? d.gate_scans_today) || 0,
    active_exit_passes: Number(d.active_exit_passes ?? d.active_gate_passes) || 0,
    push_alerts_today: Number(d.push_alerts_today ?? d.push_sent_today) || 0,
    mobile_parents_connected: Number(d.mobile_parents_connected) || 0,
    hourly_scans: rawHourly.map((h: any) => {
      const c = Number(h.count) || 0;
      return {
        hour: String(h.hour || ''),
        count: c,
        height: c > 0 ? Math.round((c / maxCount) * 100) : 0,
        is_peak: Boolean(h.is_peak),
      };
    }),
    recent_scans: Array.isArray(d.recent_scans) ? d.recent_scans : [],
    notices: Array.isArray(d.notices) ? d.notices : [],
  };
};

export const DashboardView: React.FC<DashboardViewProps> = ({
  isServerOnline = true,
  userRole,
  onStatusChange,
  onManualRefresh,
  onNavigateTab,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand, fonts, ui } = useTheme();
  const { term } = useCompliance();

  const warmPayload = useMemo(
    () => peekApiCache<Record<string, any>>(API_ROUTES.reports.dashboard),
    []
  );

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => warmPayload === undefined);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [lastSyncTime, setLastSyncTime] = useState<string>(() =>
    warmPayload ? new Date().toLocaleTimeString() : ''
  );
  const [fetchFailed, setFetchFailed] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [calendarDate, setCalendarDate] = useState<Date>(() => new Date());
  const [data, setData] = useState<DashboardState>(() =>
    normalizeDashboardPayload(warmPayload)
  );

  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const role = (userRole || localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase();
  const isAdmin = ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'FACULTY_ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL'].includes(role);
  const isFaculty = role === 'FACULTY';
  const isOnline = isServerOnline && !fetchFailed;

  useEffect(() => {
    return subscribeApiCache(API_ROUTES.reports.dashboard, undefined, (freshRaw) => {
      setData(normalizeDashboardPayload(freshRaw as Record<string, any>));
      setLastSyncTime(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
      setLoading(false);
    });
  }, []);

  const navigateTo = (tab: string, report?: string) => {
    if (onNavigateTab) {
      onNavigateTab(tab, report);
      return;
    }
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('attendsure:navigate', { detail: report ? { tab, report } : tab }));
  };

  const fetchDashboardData = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      try {
        if (!silent) setRefreshing(true);
        const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.reports.dashboard, {
          params: {
            silent: silent ? '1' : undefined,
            ...(bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : {}),
          },
          signal: controller.signal,
        });

        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        if (res.data) {
          setFetchFailed(false);
          setData(normalizeDashboardPayload(res.data));
          setLastSyncTime(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
          onStatusChange?.(true);
        }
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (
          controller.signal.aborted ||
          anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
          anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
          anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
        ) {
          return;
        }
        setFetchFailed(true);
        onStatusChange?.(false);
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [onStatusChange]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchDashboardData(warmPayload !== undefined, false);
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        void fetchDashboardData(true, true);
      }
    }, 20000);
    return () => {
      clearInterval(timer);
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchDashboardData, warmPayload]);

  const calendarDays = useMemo(() => {
    const y = calendarDate.getFullYear();
    const m = calendarDate.getMonth();
    const firstDay = new Date(y, m, 1).getDay();
    const totalDays = new Date(y, m + 1, 0).getDate();
    const now = new Date();
    return [
      ...Array.from({ length: firstDay }, () => ({ day: null as number | null, isToday: false })),
      ...Array.from({ length: totalDays }, (_, i) => ({
        day: i + 1,
        isToday: now.getFullYear() === y && now.getMonth() === m && now.getDate() === i + 1,
      })),
    ];
  }, [calendarDate]);

  const quickActions = [
    { label: 'UN SDG Impact & Safety', desc: 'Early-warning, Ed-Fi & Roll-Call', icon: <Globe size={19} />, onClick: () => navigateTo('impact') },
    { label: 'QR Scanner', desc: 'Scan signed student QR ID card', icon: <QrCode size={19} />, onClick: () => navigateTo('classroom-scanner') },
    { label: isFaculty ? 'Student Exit Permit' : 'Exit Passes', desc: 'Student exit & faculty travel', icon: <Ticket size={19} />, onClick: () => navigateTo('gate-passes') },
    {
      label: term('Daily Attendance Register', 'Daily Attendance (SF2)'),
      desc: term('Exportable attendance register', 'Official DepEd register'),
      icon: <CalendarCheck size={19} />,
      onClick: () => navigateTo('reports', 'sf2'),
    },
    {
      label: term('Staff Timesheets', 'Monthly DTR'),
      desc: term('GPS-verified faculty hours', 'CSC Form 48 work hours'),
      icon: <Clock size={19} />,
      onClick: () => navigateTo('dtr'),
    },
    { label: isFaculty ? 'My Classes' : 'Class Lists', desc: 'Enrolled students by section', icon: isFaculty ? <BookOpen size={19} /> : <Users size={19} />, onClick: () => navigateTo(isFaculty ? 'my-classes' : 'students') },
    ...(isAdmin ? [{ label: 'Push Alerts', desc: 'Send mobile alerts to parents', icon: <Send size={19} />, onClick: () => navigateTo('push') }] : []),
  ];

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{ padding: 48, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
        <RefreshCw size={22} className="animate-spin" style={{ margin: '0 auto 8px', display: 'block', color: brand.primary }} />
        <span>Loading dashboard...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ height: '100%', overflowY: 'auto', backgroundColor: tokens.bgCanvas, padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px)' }}>
      <div style={{ maxWidth: 1380, margin: '0 auto', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
        <div style={{ ...ui.card, padding: '10px 16px', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 10 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <span style={ui.badge(isOnline ? tokens.successLight : tokens.dangerLight, isOnline ? brand.success : brand.danger)}>
              ● {isOnline ? 'ONLINE' : 'OFFLINE'}
            </span>
            {isAdmin && (
              <>
                <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textSecondary, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5 }}>
                  <Database size={13} color={brand.primary} /> Database: {isOnline ? 'Connected' : 'Offline'}
                </span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textSecondary, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5 }}>
                  <Radio size={13} color={brand.primary} /> Push Alerts Today: {data.push_alerts_today.toLocaleString()} &bull; Parents Linked: {data.mobile_parents_connected.toLocaleString()}
                </span>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
            {lastSyncTime && <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textMuted, fontFamily: fonts.mono }}>Updated: {lastSyncTime}</span>}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                void fetchDashboardData(false, true);
                onManualRefresh?.();
              }}
              disabled={refreshing}
              style={ui.btnSecondary}
            >
              <RefreshCw size={13} className={refreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''} /> {refreshing ? 'Updating...' : 'Refresh'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 210px), 1fr))', gap: 12 }}>
          <StatsCard
            label="STUDENTS IN CLASS"
            value={isOnline ? data.students_present.toLocaleString() : '—'}
            helpText={`${data.attendance_rate}% of ${data.total_students.toLocaleString()} students`}
            badge={<UserCheck size={18} color={brand.success} />}
          />
          <StatsCard
            label="NOT SCANNED TODAY"
            value={isOnline ? data.students_absent.toLocaleString() : '—'}
            valueColor={data.students_absent > 0 ? brand.danger : tokens.textPrimary}
            helpText="No classroom scan yet today"
            badge={<UserX size={18} color={brand.danger} />}
          />
          <StatsCard
            label="FACULTY ON CAMPUS"
            value={isOnline ? `${data.faculty_on_duty}/${data.total_faculty}` : '—'}
            helpText="Verified via mobile face & GPS check-in"
            badge={<Clock size={18} color={brand.success} />}
          />
          <StatsCard
            label="CLASSROOM QR SCANS"
            value={isOnline ? data.classroom_scans_today.toLocaleString() : '—'}
            helpText={`${data.active_exit_passes} Active Exit Passes`}
            badge={<Scan size={18} color={brand.primary} />}
          />
        </div>

        <div style={ui.card}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginBottom: 10 }}>
            <Sparkles size={15} color={brand.primary} />
            <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: fonts.size.md, fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Quick Actions</h3>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 185px), 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
            {quickActions.map((act) => (
              <button
                key={act.label}
                type="button"
                onClick={act.onClick}
                style={{ ...ui.subtleBox, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, cursor: 'pointer', textAlign: 'left' }}
              >
                <div style={{ width: 34, height: 34, borderRadius: 8, backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight, color: brand.primary, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}>
                  {act.icon}
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.base, fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{act.label}</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textMuted }}>{act.desc}</div>
                </div>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 300px), 1fr))', gap: 14 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
            <div style={ui.card}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 12 }}>
                <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: fonts.size.md, fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Classroom Scans by Hour</h3>
                <span style={ui.badge(tokens.primaryLight, brand.primary)}><TrendingUp size={12} /> Today</span>
              </div>
              {data.hourly_scans.some((h) => h.count > 0) ? (
                <div style={{ height: 150, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-end', gap: 8 }}>
                  {data.hourly_scans.map((item, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', height: '100%', justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textMuted }}>{item.count || ''}</span>
                      <div style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: 26, height: `${item.height}%`, backgroundColor: item.is_peak ? brand.primary : brand.secondary, borderRadius: '4px 4px 0 0' }} />
                      <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}>{item.hour}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div style={{ padding: 24, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                  <Inbox size={22} style={{ margin: '0 auto 4px', display: 'block' }} /> No classroom scans recorded today
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div style={ui.card}>
              <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 10px', fontSize: fonts.size.md, fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Recent Classroom QR Scans</h3>
              {data.recent_scans.length > 0 ? (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
                  {data.recent_scans.slice(0, 5).map((s, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} style={{ ...ui.subtleBox, display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                      <div>
                        <strong style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.base, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{s.person_name}</strong>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textMuted }}>{s.grade_section}</div>
                      </div>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>{s.scan_time}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div style={{ padding: 20, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>No scans recorded yet</div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
            <div style={ui.card}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 10 }}>
                <strong style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.base, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                  {calendarDate.toLocaleString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })}
                </strong>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4 }}>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setCalendarDate(new Date(calendarDate.getFullYear(), calendarDate.getMonth() - 1, 1))} style={ui.btnSecondary}><ChevronLeft size={13} /></button>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setCalendarDate(new Date())} style={ui.btnSecondary}>Today</button>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setCalendarDate(new Date(calendarDate.getFullYear(), calendarDate.getMonth() + 1, 1))} style={ui.btnSecondary}><ChevronRight size={13} /></button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(7, 1fr)', textAlign: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                {['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'].map((d) => (
                  <span key={d} style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textMuted }}>{d}</span>
                ))}
                {calendarDays.map((item, idx) => (
                  <div key={idx} style={{ height: 28, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', borderRadius: 6, fontSize: fonts.size.sm, fontWeight: item.isToday ? 800 : 500, backgroundColor: item.isToday ? brand.buttonBg : 'transparent', color: item.isToday ? '#fff' : tokens.textPrimary }}>
                    {item.day || ''}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={ui.card}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginBottom: 10 }}>
                <Bell size={15} color={brand.primary} />
                <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: fonts.size.md, fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>School Bulletin</h3>
              </div>
              {data.notices.length === 0 ? (
                <div style={{ padding: 18, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted, fontSize: fonts.size.sm }}>No announcements posted</div>
              ) : (
                data.notices.map((n) => (
                  <div key={n.id} style={{ ...ui.subtleBox, marginBottom: 8 }}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.base, fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{n.title}</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>{n.details}</div>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default DashboardView;

/**
 * AttendSure - UN SDG Impact, Dropout Early-Warning, Global Ed-Fi Export & Emergency Campus Roll-Call

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  Award,
  Briefcase,
  CheckCircle2,
  Download,
  Globe,
  Leaf,
  Lock,
  RefreshCw,
  ShieldAlert,
  ShieldCheck,
  Smartphone,
  Users,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { useApiResource } from '../../hooks/useApiResource';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { useCompliance } from '../../context/ComplianceContext';

interface EmergencyStudent {
  student_id: number;
  lrn: string;
  full_name: string;
  section: string;
  parent_contact: string;
}

interface EmergencyFaculty {
  faculty_id: number;
  employee_id: string;
  full_name: string;
  department: string;
}

interface EmergencyRollCallData {
  timestamp: string;
  total_people_on_campus: number;
  students_count: number;
  faculty_count: number;
  students: EmergencyStudent[];
  faculty: EmergencyFaculty[];
}

export const EnterpriseSDGWidget: React.FC = () => {
  const { mode, tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const { isGlobalMode, term } = useCompliance();
  const userRole = (localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase();
  const isLeader = ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'FACULTY_ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD'].includes(userRole);

  const { data: sdgData, loading: loadingSdg, reload: reloadSdg } = useApiResource<any>(
    API_ROUTES.reports.sdgImpact,
    null
  );
  const { data: sardoData, loading: loadingSardo, reload: reloadSardo } = useApiResource<any>(
    API_ROUTES.reports.dropoutRisk,
    null
  );

  const [showAtRiskList, setShowAtRiskList] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [rollCallOpen, setRollCallOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [rollCallLoading, setRollCallLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [rollCallData, setRollCallData] = useState<EmergencyRollCallData | null>(null);
  const [rollCallSearch, setRollCallSearch] = useState<string>('');
  const [safeStudentIds, setSafeStudentIds] = useState<Record<number, boolean>>({});
  const [exportingEdFi, setExportingEdFi] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [anonymizeEdFi, setAnonymizeEdFi] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [exportStatus, setExportStatus] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const rollCallAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const exportAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const revokeTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      rollCallAbortRef.current?.abort();
      exportAbortRef.current?.abort();
      if (revokeTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(revokeTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  const loading = loadingSdg || loadingSardo;
  const purpleAccent = mode === 'dark' ? '#c084fc' : '#7c3aed';
  const purpleBg = mode === 'dark' ? 'rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.16)' : 'rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.12)';
  const dangerSolidBg = mode === 'dark' ? '#dc2626' : brand.danger;

  const handleRefresh = () => {
    void reloadSdg(false, true);
    void reloadSardo(false, true);
  };

  const handleOpenEmergencyRollCall = async () => {
    rollCallAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    rollCallAbortRef.current = controller;

    setRollCallOpen(true);
    setRollCallLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.campus.rollCall, {
        params: { nocache: 1 },
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
      setRollCallData(res.data);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (
        controller.signal.aborted ||
        anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
        anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
        anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
      ) {
        return;
      }
      setRollCallData(null);
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setRollCallLoading(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleCloseEmergencyRollCall = () => {
    rollCallAbortRef.current?.abort();
    setRollCallOpen(false);
  };

  const toggleStudentSafe = (studentId: number) => {
    setSafeStudentIds((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [studentId]: !prev[studentId],
    }));
  };

  const handleExportEdFi = async () => {
    exportAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    exportAbortRef.current = controller;

    setExportingEdFi(true);
    setExportStatus(null);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.reports.edfiExport, {
        params: {
          days: 30,
          anonymize: anonymizeEdFi ? 1 : 0,
        },
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

      const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(res.data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      const modeTag = anonymizeEdFi ? 'gdpr_pseudonymized' : 'standard';
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `attendsure_edfi_${modeTag}_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.json`;
      a.click();
      if (revokeTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(revokeTimerRef.current);
      revokeTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      }, 1000);

      const eventCount = res.data?.recordCounts?.studentSchoolAttendanceEvents ?? 0;
      setExportStatus(
        `Exported Ed-Fi bundle (${eventCount} attendance events • ${
          anonymizeEdFi ? 'GDPR Pseudonymized' : 'Standard Institutional'
        }).`
      );
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (
        controller.signal.aborted ||
        anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
        anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
        anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
      ) {
        return;
      }
      setExportStatus(
        extractApiError(err, 'Ed-Fi export requires School Leadership permissions (Admin / Principal).')
      );
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setExportingEdFi(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const filteredRollCallStudents = useMemo(() => {
    const list = rollCallData?.students || [];
    const q = rollCallSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return list;
    return list.filter(
      (s) =>
        s.full_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        s.lrn.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        s.section.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
  }, [rollCallData, rollCallSearch]);

  const safeCount = useMemo(() => {
    if (!rollCallData?.students) return 0;
    return rollCallData.students.filter((s) => Boolean(safeStudentIds[s.student_id])).length;
  }, [rollCallData, safeStudentIds]);

  const sdg4 = sdgData?.sdg_metrics?.sdg_4_quality_education;
  const sdg5 = sdgData?.sdg_metrics?.sdg_5_and_10_equality_and_inclusion;
  const sdg8 = sdgData?.sdg_metrics?.sdg_8_decent_work;
  const sdg12 = sdgData?.sdg_metrics?.sdg_12_and_13_climate_and_sustainability;
  const sdg16 = sdgData?.sdg_metrics?.sdg_16_accountable_institutions;
  const atRiskStudents = Array.isArray(sardoData?.at_risk_students) ? sardoData.at_risk_students : [];

  return (
    <div style={{ ...containerStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle }}>
      {/* Top Action Header */}
      <div style={headerBarStyle}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <span style={{ ...badgePillStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight, color: brand.primary }}>
              <Globe size={13} /> UN SDG IMPACT &amp; SAFETY COMMAND CENTER
            </span>
            <span style={{ ...privacyPillStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.successLight, color: brand.success }}>
              <ShieldCheck size={13} />{' '}
              {term(
                'Global Ed-Fi • GDPR Art. 25 • FERPA & COPPA Ready',
                'DepEd PH • RA 10173 & GDPR Compliant • Pure Software'
              )}
            </span>
          </div>
          <h3 style={{ margin: '4px 0 0', fontSize: '1.08rem', fontWeight: 900, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
            {term(
              'UN Sustainable Development Goals, Dropout Early-Warning & Emergency Roll-Call',
              'UN SDG Impact, SARDO Early-Warning & Emergency Campus Roll-Call'
            )}
          </h3>
          <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '0.78rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
            Pure-Software Campus Platform &bull; Live school data from USB QR Scans, Mobile Face &amp; GPS Check-Ins, and Parent Push Alerts
          </p>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleOpenEmergencyRollCall}
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 6,
              padding: '7px 13px',
              borderRadius: 8,
              border: 'none',
              backgroundColor: dangerSolidBg,
              color: '#ffffff',
              fontSize: '0.76rem',
              fontWeight: 800,
              cursor: 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            <ShieldAlert size={14} /> Emergency Campus Roll-Call
          </button>

          {isLeader && (
            <>
              <label
                title="GDPR Art. 25 Pseudonymization replaces student and staff personal identifiers with privacy-safe codes in Ed-Fi exports"
                style={{
                  display: 'inline-flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 6,
                  padding: '6px 10px',
                  borderRadius: 8,
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                  fontSize: '0.72rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                }}
              >
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={anonymizeEdFi}
                  onChange={(e) => setAnonymizeEdFi(e.target.checked)}
                  style={{ accentColor: brand.success }}
                />
                <Lock size={12} color={brand.success} /> GDPR Anonymize
              </label>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleExportEdFi}
                disabled={exportingEdFi}
                style={{
                  ...secondaryBtnStyle,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight,
                  borderColor: brand.primary,
                  color: brand.primary,

              </button>
            </>
          )}

          <button
            type="button"

            style={{
              ...secondaryBtnStyle,
              backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
              borderColor: tokens.borderStrong,

          >

      {exportStatus && (

      {/* Emergency Campus Roll-Call Panel (SDG 11) */}

              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.95rem', fontWeight: 800, color: brand.danger, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>

            <button
              type="button"

      )}

      {/* 5 UN SDG Live Impact Cards */}
      <div style={cardsGridStyle}>
        <div style={{ ...cardStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>

              SDG 4 &bull; QUALITY EDUCATION
            </span>
            <Award size={18} color={brand.danger} />

            {loading ? '...' : (sdg4?.verified_classroom_qr_scans ?? 0).toLocaleString()}
          </div>
          <div style={{ ...metricSubStyle, color: tokens.textMuted }}>
            Verified Signed Classroom QR Scans ({sdg4?.attendance_rate_today ?? 0}% Present Today)

          <div style={{ ...metaRowStyle, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>

          </div>
          <div style={{ ...metaRowStyle, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
            <span>Early-Warning Watch:</span>
            <strong style={{ color: brand.warning }}>{sardoData?.early_warning_count ?? 0} Learners</strong>

        <div style={{ ...cardStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle }}>

/**
 * AttendSure - Top Navigation Header & Role-Aware Official Pass Modal
 * File: web/src/components/layout/Header.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import apiClient, { peekApiCache } from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { useCompliance } from '../../context/ComplianceContext';
import { ProfileAvatar } from '../common/ProfileAvatar';
import { QrCodeSvg } from '../common/QrCodeSvg';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import type { NavItemKey } from './Sidebar';
import type { UserSession } from '../../types/section';
import {
  Bell,
  Sun,
  Moon,
  QrCode,
  ShieldCheck,
  Printer,
  Copy,
  Check,
  User,
  Settings,
  LogOut,
  ChevronDown,
  Globe2,
} from 'lucide-react';


export type TabBadgeCounts = Partial<Record<NavItemKey, number>>;

export interface HeaderProps {
  title: string;
  isSystemOnline: boolean;
  session: UserSession | null;
  userPhoto?: string | null;
  schoolName?: string;
  schoolId?: string;
  schoolLogo?: string | null;
  badgeCounts?: TabBadgeCounts;
  onLogout: () => void;
  onNavigateTab: (tab: NavItemKey) => void;
  onOpenProfile: () => void;
}

interface CurrentUserAccountData {
  id?: number;
  username?: string;
  employee_id?: string | null;
  lrn?: string | null;
  position?: string | null;
  department?: string | null;
  qr_payload?: string | null;
}

const sanitizePlainText = (raw: unknown, maxLen = 100): string =>
  String(raw ?? '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLen);

export const Header: React.FC<HeaderProps> = ({
  title,
  isSystemOnline,
  session,
  userPhoto,
  schoolName,
  schoolId,
  onLogout,
  onNavigateTab,
  onOpenProfile,
}) => {
  const themeCtx = useTheme();
  const { mode, tokens, brand, fonts, ui } = themeCtx;
  const complianceCtx = useCompliance() as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;

  const activeComplianceMode = useMemo(() => {
    const raw =
      complianceCtx.standard ??
      complianceCtx.complianceMode ??
      complianceCtx.regionMode ??
      complianceCtx.mode ??
      'DEPED_PH';
    return String(raw).toUpperCase().includes('GLOBAL') ? 'GLOBAL' : 'DEPED_PH';
  }, [complianceCtx]);

  const handleToggleTheme = useCallback(() => {
    const rawTheme = themeCtx as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (typeof rawTheme.toggleTheme === 'function') {
      (rawTheme.toggleTheme as () => void)();
    } else if (typeof rawTheme.toggleMode === 'function') {
      (rawTheme.toggleMode as () => void)();
    } else if (typeof rawTheme.setMode === 'function') {
      (rawTheme.setMode as (next: 'light' | 'dark') => void)(mode === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark');
    }
  }, [themeCtx, mode]);

  const handleToggleCompliance = useCallback(() => {
    const next = activeComplianceMode === 'DEPED_PH' ? 'GLOBAL' : 'DEPED_PH';
    if (typeof complianceCtx.toggleStandard === 'function') {
      (complianceCtx.toggleStandard as () => void)();
    } else if (typeof complianceCtx.toggleMode === 'function') {
      (complianceCtx.toggleMode as () => void)();
    } else if (typeof complianceCtx.setStandard === 'function') {
      (complianceCtx.setStandard as (val: string) => void)(next);
    } else if (typeof complianceCtx.setComplianceMode === 'function') {
      (complianceCtx.setComplianceMode as (val: string) => void)(next);
    } else if (typeof complianceCtx.setMode === 'function') {
      (complianceCtx.setMode as (val: string) => void)(next);
    }
  }, [complianceCtx, activeComplianceMode]);

  const [isPassModalOpen, setIsPassModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isUserMenuOpen, setIsUserMenuOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [unreadCount, setUnreadCount] = useState<number>(0);

  const cachedMe = peekApiCache<CurrentUserAccountData>(API_ROUTES.accounts.me);
  const [accountMeta, setAccountMeta] = useState<CurrentUserAccountData | null>(cachedMe || null);

  const userMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const copyTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const roleUpper = useMemo(
    () =>
      sanitizePlainText(
        session?.role || localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || 'FACULTY',
        30
      ).toUpperCase(),
    [session?.role]
  );

  const isStudentAccount = roleUpper === 'STUDENT';
  const canOpenSettings = ['SUPERADMIN', 'ADMIN', 'FACULTY_ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL'].includes(roleUpper);

  const fetchAccountAndAlerts = useCallback(
    async (signal?: AbortSignal) => {
      if (!session?.token) return;

      const [meRes, notifRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
        apiClient.get<CurrentUserAccountData>(API_ROUTES.accounts.me, { signal }),
        apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.messaging.notifications, {
          params: { page_size: 20 },
          signal,
        }),
      ]);

      if (signal?.aborted) return;

      if (meRes.status === 'fulfilled' && meRes.value?.data) {
        setAccountMeta(meRes.value.data);
      }

      if (notifRes.status === 'fulfilled' && notifRes.value?.data) {
        const payload = notifRes.value.data;
        const items: Array<{ is_read?: boolean }> = Array.isArray(payload)
          ? payload
          : Array.isArray(payload?.results)
            ? payload.results
            : [];
        const unread =
          typeof payload?.unread_count === 'number'
            ? payload.unread_count
            : items.filter((item) => item && item.is_read === false).length;
        setUnreadCount(unread);
      }
    },
    [session?.token]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    void fetchAccountAndAlerts(controller.signal);

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        void fetchAccountAndAlerts();
      }
    }, 30000);

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
      clearInterval(interval);
      if (copyTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(copyTimerRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, [fetchAccountAndAlerts]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isUserMenuOpen) return;

    const handleOutsideClick = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (userMenuRef.current && !userMenuRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsUserMenuOpen(false);
      }
    };
    const handleEsc = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        setIsUserMenuOpen(false);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleOutsideClick);
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleEsc);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleOutsideClick);
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleEsc);
    };
  }, [isUserMenuOpen]);

  const displaySchoolName = sanitizePlainText(schoolName, 140) || 'AttendSure Campus';
  const displaySchoolId = sanitizePlainText(schoolId, 30);
  const displayUserName =
    sanitizePlainText(session?.faculty_name || session?.username, 100) || 'Staff Member';

  // Strictly separate Student LRN vs Staff Employee ID
  const badgeIdLabel = isStudentAccount ? 'LRN' : 'Employee ID';
  const badgeIdValue = useMemo(() => {
    if (isStudentAccount) {
      return sanitizePlainText(accountMeta?.lrn || session?.username, 30) || 'Unassigned';
    }
    const empId = sanitizePlainText(accountMeta?.employee_id, 40);
    if (empId) return empId;
    const uname = sanitizePlainText(accountMeta?.username || session?.username, 40);
    return uname || `STAFF-${session?.user_id || 1}`;
  }, [isStudentAccount, accountMeta, session?.username, session?.user_id]);

  const qrBadgeValue = useMemo(() => {
    const signed = sanitizePlainText(accountMeta?.qr_payload, 240);
    if (signed) return signed;
    return isStudentAccount
      ? `ATTENDSURE:STUDENT:${badgeIdValue}`
      : `ATTENDSURE:FACULTY:${badgeIdValue}`;
  }, [accountMeta?.qr_payload, isStudentAccount, badgeIdValue]);

  const handleCopyIdentifier = async () => {
    if (!badgeIdValue) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(badgeIdValue);
      setCopiedId(true);
      if (copyTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(copyTimerRef.current);
      copyTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        setCopiedId(false);
        copyTimerRef.current = null;
      }, 2000);
    } catch {
      // Ignore clipboard permission denial
    }
  };

  const cleanHeaderTitle = useMemo(() => {
    const prefix = displaySchoolName ? `${displaySchoolName} • ` : '';
    return title.startsWith(prefix) ? title.slice(prefix.length) : title;
  }, [title, displaySchoolName]);

  return (
    <>
      <header
        className="no-print"

  | 'classroom-scanner'
