interface SidebarProps {
  activeTab: NavItemKey;
  onSelectTab: (tab: NavItemKey) => void;
  onPrefetchTab?: (tab: NavItemKey) => void;
  session?: UserSession | null;
  userPhoto?: string | null;
  isCollapsed?: boolean;
  onToggleCollapse?: () => void;
  schoolName?: string;
  schoolId?: string;
  schoolLogo?: string | null;
  canTeach?: boolean;
  allowedTabs?: NavItemKey[];
  badgeCounts?: TabBadgeCounts;
}

interface NavItem {
  key: NavItemKey;
  label: string;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
}

interface NavGroup {
  groupTitle: string;
  items: NavItem[];
}

const getSchoolAbbreviation = (name?: string): string => {
  if (!name || !name.trim()) return 'AS';
  const ignore = new Set(['of', 'the', 'and', 'in', 'at', 'for', 'to', 'ng', 'sa']);
  const words = name.trim().split(/\s+/).filter((w) => !ignore.has(w.toLowerCase()));
  return words.length === 1
    ? words[0].slice(0, 4).toUpperCase()
    : words.map((w) => w[0]).join('').toUpperCase().slice(0, 6);
};

const formatBadge = (count?: number): string => {
  if (!count || count <= 0) return '';
  return count > 99 ? '99+' : String(count);
};

export const Sidebar: React.FC<SidebarProps> = ({

  schoolName = '',

  const { mode, tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const { isGlobalMode, t } = useCompliance();
  const [liveBadges, setLiveBadges] = useState<TabBadgeCounts>({});
  const [internalCollapsed, setInternalCollapsed] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem('attendsure_sidebar_collapsed') === 'true';
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  });

  const isCollapsed = controlledCollapsed !== undefined ? controlledCollapsed : internalCollapsed;
  const role = (session?.role || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase();

  useEffect(() => {
    const onSync = (e: Event) => {
      const detail = (e as CustomEvent<TabBadgeCounts>).detail;
      if (detail) setLiveBadges(detail);
    };
    window.addEventListener('attendsure:notifications-sync', onSync);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('attendsure:notifications-sync', onSync);

  const handleToggle = () => {

              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              fontWeight: 800,
              fontSize: '0.76rem',
            }}
          >
            {schoolAbbr.slice(0, 2)}
          </div>
        )}

        {!isCollapsed && schoolName && (
          <div
            style={{
              fontSize: '0.70rem',
              fontWeight: 700,
              color: tokens.textSecondary,
              textAlign: 'center',
              marginTop: 5,
              lineHeight: 1.25,
            }}
          >
            {schoolName}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <nav style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto', padding: isCollapsed ? '8px 6px' : '8px 8px', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
        {visibleGroups.map((group) => (
          <div key={group.groupTitle} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
            {!isCollapsed && (
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.60rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textMuted, padding: '3px 8px', letterSpacing: '0.5px' }}>
                {group.groupTitle}
              </div>
            )}
            {group.items.map((item) => {
              const active = activeTab === item.key;
              const badge = formatBadge(mergedBadges[item.key]);
              return (
                <button
                  key={item.key}
                  type="button"
                  title={isCollapsed ? item.label : undefined}
                  onMouseEnter={() => onPrefetchTab?.(item.key)}
                  onFocus={() => onPrefetchTab?.(item.key)}
                  onClick={() => onSelectTab(item.key)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: isCollapsed ? 'center' : 'flex-start',
                    gap: 9,
                    height: 36,
                    padding: isCollapsed ? 0 : '0 10px',
                    borderRadius: 9,
                    borderWidth: 0,
                    borderStyle: 'none',
                    backgroundColor: active ? brand.buttonBg : 'transparent',
                    color: active ? '#ffffff' : tokens.textSecondary,
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    position: 'relative',
                  }}
                >
                  <span style={{ display: 'flex', color: active ? '#ffffff' : tokens.textMuted }}>{item.icon}</span>
                  {!isCollapsed && (
                    <span
                      style={{
                        fontSize: '0.78rem',
                        fontWeight: active ? 800 : 600,
                        color: active ? '#ffffff' : tokens.textPrimary,
                        flex: 1,
                        textAlign: 'left',
                        whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                        overflow: 'hidden',
                        textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                      }}
                    >
                      {item.label}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {badge && (
                    <span
                      style={{
                        backgroundColor: mode === 'dark' ? '#dc2626' : brand.danger,
                        color: '#ffffff',
                        fontSize: '0.58rem',
                        fontWeight: 800,
                        borderRadius: 9999,
                        padding: '1px 5px',
                      }}
                    >
                      {badge}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        ))}
      </nav>

      <div
        style={{
          padding: isCollapsed ? '8px 0' : '8px 10px',
          borderTopWidth: 1,
          borderTopStyle: 'solid',
          borderTopColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: isCollapsed ? 'center' : 'flex-start',
          gap: 8,
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ width: 30, height: 30, borderRadius: '50%', overflow: 'hidden', backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}>
          {safeUserPhoto ? (
            <img src={safeUserPhoto} alt="User" style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }} />
          ) : (
            <span style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: '0.78rem', color: brand.primary }}>
              {(session?.faculty_name || session?.username || 'U').charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        {!isCollapsed && (
          <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
              {session?.faculty_name || session?.username || 'User'}
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.60rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textMuted }}>{role}</div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
};

export default Sidebar;

export type TabType =
  | 'SECTIONS'
  | 'SCHEDULE'
  | 'SECTION'
  | 'ROOM'
  | 'ROOMS'
  | 'SUBJECT'
  | 'SUBJECTS'
  | 'GRADES'
  | 'YEARS'
  | 'HOLIDAYS';

export interface AcademicSetupModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onUpdated?: () => void;
  onSuccess?: () => void;
  initialTab?: TabType;
  editItem?: any;
}

type ActiveSubTab = 'SECTIONS' | 'SCHEDULE' | 'ROOMS' | 'SUBJECTS' | 'GRADES' | 'YEARS' | 'HOLIDAYS';

const normalizeTab = (tab: TabType): ActiveSubTab => {
  if (tab === 'SECTION' || tab === 'SECTIONS') return 'SECTIONS';
  if (tab === 'SCHEDULE') return 'SCHEDULE';
  if (tab === 'ROOM' || tab === 'ROOMS') return 'ROOMS';
  if (tab === 'SUBJECT' || tab === 'SUBJECTS') return 'SUBJECTS';
  if (tab === 'GRADES') return 'GRADES';
  if (tab === 'HOLIDAYS') return 'HOLIDAYS';
  return 'YEARS';
};

const sanitizeField = (raw: string, maxLength = 100): string =>
  String(raw || '').replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '').slice(0, maxLength);

const extractFacultyId = (item: any): string => {
  if (!item) return '';
  const candidate =
    item.faculty_id ??
    (typeof item.faculty === 'object' && item.faculty ? item.faculty.id : item.faculty) ??
    '';
  return candidate !== null && candidate !== undefined ? String(candidate) : '';
};

const extractFacultyName = (item: any, facultyList: any[]): string => {
  if (!item) return 'Unassigned';
  const directName =
    item.faculty_name ||
    (typeof item.faculty === 'object' && item.faculty ? item.faculty.full_name || item.faculty.name : null);
  if (directName && String(directName).trim()) return String(directName).trim();

  const fid = extractFacultyId(item);
  if (fid) {
    const match = facultyList.find((f) => String(f.id) === fid);
    if (match) return match.full_name || match.name || 'Unassigned';
  }
  return 'Unassigned';
};

  const handleSaveSection = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    const adviserPk = sectionForm.adviser_id ? Number(sectionForm.adviser_id) : null;

  };

  const handleSaveSchedule = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {

  const handleSaveSimpleItem = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    setError(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    try {
      const isEdit = Boolean(simpleForm.id);
      if (activeSubTab === 'ROOMS') {
        const cleanRoomName = sanitizeField(simpleForm.name, 60).trim();

        if (!cleanRoomName) {
          setError('Room name is required.');
          setSubmitting(false);

        }
        const payload = {
          name: cleanRoomName,
          building: cleanBuilding,
          capacity: Math.max(1, Number(simpleForm.capacity) || 45),
        };
        if (isEdit) {
          await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.school.rooms}${simpleForm.id}/`, payload);
        } else {
          await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.school.rooms, payload);
        }
      } else if (activeSubTab === 'SUBJECTS') {
        const cleanCode = sanitizeField(simpleForm.code, 30).trim().toUpperCase();
        const cleanTitle = sanitizeField(simpleForm.title, 100).trim();
        if (!cleanCode || !cleanTitle) {
          setError('Subject code and title are required.');
          setSubmitting(false);
          return;
        }
        const payload = {
          code: cleanCode,
          title: cleanTitle,
          units: Math.max(1, Number(simpleForm.units) || 1),
        };
        if (isEdit) {
          await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.school.subjects}${simpleForm.id}/`, payload);
        } else {
          await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.school.subjects, payload);
        }
      } else if (activeSubTab === 'GRADES') {
        const cleanCode = sanitizeField(simpleForm.code, 20).trim().toUpperCase();
        const cleanName = sanitizeField(simpleForm.name, 60).trim();
        if (!cleanCode || !cleanName) {
          setError('Grade code and name are required.');
          setSubmitting(false);
          return;
        }
        const payload = {
          code: cleanCode,
          name: cleanName,
          stage: sanitizeField(simpleForm.stage || 'JHS', 20).trim() || 'JHS',
          level_order: Number(simpleForm.level_order) || 1,
        };
        if (isEdit) {
          await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.school.gradeLevels}${simpleForm.id}/`, payload);
        } else {
          await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.school.gradeLevels, payload);
        }
      } else if (activeSubTab === 'YEARS') {
        const cleanCode = sanitizeField(simpleForm.code, 20).trim();
        if (!cleanCode || !simpleForm.start_date || !simpleForm.end_date) {
          setError('School year code, start date, and end date are required.');
          setSubmitting(false);
          return;
        }
        const payload = {
          code: cleanCode,
          start_date: simpleForm.start_date,
          baseline_cutoff_date: simpleForm.baseline_cutoff_date || simpleForm.start_date,
          end_date: simpleForm.end_date,
          is_active: Boolean(simpleForm.is_active),
        };
        if (isEdit) {
          await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.school.schoolYears}${simpleForm.id}/`, payload);
        } else {
          await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.school.schoolYears, payload);
        }
      } else if (activeSubTab === 'HOLIDAYS') {
        const cleanReason = sanitizeField(simpleForm.holiday_reason, 140).trim();
        if (!simpleForm.holiday_date || !cleanReason) {

        };

          await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.school.holidays}${simpleForm.id}/`, payload);
        } else {
          await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.school.holidays, payload);
        }
      }

      resetSimpleForm();
      setSuccessMessage(isEdit ? 'Record updated.' : 'Record added.');
      await loadData();
      if (onUpdated) onUpdated();
      if (onSuccess) onSuccess();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(extractApiError(err, 'Failed to save record.'));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteItem = (baseRoute: string, id: number, label = 'Record') => {
    showConfirm({
      title: `Delete ${label}`,
      message: `Are you sure you want to permanently delete this ${label.toLowerCase()}?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Delete',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setError(null);
        setSuccessMessage(null);
        try {
          await apiClient.delete(`${baseRoute}${id}/`);
          setSuccessMessage(`${label} deleted.`);
          await loadData();
          if (onUpdated) onUpdated();
          if (onSuccess) onSuccess();
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          setError(extractApiError(err, `Could not delete ${label.toLowerCase()}.`));
        }
      },
    });
  };

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={onClose} title="Academic Structure & Faculty Assignments">
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16 }}>
        {/* Navigation Tabs */}
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            gap: 8,
            borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
            paddingBottom: 8,
            overflowX: 'auto',
          }}
        >
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('SECTIONS'); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'SECTIONS', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <Users size={14} /> Sections &amp; Advisers
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('SCHEDULE'); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'SCHEDULE', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <Clock size={14} /> Schedules &amp; Subject Faculty
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('SUBJECTS'); resetSimpleForm(); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'SUBJECTS', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <BookOpen size={14} /> Subjects
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('ROOMS'); resetSimpleForm(); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'ROOMS', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <DoorOpen size={14} /> Classrooms
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('GRADES'); resetSimpleForm(); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'GRADES', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <Layers size={14} /> Grade Levels
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('YEARS'); resetSimpleForm(); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'YEARS', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <Calendar size={14} /> School Years
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('HOLIDAYS'); resetSimpleForm(); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'HOLIDAYS', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <Calendar size={14} /> Holidays
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Status Alerts */}
        {loading && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, fontSize: '0.76rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
            <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" color={brand.primary} />
            <span>Loading academic records...</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {error && (
          <div style={alertBoxStyle(tokens.dangerLight, brand.danger)}>
            <AlertCircle size={15} />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {successMessage && (
          <div style={alertBoxStyle(tokens.successLight, brand.success)}>
            <CheckCircle2 size={15} />
            <span>{successMessage}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 1. SECTIONS & CLASS ADVISER FORM */}
        {activeSubTab === 'SECTIONS' && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
            <form onSubmit={handleSaveSection} style={formCardStyle(tokens)}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary, marginBottom: 8 }}>
                {sectionForm.id ? 'Edit Section & Adviser' : 'Add Section & Assign Class Adviser'}
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Section Name *</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    maxLength={80}
                    placeholder="e.g. Diamond"
                    value={sectionForm.name}
                    onChange={(e) => setSectionForm({ ...sectionForm, name: sanitizeField(e.target.value, 80) })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Grade Level *</label>
                  <select
                    required
                    value={sectionForm.grade_level}
                    onChange={(e) => setSectionForm({ ...sectionForm, grade_level: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  >
                    <option value="">Select Grade Level</option>
                    {grades.map((g) => (
                      <option key={g.id} value={g.id}>
                        {g.name || g.code}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Class Adviser (Faculty)</label>
                  <select
                    value={sectionForm.adviser_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setSectionForm({ ...sectionForm, adviser_id: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  >
                    <option value="">(None / Unassigned)</option>
                    {facultyList.map((f) => (
                      <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>
                        {f.full_name || f.name} {f.employee_id ? `(${f.employee_id})` : ''}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Default Room Number</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    maxLength={50}
                    placeholder="e.g. Room 204"
                    value={sectionForm.room_number}
                    onChange={(e) => setSectionForm({ ...sectionForm, room_number: sanitizeField(e.target.value, 50) })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 12 }}>
                {sectionForm.id && (
                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    size="sm"
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setSectionForm({ id: null, name: '', grade_level: '', adviser_id: '', room_number: '', capacity: 45 })
                    }
                  >
                    Cancel Edit
                  </Button>
                )}
                <Button variant="primary" size="sm" type="submit" disabled={submitting}>
                  {submitting ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} /> : sectionForm.id ? 'Save Changes' : 'Create Section'}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>

            <div style={tableContainer(tokens)}>
              <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left', fontSize: '0.78rem' }}>
                <thead>
                  <tr style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle }}>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Section</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Grade</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Class Adviser</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {sections.map((sec) => {
                    const adviserName =
                      sec.adviser_name ||
                      sec.adviser_full_name ||
                      (typeof sec.adviser === 'object' && sec.adviser ? sec.adviser.full_name || sec.adviser.name : null) ||
                      facultyList.find((f) => f.id === sec.adviser_id || f.id === sec.adviser)?.full_name ||
                      'Unassigned';

                    return (
                      <tr key={sec.id} style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{sec.name}</td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                          {sec.grade_level_name || sec.grade_level?.name || '—'}
                        </td>
                        <td
                          style={{
                            padding: '8px 10px',
                            color: adviserName === 'Unassigned' ? brand.warning : brand.primary,
                            fontWeight: 600,
                          }}
                        >
                          {adviserName}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right' }}>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => {
                              const advId =
                                sec.adviser_id ??
                                (typeof sec.adviser === 'object' && sec.adviser ? sec.adviser.id : sec.adviser) ??
                                '';
                              setSectionForm({
                                id: sec.id,
                                name: sec.name,
                                grade_level: String(sec.grade_level?.id || sec.grade_level || ''),
                                adviser_id: String(advId || ''),
                                room_number: sec.room_number || '',
                                capacity: sec.capacity || 45,
                              });
                            }}
                            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.primary, cursor: 'pointer', marginRight: 8 }}
                            title="Edit Section & Adviser"
                            aria-label={`Edit section ${sec.name}`}
                          >
                            <Edit2 size={13} />
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleDeleteItem(API_ROUTES.school.sections, sec.id, 'Section')}
                            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.danger, cursor: 'pointer' }}
                            title="Delete Section"
                            aria-label={`Delete section ${sec.name}`}
                          >
                            <Trash2 size={13} />
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 2. SCHEDULES & SUBJECT FACULTY FORM */}
        {activeSubTab === 'SCHEDULE' && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
            <form onSubmit={handleSaveSchedule} style={formCardStyle(tokens)}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary, marginBottom: 8 }}>
                {scheduleForm.id ? 'Edit Class Schedule & Faculty' : 'Add Subject Period & Assign Faculty'}
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Class Section *</label>
                  <select
                    required
                    value={scheduleForm.section_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, section_id: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  >
                    <option value="">Select Section</option>
                    {sections.map((s) => (
                      <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                        {s.name} ({s.grade_level_name || s.grade_level?.name || 'Section'})
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Subject *</label>
                  <select
                    required
                    value={scheduleForm.subject_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, subject_id: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  >
                    <option value="">Select Subject</option>
                    {subjects.map((sub) => (
                      <option key={sub.id} value={sub.id}>
                        {sub.code} - {sub.title}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Subject Faculty</label>
                  <select
                    value={scheduleForm.faculty_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, faculty_id: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  >
                    <option value="">(None / Unassigned)</option>
                    {facultyList.map((f) => (
                      <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>
                        {f.full_name || f.name} {f.employee_id ? `(${f.employee_id})` : ''}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Classroom</label>
                  <select
                    value={scheduleForm.room_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, room_id: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  >
                    <option value="">(Select Room)</option>
                    {rooms.map((r) => (
                      <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>
                        {r.name} {r.building ? `(${r.building})` : ''}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Start Time</label>
                  <input
                    type="time"
                    required
                    value={scheduleForm.start_time}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, start_time: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>End Time</label>
                  <input
                    type="time"
                    required
                    value={scheduleForm.end_time}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, end_time: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 12 }}>
                {scheduleForm.id && (
                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    size="sm"
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setScheduleForm({
                        id: null,
                        section_id: '',
                        subject_id: '',
                        faculty_id: '',
                        room_id: '',
                        start_time: '07:30',
                        end_time: '08:30',
                        days_of_week: 'MON-FRI',
                      })
                    }
                  >
                    Cancel Edit
                  </Button>
                )}
                <Button variant="primary" size="sm" type="submit" disabled={submitting}>
                  {submitting
                    ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} />
                    : scheduleForm.id
                      ? 'Save Changes'
                      : 'Create Class Period'}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>

            <div style={tableContainer(tokens)}>
              <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left', fontSize: '0.78rem' }}>
                <thead>
                  <tr style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle }}>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Section</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Subject</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Subject Faculty</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Time</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {schedules.map((sc) => {
                    const secName = sc.section_name || sc.section?.name || 'Section';
                    const subCode = sc.subject_code || sc.subject?.code || 'SUB';
                    const facultyName = extractFacultyName(sc, facultyList);

                    return (
                      <tr key={sc.id} style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{secName}</td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: brand.primary, fontWeight: 700 }}>{subCode}</td>
                        <td
                          style={{
                            padding: '8px 10px',
                            color: facultyName === 'Unassigned' ? brand.warning : tokens.textSecondary,
                            fontWeight: 600,
                          }}
                        >
                          {facultyName}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                          {String(sc.start_time).slice(0, 5)} - {String(sc.end_time).slice(0, 5)}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right' }}>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => {
                              const secId =
                                sc.section_id ??
                                (typeof sc.section === 'object' && sc.section ? sc.section.id : sc.section) ??
                                '';
                              const subId =
                                sc.subject_id ??
                                (typeof sc.subject === 'object' && sc.subject ? sc.subject.id : sc.subject) ??
                                '';
                              const facId = extractFacultyId(sc);
                              const roomId =
                                sc.room_id ??
                                (typeof sc.room === 'object' && sc.room ? sc.room.id : sc.room) ??
                                '';

                              setScheduleForm({
                                id: sc.id,
                                section_id: String(secId || ''),
                                subject_id: String(subId || ''),
                                faculty_id: facId,
                                room_id:
                                  typeof roomId === 'number' || /^\d+$/.test(String(roomId))
                                    ? String(roomId)
                                    : '',
                                start_time: sc.start_time ? String(sc.start_time).slice(0, 5) : '07:30',
                                end_time: sc.end_time ? String(sc.end_time).slice(0, 5) : '08:30',
                                days_of_week: sc.days_of_week || 'MON-FRI',
                              });
                            }}
                            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.primary, cursor: 'pointer', marginRight: 8 }}
                            title="Edit Schedule & Faculty"
                            aria-label={`Edit schedule ${subCode}`}
                          >
                            <Edit2 size={13} />
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleDeleteItem(API_ROUTES.school.periods, sc.id, 'Class Schedule')}
                            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.danger, cursor: 'pointer' }}
                            title="Delete Schedule"
                            aria-label={`Delete schedule ${subCode}`}
                          >
                            <Trash2 size={13} />
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 3. FULL CRUD MODES: ROOMS, SUBJECTS, GRADES, YEARS, HOLIDAYS */}
        {!['SECTIONS', 'SCHEDULE'].includes(activeSubTab) && (
          <form onSubmit={handleSaveSimpleItem} style={{ ...formCardStyle(tokens), display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'flex-end', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              {activeSubTab === 'ROOMS' && (
                <>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 120 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Room Name *</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      required
                      maxLength={60}
                      placeholder="e.g. Room 101"
                      value={simpleForm.name}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, name: sanitizeField(e.target.value, 60) })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 120 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Building</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      maxLength={80}
                      placeholder="e.g. Science Wing"
                      value={simpleForm.building}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, building: sanitizeField(e.target.value, 80) })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ width: 90 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Capacity</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min={1}
                      max={500}
                      value={simpleForm.capacity}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, capacity: Number(e.target.value) || 45 })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                    />
                  </div>
                </>
              )}

              {activeSubTab === 'GRADES' && (
                <>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 90 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Grade Code *</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      required
                      maxLength={20}
                      placeholder="e.g. G7"
                      value={simpleForm.code}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, code: sanitizeField(e.target.value, 20) })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ flex: 2, minWidth: 140 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Grade Name *</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      required
                      maxLength={60}
                      placeholder="e.g. Grade 7"
                      value={simpleForm.name}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, name: sanitizeField(e.target.value, 60) })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ width: 95 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Stage</label>
                    <select
                      value={simpleForm.stage}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, stage: e.target.value })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                    >
                      <option value="ELEM">ELEM</option>
                      <option value="JHS">JHS</option>
                      <option value="SHS">SHS</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ width: 76 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Order</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min={1}
                      max={20}
                      value={simpleForm.level_order}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, level_order: Number(e.target.value) || 1 })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                    />
                  </div>
                </>
              )}

              {activeSubTab === 'SUBJECTS' && (
                <>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 100 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Subject Code *</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      required
                      maxLength={30}
                      placeholder="e.g. MATH7"
                      value={simpleForm.code}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, code: sanitizeField(e.target.value, 30) })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ flex: 2, minWidth: 140 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Subject Title *</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      required
                      maxLength={100}
                      placeholder="e.g. Mathematics 7"
                      value={simpleForm.title}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, title: sanitizeField(e.target.value, 100) })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ width: 76 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Units</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min={1}
                      max={10}
                      value={simpleForm.units}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, units: Number(e.target.value) || 1 })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                    />
                  </div>
                </>
              )}

/**
 * AttendSure - First-Time Profile Completion Modal
 * File: web/src/components/modals/CompleteProfileModal.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { isSafeImageUrl } from '../../theme/tokens';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import { UserCheck, ShieldCheck, Loader2, Camera, X } from 'lucide-react';

export interface CompletedProfileUser {
  full_name?: string;
  username?: string;
  photo?: string | null;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

interface CompleteProfileModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onCompleted: (updatedUser: CompletedProfileUser) => void;
}

const sanitizeField = (raw: string, maxLen = 100): string =>
  String(raw || '').replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '').slice(0, maxLen);

const sanitizePassword = (raw: string): string =>
  String(raw || '').replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/g, '').slice(0, 128);

export const CompleteProfileModal: React.FC<CompleteProfileModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onCompleted }) => {
  const { tokens, brand, fonts, ui } = useTheme();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [photoPreview, setPhotoPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    first_name: '',
    middle_name: '',
    last_name: '',
    suffix: '',
    contact_number: '',
    department: 'Junior High School',
    password: '',
    photo: null as string | null,
  });

  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  const submitAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const fileReaderRef = useRef<FileReader | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      mountedRef.current = false;
      submitAbortRef.current?.abort();
      fileReaderRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    setLoading(true);
    apiClient
      .get(API_ROUTES.accounts.me, { params: { nocache: 1 }, signal: controller.signal })
      .then((res) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted || !mountedRef.current || !res.data) return;
        const u = res.data;
        const pic = u.photo_url || u.photo || null;
        setFormData((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          first_name: sanitizeField(u.first_name || '', 100),
          middle_name: sanitizeField(u.middle_name || '', 100),
          last_name: sanitizeField(u.last_name || '', 100),
          suffix: sanitizeField(u.suffix || '', 12),
          contact_number: sanitizeField(u.contact_number || '', 13),
          department: sanitizeField(u.department || 'Junior High School', 100) || 'Junior High School',
          password: '',
          photo: null,
        }));
        setPhotoPreview(isSafeImageUrl(pic) ? pic : null);
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (
          controller.signal.aborted ||
          !mountedRef.current ||
          anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
          anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
          anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
        ) {
          return;
        }
        showAlert({ title: 'Notice', message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not pre-load profile details.'), type: 'warning' });
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted && mountedRef.current) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      });

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [isOpen, showAlert]);

  const handlePhotoSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type) || file.size > 2.5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Image', message: 'Use JPG, PNG, or WebP under 2.5 MB.', type: 'error' });
      e.target.value = '';
      return;
    }
    fileReaderRef.current?.abort();
    const reader = new FileReader();
    fileReaderRef.current = reader;
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      if (!mountedRef.current || reader.readyState !== FileReader.DONE) return;
      const b64 = typeof reader.result === 'string' ? reader.result : '';
      if (!isSafeImageUrl(b64)) {
        showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Image', message: 'Could not verify the selected image file.', type: 'error' });
        return;
      }
      setPhotoPreview(b64);
      setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, photo: b64 }));
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const cleanPhone = formData.contact_number.trim().replace(/[\s-]/g, '');
  const isPhoneValid = /^(09|\+639)\d{9}$/.test(cleanPhone);
  const isPasswordValid =
    !formData.password ||
    (formData.password.length >= 8 && /[A-Za-z]/.test(formData.password) && /[0-9]/.test(formData.password));
  const isFormValid =
    formData.first_name.trim().length >= 2 &&
    formData.last_name.trim().length >= 2 &&
    isPhoneValid &&
    isPasswordValid;

  const setField = (key: Exclude<keyof typeof formData, 'photo'>, val: string) => {
    const clean = key === 'password' ? sanitizePassword(val) : sanitizeField(val, key === 'contact_number' ? 13 : 100);
    setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, [key]: clean }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!isFormValid || saving) return;

    submitAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    submitAbortRef.current = controller;

    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload: Record<string, string | null> = {
        first_name: sanitizeField(formData.first_name, 100).trim(),
        middle_name: sanitizeField(formData.middle_name, 100).trim(),
        last_name: sanitizeField(formData.last_name, 100).trim(),
        suffix: sanitizeField(formData.suffix, 12).trim(),
        contact_number: cleanPhone,
        department: sanitizeField(formData.department, 100).trim(),
      };
      const cleanPw = sanitizePassword(formData.password).trim();
      if (cleanPw.length >= 8) payload.password = cleanPw;
      if (formData.photo !== null) {
        payload.photo = formData.photo === '' ? null : isSafeImageUrl(formData.photo) ? formData.photo : null;
      }

      const res = await apiClient.put(API_ROUTES.accounts.me, payload, { signal: controller.signal });
      if (controller.signal.aborted || !mountedRef.current) return;
      showAlert({ title: 'Profile Completed', message: 'Your faculty record is now active.', type: 'success' });
      onCompleted(res.data);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (
        controller.signal.aborted ||
        !mountedRef.current ||
        anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
        anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
        anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
      ) {
        return;
      }
      showAlert({ title: 'Error', message: extractApiError(err, 'Failed to update profile.'), type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted && mountedRef.current) {
        setSaving(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const responsiveGrid: React.CSSProperties = {
    display: 'grid',
    gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 190px), 1fr))',
    gap: 10,
  };

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={() => {}} title="Complete Your Profile Information">
      {loading ? (
        <div style={{ padding: 24, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
          <Loader2 size={18} className="animate-spin" style={{ margin: '0 auto 6px', display: 'block', color: brand.primary }} />
          Loading profile...
        </div>
      ) : (
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
          <div
            style={{
              ...ui.subtleBox,
              backgroundColor: tokens.infoLight,
              borderColor: brand.secondary,
              display: 'flex',
              gap: 10,
              alignItems: 'center',
            }}
          >

/**
 * AttendSure - User Profile View & Edit Modal
 * File: web/src/components/modals/ProfileModal.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { isSafeImageUrl } from '../../theme/tokens';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import { Camera, X, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

export interface ProfileUpdatePayload {
  full_name?: string;
  photo?: string | null;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  token?: string;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

interface ProfileModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onProfileUpdated?: (updated: ProfileUpdatePayload) => void;
}

const SUFFIX_OPTIONS = ['', 'Jr.', 'Sr.', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V'];

const sanitizeField = (raw: string, maxLen = 100): string =>
  String(raw || '').replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '').slice(0, maxLen);

const sanitizePassword = (raw: string): string =>
  String(raw || '').replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/g, '').slice(0, 128);

export const ProfileModal: React.FC<ProfileModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onClose, onProfileUpdated }) => {
  const { tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [photoPreview, setPhotoPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    first_name: '',
    middle_name: '',
    last_name: '',
    suffix: '',
    email: '',
    contact_number: '',
    position: '',
    department: '',
    current_password: '',
    password: '',
    photo: null as string | null,
  });

  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  const submitAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const fileReaderRef = useRef<FileReader | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      mountedRef.current = false;
      submitAbortRef.current?.abort();
      fileReaderRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    setLoading(true);
    apiClient
      .get(API_ROUTES.accounts.me, { params: { nocache: 1 }, signal: controller.signal })
      .then((res) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted || !mountedRef.current || !res.data) return;
        const u = res.data;
        const pic = u.photo_url || u.photo || null;
        setFormData({
          first_name: sanitizeField(u.first_name || '', 100),
          middle_name: sanitizeField(u.middle_name || '', 100),
          last_name: sanitizeField(u.last_name || '', 100),
          suffix: sanitizeField(u.suffix || '', 12),
          email: sanitizeField(u.email || '', 150),
          contact_number: sanitizeField(u.contact_number || '', 30),
          position: sanitizeField(u.position || '', 100),
          department: sanitizeField(u.department || '', 100),
          current_password: '',
          password: '',
          photo: null,
        });
        setPhotoPreview(isSafeImageUrl(pic) ? pic : null);
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (
          controller.signal.aborted ||
          !mountedRef.current ||
          anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
          anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
          anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
        ) {
          return;
        }
        showAlert({ title: 'Error', message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not load profile details.'), type: 'error' });
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted && mountedRef.current) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      });

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [isOpen, showAlert]);

  const handlePhotoSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type) || file.size > 2.5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Image', message: 'Use JPG, PNG, or WebP under 2.5 MB.', type: 'error' });
      e.target.value = '';
      return;
    }
    fileReaderRef.current?.abort();
    const reader = new FileReader();
    fileReaderRef.current = reader;
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      if (!mountedRef.current || reader.readyState !== FileReader.DONE) return;
      const b64 = typeof reader.result === 'string' ? reader.result : '';
      if (!isSafeImageUrl(b64)) {
        showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Image', message: 'Could not verify the selected image file.', type: 'error' });
        return;
      }
      setPhotoPreview(b64);
      setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, photo: b64 }));
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (saving) return;

    const cleanFirst = sanitizeField(formData.first_name, 100).trim();
    const cleanLast = sanitizeField(formData.last_name, 100).trim();
    const cleanEmail = sanitizeField(formData.email, 150).trim().toLowerCase();
    const cleanPw = sanitizePassword(formData.password).trim();
    const cleanCurrentPw = sanitizePassword(formData.current_password).trim();

    if (!cleanFirst || !cleanLast) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Missing Information', message: 'First name and last name are required.', type: 'warning' });
      return;
    }
    if (cleanEmail && !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(cleanEmail)) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Email', message: 'Please enter a valid email address.', type: 'warning' });
      return;
    }
    if (cleanPw && cleanPw.length < 8) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Weak Password',
        message: 'New password must be at least 8 characters long.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    submitAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    submitAbortRef.current = controller;

    setSaving(true);
    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
      first_name: cleanFirst,
      middle_name: sanitizeField(formData.middle_name, 100).trim(),
      last_name: cleanLast,
      suffix: SUFFIX_OPTIONS.includes(formData.suffix) ? formData.suffix : '',
      email: cleanEmail,
      contact_number: sanitizeField(formData.contact_number, 30).trim(),
    };
    if (cleanPw) {
      payload.password = cleanPw;
      if (cleanCurrentPw) {
        payload.current_password = cleanCurrentPw;
      }
    }
    if (formData.photo !== null) {
      payload.photo = formData.photo === '' ? null : isSafeImageUrl(formData.photo) ? formData.photo : null;
    }

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.put(API_ROUTES.accounts.me, payload, { signal: controller.signal });
      if (controller.signal.aborted || !mountedRef.current) return;
      if (res.data?.token) {
        localStorage.setItem('attendsure_token', res.data.token);
      }
      showAlert({ title: 'Saved', message: 'Profile updated.', type: 'success' });
      onProfileUpdated?.(res.data);
      onClose();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (
        controller.signal.aborted ||
        !mountedRef.current ||
        anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
        anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
        anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
      ) {
        return;
      }
      showAlert({ title: 'Error', message: extractApiError(err, 'Update failed.'), type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted && mountedRef.current) {
        setSaving(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const setField = (k: Exclude<keyof typeof formData, 'photo'>, v: string) => {
    let clean = v;
    if (k === 'password' || k === 'current_password') {
      clean = sanitizePassword(v);
    } else if (k === 'email') {
      clean = sanitizeField(v, 150);
    } else if (k === 'contact_number') {
      clean = sanitizeField(v, 30);
    } else {
      clean = sanitizeField(v, 100);
    }
    setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, [k]: clean }));
  };

  const responsiveGrid: React.CSSProperties = {
    display: 'grid',
    gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 190px), 1fr))',
    gap: 10,
  };

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={onClose} title="My User Profile">
      {loading ? (
        <div style={{ padding: 24, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
          <Loader2 size={18} className="animate-spin" style={{ margin: '0 auto 6px', display: 'block', color: brand.primary }} />
          Loading profile...
        </div>
      ) : (
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
          <div style={{ ...ui.subtleBox, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 14, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <div
              style={{
                width: 52,
                height: 52,
                borderRadius: '50%',
                overflow: 'hidden',
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                flexShrink: 0,
              }}
            >
              {photoPreview && isSafeImageUrl(photoPreview) ? (
                <img src={photoPreview} alt="Profile" style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }} />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>No Pic</span>
              )}
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              <label style={ui.btnPrimary}>
                <Camera size={12} /> Change Photo
                <input type="file" accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp" onChange={handlePhotoSelect} style={{ display: 'none' }} />
              </label>
              {photoPreview && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setPhotoPreview(null);
                    setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, photo: '' }));
                  }}
                  style={{
                    color: brand.danger,
                    background: 'none',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    fontSize: '0.74rem',
                    display: 'inline-flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: 3,
                  }}
                >
                  <X size={12} /> Remove
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={responsiveGrid}>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>First Name</label>
              <input required maxLength={100} style={ui.input} value={formData.first_name} onChange={(e) => setField('first_name', e.target.value)} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Last Name</label>
              <input required maxLength={100} style={ui.input} value={formData.last_name} onChange={(e) => setField('last_name', e.target.value)} />
            </div>

          <div style={responsiveGrid}>

/**
 * AttendSure - Digital ID & Signed QR Pass Modal

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { escapeHtml } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { useSchool } from '../../context/SchoolContext';
import { isSafeImageUrl } from '../../theme/tokens';
import { QrCodeSvg, buildQrSvgDataUri } from '../common/QrCodeSvg';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { ShieldCheck, Copy, Check, Printer, User as UserIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import type { StudentItem, AssignedClass } from '../tabs/MyAssignedClassesTab';

interface StudentIdPassModalProps {
  student:
    | (Partial<StudentItem> & {
        name: string;
        lrn: string;
        qr_token?: string;
        qr_payload?: string;
        photo_url?: string | null;
      })
    | null;
  selectedClass?: AssignedClass | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onCopyLrn: (lrn: string) => void;
}

export const StudentIdPassModal: React.FC<StudentIdPassModalProps> = ({
  student,
  selectedClass,
  onClose,
  onCopyLrn,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand, fonts, ui } = useTheme();
  const { school } = useSchool();
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const copyTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (copyTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(copyTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  if (!student) return null;
  const safePhoto = isSafeImageUrl(student.photo_url) ? student.photo_url : null;
  const identifier = student.lrn || 'ID-00000';
  // Prefer digitally signed qr_payload so passes verify cleanly on classroom USB QR scanners
  const qrData = student.qr_payload || identifier;
  const schoolName = school.school_name || 'Authorized School Campus';
  const subtitle = selectedClass?.section_name || 'Authorized Student';
  const signatureLabel = student.qr_payload ? 'Digitally Verified' : 'Active';

  const handleCopyIdentifier = () => {
    onCopyLrn(identifier);
    setCopied(true);
    if (copyTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(copyTimerRef.current);
    copyTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const handlePrintPass = () => {
    const qrDataUri = buildQrSvgDataUri(qrData, 180);
    const printWin = window.open('', '_blank', 'width=460,height=640');
    if (!printWin) {
      window.print();
      return;
    }
    printWin.opener = null;
    const photoMarkup =
      safePhoto && isSafeImageUrl(safePhoto)
        ? `<img src="${escapeHtml(safePhoto)}" alt="${escapeHtml(student.name)}" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;" />`
        : `<span style="font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:#004b87;">${escapeHtml(student.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'S')}</span>`;

    printWin.document.open();
    printWin.document.write(`<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <title>AttendSure ID Pass - ${escapeHtml(student.name)}</title>
