  SlidersHorizontal,
  FileSpreadsheet,
  ExternalLink,
  Table as TableIcon,
  FileCode,
  Loader2,
  RefreshCw,
  Search,
  X,
  Maximize2,
  Calendar,
} from 'lucide-react';

export interface ReportTabItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: React.ComponentType<{ size?: number; className?: string }>;
}

export interface SectionOption {
  id: number | string;
  name: string;
  grade_level?: any;
  grade_level_name?: string;
  academic_year?: string;
  school_year_code?: string;
  adviser_name?: string;
  display_label?: string;
}

export interface ReportExportHandlers {
  onExportPdf?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  onExportExcel?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  onExportGoogleSheets?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  onExportWord?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  onExportGoogleDocs?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  onExportCsv?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  onExportJson?: () => void | Promise<void>;
}

export type LayoutMode = 'pages' | 'pageless';

export interface ReportNavBarProps {
  reports?: ReportTabItem[];
  activeReportId: string;
  onSelectReport: (reportId: string) => void;
  academicYears?: string[];
  selectedAcademicYear?: string;
  onAcademicYearChange?: (year: string) => void;
  showAcademicYearFilter?: boolean;
  gradeLevels?: string[];
  selectedGradeLevel?: string;
  onGradeLevelChange?: (grade: string) => void;
  showGradeLevelFilter?: boolean;
  sections: SectionOption[];
  selectedSectionId: string | number;
  onSectionChange: (sectionId: string) => void;
  showSectionFilter?: boolean;
  showDateFilter?: boolean;
  selectedDate?: string;
  onDateChange?: (date: string) => void;
  showMonthFilter?: boolean;
  selectedMonth?: string;
  onMonthChange?: (month: string) => void;
  monthsList?: string[];
  showCalendarYearFilter?: boolean;
  selectedCalendarYear?: number;
  onCalendarYearChange?: (year: number) => void;
  searchQuery?: string;
  onSearchChange?: (query: string) => void;
  showSearch?: boolean;
  layoutMode?: LayoutMode;
  onToggleLayoutMode?: (mode: LayoutMode) => void;
  showLayoutModeToggle?: boolean;
  onRefresh?: () => void;
  isRefreshing?: boolean;
  onOpenPageSetup?: () => void;
  exportHandlers?: ReportExportHandlers;
  onPrint?: () => void;
  isExporting?: boolean;
  exportingText?: string;
  disableActions?: boolean;
}

const DEFAULT_REPORTS: ReportTabItem[] = [
  { id: 'sf1', label: 'Form 1 (School Register)', icon: FileText },
  { id: 'sf2', label: 'Form 2 (Daily Attendance)', icon: CalendarCheck },
  { id: 'sf4', label: 'Form 4 (Monthly Movement)', icon: FileSpreadsheet },
];

const DEFAULT_MONTHS = [
  'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
  'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December',
];

const getCurrentMonthName = (): string => {
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { month: 'long' }).format(new Date());
  } catch {
    return 'January';
  }
};

const extractSectionGradeName = (sec?: SectionOption | null): string => {
  if (!sec) return '';
  if (sec.grade_level_name && String(sec.grade_level_name).trim()) {
    return String(sec.grade_level_name).trim();
  }
  const val = sec.grade_level;
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
  if (typeof val === 'string') return /^\d+$/.test(val.trim()) ? '' : val.trim();
  if (typeof val === 'object') {
    const name = val.name || val.grade_name || val.level || val.code;
    return name ? String(name).trim() : '';
  }
  return '';
};

export const ReportNavBar: React.FC<ReportNavBarProps> = ({
  reports = DEFAULT_REPORTS,
  activeReportId,
  onSelectReport,
  academicYears = [],
  selectedAcademicYear = '',
  onAcademicYearChange,
  showAcademicYearFilter = false,
  gradeLevels = [],
  selectedGradeLevel = 'ALL',
  onGradeLevelChange,
  showGradeLevelFilter = true,
  sections = [],
  selectedSectionId,
  onSectionChange,
  showSectionFilter = true,
  showDateFilter = false,
  selectedDate = '',
  onDateChange,
  showMonthFilter = false,
  selectedMonth = getCurrentMonthName(),
  onMonthChange,
  monthsList = DEFAULT_MONTHS,
  showCalendarYearFilter = false,
  selectedCalendarYear = new Date().getFullYear(),
  onCalendarYearChange,
  searchQuery = '',
  onSearchChange,
  showSearch = true,
  layoutMode = 'pages',
  onToggleLayoutMode,
  showLayoutModeToggle = true,
  onRefresh,
  isRefreshing = false,
  onOpenPageSetup,
  exportHandlers,
  onPrint,
  isExporting = false,
  exportingText = 'Exporting...',
  disableActions = false,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const [isExportDropdownOpen, setIsExportDropdownOpen] = useState(false);
  const dropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const userRole = (localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || '').toUpperCase();
  const isSchoolLeader = ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'FACULTY_ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD'].includes(userRole);

  const filteredReports = useMemo(() => {
    return reports.filter((rep) => {
      if (rep.id === 'sf4' && !isSchoolLeader) return false;
      return true;
    });
  }, [reports, isSchoolLeader]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isExportDropdownOpen) return;

    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsExportDropdownOpen(false);
      }
    };

    const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        setIsExportDropdownOpen(false);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isExportDropdownOpen]);

  const filteredSections = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedGradeLevel || selectedGradeLevel === 'ALL') {
      return sections;
    }
    const target = selectedGradeLevel.toLowerCase().trim();
    return sections.filter((sec) => {
      const g = extractSectionGradeName(sec).toLowerCase();
      return g === target || g.includes(target);
    });
  }, [sections, selectedGradeLevel]);

  const availableGradeLevels = useMemo(() => {
    if (gradeLevels && gradeLevels.length > 0) {
      return gradeLevels
        .map((g) => String(g || '').trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
        .sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' }));
    }
    const extracted = Array.from(new Set(sections.map(extractSectionGradeName).filter(Boolean)));
    return extracted.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' }));
  }, [gradeLevels, sections]);

  const handleExportAction = (action?: () => void | Promise<void>) => {
    setIsExportDropdownOpen(false);
    if (action) void action();
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="no-print"
      style={{
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        width: '100%',
        flexShrink: 0,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: 12,
          padding: '10px 24px',
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
          borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        }}
      >
        <span style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textMuted, letterSpacing: '0.4px', textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
          REPORT FORM:
        </span>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, padding: '4px', borderRadius: 10, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
          {filteredReports.map((rep) => {
            const Icon = rep.icon;
            const isActive = rep.id === activeReportId;
            return (
              <button
                key={rep.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onSelectReport(rep.id)}
                style={{
                  padding: '6px 14px',
                  borderRadius: 8,
                  border: 'none',
                  fontSize: '0.80rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 6,
                  backgroundColor: isActive ? brand.buttonBg : 'transparent',
                  color: isActive ? '#FFFFFF' : tokens.textSecondary,
                  boxShadow: isActive ? tokens.cardShadow : 'none',
                  transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
                }}
              >
                {Icon && <Icon size={15} />}
                <span>{rep.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center',
          padding: '10px 24px',
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
          borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: 12,
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {showAcademicYearFilter && onAcademicYearChange && academicYears.length > 0 && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>School Year:</span>
              <select
                value={selectedAcademicYear}
                onChange={(e) => onAcademicYearChange(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  padding: '6px 10px',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                  fontSize: '0.80rem',
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                  outline: 'none',
                }}
              >
                {!selectedAcademicYear && <option value="">-- Select S.Y. --</option>}
                {academicYears.map((sy) => (
                  <option key={sy} value={sy}>
                    {sy}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          )}

          {showGradeLevelFilter && onGradeLevelChange && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Grade Level:</span>
              <select
                value={selectedGradeLevel}
                onChange={(e) => onGradeLevelChange(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  padding: '6px 10px',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                  fontSize: '0.80rem',
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                  outline: 'none',
                }}
              >
                <option value="ALL">All Grades</option>
                {availableGradeLevels.map((g) => (
                  <option key={g} value={g}>
                    {g}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          )}

          {showSectionFilter && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Section:</span>
              <select
                value={String(selectedSectionId ?? '')}
                onChange={(e) => onSectionChange(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  padding: '6px 10px',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                  fontSize: '0.80rem',
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                  outline: 'none',
                }}
              >
                {!selectedSectionId && <option value="">-- Choose Section --</option>}
                {filteredSections.length === 0 ? (
                  <option value="" disabled>
                    No sections available
                  </option>
                ) : (
                  filteredSections.map((sec) => {
                    const gradeStr = extractSectionGradeName(sec);
                    return (
                      <option key={sec.id} value={String(sec.id)}>
                        {sec.display_label ||
                          `${gradeStr ? `${gradeStr} - ` : ''}${sec.name}${sec.adviser_name ? ` (${sec.adviser_name})` : ''}`}
                      </option>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </select>
            </div>
          )}

          {showDateFilter && onDateChange && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Date:</span>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, padding: '4px 8px', borderRadius: 6, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle }}>
                <Calendar size={13} color={tokens.textMuted} />
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={selectedDate}
                  onChange={(e) => onDateChange(e.target.value)}
                  style={{ border: 'none', outline: 'none', background: 'transparent', fontSize: '0.80rem', fontWeight: 600, color: tokens.textPrimary }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {showMonthFilter && onMonthChange && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Month:</span>
              <select
                value={selectedMonth}
                onChange={(e) => onMonthChange(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  padding: '6px 10px',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                  fontSize: '0.80rem',
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                  outline: 'none',
                }}
              >
                {monthsList.map((m) => (
                  <option key={m} value={m}>
                    {m}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          )}

          {showCalendarYearFilter && onCalendarYearChange && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Year:</span>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={selectedCalendarYear || new Date().getFullYear()}
                onChange={(e) => onCalendarYearChange(Number(e.target.value) || new Date().getFullYear())}
                style={{
                  padding: '6px 10px',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                  fontSize: '0.80rem',
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                  outline: 'none',
                  width: 80,
                }}
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {showSearch && onSearchChange && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, padding: '5px 10px', borderRadius: 6, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, width: 200 }}>
              <Search size={14} color={tokens.textMuted} />
              <input
                type="text"
                maxLength={80}
                value={searchQuery}
                placeholder="Search name or LRN..."
                onChange={(e) => onSearchChange(e.target.value.replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, ''))}
                style={{ border: 'none', outline: 'none', background: 'transparent', fontSize: '0.78rem', width: '100%', color: tokens.textPrimary }}
              />
              {searchQuery && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onSearchChange('')}
                  style={{ border: 'none', background: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 0 }}
                  title="Clear search"
                >
                  <X size={13} color={tokens.textMuted} />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {onRefresh && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onRefresh}
              disabled={isRefreshing}
              title="Refresh Record from Database"
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 6,
                padding: '6px 12px',
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                borderRadius: 6,
                fontSize: '0.80rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                color: tokens.textPrimary,
                cursor: 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              <RefreshCw size={14} className={isRefreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''} />
              <span>Refresh</span>
            </button>
          )}

          {showLayoutModeToggle && onToggleLayoutMode && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onToggleLayoutMode(layoutMode === 'pageless' ? 'pages' : 'pageless')}
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 6,
                padding: '6px 12px',
                backgroundColor: layoutMode === 'pageless' ? tokens.primaryLight : tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                border: `1px solid ${layoutMode === 'pageless' ? brand.primary : tokens.borderStrong}`,
                borderRadius: 6,
                fontSize: '0.80rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                color: layoutMode === 'pageless' ? brand.primary : tokens.textPrimary,
                cursor: 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              {layoutMode === 'pageless' ? <Maximize2 size={14} /> : <FileText size={14} />}
              <span>{layoutMode === 'pageless' ? 'Pageless' : 'Pages'}</span>
            </button>
          )}

          {onOpenPageSetup && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onOpenPageSetup}
              disabled={disableActions}
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 6,
                padding: '6px 12px',
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                borderRadius: 6,
                fontSize: '0.80rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                color: tokens.textPrimary,
                cursor: 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              <SlidersHorizontal size={14} />
              <span>Page Setup</span>
            </button>
          )}

          {exportHandlers && (
            <div style={{ position: 'relative' }} ref={dropdownRef}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsExportDropdownOpen((prev) => !prev)}
                disabled={disableActions || isExporting}
                aria-haspopup="true"
                aria-expanded={isExportDropdownOpen}
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 6,
                  padding: '6px 12px',
                  backgroundColor: tokens.successLight,
                  border: `1px solid ${brand.success}`,
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  fontSize: '0.80rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  color: brand.success,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                }}
              >
                {isExporting ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" />
                    <span>{exportingText}</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Download size={14} />
                    <span>Download Report</span>
                    <ChevronDown size={13} />
                  </>
                )}
              </button>

              {isExportDropdownOpen && (
                <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 'calc(100% + 6px)', right: 0, width: 270, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, borderRadius: 10, boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, padding: '6px 0', zIndex: 1000, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
                  {exportHandlers.onExportPdf && (
                    <>
                      <div style={{ padding: '6px 14px 2px 14px', fontSize: '0.62rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textMuted, letterSpacing: '0.5px' }}>FILE DOWNLOADS</div>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleExportAction(exportHandlers.onExportPdf)}
                        style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '8px 14px', border: 'none', backgroundColor: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '0.78rem', textAlign: 'left', width: '100%', color: tokens.textPrimary }}
                      >
                        <Download size={15} color={brand.primary} />
                        <div style={{ flex: 1, textAlign: 'left' }}>
                          <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Adobe PDF (.pdf)</div>
                          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Official Document Format</div>
                        </div>
                      </button>
                    </>
                  )}

                  {(exportHandlers.onExportExcel || exportHandlers.onExportGoogleSheets || exportHandlers.onExportWord) && (
                    <>
                      <div style={{ padding: '6px 14px 2px 14px', fontSize: '0.62rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textMuted, letterSpacing: '0.5px' }}>OFFICE DOCUMENTS</div>
                      {exportHandlers.onExportExcel && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleExportAction(exportHandlers.onExportExcel)}
                          style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '8px 14px', border: 'none', backgroundColor: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '0.78rem', textAlign: 'left', width: '100%', color: tokens.textPrimary }}
                        >
                          <FileSpreadsheet size={15} color={brand.success} />
                          <div style={{ flex: 1, textAlign: 'left' }}>
                            <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Microsoft Excel (.xls)</div>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Formatted DepEd spreadsheet</div>
                          </div>
                        </button>
                      )}
                      {exportHandlers.onExportWord && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleExportAction(exportHandlers.onExportWord)}
                          style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '8px 14px', border: 'none', backgroundColor: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '0.78rem', textAlign: 'left', width: '100%', color: tokens.textPrimary }}
                        >
                          <FileText size={15} color={brand.primary} />
                          <div style={{ flex: 1, textAlign: 'left' }}>
                            <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Microsoft Word (.doc)</div>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Editable official form</div>
                          </div>
                        </button>
                      )}
                      {exportHandlers.onExportGoogleSheets && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleExportAction(exportHandlers.onExportGoogleSheets)}
                          style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '8px 14px', border: 'none', backgroundColor: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '0.78rem', textAlign: 'left', width: '100%', color: tokens.textPrimary }}
                        >
                          <ExternalLink size={15} color={brand.success} />
                          <div style={{ flex: 1, textAlign: 'left' }}>
                            <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Google Sheets</div>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Opens in web spreadsheet</div>
                          </div>
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </>
                  )}

                  {(exportHandlers.onExportCsv || exportHandlers.onExportJson) && (
                    <>
                      <div style={{ padding: '6px 14px 2px 14px', fontSize: '0.62rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textMuted, letterSpacing: '0.5px' }}>DATA EXCHANGE</div>
                      {exportHandlers.onExportCsv && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleExportAction(exportHandlers.onExportCsv)}
                          style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '8px 14px', border: 'none', backgroundColor: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '0.78rem', textAlign: 'left', width: '100%', color: tokens.textPrimary }}
                        >
                          <TableIcon size={15} color={brand.warning} />
                          <div style={{ flex: 1, textAlign: 'left' }}>
                            <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>LIS CSV Spreadsheet (.csv)</div>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Standard DepEd data exchange</div>
                          </div>
                        </button>
                      )}
                      {exportHandlers.onExportJson && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleExportAction(exportHandlers.onExportJson)}
                          style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '8px 14px', border: 'none', backgroundColor: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '0.78rem', textAlign: 'left', width: '100%', color: tokens.textPrimary }}
                        >
                          <FileCode size={15} color={brand.secondary} />
                          <div style={{ flex: 1, textAlign: 'left' }}>
                            <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Raw JSON Data (.json)</div>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Database export &amp; backup</div>
                          </div>
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {onPrint && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onPrint}
              disabled={disableActions}
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 6,
                padding: '6px 16px',
                backgroundColor: brand.buttonBg,
                border: 'none',
                borderRadius: 6,
                fontSize: '0.80rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                color: '#FFFFFF',
                cursor: 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              <Printer size={15} />
              <span>Print</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export const resolvePaperDimensionsInches = (
  config: PageSetupConfig
): { widthIn: number; heightIn: number } => {
  const paper = PAPER_SIZES[config.paperSize] || PAPER_SIZES.legal;
  const isLandscape = config.orientation === 'landscape';
  return isLandscape
    ? { widthIn: paper.height, heightIn: paper.width }
    : { widthIn: paper.width, heightIn: paper.height };
};

export const ReportHeaderBar: React.FC<ReportHeaderBarProps> = ({
  activeReportId = 'sf1',
  onSelectReport,
  documentTitle,
  subtitle,
  isSavingPdf = false,
  onOpenPageSetup,
  onPrint,
  onSavePdf,
  onSavePdfAs,
  onDownloadExcel,
  onSaveExcelAs,
  onDownloadCsv,
  onSaveCsvAs,
  onDownloadWord,
  onSaveWordAs,
  onDownloadJson,
  onSaveJsonAs,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const dropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const userRole = (localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || '').toUpperCase();
  const isLeader = ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'FACULTY_ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD'].includes(
    userRole
  );

  const reportTabs = [
    { id: 'sf1', label: 'Form 1 (School Register)' },
    { id: 'sf2', label: 'Form 2 (Daily Attendance)' },
    ...(isLeader ? [{ id: 'sf4', label: 'Form 4 (Monthly Movement)' }] : []),
  ];

  const handleSwitchReport = (reportId: string) => {
    if (onSelectReport) {
      onSelectReport(reportId);
    } else {
      window.dispatchEvent(
        new CustomEvent('attendsure:navigate', { detail: { tab: 'reports', report: reportId } })
      );
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!menuOpen) return;

    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setMenuOpen(false);
      }
    };

    const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        setMenuOpen(false);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [menuOpen]);

  const menuActions: Array<{ label: string; fn: () => void }> = [
    { label: 'Download PDF (.pdf)', fn: onSavePdf },
    ...(onSavePdfAs ? [{ label: 'Save PDF As...', fn: onSavePdfAs }] : []),
    { label: 'Download Excel (.xls)', fn: onDownloadExcel },
    ...(onSaveExcelAs ? [{ label: 'Save Excel As...', fn: onSaveExcelAs }] : []),
    { label: 'Download CSV (.csv)', fn: onDownloadCsv },
    ...(onSaveCsvAs ? [{ label: 'Save CSV As...', fn: onSaveCsvAs }] : []),
    { label: 'Download Word (.doc)', fn: onDownloadWord },
    ...(onSaveWordAs ? [{ label: 'Save Word As...', fn: onSaveWordAs }] : []),
    { label: 'Download JSON (.json)', fn: onDownloadJson },
    ...(onSaveJsonAs ? [{ label: 'Save JSON As...', fn: onSaveJsonAs }] : []),
  ];

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', width: '100%' }}>
      {/* Report Form Switcher Bar (Form 1 / Form 2 / Form 4) */}
      <div
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: 12,
          padding: '8px 24px',
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
          borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
        }}
      >
        <span
          style={{
            fontSize: '0.72rem',
            fontWeight: 800,
            color: tokens.textMuted,
            letterSpacing: '0.4px',
            textTransform: 'uppercase',
          }}
        >
          REPORT FORM:
        </span>
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            gap: 6,
            backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
            padding: 4,
            borderRadius: 10,
            border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
            flexWrap: 'wrap',
          }}
        >
          {reportTabs.map((tab) => {
            const isActive = activeReportId === tab.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleSwitchReport(tab.id)}
                style={{
                  padding: '6px 14px',
                  borderRadius: 8,
                  border: 'none',
                  fontSize: '0.80rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  backgroundColor: isActive ? brand.buttonBg : 'transparent',
                  color: isActive ? '#ffffff' : tokens.textSecondary,
                  boxShadow: isActive ? tokens.cardShadow : 'none',
                  transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
                }}
              >
                {tab.label}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Document Title & Export Actions Row */}
      <div
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: 12,
          padding: '10px 24px',
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
          borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        }}
      >
        <div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.92rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>

          </div>
          {subtitle && (

        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: 8,
            flexWrap: 'wrap',
            position: 'relative',
          }}
        >
          <button type="button" onClick={onOpenPageSetup} style={ui.btnSecondary}>
            <Settings size={14} />
            <span>Page Setup</span>
          </button>

          <div ref={dropdownRef} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-haspopup="true"
              aria-expanded={menuOpen}
              onClick={() => setMenuOpen((prev) => !prev)}
              style={ui.btnSecondary}
            >
              <FileSpreadsheet size={14} />
              <span>Export Formats</span>
            </button>

                  boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
                  padding: 6,
                  display: 'flex',
                  flexDirection: 'column',
                  gap: 2,
                }}
              >
                {menuActions.map((item) => (
                  <button
                    key={item.label}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setMenuOpen(false);
                      item.fn();
                    }}

                      textAlign: 'left',
                      padding: '7px 10px',

export interface ReportViewerShellProps {
  loading: boolean;
  loadingMessage: string;
  error: string | null;
  hasData: boolean;
  isPrinting: boolean;
  isExportingPdf: boolean;
  pageWidthInches: number;
  pageHeightInches: number;
  pageConfig: PageSetupConfig;
  sheetClassName: string;
  documentId: string;
  reportRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  leftToolbarContent?: React.ReactNode;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

const sanitizeCssToken = (raw: string, fallback: string): string => {
  const cleaned = String(raw || '').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '');
  return cleaned || fallback;
};

const sanitizePageColor = (raw?: string): string => {
  if (raw && /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(raw.trim())) {
    return raw.trim();
  }
  return '#ffffff';
};

export const ReportViewerShell: React.FC<ReportViewerShellProps> = ({
  loading,
  loadingMessage,
  error,
  hasData,
  isPrinting,
  isExportingPdf,
  pageWidthInches,
  pageHeightInches,
  pageConfig,
  sheetClassName,
  documentId,
  reportRef,
  leftToolbarContent,
  children,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const [zoomScale, setZoomScale] = useState<number>(1);
  const [fitToWidth, setFitToWidth] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const viewportRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const safeDocId = sanitizeCssToken(documentId, 'report-print-document');
  const safeSheetClass = sanitizeCssToken(sheetClassName, 'report-sheet-page');
  const safePageColor = sanitizePageColor(pageConfig.pageColor);

  const updateFitScale = useCallback(() => {
    if (!viewportRef.current) return;
    const containerWidth = viewportRef.current.clientWidth - 48;
    const targetWidth = pageWidthInches * 96;
    if (containerWidth > 0 && targetWidth > 0) {
      const scale = containerWidth / targetWidth;
      setZoomScale(Number(Math.min(1.15, Math.max(0.35, scale)).toFixed(3)));
    }
  }, [pageWidthInches]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (fitToWidth && !isPrinting && !isExportingPdf) {
      const timer = setTimeout(updateFitScale, 50);
      window.addEventListener('resize', updateFitScale);
      return () => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        window.removeEventListener('resize', updateFitScale);
      };
    }
  }, [fitToWidth, isPrinting, isExportingPdf, updateFitScale, hasData, pageConfig]);

  return (
    <>
      <div
        className="no-print"
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          padding: '8px 24px',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: 10,
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
          borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {leftToolbarContent}
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setFitToWidth(true);
              updateFitScale();
            }}
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 5,
              padding: '4px 10px',
              borderRadius: 6,
              cursor: 'pointer',
              fontSize: '0.76rem',
              fontWeight: 700,
              backgroundColor: fitToWidth ? tokens.primaryLight : tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
              border: `1px solid ${fitToWidth ? brand.primary : tokens.borderStrong}`,
              color: fitToWidth ? brand.primary : tokens.textSecondary,
            }}
          >
            <Maximize2 size={13} /> Fit Screen ({Math.round(zoomScale * 100)}%)
          </button>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label="Zoom out"
              onClick={() => {
                setFitToWidth(false);
                setZoomScale((prev) => Math.max(0.35, Number((prev - 0.05).toFixed(2))));
              }}
              style={{
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: 6,
                cursor: 'pointer',
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                color: tokens.textPrimary,
              }}
            >
              <ZoomOut size={13} />
            </button>
            <span
              style={{
                minWidth: 42,
                textAlign: 'center',
                fontWeight: 700,
                fontSize: '0.76rem',
                color: tokens.textPrimary,
              }}
            >
              {Math.round(zoomScale * 100)}%
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label="Zoom in"
              onClick={() => {
                setFitToWidth(false);
                setZoomScale((prev) => Math.min(1.4, Number((prev + 0.05).toFixed(2))));
              }}
              style={{
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: 6,
                cursor: 'pointer',
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                color: tokens.textPrimary,
              }}
            >
              <ZoomIn size={13} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div
        ref={viewportRef}
        className="report-viewer-viewport"
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          overflowY: 'auto',
          overflowX: 'auto',
          padding: '16px 20px',
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          alignItems: 'center',
          width: '100%',
          boxSizing: 'border-box',
        }}
      >
        {loading ? (
          <div
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 12,
              marginTop: 80,
              fontWeight: 600,
              color: tokens.textSecondary,
            }}
          >
            <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={28} color={brand.primary} />
            <span>{loadingMessage}</span>
          </div>
        ) : error ? (
          <div
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 8,
              marginTop: 80,
              fontWeight: 600,
              padding: '12px 20px',
              borderRadius: 8,
              color: brand.danger,
              backgroundColor: tokens.dangerLight,
              border: `1px solid ${brand.danger}`,
            }}
          >
            <AlertCircle size={24} color={brand.danger} />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
        ) : hasData ? (
          <div
            style={{
              width: isPrinting ? '100%' : `${pageWidthInches * zoomScale}in`,
              maxWidth: '100%',
              margin: '0 auto',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              alignItems: 'center',
            }}
          >
            <div
              style={{
                transform: isPrinting ? 'none' : `scale(${zoomScale})`,
                transformOrigin: 'top center',
                width: isPrinting ? '100%' : `${pageWidthInches}in`,
                minWidth: isPrinting ? '100%' : `${pageWidthInches}in`,
                transition: isPrinting ? 'none' : 'transform 0.15s ease-out',
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
              }}
            >
              <div
                id={safeDocId}
                ref={reportRef}
                style={{
                  width: '100%',
                  display: 'flex',
                  flexDirection: 'column',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                }}
              >
                {children}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <style>{`
        @media print {
          @page {
            size: ${pageWidthInches}in ${pageHeightInches}in;
            margin: 0 !important;
          }
          .no-print, nav, aside, header, footer, button, input, select {
            display: none !important;
          }
          html, body, #root, #root > div, main, .report-tab-root, .report-viewer-viewport {
            margin: 0 !important;

            overflow: visible !important;

            background: #ffffff !important;

            -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact !important;
            print-color-adjust: exact !important;
          }
          * {
            -webkit-transform: none !important;
            transform: none !important;
            zoom: 1 !important;
          }
          #${safeDocId} {
            width: 100% !important;
            max-width: 100% !important;
            min-width: 100% !important;
            margin: 0 auto !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
            display: block !important;
          }
          .${safeSheetClass} {

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import type { AxiosResponse } from 'axios';
import jsQR from 'jsqr';
import apiClient, { peekApiCache } from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import { isSafeImageUrl } from '../../theme/tokens';

export interface ScannedStudent {
  student_id: number;
  student_name: string;
  lrn: string;
  section: string;
  status: string;
  scanned_at: string;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  attendance_note?: string;
  is_duplicate?: boolean;
}

interface ClassPeriodOption {
  id: number;
  schedule_id?: number | null;
  name: string;
  grade_level: string;
  subject_code: string;
  subject_title: string;
  time_display: string;
}

interface OfflineScanEntry {
  qr_token: string;
  period_id: number | null;
  scanned_at: string;
}

export interface ClassroomScannerProps {
  onClose?: () => void;
  isModal?: boolean;
}

const OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY = 'attendsure_offline_qr_queue';

const loadOfflineQueue = (): OfflineScanEntry[] => {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY);
    return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as OfflineScanEntry[]) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
};

const playFeedbackChime = (type: 'SUCCESS' | 'WARNING' | 'ERROR') => {
  try {
    const AudioCtx =
      window.AudioContext ||
      (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioCtx) return;
    const ctx = new AudioCtx();
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = ctx.createGain();
    osc.type = type === 'SUCCESS' ? 'sine' : 'triangle';
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(type === 'SUCCESS' ? 1046 : 250, ctx.currentTime);
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, ctx.currentTime);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.22);
    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
    osc.onended = () => {
      void ctx.close().catch(() => {});
    };
    osc.start();
    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.22);
  } catch {
    // Browser autoplay policy blocked audio
  }
};

const MAX_QR_INPUT_LENGTH = 256;
const sanitizeQrInput = (raw: string): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .slice(0, MAX_QR_INPUT_LENGTH);

export const ClassroomScanner: React.FC<ClassroomScannerProps> = ({ onClose, isModal = false }) => {
  const { tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();

  const warmPeriods = useMemo(() => {
    const cached = peekApiCache<ClassPeriodOption[]>(API_ROUTES.attendance.classes, { summary: 1 });
    return Array.isArray(cached) ? cached.filter((p) => p.id > 0) : [];
  }, []);

  const [scannerMode, setScannerMode] = useState<'USB_GUN' | 'CAMERA'>('USB_GUN');
  const [soundEnabled, setSoundEnabled] = useState(true);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [syncingOffline, setSyncingOffline] = useState(false);
  const [inputCode, setInputCode] = useState('');

  const [periods, setPeriods] = useState<ClassPeriodOption[]>(() => warmPeriods);
  const [selectedPeriodId, setSelectedPeriodId] = useState<number | null>(() =>
    warmPeriods.length > 0 ? warmPeriods[0].id : null
  );
  const [activeStudent, setActiveStudent] = useState<ScannedStudent | null>(null);
  const [sessionList, setSessionList] = useState<ScannedStudent[]>([]);
  const [offlineQueue, setOfflineQueue] = useState<OfflineScanEntry[]>(loadOfflineQueue);
  const [cameraMessage, setCameraMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  const loadingRef = useRef(false);
  const cooldownRef = useRef(false);
  const processScanRef = useRef<(rawCode: string) => Promise<void>>(async () => {});
  const keyBuffer = useRef('');
  const lastKeyTime = useRef(0);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const frameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const focusTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const cameraCooldownTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const scanAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  loadingRef.current = loading;

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      mountedRef.current = false;
      scanAbortRef.current?.abort();
      if (focusTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(focusTimerRef.current);
      if (cameraCooldownTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(cameraCooldownTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    apiClient
      .get<ClassPeriodOption[]>(API_ROUTES.attendance.classes, {
        params: { summary: 1 },
        signal: controller.signal,
      })
      .then((res: AxiosResponse<ClassPeriodOption[]>) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const rawList: ClassPeriodOption[] = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : [];
        const validList = rawList.filter((p) => p.id > 0);
        setPeriods(validList);
        if (validList.length > 0) setSelectedPeriodId((prev) => prev ?? validList[0].id);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, []);

  const syncOfflineScans = useCallback(async () => {
    const queued = loadOfflineQueue();
    if (queued.length === 0) return;
    setSyncingOffline(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.attendance.offlineSync, { scans: queued });
      if (!mountedRef.current) return;
      try {
        localStorage.removeItem(OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY);
      } catch {
        // Ignore storage error
      }
      setOfflineQueue([]);
      showAlert({
        title: 'Offline Scans Synced',
        message: `Synced ${res.data?.synced_count ?? 0} scan(s) (${res.data?.duplicate_count ?? 0} duplicate).`,
        type: 'success',
      });
    } catch (err) {
      if (!mountedRef.current) return;
      showAlert({ title: 'Sync Notice', message: extractApiError(err, 'Still offline.'), type: 'warning' });
    } finally {
      if (mountedRef.current) setSyncingOffline(false);
    }
  }, [showAlert]);

  const handleProcessScan = useCallback(
    async (rawCode: string) => {
      const clean = sanitizeQrInput(rawCode).trim();
      if (!clean || loadingRef.current) return;

      scanAbortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      scanAbortRef.current = controller;

      loadingRef.current = true;
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await apiClient.post(
          API_ROUTES.attendance.scan,
          {
            qr_text: clean,
            period_id: selectedPeriodId && selectedPeriodId > 0 ? selectedPeriodId : undefined,
          },
          { signal: controller.signal }
        );
        if (controller.signal.aborted || !mountedRef.current) return;

        const d = res.data || {};
        const item: ScannedStudent = {
          student_id: d.student_id,
          student_name: d.student_name,
          lrn: d.lrn,
          section: d.section,
          status: d.status || 'PRESENT',
          scanned_at: d.scanned_at,
          photo_url: isSafeImageUrl(d.photo_url) ? d.photo_url : null,
          attendance_note: d.attendance_note,
          is_duplicate: Boolean(d.is_duplicate),
        };

        setActiveStudent(item);
        if (soundEnabled) playFeedbackChime(item.is_duplicate ? 'WARNING' : 'SUCCESS');
        if (!item.is_duplicate) {
          setSessionList((prev) => [item, ...prev.filter((p) => p.lrn !== item.lrn)]);
        }
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const netErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string; response?: unknown };
        if (
          controller.signal.aborted ||
          !mountedRef.current ||
          netErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
          netErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
          netErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
        ) {
          return;
        }
        if (!netErr?.response) {
          const nextQueue: OfflineScanEntry[] = [
            ...loadOfflineQueue(),
            {
              qr_token: clean,
              period_id: selectedPeriodId && selectedPeriodId > 0 ? selectedPeriodId : null,
              scanned_at: new Date().toISOString(),
            },
          ];
          try {
            localStorage.setItem(OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY, JSON.stringify(nextQueue));
          } catch {
            // Ignore storage quota error
          }
          setOfflineQueue(nextQueue);
          if (soundEnabled) playFeedbackChime('WARNING');
          showAlert({
            title: 'Saved to Offline Queue',
            message: `Internet unavailable. Queued "${clean.slice(0, 20)}" for automatic sync.`,
            type: 'info',
          });
        } else {
          if (soundEnabled) playFeedbackChime('ERROR');
          showAlert({ title: 'Scan Rejected', message: extractApiError(err), type: 'warning' });
        }
      } finally {
        loadingRef.current = false;
        if (mountedRef.current && !controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setInputCode('');
          if (focusTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(focusTimerRef.current);
          focusTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
            if (scannerMode === 'USB_GUN') {
              inputRef.current?.focus();
            }
          }, 40);
        }
      }
    },
    [selectedPeriodId, soundEnabled, showAlert, scannerMode]
  );

  processScanRef.current = handleProcessScan;

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const tag = (document.activeElement as HTMLElement)?.tagName;
      if (tag === 'INPUT' && document.activeElement !== inputRef.current) return;
      const now = Date.now();
      if (now - lastKeyTime.current > 120) keyBuffer.current = '';
      lastKeyTime.current = now;
      if (e.key === 'Enter' && keyBuffer.current.length >= 4) {
        e.preventDefault();
        void processScanRef.current(keyBuffer.current);
        keyBuffer.current = '';
      } else if (e.key.length === 1 && keyBuffer.current.length < MAX_QR_INPUT_LENGTH) {
        const ch = e.key.replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '');
        if (ch) keyBuffer.current += ch;
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (scannerMode !== 'CAMERA') {
      streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
      if (frameRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(frameRef.current);
      if (cameraCooldownTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(cameraCooldownTimerRef.current);
      cooldownRef.current = false;
      return;
    }

    setCameraMessage(null);

    if (!window.isSecureContext || !navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
      const portSuffix = window.location.port ? `:${window.location.port}` : '';
      setCameraMessage(
        `Browser security blocks webcam access on non-HTTPS domains (${window.location.origin}). Open http://localhost${portSuffix} in your browser to use your laptop webcam, or paste a signed QR string in USB QR Scanner mode.`
      );
      return;
    }

    let active = true;
    const startCameraStream = async () => {
      let stream: MediaStream;
      try {
        stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
          video: { facingMode: { ideal: 'environment' }, width: { ideal: 640 }, height: { ideal: 480 } },
          audio: false,
        });
      } catch {
        stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: true, audio: false });
      }

      if (!active) {
        stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
        return;
      }

      streamRef.current = stream;
      if (videoRef.current) {
        videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
        await videoRef.current.play().catch(() => {});
      }

      if (!canvasRef.current) {
        canvasRef.current = document.createElement('canvas');
      }
      const canvas = canvasRef.current;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });

      const scanFrame = async () => {
        if (!active) return;
        const video = videoRef.current;
        if (
          video &&
          ctx &&
          video.readyState >= video.HAVE_ENOUGH_DATA &&
          video.videoWidth > 0 &&
          video.videoHeight > 0 &&
          !loadingRef.current &&
          !cooldownRef.current
        ) {
          canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
          canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
          ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
          const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
          const decoded = jsQR(imageData.data, imageData.width, imageData.height, {
            inversionAttempts: 'dontInvert',
          });

          if (decoded?.data) {
            cooldownRef.current = true;
            await processScanRef.current(decoded.data);
            if (cameraCooldownTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(cameraCooldownTimerRef.current);
            cameraCooldownTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
              cooldownRef.current = false;
            }, 1400);
          }
        }
        if (active) {
          frameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            void scanFrame();
          });
        }
      };

      frameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        void scanFrame();
      });
    };

      if (!active) return;
      const errName = (err as { name?: string })?.name || '';
      if (errName === 'NotFoundError' || errName === 'DevicesNotFoundError') {
        setCameraMessage('No webcam was detected on this laptop. Check if your camera is enabled in Windows Settings.');
      } else if (errName === 'NotReadableError' || errName === 'TrackStartError') {
        setCameraMessage('Your webcam is currently in use by another app (such as Zoom, Teams, or Camera). Close the other app and try again.');
      } else {
        setCameraMessage(
          'Camera permission was blocked. Click the lock/tune icon in your browser address bar, set Camera to Allow, and refresh.'
        );
      }
    });

    return () => {
      active = false;
      streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
      if (frameRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(frameRef.current);
      if (cameraCooldownTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(cameraCooldownTimerRef.current);
      cooldownRef.current = false;
    };
  }, [scannerMode]);

  return (
    <div
      style={
        isModal
          ? {
              position: 'fixed',
              inset: 0,
              zIndex: 9999,
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(15,23,42,0.65)',
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: 16,
            }
          : { width: '100%' }
      }
    >
      <div style={{ ...ui.card, padding: 0, overflow: 'hidden', width: '100%', maxWidth: isModal ? 900 : '100%' }}>
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            alignItems: 'center',
            flexWrap: 'wrap',

          }}

              options={[
                { value: 'USB_GUN', label: 'USB QR Scanner', icon: <HardDrive size={14} /> },
                { value: 'CAMERA', label: 'Device Camera', icon: <Camera size={14} /> },
              ]}
              value={scannerMode}
              onChange={setScannerMode}
            />

            {periods.length > 0 && (
              <select
                aria-label="Select class period"

                    <ShieldCheck size={14} /> {activeStudent.attendance_note}

                )}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div
                key="waiting-scan-card"
                style={{
                  ...ui.card,
                  borderStyle: 'dashed',
                  borderColor: tokens.borderStrong,
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  padding: 24,
                }}
              >
                <QrCode size={30} color={tokens.textMuted} style={{ margin: '0 auto 6px', display: 'block' }} />
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.80rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                  Waiting for First QR Scan
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div style={{ ...ui.card, padding: 0, overflow: 'hidden', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
            <div
              style={{
                padding: '12px 16px',
                borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                display: 'flex',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                alignItems: 'center',
              }}
            >
              <strong style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: tokens.textPrimary }}>SESSION SCANS ({sessionList.length})</strong>
              {sessionList.length > 0 && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSessionList([])}
                  style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.danger, fontSize: '0.74rem', fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer' }}
                >
                  Clear
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
            <div style={{ height: 340, overflowY: 'auto', padding: 12, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
              {sessionList.length === 0 ? (
                <div style={{ margin: 'auto', textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted, fontSize: '0.78rem' }}>
                  <Info size={22} style={{ margin: '0 auto 6px', display: 'block' }} /> Scanned students appear here live.
                </div>
              ) : (
                sessionList.map((item, idx) => (
                  <div key={`${item.lrn}-${idx}`} style={{ ...ui.subtleBox, display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                    <div>
                      <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: '0.82rem', color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                        #{idx + 1} {item.student_name}
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                        LRN: {item.lrn} &bull; {item.section}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}>
                      <span style={ui.badge(tokens.successLight, brand.success)}>
                        <CheckCircle2 size={11} /> {item.status}
                      </span>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '0.64rem', color: tokens.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}>{item.scanned_at}</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ClassroomScanner;

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

interface DemoRoleOption {
  role: string;
  label: string;
  description: string;
}

interface StartupShowcasePageProps {
  onOpenSignIn: () => void;
  onDemoLoginSuccess: (session: UserSession, targetTab?: NavItemKey) => void;
}

const clearPreviousSessionStorage = (): void => {
  [
    'attendsure_access',
    'attendsure_refresh',
    'attendsure_token',
    'auth_token',
    'token',
    'attendsure_username',
    'attendsure_faculty_name',
    'attendsure_role',
    'attendsure_user_id',
    'attendsure_user_photo',
    'attendsure_can_teach',
  ].forEach((k) => localStorage.removeItem(k));
};

export const StartupShowcasePage: React.FC<StartupShowcasePageProps> = ({
  onOpenSignIn,
  onDemoLoginSuccess,
}) => {
  const { mode, setThemeMode, tokens, brand, fonts } = useTheme();
  const { school, updateSchoolInstantly, refreshSchool } = useSchool();
  const { complianceMode, toggleComplianceMode, isGlobalMode, locale, setLocale, t } = useCompliance();

  const [demoEnabled, setDemoEnabled] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [demoRoles, setDemoRoles] = useState<DemoRoleOption[]>([]);
  const [launchingRole, setLaunchingRole] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [demoError, setDemoError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const loginAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    apiClient
      .get(API_ROUTES.accounts.demoStatus, { timeout: 4000, signal: controller.signal })
      .then((res) => {
        if (!active || controller.signal.aborted || !res.data) return;
        setDemoEnabled(Boolean(res.data.enabled));
        const roles: DemoRoleOption[] = Array.isArray(res.data.roles) ? res.data.roles : [];
        // Keep web-compatible staff roles on the Web Portal launcher
        setDemoRoles(roles.filter((r) => r.role.toLowerCase() !== 'parent'));
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (active && !controller.signal.aborted) setDemoEnabled(false);
      });
    return () => {
      active = false;
      controller.abort();
      loginAbortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  const handleLaunchDemo = async (role: string, targetTab: NavItemKey = 'dashboard') => {
    if (launchingRole) return;
    loginAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    loginAbortRef.current = controller;

    setDemoError(null);
    setLaunchingRole(`${role}:${targetTab}`);

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post(
        API_ROUTES.accounts.demoLogin,
        { role },
        { signal: controller.signal }
      );
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
      const data = res.data || {};
      const userObj = data.user || data;
      const resolvedRole = String(userObj.role || userObj.system_role || 'ADMIN').toUpperCase();
      const token = String(data.token || data.access || '').trim();
      const access = String(data.access || '').trim();
      const refresh = String(data.refresh || '').trim();
      const username = String(userObj.username || `demo_${role}`).trim();
      const facultyName = String(userObj.faculty_name || userObj.full_name || username).trim();
      const userId = Number(userObj.id || userObj.user_id || 0);
      const canTeach = Boolean(
        userObj.can_teach || userObj.is_teaching || Number(userObj.assigned_class_count) > 0 || resolvedRole === 'FACULTY'
      );
      const rawPhoto = (userObj.photo_url || userObj.photo) as string | null | undefined;
      const safeUserPhoto = isSafeImageUrl(rawPhoto) ? rawPhoto! : null;

      clearPreviousSessionStorage();
      clearApiClientCache();

      if (token) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_token', token);
      if (access) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_access', access);
      if (refresh) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_refresh', refresh);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_username', username);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_faculty_name', facultyName);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_role', resolvedRole);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_can_teach', String(canTeach));
      if (userId) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_id', String(userId));
      if (safeUserPhoto) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_photo', safeUserPhoto);

      if (userObj.school_name || userObj.school_id) {
        updateSchoolInstantly({
          school_name: String(userObj.school_name || ''),
          school_id: String(userObj.school_id || ''),
          school_logo: isSafeImageUrl(userObj.school_logo) ? userObj.school_logo : school.school_logo,
          left_logo: isSafeImageUrl(userObj.left_logo) ? userObj.left_logo : school.left_logo,
          right_logo: isSafeImageUrl(userObj.right_logo) ? userObj.right_logo : school.right_logo,
        });
      }
      refreshSchool().catch(() => {});

      onDemoLoginSuccess(
        {
          user_id: userId,
          token,
          username,
          faculty_name: facultyName,
          role: resolvedRole,
        },
        targetTab
      );
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (
        controller.signal.aborted ||
        anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
        anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
        anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
      ) {
        return;
      }
      setDemoError(
        extractApiError(
          err,
          'Demo workspace is currently unavailable. Please try again later or use Staff Sign In.'
        )
      );
    } finally {

    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()

    (raw: any): DTRReportData => {
      const rawRows: any[] = Array.isArray(raw.rows)
        ? raw.rows
        : Array.isArray(raw.daily_logs)
          ? raw.daily_logs
          : [];

      const rowsByDay = new Map<number, any>();
      rawRows.forEach((r) => {
        if (r && typeof r.day === 'number') rowsByDay.set(r.day, r);
      });

      const rows31: DailyDTRRow[] = [];
      for (let dayNum = 1; dayNum <= 31; dayNum++) {
        const found = rowsByDay.get(dayNum);
        if (found) {
          rows31.push({
            day: dayNum,
            date_str: String(found.date_str || found.date || ''),
            day_of_week: String(found.day_of_week || found.weekday || ''),
            is_weekend: Boolean(found.is_weekend || found.status === 'WEEKEND'),

            am_departure: String(found.am_departure || ''),
            pm_arrival: String(found.pm_arrival || ''),
