            undertime_hours: found.undertime_hours ?? '',
            undertime_minutes: found.undertime_minutes ?? '',
            is_loafing: Boolean(found.is_loafing),
            loafing_excused: Boolean(found.loafing_excused),
            loafing_remarks: String(found.loafing_remarks || ''),
          });
        } else {
          rows31.push({
            day: dayNum,
            date_str: '',
            day_of_week: '',
            is_weekend: false,
            am_arrival: '',
            am_departure: '',
            pm_arrival: '',
            pm_departure: '',
            undertime_hours: '',
            undertime_minutes: '',
            is_loafing: false,
            loafing_excused: false,
            loafing_remarks: '',
          });
        }
      }

      const resolvedMonthNum = Number(raw.month_number || selectedMonth);
      const resolvedMonthName =
        typeof raw.month === 'string' && isNaN(Number(raw.month))
          ? raw.month
          : MONTH_NAMES[resolvedMonthNum - 1] || 'Month';

      const regHrs = String(raw.regular_days_hours ?? raw.regular_hours ?? '');
      const satHrs = String(raw.saturdays_hours ?? raw.saturday_hours ?? '');

      if (!isInteracting.current) {
        setRegularHours(regHrs);
        setSaturdayHours(satHrs);
      }

      if (!isFaculty && raw.faculty_id && !selectedFacultyId) {
        setSelectedFacultyId(String(raw.faculty_id));
      }

      return {
        faculty_id: Number(raw.faculty_id || 0),
        faculty_name: String(raw.faculty_name || ''),
        employee_id: String(raw.employee_id || ''),
        department: String(raw.department || ''),
        month: resolvedMonthName,
        month_number: resolvedMonthNum,
        year: Number(raw.year || selectedYear),
        regular_days_hours: regHrs,
        saturdays_hours: satHrs,
        school_head: String(raw.school_head || raw.school?.school_head || ''),
        school_head_title: String(raw.school_head_title || raw.school?.principal_title || ''),
        dtr_submitted: Boolean(raw.dtr_submitted ?? raw.is_submitted),
        dept_head_approved: Boolean(raw.dept_head_approved ?? raw.is_dept_head_approved),
        can_approve_dept: Boolean(
          raw.can_approve_dept ?? ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD'].includes(currentUserRole)
        ),
        can_clear_loafing: Boolean(
          raw.can_clear_loafing ?? ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL'].includes(currentUserRole)
        ),
        rows: rows31,
        total_undertime_hours: Number(raw.total_undertime_hours || 0),
        total_undertime_minutes: Number(raw.total_undertime_minutes || 0),
        days_present: Number(raw.days_present || 0),
      };
    },
    [selectedFacultyId, selectedMonth, selectedYear, currentUserRole, isFaculty]
  );

  const fetchDTR = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      if (!isFaculty && !selectedFacultyId && facultyList.length > 0) return;

      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      const endpoint =
        !isFaculty && selectedFacultyId
          ? `${API_ROUTES.reports.dtr}${selectedFacultyId}/`
          : API_ROUTES.reports.dtr;

      const baseParams = { month: selectedMonth, year: selectedYear };
      const cached = !bypassCache ? peekApiCache<any>(endpoint, baseParams) : undefined;
      if (cached) {
        setDtrData(normalizeDtrPayload(cached));
        setLoading(false);
        if (silent) setRefreshing(true);
      } else if (!silent) {
        setLoading(true);
      } else {
        setRefreshing(true);
      }
      setError(null);

      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<any>(endpoint, {
          params: {
            ...baseParams,
            ...(bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : {}),
          },
          signal: controller.signal,
        });

        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        setDtrData(normalizeDtrPayload(res.data || {}));
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        if (!silent) {
          setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load Daily Time Record.'));
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [isFaculty, selectedFacultyId, selectedMonth, selectedYear, facultyList.length, normalizeDtrPayload]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchDTR(false, false);
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchDTR]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isInteracting.current && document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        void fetchDTR(true, true);
      }
    }, 20000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [fetchDTR]);

  const handleSubmitDTR = () => {
    if (!dtrData) return;

    showConfirm({
      title: 'Certify & Submit DTR',
      message: `Certify and submit your Daily Time Record for ${dtrData.month} ${dtrData.year} to your Department Head for review?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Certify & Submit',
      isDestructive: false,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setActionProcessing(true);
        try {
          await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.reports.dtr}${dtrData.faculty_id}/`, {
            action: 'SUBMIT_DTR',
            faculty_id: dtrData.faculty_id,
            month: dtrData.month_number,
            year: dtrData.year,
            regular_days_hours: sanitizeInput(regularHours, 100),
            saturdays_hours: sanitizeInput(saturdayHours, 100),
          });
          setHoursDirty(false);
          showAlert({
            title: 'DTR Submitted',
            message: 'Your Daily Time Record was submitted for Department Head approval.',
            type: 'success',
          });
          void fetchDTR(true, true);
        } catch (err) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Submission Failed',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not submit DTR.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        } finally {
          setActionProcessing(false);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleApproveByDeptHead = () => {
    if (!dtrData) return;

    showConfirm({
      title: 'Approve Official DTR',
      message: `Approve the Daily Time Record for ${dtrData.faculty_name} (${dtrData.month} ${dtrData.year})? This removes the DRAFT watermark and unlocks printing.`,
      confirmLabel: 'Approve DTR',
      isDestructive: false,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setActionProcessing(true);
        try {
          await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.reports.dtr}${dtrData.faculty_id}/`, {
            action: 'APPROVE_DEPT_HEAD',
            faculty_id: dtrData.faculty_id,
            month: dtrData.month_number,
            year: dtrData.year,
            regular_days_hours: sanitizeInput(regularHours, 100),
            saturdays_hours: sanitizeInput(saturdayHours, 100),
          });
          setHoursDirty(false);
          showAlert({
            title: 'DTR Approved',
            message: `Official DTR for ${dtrData.faculty_name} is now unlocked for printing.`,
            type: 'success',
          });
          void fetchDTR(true, true);
        } catch (err) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Approval Failed',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not approve DTR.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        } finally {
          setActionProcessing(false);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleExcuseAlertByPrincipal = async () => {
    if (!dtrData || !selectedAlertRow) return;
    const cleanReason = sanitizeInput(excuseRemarks, 240);
    if (!cleanReason) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Reason Required',
        message: 'Please enter official remarks explaining why this off-campus alert is excused.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    setActionProcessing(true);
    try {
      await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.reports.dtr}${dtrData.faculty_id}/`, {
        action: 'EXCUSE_LOAFING',
        faculty_id: dtrData.faculty_id,
        date_str: selectedAlertRow.date_str,
        month: dtrData.month_number,
        year: dtrData.year,
        remarks: cleanReason,
      });
      showAlert({
        title: 'Alert Excused',
        message: `Off-campus alert on ${selectedAlertRow.date_str} has been marked as excused.`,
        type: 'success',
      });
      setSelectedAlertRow(null);
      setExcuseRemarks('');
      void fetchDTR(true, true);
    } catch (err) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Action Denied',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Only authorized leadership can excuse campus alerts.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setActionProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadPdf = async () => {
    if (!printAreaRef.current || !dtrData) return;
    if (!dtrData.dept_head_approved) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Approval Required',
        message: 'Department Head approval is required before exporting official PDF copies.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    setExportingPdf(true);
    try {
      const safeName = (dtrData.faculty_name || 'Faculty').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_');
      await exportElementToLocalPdf({
        element: printAreaRef.current,
        filename: `CSC_Form_48_${safeName}_${dtrData.month}_${dtrData.year}.pdf`,
        pageWidthInches: 8.5,
        pageHeightInches: 14.0,
        orientation: 'portrait',
        marginsInches: [0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15],
      });
    } catch {
      window.print();
    } finally {
      setExportingPdf(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {
    if (!dtrData?.dept_head_approved) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Printing Locked',
        message: 'Printing is locked until the Department Head approves this record.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }
    window.print();
  };

  const resolvedSchoolHead = (dtrData?.school_head || school.principal_name || '').trim();
  const resolvedSchoolHeadTitle = (dtrData?.school_head_title || school.principal_title || '').trim();

  const renderDTRCopy = () => {
    if (!dtrData) return null;

    return (
      <div style={formCardContainer}>
        {!dtrData.dept_head_approved && (
          <div style={draftWatermarkStyle}>
            <div style={{ transform: 'rotate(-32deg)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <div style={draftWatermarkText}>DRAFT</div>
              <div style={draftWatermarkSub}>PENDING DEPT HEAD APPROVAL</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 2 }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '7.5pt', fontStyle: 'italic', fontFamily: "'Times New Roman', Times, serif" }}>
            Civil Service Form No. 48
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '11.5pt', fontWeight: 900, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.6px', marginTop: 1 }}>
            DAILY TIME RECORD
          </div>

          <div style={{ marginTop: 8, borderBottom: '1.2px solid #000', paddingBottom: 1, minHeight: 18 }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '9.2pt', fontWeight: 800, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
              {dtrData.faculty_name}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '6.5pt', fontStyle: 'italic', marginTop: 1 }}>(Name)</div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ fontSize: '6.8pt', marginBottom: 4, lineHeight: 1.25 }}>
          <div style={{ borderBottom: '0.8px solid #000', paddingBottom: 2 }}>
            <span>
              For the month of <u>&nbsp;<strong>{dtrData.month}</strong>&nbsp;</u>, {dtrData.year}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', marginTop: 3 }}>
            <div style={{ width: '46%', fontSize: '6.2pt', lineHeight: 1.15 }}>
              Official hours of arrival<br />
              and departure
            </div>
            <div style={{ width: '54%', fontSize: '6.2pt', lineHeight: 1.15 }}>
              <div>Regular Days: <u>{regularHours || '\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0'}</u></div>
              <div style={{ marginTop: 1 }}>Saturdays: <u>{saturdayHours || '\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0'}</u></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <table style={dtrTable}>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th rowSpan={2} style={{ width: '10%', ...dtrTh }}>Days</th>
              <th colSpan={2} style={dtrTh}>A. M.</th>
              <th colSpan={2} style={dtrTh}>P. M.</th>
              <th colSpan={2} style={dtrTh}>
                UNDER<br />TIME
              </th>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <th style={{ width: '17.5%', ...dtrThSub }}>ARRIVAL</th>
              <th style={{ width: '17.5%', ...dtrThSub }}>DEPAR-<br />TURE</th>
              <th style={{ width: '17.5%', ...dtrThSub }}>ARRIVAL</th>
              <th style={{ width: '17.5%', ...dtrThSub }}>DEPAR-<br />TURE</th>
              <th style={{ width: '10%', ...dtrThSub }}>Hours</th>
              <th style={{ width: '10%', ...dtrThSub }}>Minutes</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {dtrData.rows.map((row) => {
              const hasOpenAlert = Boolean(row.is_loafing && !row.loafing_excused);

              return (
                <tr
                  key={row.day}
                  style={{
                    height: 14,
                    backgroundColor: hasOpenAlert ? '#fee2e2' : row.is_weekend ? '#fafafa' : '#ffffff',
                  }}
                >
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, fontWeight: 700 }}>
                    {row.day}
                    {row.is_loafing && (
                      <span
                        onClick={() => dtrData.can_clear_loafing && setSelectedAlertRow(row)}
                        title={hasOpenAlert ? 'Off-campus alert. Click to review.' : 'Excused by Principal'}
                        style={{
                          marginLeft: 2,
                          fontSize: '5.2pt',
                          color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#059669',
                          cursor: dtrData.can_clear_loafing ? 'pointer' : 'default',
                        }}
                      >
                        {hasOpenAlert ? '(!)' : '(✓)'}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 700 : 400 }}>
                    {row.am_arrival}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 700 : 400 }}>
                    {row.am_departure}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 700 : 400 }}>
                    {row.pm_arrival}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 700 : 400 }}>
                    {row.pm_departure}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 800 : 400 }}>
                    {row.undertime_hours}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 800 : 400 }}>
                    {row.undertime_minutes}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}

            <tr style={{ height: 16, borderTop: '1.2px solid #000', fontWeight: 800 }}>
              <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, fontWeight: 900 }}>TOTAL</td>
              <td colSpan={4} style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, fontSize: '5.6pt' }}>
                Days Present: <strong>{dtrData.days_present}</strong> &bull; Undertime:
              </td>
              <td style={dtrTdCenter}>{dtrData.total_undertime_hours || ''}</td>
              <td style={dtrTdCenter}>{dtrData.total_undertime_minutes || ''}</td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>

        <div style={{ marginTop: 6, fontSize: '5.8pt', textAlign: 'justify', lineHeight: 1.25 }}>
          I CERTIFY on my honor that the above is a true and correct report of the hours of work performed, record of which was made daily at the time of arrival and departure from office.
        </div>

        <div style={{ marginTop: 16, textAlign: 'center' }}>
          <div style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid #000', width: '82%', margin: '0 auto' }} />
          <div style={{ fontSize: '5.6pt', fontStyle: 'italic', marginTop: 1 }}>
            (Signature of Faculty / Employee)
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ marginTop: 10, textAlign: 'center' }}>
          <div style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid #000', width: '82%', margin: '0 auto', minHeight: 14 }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '7.5pt', fontWeight: 800, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
              {resolvedSchoolHead}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '6.4pt', fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 1 }}>
            {resolvedSchoolHeadTitle || 'In-Charge'}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: 4, fontSize: '5.6pt', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
          (See Instructions on back)
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  const renderInstructionsCopy = () => (
    <div style={formCardContainer}>
      <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 8, borderBottom: '1px solid #000', paddingBottom: 4 }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: '11pt', fontWeight: 900, letterSpacing: '0.8px' }}>INSTRUCTIONS</div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ fontSize: '6.0pt', textAlign: 'justify', lineHeight: 1.35, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
        <p style={{ margin: 0 }}>
          Civil Service Form No. 48, after completion, should be filed in the records of the Bureau or Office which submits the monthly report on Civil Service Form No. 3 to the Bureau of Civil Service.
        </p>
        <p style={{ margin: 0 }}>
          In the space provided for the purpose on the other side will be indicated the office hours the employee is required to observe, as for example, &ldquo;Regular days, 8:00 to 12:00 and 1:00 to 4:00; Saturdays, 8:00 to 1:00.&rdquo;
        </p>
        <p style={{ margin: 0 }}>
          Attention is invited to paragraph 3, Civil Service Rule XV, Executive Order No. 5, series of 1909, which reads as follows:
        </p>
        <blockquote style={{ margin: '0 0 0 8px', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #000', paddingLeft: 6, fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
          &ldquo;Each chief of a Bureau or Office shall require a daily record of attendance of all the officers and employees under him entitled to leave of absence or vacation (including faculty) to be kept on the proper form and also a systematic office record showing for each day all absences from duty from any cause whatever. At the beginning of each month he shall report to the Commissioner on the proper form of all absences from any cause whatever, including the exact amount of undertime of each person for each day. Falsification of time records will render the offending officer or employee liable to summary removal from the service and criminal prosecution.&rdquo;
        </blockquote>
        <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0 0', fontSize: '5.7pt' }}>
          <strong>(NOTE:</strong> A record made from memory at sometime subsequent to the occurrence of an event is not reliable. Non-observance of office hours deprives the employee of leave privileges although he may have rendered overtime service. Where service is rendered outside of the Office for the whole morning or afternoon, notation to that effect should be made clearly.)
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14, padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px)' }}>
      <div
        style={{
          ...ui.card,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: 12,
          padding: '12px 16px',
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 10, alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
            <ProfileAvatar
              photoUrl={activeFaculty?.photo_url}
              name={activeFaculty?.full_name || dtrData?.faculty_name || 'Faculty'}
              size={36}
              iconSize={18}
            />

            {isFaculty ? (
              <div
                style={{
                  ...ui.subtleBox,
                  display: 'inline-flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 6,
                  padding: '6px 12px',
                  fontSize: '0.82rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                }}
                title="Locked to your personal time record"
              >
                <Lock size={13} color={tokens.textMuted} />
                <span>
                  {dtrData?.faculty_name || 'My Time Record'}
                  {dtrData?.employee_id ? ` (${dtrData.employee_id})` : ''}
                </span>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <select
                aria-label="Select faculty member"
                value={selectedFacultyId}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedFacultyId(e.target.value)}
                style={{ ...ui.input, width: 'auto', minWidth: 220, fontWeight: 700 }}
              >
                {facultyList.map((f) => (
                  <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>
                    {f.full_name} ({f.employee_id})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            )}
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
            <Calendar size={15} color={brand.primary} />
            <select
              aria-label="Select month"
              value={selectedMonth}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedMonth(Number(e.target.value))}
              style={{ ...ui.input, width: 'auto', padding: '6px 10px' }}
            >
              {MONTH_NAMES.map((m, idx) => (
                <option key={m} value={idx + 1}>
                  {m}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <select
            aria-label="Select year"
            value={selectedYear}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedYear(Number(e.target.value))}
            style={{ ...ui.input, width: 'auto', padding: '6px 10px' }}
          >
            {yearOptions.map((y) => (
              <option key={y} value={y}>
                {y}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>

          <ControlSwitch<FormSide>
            options={[
              { value: 'BOTH', label: 'Front & Back' },
              { value: 'FRONT', label: 'Front Only' },
              { value: 'BACK', label: 'Instructions' },
            ]}
            value={viewSide}
            onChange={setViewSide}
            size="sm"
            ariaLabel="Form Side View"
          />

          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            size="md"
            type="button"
            onClick={() => void fetchDTR(true, true)}
            disabled={loading || refreshing}
          >
            <RefreshCw size={14} className={refreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''} />
            <span>Refresh</span>
          </Button>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {isFaculty && dtrData && !dtrData.dtr_submitted && !dtrData.dept_head_approved && (
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="md"
              type="button"
              onClick={handleSubmitDTR}
              disabled={actionProcessing}
            >
              {actionProcessing ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} /> : <Send size={14} />}
              <span>Certify &amp; Submit</span>

const cleanInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 120): string => {
  const stripped = String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/g, '')
    .replace(/[<>]/g, '');
  return sanitizeText(stripped, maxLength);
};

const getSafeAvatarUrl = (faculty: Pick<Faculty, 'photo_url' | 'photo'>): string | null => {
  const candidate = faculty.photo_url || faculty.photo || null;
  return isSafeImageUrl(candidate) ? candidate : null;
};

const getInitials = (name: string): string => {
  const words = cleanInput(name, 80)
    .replace(/,/g, ' ')
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean);
  if (words.length >= 2) return `${words[0][0]}${words[1][0]}`.toUpperCase();
  return (words[0] || 'F').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
};

const getUserScopedCacheKey = (): string => {
  const scope = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_user_id') || localStorage.getItem('attendsure_username') || 'default';
  return `${CACHE_STORAGE_KEY}_${scope}`;
};

const readCachedFacultyList = (): { items: Faculty[]; count: number } | null => {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(getUserScopedCacheKey());
    if (!raw) return null;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as { items?: Faculty[]; count?: number; savedAt?: number };
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed.items)) return null;
    return {
      items: parsed.items,
      count: typeof parsed.count === 'number' ? parsed.count : parsed.items.length,
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

const writeCachedFacultyList = (items: Faculty[], count: number): void => {
  try {
    const compact = items.slice(0, 100).map((item) => ({
      ...item,
      photo: item.photo && item.photo.length > 500 ? null : item.photo,
    }));
    localStorage.setItem(
      getUserScopedCacheKey(),
      JSON.stringify({ items: compact, count, savedAt: Date.now() })
    );
  } catch {
    // Ignore storage quota restrictions
  }
};

        helper.value = cleanValue;
        helper.style.position = 'fixed';
        helper.style.left = '-99999px';
        document.body.appendChild(helper);
        helper.focus();
        helper.select();
        copied = document.execCommand('copy');
        helper.remove();
      } catch {
        copied = false;
      }
    }

    if (copied) {
      if (copyTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(copyTimerRef.current);
      setCopiedKey(key);
      copyTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(null), 2000);
    }
  }, []);

  const loadFacultyList = useCallback(
    async (
      page = 1,
      size = 25,
      query = '',
      deptVal = '',
      silent = false,
      bypassCache = false
    ) => {
      activeAbortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      activeAbortRef.current = controller;

      const cleanQuery = cleanInput(query, 80);
      const cleanDept = cleanInput(deptVal, 100);
      const isAll = size >= ALL_ROWS_SIZE;

      try {
        if (!silent) {
          if (!hasLoadedItemsRef.current) setLoading(true);
          setRefreshing(true);
        }
        setErrorMessage(null);

        const [listOutcome, dropdownOutcome] = await Promise.allSettled([
          apiClient.get<PaginatedResponse<Faculty> | Faculty[]>(FACULTY_ENDPOINT, {
            params: {
              page: isAll ? 1 : page,
              page_size: isAll ? 'ALL' : size,
              search: cleanQuery || undefined,
              department: cleanDept || undefined,
              ...(bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : {}),
            },
            signal: controller.signal,
          }),
          apiClient.get<Faculty[]>(FACULTY_DROPDOWN_ENDPOINT, {
            params: { include_all: 1 },
            signal: controller.signal,
          }),
        ]);

        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

        if (listOutcome.status === 'fulfilled') {
          const payload = listOutcome.value.data;
          if (payload && !Array.isArray(payload) && Array.isArray(payload.results)) {
            setFacultyList(payload.results);
            hasLoadedItemsRef.current = payload.results.length > 0;
            setTotalCount(payload.count);
            setTotalPages(isAll ? 1 : payload.total_pages || Math.ceil(payload.count / size) || 1);
            setCurrentPage(isAll ? 1 : payload.current_page || page);
            if (!cleanQuery && !cleanDept && page === 1) {
              writeCachedFacultyList(payload.results, payload.count);
            }
          } else if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
            setFacultyList(payload);
            hasLoadedItemsRef.current = payload.length > 0;
            setTotalCount(payload.length);
            setTotalPages(1);
            setCurrentPage(1);
            if (!cleanQuery && !cleanDept) {
              writeCachedFacultyList(payload, payload.length);
            }
          }
          setLastUpdated(new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }));
        } else {
          const reason = listOutcome.reason as { name?: string; code?: string };
          if (reason?.name === 'CanceledError' || reason?.name === 'AbortError' || reason?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
            return;
          }
          if (!silent) {
            setErrorMessage(
              extractApiError(
                listOutcome.reason,
                'Could not load the faculty directory right now. Please check your connection and try again.'
              )
            );
          }
        }

        if (dropdownOutcome.status === 'fulfilled' && Array.isArray(dropdownOutcome.value.data)) {
          const foundDepts = Array.from(
            new Set(
              dropdownOutcome.value.data
                .map((item) => cleanInput(item.department || '', 100))
                .filter(Boolean)
            )
          ).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
          setDirectoryDepartments(foundDepts);
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    []
  );

  // Clean up pending requests, readers, and timers on unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      mountedRef.current = false;
      activeAbortRef.current?.abort();
      fileReaderRef.current?.abort();
      if (copyTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(copyTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  // Reload when search (debounced), department filter, or page size changes
  useEffect(() => {
    const searchChanged = prevSearchRef.current !== search;
    prevSearchRef.current = search;
    const delay = searchChanged ? 280 : 0;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setCurrentPage(1);
      void loadFacultyList(1, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, false, false);
    }, delay);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [search, departmentFilter, pageSize, loadFacultyList]);

  // Gentle background refresh only while page is visible and user is not inside a modal
  useEffect(() => {
    const intervalId = setInterval(() => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible' && !isInteractingRef.current) {
        void loadFacultyList(currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, true, true);
      }
    }, 15000);
    return () => clearInterval(intervalId);
  }, [currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, loadFacultyList]);

  // Merge built-in departments with any live database departments
  const departmentOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const combined = new Set<string>(DEFAULT_DEPARTMENTS);
    directoryDepartments.forEach((d) => combined.add(d));
    facultyList.forEach((f) => {
      if (f.department?.trim()) combined.add(f.department.trim());
    });
    if (formData.department.trim()) combined.add(formData.department.trim());
    return Array.from(combined).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
  }, [directoryDepartments, facultyList, formData.department]);

  // Preserve any custom position already stored in the database when editing
  const positionGroups = useMemo(() => {
    const knownRanks = new Set(DEFAULT_POSITION_GROUPS.flatMap((g) => g.ranks));
    const currentPos = formData.position.trim();
    if (!currentPos || knownRanks.has(currentPos)) {
      return DEFAULT_POSITION_GROUPS;
    }
    return [
      { category: 'Current Assignment', ranks: [currentPos] },
      ...DEFAULT_POSITION_GROUPS,
    ];
  }, [formData.position]);

  const displayedFaculty = useMemo(() => {
    return facultyList.filter((item) => {
      if (statusFilter === 'ACTIVE') return item.is_active;
      if (statusFilter === 'INACTIVE') return !item.is_active;
      if (statusFilter === 'BOUND') return Boolean(item.bound_device_id);
      if (statusFilter === 'UNBOUND') return !item.bound_device_id;
      return true;
    });
  }, [facultyList, statusFilter]);

  const activeFacultyCount = useMemo(
    () => facultyList.filter((f) => f.is_active).length,
    [facultyList]
  );

  const boundPhonesCount = useMemo(
    () => facultyList.filter((f) => Boolean(f.bound_device_id && f.bound_device_id.trim())).length,
    [facultyList]
  );

  const uniqueDepartmentCount = useMemo(() => {
    const source = directoryDepartments.length > 0 ? directoryDepartments : facultyList.map((f) => f.department);
    return new Set(source.filter(Boolean)).size;
  }, [directoryDepartments, facultyList]);

  const handlePageChange = (nextPage: number) => {
    if (nextPage < 1 || nextPage > totalPages) return;
    setCurrentPage(nextPage);
    void loadFacultyList(nextPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, false, false);
  };

  const handlePageSizeChange = (nextSize: number) => {
    if (nextSize === pageSize) return;
    setPageSize(nextSize);
    setCurrentPage(1);
  };

  const handleManualRefresh = () => {
    void refreshSchool();
    void loadFacultyList(currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, false, true);
  };

  const handleExportCsv = () => {
    const suffix = pageSize >= ALL_ROWS_SIZE ? 'All' : `Page${currentPage}_${pageSize}rows`;
    const exported = exportToCsv(
      `AttendSure_Faculty_${suffix}.csv`,
      [
        'Employee ID',
        'Full Name',
        'Position',
        'Department',
        'Handles Classes',
        'Email',
        'Phone Number',
        'Linked Mobile Device',
        'Status',
      ],
      displayedFaculty.map((f) => [
        f.employee_id,
        f.full_name,
        f.position,
        f.department,
        f.can_teach ? 'YES' : 'NO',
        f.email || '',
        f.contact_number || '',
        f.bound_device_id ? f.device_model || 'Linked Phone' : 'Not Linked',
        f.is_active ? 'ACTIVE' : 'INACTIVE',
      ])
    );

    if (exported) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'CSV Downloaded',
        message: `Saved ${displayedFaculty.length} faculty records to a CSV file.`,
        type: 'success',
      });
    } else {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Nothing to Export',
        message: 'There are no faculty records matching your current filters.',
        type: 'info',
      });
    }
  };

  const handlePhotoSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    const allowedTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'];
    if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Unsupported Image',
        message: 'Please choose a JPG, PNG, or WebP photo.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
      return;
    }

    if (file.size > 2.5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Photo Too Large',
        message: 'Profile photos must be 2.5 MB or smaller.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
      return;
    }

    fileReaderRef.current?.abort();
    const reader = new FileReader();
    fileReaderRef.current = reader;
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      if (!mountedRef.current || reader.readyState !== FileReader.DONE) return;
      const result = typeof reader.result === 'string' ? reader.result : '';
      if (!isSafeImageUrl(result)) {
        showAlert({
          title: 'Invalid Image',
          message: 'Could not verify the selected image file.',
          type: 'error',
        });
        return;
      }
      setPhotoPreview(result);
      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, photo: result }));
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleRemovePhoto = () => {
    setPhotoPreview(null);
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, photo: '' }));
    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
  };

  const handleOpenCreate = () => {
    setEditingFaculty(null);
    setFormData(INITIAL_FORM_DATA);
    setPhotoPreview(null);
    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (faculty: Faculty) => {
    setEditingFaculty(faculty);
    setFormData({
      employee_id: faculty.employee_id || '',
      first_name: faculty.first_name || '',
      middle_name: faculty.middle_name || '',
      last_name: faculty.last_name || '',
      suffix: faculty.suffix || '',
      position: faculty.position || 'Faculty I',
      department: faculty.department || 'Junior High School',
      contact_number: faculty.contact_number || '',
      email: faculty.email || '',
      can_teach: faculty.can_teach ?? true,
      is_active: faculty.is_active ?? true,
      photo: null,
    });
    setPhotoPreview(getSafeAvatarUrl(faculty));
    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (saving) return;

    const cleanEmployeeId = cleanInput(formData.employee_id, 50).toUpperCase();
    const cleanFirstName = cleanInput(formData.first_name, 100);
    const cleanMiddleName = cleanInput(formData.middle_name, 100);
    const cleanLastName = cleanInput(formData.last_name, 100);
    const cleanSuffix = SUFFIX_OPTIONS.includes(formData.suffix) ? formData.suffix : '';
    const cleanEmail = cleanInput(formData.email, 150).toLowerCase();
    const cleanPhone = cleanInput(formData.contact_number, 30).replace(/[^\d+\-()\s]/g, '').replace(/[\s()-]/g, '');

    if (!cleanEmployeeId || !cleanFirstName || !cleanLastName) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Missing Information',
        message: 'Please enter the Employee ID, First Name, and Last Name.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    if (cleanEmail && !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(cleanEmail)) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Invalid Email Address',
        message: 'Please enter a valid email address or leave the email box blank.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);

    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
      employee_id: cleanEmployeeId,
      first_name: cleanFirstName,
      middle_name: cleanMiddleName,
      last_name: cleanLastName,
      suffix: cleanSuffix,
      position: cleanInput(formData.position, 100),
      department: cleanInput(formData.department, 100),
      email: cleanEmail,
      contact_number: cleanPhone,
      can_teach: Boolean(formData.can_teach),
      is_active: Boolean(formData.is_active),
    };

    if (formData.photo !== null) {
      payload.photo = formData.photo === '' ? null : formData.photo;
    }

    try {
      if (editingFaculty) {
        const res = await apiClient.put<Faculty>(`${FACULTY_ENDPOINT}${editingFaculty.id}/`, payload);
        setFacultyList((prev) => prev.map((f) => (f.id === editingFaculty.id ? res.data : f)));
        showAlert({
          title: 'Profile Saved',
          message: `Updated details for ${cleanFirstName} ${cleanLastName}.`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      } else {
        const res = await apiClient.post<Faculty>(FACULTY_ENDPOINT, payload);
        setFacultyList((prev) => [res.data, ...prev]);
        showAlert({
          title: 'Faculty Added',
          message: `${cleanFirstName} ${cleanLastName} has been added to the directory.`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      }
      setIsModalOpen(false);
      void loadFacultyList(currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, true, true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Could Not Save',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Unable to save this faculty record. Please check the details and try again.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResetDeviceBinding = (faculty: Faculty) => {
    showConfirm({
      title: 'Reset Phone Lock',
      message: `Unlink the current mobile phone for ${faculty.full_name}? Their next GPS & facial check-in will automatically pair their new phone.`,
      confirmLabel: 'Reset Phone Lock',
      isDestructive: false,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setResettingDeviceId(faculty.id);
        try {
          const res = await apiClient.post<{ message?: string }>(`${FACULTY_ENDPOINT}${faculty.id}/reset-device/`, {
            faculty_id: faculty.id,
          });
          setFacultyList((prev) =>
            prev.map((item) =>
              item.id === faculty.id
                ? { ...item, bound_device_id: null, device_model: null, device_bound_at: null }
                : item
            )
          );
          if (inspectingFaculty?.id === faculty.id) {
            setInspectingFaculty((prev) =>
              prev ? { ...prev, bound_device_id: null, device_model: null, device_bound_at: null } : null
            );
          }
          showAlert({
            title: 'Phone Lock Cleared',
            message: res.data?.message || `Cleared the bound phone for ${faculty.full_name}.`,
            type: 'success',
          });
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Reset Failed',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not reset the phone lock for this faculty member.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        } finally {
          setResettingDeviceId(null);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const promptDelete = (faculty: Faculty) => {
    showConfirm({
      title: 'Remove Faculty Member',
      message: `Permanently remove ${faculty.full_name || faculty.first_name} (${faculty.employee_id}) from the AttendSure faculty directory?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Remove Faculty',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await apiClient.delete(`${FACULTY_ENDPOINT}${faculty.id}/`);
          setFacultyList((prev) => prev.filter((f) => f.id !== faculty.id));
          if (inspectingFaculty?.id === faculty.id) setInspectingFaculty(null);
          showAlert({
            title: 'Faculty Removed',
            message: `Removed ${faculty.full_name || faculty.first_name} from the directory.`,
            type: 'info',
          });
          void loadFacultyList(currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, true, true);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Could Not Remove',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Unable to remove this faculty record right now.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const styles = useMemo(
    () => ({
      page: {
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column' as const,
        gap: 16,
        padding: 'clamp(12px, 2.2vw, 20px)',
        maxWidth: 1400,
        margin: '0 auto',
        fontFamily: fonts.sans,
      },
      headerCard: {
        ...ui.card,
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        flexWrap: 'wrap' as const,
        gap: 12,
      },
      statsGrid: {
        display: 'grid',
        gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 205px), 1fr))',
        gap: 12,
      },
      controlsBar: {
        ...ui.card,
        padding: '12px 16px',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column' as const,
        gap: 10,
      },
      controlsTopRow: {
        display: 'flex',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        alignItems: 'center',
        flexWrap: 'wrap' as const,
        gap: 10,
      },
      searchWrap: {
        position: 'relative' as const,
        flex: '1 1 220px',
        maxWidth: 320,
      },
      searchInput: {
        ...ui.input,
        paddingLeft: 34,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
      },
      deptSelect: {
        ...ui.input,
        width: 'auto',
        minWidth: 210,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        cursor: 'pointer',
      },
      filterPillsRow: {
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: 6,
        flexWrap: 'wrap' as const,
      },
      tableCard: {
        ...ui.card,
        padding: 0,
        overflow: 'hidden',
      },
      actionBtn: {
        width: 30,
        height: 30,
        borderRadius: radius.sm,
        borderWidth: 1,
        borderStyle: 'solid' as const,
        borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        color: tokens.textSecondary,
        display: 'inline-flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        cursor: 'pointer',
      },
      modalBodySurface: {
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
        color: tokens.textPrimary,
        margin: -20,
        padding: 20,
        fontFamily: fonts.sans,
      },
      formGrid2: {
        display: 'grid',
        gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr))',
        gap: 10,
      },
      nameGrid: {
        display: 'grid',
        gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(115px, 1fr))',
        gap: 10,
      },
    }),
    [tokens, fonts, radius, ui]
  );

  const filterPillOptions: { key: StatusFilter; label: string }[] = [
    { key: 'ALL', label: `All (${facultyList.length})` },
    { key: 'ACTIVE', label: `Active (${activeFacultyCount})` },
    { key: 'INACTIVE', label: `Inactive (${Math.max(0, facultyList.length - activeFacultyCount)})` },
    { key: 'BOUND', label: `Phone Linked (${boundPhonesCount})` },
    { key: 'UNBOUND', label: `Unlinked (${Math.max(0, facultyList.length - boundPhonesCount)})` },
  ];

  const activeSchoolName = school.school_name?.trim() || 'AttendSure School Campus';

  const inspectingQrValue = inspectingFaculty
    ? `ATTENDSURE-FACULTY:${inspectingFaculty.employee_id}`
    : '';

  return (
    <div style={styles.page}>
      {/* Top Directory Header */}
      <div style={styles.headerCard}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, minWidth: 0 }}>
          <AttendSureBrandBadge size={42} mode={mode} />
          <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
            <h2
              style={{
                margin: 0,
                fontSize: fonts.size.lg,
                fontWeight: fonts.weight.extrabold,
                color: tokens.textPrimary,
                fontFamily: fonts.display,
              }}
            >
              Faculty Directory
            </h2>
            <p style={{ margin: '2px 0 0', fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
              Manage faculty profiles, class list assignments, and 1-to-1 mobile check-in phone bindings.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {lastUpdated && (
            <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textMuted, fontFamily: fonts.mono }}>
              Synced {lastUpdated}
            </span>
          )}
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleManualRefresh}
            loading={refreshing}
            icon={<RefreshCw size={13} />}
          >
            Refresh
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleExportCsv}
            icon={<Download size={13} />}
          >
            Export CSV
          </Button>
          {canManageFaculty && (
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleOpenCreate}
              icon={<Plus size={14} />}
            >
              Add Faculty
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Recoverable Network Error Banner */}
      {errorMessage && (
        <div
          role="alert"
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            flexWrap: 'wrap',
            gap: 10,
            padding: '10px 14px',
            borderRadius: radius.lg,
            backgroundColor: tokens.dangerLight,
            border: `1px solid ${brand.danger}`,
            color: brand.danger,
            fontSize: fonts.size.sm,
            fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold,
          }}
        >
          <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
            <AlertCircle size={16} />
            {errorMessage}
          </span>
          <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={handleManualRefresh}>
            Try Again
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Telemetry Summary Cards */}
      <div style={styles.statsGrid}>
        <StatsCard
          label="Total Faculty"
          value={(totalCount || facultyList.length).toLocaleString()}
          helpText="Registered classroom & support personnel"
          badge={<Users size={17} color={brand.primary} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="Active Faculty"
          value={activeFacultyCount.toLocaleString()}
          valueColor={brand.success}
          helpText="Cleared for daily mobile GPS check-in"
          badge={<ShieldCheck size={17} color={brand.success} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="Mobile Phones Linked"
          value={`${boundPhonesCount} / ${facultyList.length}`}
          valueColor={brand.primary}
          helpText="1-to-1 bound for face & GPS verification"
          badge={<Smartphone size={17} color={brand.primary} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="Departments"
          value={uniqueDepartmentCount.toLocaleString()}
          valueColor={brand.secondary}
          helpText="Active school academic units"
          badge={<Building2 size={17} color={brand.secondary} />}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Search, Department Selector & Status Filter Pills */}
      <div style={styles.controlsBar}>
        <div style={styles.controlsTopRow}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap', flex: 1 }}>
            <div style={styles.searchWrap}>
              <Search
                size={14}
                color={tokens.textMuted}
                style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 11, top: '50%', transform: 'translateY(-50%)', pointerEvents: 'none' }}
              />
              <input
                type="text"
                aria-label="Search faculty"
                placeholder="Search by name, Employee ID, or role..."
                value={search}
                maxLength={80}
                onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                style={styles.searchInput}
              />
            </div>

            <select
              aria-label="Filter by department"
              value={departmentFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setDepartmentFilter(e.target.value)}
              style={styles.deptSelect}
            >
              <option value="">All Departments</option>
              {departmentOptions.map((dept) => (
                <option key={dept} value={dept}>
                  {dept}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textMuted, fontWeight: fonts.weight.semibold }}>
            Showing {displayedFaculty.length} of {facultyList.length} loaded
          </span>
        </div>

        <div style={styles.filterPillsRow}>
          {filterPillOptions.map((pill) => {
            const active = statusFilter === pill.key;
            return (
              <button
                key={pill.key}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setStatusFilter(pill.key)}
                style={{
                  padding: '5px 11px',
                  borderRadius: radius.pill,
                  borderWidth: 1,
                  borderStyle: 'solid',
                  borderColor: active ? brand.primary : tokens.borderStrong,
                  backgroundColor: active ? tokens.primaryLight : tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                  color: active ? brand.primary : tokens.textSecondary,
                  fontSize: fonts.size.xs,
                  fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                }}
              >
                {pill.label}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Faculty Directory Table */}
      <div style={styles.tableCard}>
        <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
          <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left' }}>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th style={{ ...ui.th, width: 54 }}>Photo</th>
                <th style={ui.th}>Employee ID</th>
                <th style={ui.th}>Full Name</th>
                <th style={ui.th}>Position &amp; Department</th>
                <th style={ui.th}>Contact Details</th>
                <th style={ui.th}>Mobile Check-In Phone</th>
                <th style={ui.th}>Status</th>
                <th style={{ ...ui.th, textAlign: 'right' }}>Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {loading && facultyList.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={8} style={{ padding: 44, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                    <Loader2
                      className="animate-spin"
                      size={24}

                    />

                  </td>

              ) : displayedFaculty.length === 0 ? (

                  <td colSpan={8} style={{ padding: 44, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>

                    </div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, marginTop: 4 }}>
                      Try clearing your search or switching the department filter.
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                displayedFaculty.map((faculty) => {
                  const avatarUrl = getSafeAvatarUrl(faculty);
                  const isPhoneLinked = Boolean(faculty.bound_device_id && faculty.bound_device_id.trim());
                  return (
                    <tr key={faculty.id}>
                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        <div
                          style={{
                            width: 38,
                            height: 38,
                            borderRadius: '50%',
                            overflow: 'hidden',
                            backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight,
                            color: brand.primary,
                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            justifyContent: 'center',
                            border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                            fontWeight: fonts.weight.extrabold,
                            fontSize: fonts.size.xs,
                            flexShrink: 0,
                          }}
                        >
                          {avatarUrl ? (
                            <img
                              src={avatarUrl}
                              alt={faculty.full_name}
                              style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }}
                            />
                          ) : (
                            getInitials(faculty.full_name || faculty.first_name)
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => void handleCopy(faculty.employee_id, `emp-${faculty.id}`)}
                          title="Copy Employee ID"

                            alignItems: 'center',
                            gap: 5,
                            padding: '3px 8px',
                            borderRadius: radius.sm,
                            border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                            backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                            color: tokens.textPrimary,
                            fontFamily: fonts.mono,
                            fontSize: fonts.size.xs,
                            fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold,
                            cursor: 'pointer',
                          }}
                        >
                          {copiedKey === `emp-${faculty.id}` ? (
                            <Check size={11} color={brand.success} />

                      </td>

                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        <div style={{ fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>

            </tbody>

        <Pagination

      </div>

      {/* Add / Edit Faculty Modal */}
      {isModalOpen && (
        <Modal
          isOpen={isModalOpen}

        >
          <div style={styles.modalBodySurface}>

              {/* Profile Photo Picker */}
              <div
                style={{

              >
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
                  <div
                    style={{
                      width: 54,
                      height: 54,
                      borderRadius: '50%',
                      overflow: 'hidden',

                    </div>

                      Optional JPG, PNG, or WebP (max 2.5 MB). Facial check-in runs privately on-device.

                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                  <input
                    type="file"

                    style={{ display: 'none' }}
                  />
                  <Button

                    onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}

                  {photoPreview && (

                      />

                      getInitials(inspectingFaculty.full_name || inspectingFaculty.first_name)

                    {inspectingFaculty.full_name}
                  </div>

                    {inspectingFaculty.position}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                    {inspectingFaculty.department}
                  </div>

                  {inspectingQrValue && (
                    <div
                      style={{
                        margin: '12px auto',
                        width: 120,
                        height: 120,
                        padding: 6,
                        backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                        borderRadius: radius.md,
                        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                        display: 'flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        justifyContent: 'center',
                      }}
                    >
                      <QrCodeSvg
                        value={inspectingQrValue}

                  )}

                  <div
                    style={{
                      fontSize: fonts.size.sm,

                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,

                    borderTop: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                    fontSize: fonts.size.xs,

                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    gap: 4,
                  }}

                  <div style={{ fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                    Mobile Check-In:{' '}
                    {inspectingFaculty.bound_device_id
                      ? inspectingFaculty.device_model || 'Linked Phone Active'
                      : 'Pairs on first mobile check-in'}

                  <div style={{ color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                    On-device facial recognition &amp; campus GPS only. No raw face photos are stored on the server.
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginTop: 16 }}>
                {canResetPhoneLock && inspectingFaculty.bound_device_id && (
                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    size="md"
                    onClick={() => handleResetDeviceBinding(inspectingFaculty)}
                    loading={resettingDeviceId === inspectingFaculty.id}
                    icon={<RotateCcw size={14} />}
                  >
                    Reset Phone Lock
                  </Button>
                )}
                <Button variant="primary" size="md" onClick={() => setInspectingFaculty(null)}>
                  Close
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
