/**
 * AttendSure - Theme-Adaptive Parent & Faculty Direct Messaging
 * File: web/src/components/tabs/ParentChatTab.tsx
 */

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Check, Edit2, MessageSquare, RefreshCw, Send, Trash2, User, X } from 'lucide-react';
import apiClient, { peekApiCache } from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { useApiResource } from '../../hooks/useApiResource';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';

interface ChatThread {
  thread_key: string;
  student_id: number;
  student_name: string;
  section: string;
  faculty_id: number;
  parent_name: string;
  last_message: string;
  unread_count: number;
}

interface ChatMessageItem {
  id: number;
  sender_name: string;
  is_mine: boolean;
  body: string;
  time_only: string;
}

const sanitizeInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 1000): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);

export const ParentChatTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();
  const { showAlert, showConfirm } = useAlert();
  const { data: payload, loading: loadingThreads, refreshing: refreshingThreads, reload: reloadThreads } =
    useApiResource<{ threads: ChatThread[] }>(API_ROUTES.messaging.threads, { threads: [] });

  const threads = Array.isArray(payload?.threads) ? payload.threads : [];
  const [selectedThread, setSelectedThread] = useState<ChatThread | null>(null);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessageItem[]>([]);
  const [loadingMessages, setLoadingMessages] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState('');
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [editDraft, setEditDraft] = useState('');
  const [savingEdit, setSavingEdit] = useState(false);
  const [deletingId, setDeletingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');

  const bottomRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const messagesAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (threads.length > 0 && !selectedThread) {
      setSelectedThread(threads[0]);
    }
  }, [threads, selectedThread]);

  const loadMessages = useCallback(async (thread: ChatThread, silent = false) => {
    if (silent && document.visibilityState !== 'visible') return;

    messagesAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    messagesAbortRef.current = controller;

    const baseParams = { student_id: thread.student_id, faculty_id: thread.faculty_id };
    if (!silent) {
      const cached = peekApiCache<{ messages?: ChatMessageItem[] }>(API_ROUTES.messaging.messages, baseParams);
      if (cached && Array.isArray(cached.messages)) {
        setMessages(cached.messages);
        setLoadingMessages(false);
      } else {
        setLoadingMessages(true);
      }
    }

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.messaging.messages, {
        params: {
          ...baseParams,
          ...(silent ? { nocache: 1 } : {}),
        },
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
      setMessages(Array.isArray(res.data?.messages) ? res.data.messages : []);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
        return;
      }
      if (!silent) {
        showAlert({
          title: 'Messages Unavailable',
          message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not load conversation messages.'),
          type: 'warning',
        });
      }
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted && !silent) {
        setLoadingMessages(false);
      }
    }
  }, [showAlert]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedThread) return;
    void loadMessages(selectedThread, false);
    const timer = setInterval(() => void loadMessages(selectedThread, true), 12000);
    return () => {
      clearInterval(timer);
      messagesAbortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [selectedThread, loadMessages]);

  useEffect(() => {
    bottomRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [messages]);

  const handleSend = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedThread || sending) return;
    const body = sanitizeInput(draft, 1000);
    if (!body) return;

    setDraft('');
    setSending(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.messaging.messages, {
        student_id: selectedThread.student_id,
        faculty_id: selectedThread.faculty_id,
        body,
      });
      setMessages((prev) => [...prev, res.data]);
      void reloadThreads(true, true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setDraft(body);
      showAlert({
        title: 'Message Not Sent',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Unable to send message. Please try again.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  const handleStartEdit = (msg: ChatMessageItem) => {
    setEditingId(msg.id);
    setEditDraft(msg.body);
  };

  const handleSaveEdit = async (id: number) => {
    const cleanBody = sanitizeInput(editDraft, 1000);
    if (!cleanBody || savingEdit) return;
    setSavingEdit(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.put(API_ROUTES.messaging.messages, { id, body: cleanBody });
      const updatedBody = typeof res.data?.body === 'string' ? res.data.body : cleanBody;
      setMessages((prev) => prev.map((m) => (m.id === id ? { ...m, body: updatedBody } : m)));
      setEditingId(null);
      setEditDraft('');
      void reloadThreads(true, true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Update Failed',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not update message.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSavingEdit(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteMessage = (id: number) => {
    if (deletingId === id) return;
    showConfirm({
      title: 'Delete Message',
      message: 'Are you sure you want to permanently remove this message?',
      confirmLabel: 'Delete',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setDeletingId(id);
        try {
          await apiClient.delete(API_ROUTES.messaging.messages, { params: { id } });
          setMessages((prev) => prev.filter((m) => m.id !== id));
          if (editingId === id) {
            setEditingId(null);
            setEditDraft('');
          }
          void reloadThreads(true, true);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Delete Failed',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not delete message.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        } finally {
          setDeletingId(null);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const cleanSearch = sanitizeInput(search, 80).toLowerCase();
  const filteredThreads = threads.filter((t) => {
    return (
      !cleanSearch ||
      t.student_name.toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch) ||
      t.parent_name.toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch) ||
      t.section.toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch)
    );
  });

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        display: 'flex',
        flexWrap: 'wrap',
        gap: 16,
        padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 18px)',
        minHeight: 'calc(100vh - 150px)',
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
        alignItems: 'stretch',
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          ...ui.card,
          padding: 0,
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          overflow: 'hidden',
          flex: '1 1 280px',
          maxWidth: '100%',
          minHeight: 300,
          maxHeight: 'calc(100vh - 175px)',
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ padding: 14, borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <strong style={{ fontSize: '0.90rem', color: tokens.textPrimary, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <MessageSquare size={16} color={brand.primary} /> Parent Threads
            </strong>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => void reloadThreads(false, true)}
              disabled={loadingThreads || refreshingThreads}
              aria-label="Refresh parent threads"
              title="Refresh threads"
              style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', color: tokens.textMuted, display: 'inline-flex', padding: 4 }}
            >
              <RefreshCw size={14} className={refreshingThreads ? 'animate-spin' : ''} />
            </button>
          </div>
          <input
            type="text"
            maxLength={80}
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search student or parent..."
            style={ui.input}
          />
        </div>

        <div style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
          {loadingThreads ? (
            <div style={{ padding: 16, fontSize: '0.8rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Loading threads...</div>
          ) : filteredThreads.length === 0 ? (
            <div style={{ padding: 16, fontSize: '0.8rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>No linked parent accounts in your classes yet.</div>
          ) : (
            filteredThreads.map((t) => {
              const active = selectedThread?.thread_key === t.thread_key;
              return (
                <button
                  key={t.thread_key}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedThread(t)}
                  style={{
                    width: '100%',
                    textAlign: 'left',
                    padding: '12px 14px',
                    border: 'none',
                    borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                    backgroundColor: active ? tokens.primaryLight : 'transparent',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                    <strong style={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{t.student_name}</strong>
                    {t.unread_count > 0 && <span style={ui.badge(brand.buttonBg, '#ffffff')}>{t.unread_count}</span>}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: brand.primary, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 2 }}>
                    Parent: {t.parent_name} &bull; {t.section}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: tokens.textMuted, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', marginTop: 2 }}>
                    {t.last_message}
                  </div>
                </button>
              );
            })
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div
        style={{
          ...ui.card,
          padding: 0,
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          overflow: 'hidden',
          flex: '3 1 380px',
          minWidth: 0,
          minHeight: 380,
          maxHeight: 'calc(100vh - 175px)',
        }}
      >
        {!selectedThread ? (
          <div style={{ margin: 'auto', padding: 24, color: tokens.textMuted, fontSize: '0.86rem' }}>
            Select a student conversation to view messages.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div style={{ padding: '12px 16px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 8 }}>
              <div>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                  {selectedThread.student_name} ({selectedThread.section})
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: tokens.textSecondary, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5 }}>
                  <User size={12} /> Guardian: <strong>{selectedThread.parent_name}</strong>
                </div>
              </div>
              <span style={ui.badge(tokens.successLight, brand.success)}>Mobile Push Active</span>
            </div>

            <div style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto', padding: 16, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10, backgroundColor: tokens.bgCanvas }}>
              {loadingMessages ? (
                <div style={{ color: tokens.textMuted, fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>Loading messages...</div>
              ) : messages.length === 0 ? (
                <div style={{ margin: 'auto', color: tokens.textMuted, fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>
                  No messages yet. Say hello to {selectedThread.parent_name}.
                </div>
              ) : (
                messages.map((m) => (
                  <div
                    key={m.id}
                    style={{
                      alignSelf: m.is_mine ? 'flex-end' : 'flex-start',
                      maxWidth: '78%',
                      backgroundColor: m.is_mine ? brand.buttonBg : tokens.bgSurface,
                      color: m.is_mine ? '#ffffff' : tokens.textPrimary,
                      padding: '10px 14px',
                      borderRadius: 12,
                      border: m.is_mine ? 'none' : `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                    }}
                  >
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 10, fontSize: '0.68rem', opacity: 0.9, marginBottom: 4, fontWeight: 700 }}>
                      <span>{m.sender_name} &bull; {m.time_only}</span>
                      {m.is_mine && (
                        <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleStartEdit(m)}
                            aria-label="Edit message"
                            title="Edit message"
                            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: 'inherit', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 0, display: 'inline-flex' }}
                          >
                            <Edit2 size={11} />
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            disabled={deletingId === m.id}
                            onClick={() => handleDeleteMessage(m.id)}
                            aria-label="Delete message"
                            title="Delete message"
                            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: 'inherit', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 0, display: 'inline-flex' }}
                          >
                            <Trash2 size={11} />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    {editingId === m.id ? (
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'center' }}>
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          maxLength={1000}
                          value={editDraft}
                          onChange={(e) => setEditDraft(e.target.value)}
                          onKeyDown={(e) => {
                            if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                              e.preventDefault();
                              void handleSaveEdit(m.id);
                            } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                              setEditingId(null);
                              setEditDraft('');
                            }
                          }}
                          style={{
                            ...ui.input,
                            padding: '4px 8px',
                            fontSize: '0.80rem',
                            minWidth: 160,
                          }}
                        />
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          disabled={savingEdit || !editDraft.trim()}
                          onClick={() => void handleSaveEdit(m.id)}
                          aria-label="Save edited message"
                          title="Save"
                          style={{ background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)', border: 'none', borderRadius: 6, color: '#ffffff', cursor: 'pointer', padding: '4px 6px', display: 'inline-flex' }}
                        >
                          <Check size={13} />
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setEditingId(null);
                            setEditDraft('');
                          }}
                          aria-label="Cancel edit"
                          title="Cancel"
                          style={{ background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)', border: 'none', borderRadius: 6, color: '#ffffff', cursor: 'pointer', padding: '4px 6px', display: 'inline-flex' }}
                        >
                          <X size={13} />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', lineHeight: 1.4, wordBreak: 'break-word' }}>{m.body}</div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
              <div ref={bottomRef} />
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSend} style={{ padding: 12, borderTop: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
              <input
                type="text"
                maxLength={1000}
                value={draft}
                onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
                placeholder={`Message ${selectedThread.parent_name}...`}
                style={ui.input}
              />
              <button type="submit" disabled={sending || !draft.trim()} style={{ ...ui.btnPrimary, flexShrink: 0 }}>
                <Send size={14} /> {sending ? 'Sending...' : 'Send'}
              </button>
            </form>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ParentChatTab;

/**
 * AttendSure - Mobile Push Notifications & Parent Alerts Center
 * File: web/src/components/tabs/PushNotificationsTab.tsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import apiClient, { peekApiCache } from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import { StatsCard } from '../common/StatsCard';
import { ControlSwitch } from '../ui/ControlSwitch';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { Bell, CheckCircle2, Edit2, Plus, RefreshCw, Send, Smartphone, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface NotificationRow {
  id: number;
  recipient?: number | null;
  recipient_name?: string;
  student: number | null;
  student_name: string;
  title: string;
  message: string;
  category: string;
  is_read: boolean;
  is_pushed: boolean;
  created_at: string;
}

type CategoryFilter = 'ALL' | 'ATTENDANCE' | 'CUTTING_ALERT' | 'GATE_PASS' | 'ANNOUNCEMENT';

const sanitizeInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 500): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);

export const PushNotificationsTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();
  const { showAlert, showConfirm } = useAlert();

  const userRole = String(localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase();
  const isLeader = ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'FACULTY_ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD'].includes(userRole);
  const listBaseParams = isLeader ? { page_size: 100, scope: 'all' } : { page_size: 100 };

  const cachedNotifs = peekApiCache<any>(API_ROUTES.messaging.notifications, listBaseParams);
  const cachedSys = peekApiCache<any>(API_ROUTES.reports.systemStatus);

  const [rows, setRows] = useState<NotificationRow[]>(() =>
    Array.isArray(cachedNotifs) ? cachedNotifs : cachedNotifs?.results || []
  );
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => !cachedNotifs);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [markingRead, setMarkingRead] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState<CategoryFilter>('ALL');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [statusStats, setStatusStats] = useState(() => ({
    sentToday: Number(cachedSys?.push_alerts_today || 0),
    pushedToday: Number(cachedSys?.push_delivered_today || 0),
    activeStudents: Number(cachedSys?.active_students || 0),
  }));

  const [composeOpen, setComposeOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingRow, setEditingRow] = useState<NotificationRow | null>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    title: '',
    message: '',
    category: 'ANNOUNCEMENT',
    target_role: 'PARENT',
    is_read: false,
  });

  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const fetchAlerts = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      const baseQuery = isLeader ? { page_size: 100, scope: 'all' } : { page_size: 100 };
      const warmNotifs = !bypassCache
        ? peekApiCache<any>(API_ROUTES.messaging.notifications, baseQuery)
        : undefined;
      if (warmNotifs) {
        setRows(Array.isArray(warmNotifs) ? warmNotifs : warmNotifs?.results || []);
        setLoading(false);
        if (silent) setRefreshing(true);
      } else if (!silent) {
        setLoading(true);
      } else {
        setRefreshing(true);
      }

      try {
        const extra = bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : {};
        const [notifRes, sysRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
          apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.messaging.notifications, {
            params: { ...baseQuery, ...extra },
            signal: controller.signal,
          }),
          apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.reports.systemStatus, {
            params: extra,
            signal: controller.signal,
          }),
        ]);

        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

        if (notifRes.status === 'fulfilled') {
          const payload = notifRes.value.data;
          const list = Array.isArray(payload) ? payload : payload?.results || [];
          setRows(list);
        } else {
          const reason = notifRes.reason as { name?: string; code?: string };
          if (reason?.name !== 'CanceledError' && reason?.code !== 'ERR_CANCELED' && !silent) {
            showAlert({
              title: 'Load Error',
              message: extractApiError(notifRes.reason, 'Could not load notifications.'),
              type: 'error',
            });
          }
        }

        if (sysRes.status === 'fulfilled' && sysRes.value.data) {
          const data = sysRes.value.data;
          setStatusStats({
            sentToday: Number(data.push_alerts_today || 0),
            pushedToday: Number(data.push_delivered_today || 0),
            activeStudents: Number(data.active_students || 0),
          });
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [showAlert, isLeader]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchAlerts(false, false);
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchAlerts]);

  const handleOpenCreate = () => {
    setEditingRow(null);
    setForm({ title: '', message: '', category: 'ANNOUNCEMENT', target_role: 'PARENT', is_read: false });
    setComposeOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (item: NotificationRow) => {
    setEditingRow(item);
    setForm({
      title: item.title,
      message: item.message,
      category: item.category || 'ANNOUNCEMENT',
      target_role: 'PARENT',
      is_read: Boolean(item.is_read),
    });
    setComposeOpen(true);
  };

  const handleCreateOrUpdate = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const cleanTitle = sanitizeInput(form.title, 150);
    const cleanMessage = sanitizeInput(form.message, 500);
    if (!cleanTitle || !cleanMessage) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Notice Incomplete',
        message: 'Please enter both a valid title and message.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      if (editingRow) {
        const res = await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.messaging.notifications}${editingRow.id}/`, {
          title: cleanTitle,
          message: cleanMessage,
          category: form.category,
          is_read: form.is_read,
        });
        setRows((prev) => prev.map((r) => (r.id === editingRow.id ? { ...r, ...res.data } : r)));
        setComposeOpen(false);
        setEditingRow(null);
        showAlert({
          title: 'Notice Updated',
          message: 'Notification details have been saved.',
          type: 'success',
        });
      } else {
        const res = await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.messaging.notifications, {
          title: cleanTitle,
          message: cleanMessage,
          category: form.category,
          target_role: form.target_role,
        });
        const count = res.data?.dispatched_count ?? 1;
        setComposeOpen(false);
        setForm({ title: '', message: '', category: 'ANNOUNCEMENT', target_role: 'PARENT', is_read: false });
        await fetchAlerts(true, true);
        showAlert({
          title: 'Alert Dispatched',
          message: `Delivered notice to ${count} active account(s) and queued mobile push notifications.`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showAlert({
        title: editingRow ? 'Update Error' : 'Dispatch Error',
        message: extractApiError(err, editingRow ? 'Could not update notice.' : 'Could not send push alert.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleMarkAllRead = async () => {
    if (markingRead) return;
    setMarkingRead(true);
    try {
      await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.messaging.markRead, {});
      await fetchAlerts(true, true);
      showAlert({
        title: 'Inbox Cleared',
        message: 'All notifications have been marked as read.',
        type: 'success',
      });
    } catch (err) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Update Failed',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not mark notifications as read.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setMarkingRead(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = (item: NotificationRow) => {
    showConfirm({
      title: 'Delete Notification',
      message: `Remove "${item.title}" permanently?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Delete',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await apiClient.delete(`${API_ROUTES.messaging.notifications}${item.id}/`);
          setRows((prev) => prev.filter((r) => r.id !== item.id));
        } catch (err) {
          showAlert({ title: 'Delete Failed', message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not delete notification.'), type: 'error' });
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const cleanSearch = sanitizeInput(search, 80).toLowerCase();
  const filtered = rows.filter((r) => {
    if (categoryFilter !== 'ALL' && r.category !== categoryFilter) return false;
    if (!cleanSearch) return true;
    return (
      r.title.toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch) ||
      r.message.toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch) ||
      (r.student_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch)
    );
  });

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16, padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px)' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 210px), 1fr))', gap: 12 }}>
        <StatsCard
          label="ALERTS CREATED TODAY"
          value={statusStats.sentToday}
          helpText="Attendance, cutting & exit alerts"
          badge={<Bell size={18} color={brand.primary} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="MOBILE PUSH DELIVERED"
          value={statusStats.pushedToday}
          valueColor={brand.success}
          helpText="Delivered to mobile devices"
          badge={<Smartphone size={18} color={brand.success} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="UNREAD IN INBOX"
          value={rows.filter((r) => !r.is_read).length}
          helpText="Awaiting recipient read receipt"
          badge={<CheckCircle2 size={18} color={brand.secondary} />}
        />
      </div>

      <div style={{ ...ui.card, display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 10 }}>
        <ControlSwitch<CategoryFilter>
          options={[
            { value: 'ALL', label: 'All Alerts' },
            { value: 'ATTENDANCE', label: 'Attendance' },
            { value: 'CUTTING_ALERT', label: 'Cutting Alerts' },
            { value: 'GATE_PASS', label: 'Exit Passes' },
            { value: 'ANNOUNCEMENT', label: 'Announcements' },
          ]}
          value={categoryFilter}
          onChange={setCategoryFilter}
          size="sm"
        />

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <input
            type="text"
            maxLength={80}
            placeholder="Search alerts..."
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            style={{ ...ui.input, width: 200 }}
          />
          <button type="button" onClick={() => void handleMarkAllRead()} disabled={markingRead} style={ui.btnSecondary}>
            <CheckCircle2 size={14} /> {markingRead ? 'Updating...' : 'Mark All Read'}
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => void fetchAlerts(false, true)} disabled={loading || refreshing} style={ui.btnSecondary}>
            <RefreshCw size={14} className={loading || refreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''} /> Refresh
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={handleOpenCreate} style={ui.btnPrimary}>
            <Plus size={14} /> New Notice
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ ...ui.card, padding: 0, overflowX: 'auto' }}>
        <table style={{ width: '100%', minWidth: 680, borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left' }}>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th style={ui.th}>Category</th>
              <th style={ui.th}>Student</th>
              <th style={ui.th}>Title &amp; Message</th>
              <th style={ui.th}>Delivery</th>
              <th style={ui.th}>Created</th>
              <th style={{ ...ui.th, textAlign: 'right' }}>Action</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {loading ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={6} style={{ padding: 32, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                  Loading notifications...
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={6} style={{ padding: 32, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                  No notifications match the current filter.
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : (
              filtered.map((item) => (
                <tr key={item.id}>
                  <td style={ui.td}>
                    <span style={ui.badge(tokens.primaryLight, brand.primary)}>{item.category}</span>
                  </td>
                  <td style={ui.td}>{item.student_name || 'General'}</td>
                  <td style={ui.td}>
                    <strong style={{ display: 'block', color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{item.title}</strong>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '0.76rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>{item.message}</span>
                  </td>
                  <td style={ui.td}>
                    <span
                      style={ui.badge(
                        item.is_pushed ? tokens.successLight : tokens.infoLight,
                        item.is_pushed ? brand.success : brand.secondary
                      )}
                    >
                      {item.is_pushed ? 'PUSHED' : 'IN-APP'}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...ui.td, fontSize: '0.74rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                    {new Date(item.created_at).toLocaleString()}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...ui.td, textAlign: 'right' }}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', gap: 6 }}>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleOpenEdit(item)}
                        aria-label={`Edit notification ${item.title}`}
                        title="Edit Notice"
                        style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, color: brand.primary, padding: '5px 8px' }}
                      >
                        <Edit2 size={13} />
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleDelete(item)}
                        aria-label={`Delete notification ${item.title}`}
                        title="Delete Notice"
                        style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, color: brand.danger, padding: '5px 8px' }}
                      >
                        <Trash2 size={13} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <Modal
        isOpen={composeOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setComposeOpen(false);
          setEditingRow(null);
        }}
        title={editingRow ? 'Edit Notification' : 'Send Mobile Push Notice'}
      >
        <form onSubmit={handleCreateOrUpdate} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 190px), 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
            {!editingRow && (
              <div>
                <label style={ui.label}>Target Audience</label>
                <select
                  value={form.target_role}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, target_role: e.target.value })}
                  style={ui.input}
                >
                  <option value="PARENT">All Linked Parents</option>
                  <option value="FACULTY">All Faculty</option>
                  <option value="ALL">Everyone (Parents &amp; Staff)</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            )}

            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Category</label>
              <select
                value={form.category}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, category: e.target.value })}
                style={ui.input}
              >
                <option value="ANNOUNCEMENT">School Announcement</option>
                <option value="ATTENDANCE">Attendance Notice</option>
                <option value="GATE_PASS">Exit Pass Notice</option>
                <option value="CUTTING_ALERT">Cutting Alert</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label style={ui.label}>Title *</label>
            <input
              required
              maxLength={150}
              value={form.title}
              onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })}
              style={ui.input}
              placeholder="e.g. Early Dismissal Advisory"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label style={ui.label}>Message *</label>
            <textarea
              required
              rows={3}
              maxLength={500}
              value={form.message}
              onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, message: e.target.value })}
              style={ui.input}
              placeholder="Write plain-English message..."
            />
          </div>
          {editingRow && (
            <label style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, fontSize: '0.80rem', color: tokens.textPrimary, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={form.is_read}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, is_read: e.target.checked })}
              />
              <span>Mark as read</span>
            </label>
          )}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 8 }}>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setComposeOpen(false);
                setEditingRow(null);
              }}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button variant="primary" type="submit" loading={submitting} icon={<Send size={14} />}>
              {editingRow ? 'Save Changes' : 'Send Alert'}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
};

export default PushNotificationsTab;

  schedule_code?: string;
  code?: string;
  section?: number | { id: number; name?: string; section_name?: string } | null;
  section_id?: number;
  section_name?: string;
  grade_level_name?: string;
  subject?: number | { id: number; code?: string; title?: string; name?: string } | null;
  subject_id?: number;
  subject_code?: string;
  subject_name?: string;
  subject_title?: string;
  faculty_id?: number;

    | number
    | string

    | null;

  grade_level_name?: string;
  grade_level_code?: string;
  adviser?:
    | number
    | string
    | { id?: number; full_name?: string; name?: string; photo_url?: string; photo?: string; employee_id?: string }
    | null;
  adviser_id?: number | null;

const sanitizeInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 60): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);

const getUserRole = (): string => {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_user') || localStorage.getItem('user');
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      return String(parsed.role || parsed.system_role || '').toUpperCase();
    }
    return String(localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || '').toUpperCase();
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
};

const getSectionDisplayName = (sec: SectionOption): string => {
  return sec.name || sec.section_name || `Section #${sec.id}`;
};

const extractList = <T,>(payload: unknown): T[] => {
  if (Array.isArray(payload)) return payload as T[];
  if (payload && typeof payload === 'object' && Array.isArray((payload as { results?: T[] }).results)) {
    return (payload as { results: T[] }).results;
  }
  return [];
};

export const SchedulesTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { showAlert, showConfirm } = useAlert();
  const { tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();

  const cachedPeriods = peekApiCache(API_ROUTES.school.periods, { page_size: 500 });
  const cachedSections = peekApiCache(API_ROUTES.school.sections, { page_size: 500 });
  const cachedFaculty = peekApiCache(API_ROUTES.accounts.facultyDropdown);

  const [schedules, setSchedules] = useState<ScheduleItem[]>(() => extractList<ScheduleItem>(cachedPeriods));
  const [sections, setSections] = useState<SectionOption[]>(() => extractList<SectionOption>(cachedSections));
  const [facultyList, setFacultyList] = useState<FacultyOption[]>(() => extractList<FacultyOption>(cachedFaculty));
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => !cachedPeriods);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string>('');

  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
  const [selectedSectionFilter, setSelectedSectionFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');

  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [modalTab, setModalTab] = useState<AcademicTabType>('SCHEDULE');
  const [editItem, setEditItem] = useState<any>(null);

  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const isInteracting = useRef(false);
  isInteracting.current = isModalOpen;

  const userRole = useMemo(() => getUserRole(), []);
  // Strict RBAC check: never fail open on empty/unknown role
  const canManageSchedule = useMemo(() => {
    return ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'FACULTY_ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD'].includes(userRole);
  }, [userRole]);

  const loggedInFacultyName = useMemo(() => {
    return (localStorage.getItem('attendsure_faculty_name') || localStorage.getItem('faculty_name') || '')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();
  }, []);

  const loggedInUsername = useMemo(() => {
    return (localStorage.getItem('attendsure_username') || localStorage.getItem('username') || '')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();
  }, []);

  const isSectionAdvisoryForUser = useCallback(
    (sec: SectionOption): boolean => {
      if (sec.is_adviser) return true;

      if (loggedInUsername && sec.adviser_employee_id && sec.adviser_employee_id.toLowerCase() === loggedInUsername) {
        return true;
      }

      if (loggedInFacultyName) {
        if (sec.adviser_name && sec.adviser_name.toLowerCase().includes(loggedInFacultyName)) return true;
        if (sec.adviser_full_name && sec.adviser_full_name.toLowerCase().includes(loggedInFacultyName)) return true;
        if (typeof sec.adviser === 'string' && sec.adviser.toLowerCase().includes(loggedInFacultyName)) return true;
        if (typeof sec.adviser === 'object' && sec.adviser) {
          const advName = (sec.adviser.full_name || sec.adviser.name || '').toLowerCase();
          if (advName && (advName.includes(loggedInFacultyName) || loggedInFacultyName.includes(advName))) {
            return true;
          }
        }
      }

      return false;
    },
    [loggedInFacultyName, loggedInUsername]
  );

  const myAdvisorySection = useMemo(() => {
    return sections.find((sec) => isSectionAdvisoryForUser(sec)) || null;
  }, [sections, isSectionAdvisoryForUser]);

  const loadData = useCallback(async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
    abortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    abortRef.current = controller;

    if (!bypassCache && !silent) {
      const warmPeriods = peekApiCache(API_ROUTES.school.periods, { page_size: 500 });
      if (warmPeriods) {
        setSchedules(extractList<ScheduleItem>(warmPeriods));
        setLoading(false);
      } else {
        setLoading(true);
      }
    } else if (!silent) {
      setLoading(true);
    }
    setError('');

    try {
      const cacheParam = bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : {};
      const results = await Promise.allSettled([
        apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.school.periods, {
          params: { page_size: 500, ...cacheParam },
          signal: controller.signal,
        }),
        apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.school.sections, {
          params: { page_size: 500, ...cacheParam },
          signal: controller.signal,
        }),
        apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.accounts.facultyDropdown, {
          params: cacheParam,
          signal: controller.signal,
        }),
      ]);

      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

      const schedRes = results[0].status === 'fulfilled' ? results[0].value : null;
      const secRes = results[1].status === 'fulfilled' ? results[1].value : null;
      const facRes = results[2].status === 'fulfilled' ? results[2].value : null;

      if (schedRes?.data) setSchedules(extractList<ScheduleItem>(schedRes.data));
      if (secRes?.data) setSections(extractList<SectionOption>(secRes.data));
      if (facRes?.data) setFacultyList(extractList<FacultyOption>(facRes.data));

      if (results[0].status === 'rejected' && results[1].status === 'rejected') {
        const reason = results[0].reason as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (reason?.name !== 'CanceledError' && reason?.code !== 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          setError(extractApiError(results[0].reason, 'Could not load class schedule records.'));
        }
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
        return;
      }
      if (!silent) {
        setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load class schedule records. Please check server connection.'));
      }
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted && !silent) {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadData(false, false);
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [loadData]);

  const hasAutoSelectedRef = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hasAutoSelectedRef.current && myAdvisorySection && userRole === 'FACULTY') {
      setSelectedSectionFilter(String(myAdvisorySection.id));
      hasAutoSelectedRef.current = true;
    }
  }, [myAdvisorySection, userRole]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const liveInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isInteracting.current && document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        void loadData(true, true);
      }
    }, 12000);
    return () => clearInterval(liveInterval);
  }, [loadData]);

  const handleDelete = (id: number, code: string) => {
    if (!canManageSchedule) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Access Denied',
        message: 'Only school administrators can delete class schedules.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    showConfirm({
      title: 'Delete Class Schedule',
      message: `Are you sure you want to delete class period "${code}"? The assigned subject faculty will be unassigned.`,
      confirmLabel: 'Delete Schedule',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await apiClient.delete(`${API_ROUTES.school.periods}${id}/`);
          setSchedules((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== id));
          showAlert({
            title: 'Schedule Removed',
            message: `Schedule ${code} was deleted successfully.`,
            type: 'info',
          });
          void loadData(true, true);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Delete Error',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Failed to delete schedule period.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleOpenModal = (tab: AcademicTabType, item: any = null) => {
    setModalTab(tab);
    setEditItem(item);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleCloseModal = () => {
    setIsModalOpen(false);
    setEditItem(null);
  };

  const formatTime = (timeStr?: string) => {
    if (!timeStr) return '--:--';
    const parts = timeStr.split(':');
    if (parts.length < 2) return timeStr;
    let hours = parseInt(parts[0], 10);
    const minutes = parts[1];
    const ampm = hours >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
    hours = hours % 12 || 12;
    const strHours = hours < 10 ? `0${hours}` : `${hours}`;
    return `${strHours}:${minutes} ${ampm}`;
  };

  const getScheduleCode = (item: ScheduleItem) => {
    return item.schedule_code || item.code || `SCH-${String(item.id).padStart(4, '0')}`;
  };

  const getFacultyInfo = useCallback(
    (item: ScheduleItem) => {
      let name = 'Unassigned';
      let photo: string | null = null;
      let employeeId = '';

      if (item.faculty_name && item.faculty_name.trim() !== '' && item.faculty_name.trim().toLowerCase() !== 'unassigned') {
        name = item.faculty_name.trim();
      } else if (item.faculty_title && item.faculty_title.trim() !== '') {
        name = item.faculty_title.trim();
      } else if (typeof item.faculty === 'object' && item.faculty) {
        name = item.faculty.full_name || item.faculty.name || name;
        photo = item.faculty.photo_url || item.faculty.photo || null;
        employeeId = item.faculty.employee_id || '';
      }

      let targetFacultyId: number | undefined;
      if (typeof item.faculty_id === 'number') {
        targetFacultyId = item.faculty_id;
      } else if (typeof item.faculty === 'number') {
        targetFacultyId = item.faculty;
      } else if (typeof item.faculty === 'string' && !isNaN(Number(item.faculty))) {
        targetFacultyId = Number(item.faculty);
      } else if (typeof item.faculty === 'object' && item.faculty && typeof item.faculty.id === 'number') {
        targetFacultyId = item.faculty.id;
      }

      if (targetFacultyId !== undefined) {
        const matched = facultyList.find((f) => f.id === targetFacultyId);
        if (matched) {
          name = matched.full_name || matched.name || name;
          photo = matched.photo_url || matched.photo || photo;
          employeeId = matched.employee_id || employeeId;
        }
      }

      return { name, photo: isSafeImageUrl(photo) ? photo : null, employeeId };
    },
    [facultyList]
  );

  const getSubjectCode = (item: ScheduleItem) => {
    if (item.subject_code) return item.subject_code;
    if (typeof item.subject === 'object' && item.subject) {
      return item.subject.code || item.subject.title || item.subject.name || '—';
    }
    if (typeof item.subject === 'string') return item.subject;
    return item.subject ? `SUB-${item.subject}` : '—';
  };

  const getSubjectName = (item: ScheduleItem) => {
    if (item.subject_title) return item.subject_title;
    if (item.subject_name) return item.subject_name;
    if (typeof item.subject === 'object' && item.subject) {
      return item.subject.title || item.subject.name || '';
    }
    return '';
  };

  const getSectionName = (item: ScheduleItem) => {
    if (item.section_name) return item.section_name;
    if (typeof item.section === 'object' && item.section) {
      return item.section.name || item.section.section_name || `Section #${item.section.id}`;
    }
    return item.section ? `Section #${item.section}` : 'Unassigned';
  };

  const getRoomDisplay = (item: ScheduleItem) => {
    if (item.room_number) return item.room_number;
    if (item.room_name) return item.room_name;
    if (typeof item.room === 'object' && item.room) {
      return item.room.room_number || item.room.name || '—';
    }
    if (typeof item.room === 'string') return item.room;
    if (item.room) return `Rm ${item.room}`;
    return '—';
  };

  const cleanSearchQuery = useMemo(() => sanitizeInput(searchQuery, 60).toLowerCase(), [searchQuery]);

  const filteredSchedules = useMemo(() => {
    return schedules.filter((s) => {
      if (selectedSectionFilter !== 'ALL') {
        const secId = typeof s.section === 'object' && s.section ? s.section.id : s.section;
        const matchesId = String(secId) === selectedSectionFilter;
        const matchesName = String(s.section_name) === selectedSectionFilter;
        if (!matchesId && !matchesName) return false;
      }

      if (cleanSearchQuery !== '') {
        const code = getScheduleCode(s).toLowerCase();
        const sec = getSectionName(s).toLowerCase();
        const sub = `${getSubjectCode(s)} ${getSubjectName(s)}`.toLowerCase();
        const fac = getFacultyInfo(s).name.toLowerCase();
        const rm = getRoomDisplay(s).toLowerCase();

        return (
          code.includes(cleanSearchQuery) ||
          sec.includes(cleanSearchQuery) ||
          sub.includes(cleanSearchQuery) ||
          fac.includes(cleanSearchQuery) ||
          rm.includes(cleanSearchQuery)
        );
      }

      return true;
    });
  }, [schedules, selectedSectionFilter, cleanSearchQuery, getFacultyInfo]);

  const currentSelectedSectionObj = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedSectionFilter === 'ALL') return null;
    return sections.find((sec) => String(sec.id) === selectedSectionFilter) || null;
  }, [selectedSectionFilter, sections]);

  const getAdviserDetails = useCallback(
    (sec: SectionOption | null) => {
      if (!sec) return null;

      let name = '';
      let photo: string | null = null;
      let employeeId = '';

      if (sec.adviser_name) name = sec.adviser_name;
      if (sec.adviser_full_name) name = sec.adviser_full_name;
      if (sec.adviser_photo_url) photo = sec.adviser_photo_url;
      if (sec.adviser_employee_id) employeeId = sec.adviser_employee_id;

      if (typeof sec.adviser === 'object' && sec.adviser) {
        if (!name) name = sec.adviser.full_name || sec.adviser.name || '';
        if (!photo) photo = sec.adviser.photo_url || sec.adviser.photo || null;
        if (!employeeId) employeeId = sec.adviser.employee_id || '';
      } else if (typeof sec.adviser === 'string' && !name) {
        name = sec.adviser;
      }

      let adviserId: number | undefined;
      if (typeof sec.adviser_id === 'number') {
        adviserId = sec.adviser_id;
      } else if (typeof sec.adviser === 'number') {
        adviserId = sec.adviser;
      } else if (typeof sec.adviser === 'object' && sec.adviser && typeof sec.adviser.id === 'number') {
        adviserId = sec.adviser.id;
      }

      if (adviserId !== undefined) {
        const match = facultyList.find((f) => f.id === adviserId);
        if (match) {
          if (!name) name = match.full_name || match.name || '';
          if (!photo) photo = match.photo_url || match.photo || null;
          if (!employeeId) employeeId = match.employee_id || '';
        }
      }

      return {
        name: name || null,
        photo: isSafeImageUrl(photo) ? photo : null,
        employeeId: employeeId || '',
      };
    },
    [facultyList]
  );

  const resolvedAdviser = useMemo(() => getAdviserDetails(currentSelectedSectionObj), [currentSelectedSectionObj, getAdviserDetails]);
  const resolvedMyAdviser = useMemo(() => getAdviserDetails(myAdvisorySection), [myAdvisorySection, getAdviserDetails]);

  const uniqueSectionsCount = useMemo(
    () => new Set(schedules.map((s) => getSectionName(s)).filter((n) => n !== 'Unassigned')).size,
    [schedules]
  );

  const uniqueFacultyCount = useMemo(
    () => new Set(schedules.map((s) => getFacultyInfo(s).name).filter((n) => n !== 'Unassigned')).size,
    [schedules, getFacultyInfo]
  );

  const uniqueRoomsCount = useMemo(
    () => new Set(schedules.map((s) => getRoomDisplay(s)).filter((r) => r !== '—')).size,

const MAX_IMAGE_SIZE_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;

const sanitizeInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 200): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);

const compressImageToDataUrl = (file: File, maxDim = 360, quality = 0.78): Promise<string> => {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    reader.onload = (e) => {
      if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
        resolve('');
        return;
      }
      const rawDataUrl = typeof e.target?.result === 'string' ? e.target.result : '';
      if (!isSafeImageUrl(rawDataUrl)) {
        resolve('');
        return;
      }
      const img = new window.Image();
      img.src = rawDataUrl;
      img.onload = () => {
        let { width, height } = img;
        if (width > height) {
          if (width > maxDim) {
            height = Math.round((height * maxDim) / width);
            width = maxDim;
          }
        } else {
          if (height > maxDim) {
            width = Math.round((width * maxDim) / height);
            height = maxDim;
          }
        }
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width = width;
        canvas.height = height;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        if (!ctx) {
          resolve(rawDataUrl);
          return;
        }
        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);
        const compressed = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality);
        resolve(isSafeImageUrl(compressed) ? compressed : '');
      };
      img.onerror = () => resolve('');
    };
    reader.onerror = () => resolve('');
  });
};

    right_logo: false,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      initAbortRef.current?.abort();
      diagAbortRef.current?.abort();
      logsAbortRef.current?.abort();
      if (saveSuccessTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(saveSuccessTimerRef.current);
        saveSuccessTimerRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, []);

  const applySchoolPayload = useCallback((s: any) => {
    if (!s || typeof s !== 'object') return;
    setFormData({
      school_id: s.school_id || '',
      school_name: s.school_name || '',
      region: s.region || '',
      division: s.division || '',
      district: s.district || '',
      academic_year: s.academic_year || s.school_year || '',
      address: s.address || s.street_address || '',
      contact_number: s.contact_number || s.telephone || '',
      email: s.email || '',
      website: s.website || '',
      principal_faculty: s.principal_faculty ?? '',
      principal_name: s.principal_name || '',
      principal_title: s.principal_title || '',
      principal_photo_url: isSafeImageUrl(s.principal_photo_url) ? s.principal_photo_url : null,
      principal_employee_id: s.principal_employee_id || '',
      principal_department: s.principal_department || '',
      principal_contact_number: s.principal_contact_number || '',
      principal_email: s.principal_email || '',
      superintendent_name: s.superintendent_name || '',
      school_logo: isSafeImageUrl(s.school_logo) ? s.school_logo : null,
      left_logo: isSafeImageUrl(s.left_logo) ? s.left_logo : null,
      right_logo: isSafeImageUrl(s.right_logo) ? s.right_logo : null,
      latitude: s.latitude !== undefined && s.latitude !== null && s.latitude !== '' ? String(s.latitude) : '',
      longitude: s.longitude !== undefined && s.longitude !== null && s.longitude !== '' ? String(s.longitude) : '',
      geofence_radius_meters: s.geofence_radius_meters ? Number(s.geofence_radius_meters) : 150,
    });
  }, []);

  const fetchDiagnostics = useCallback(async () => {
    diagAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    diagAbortRef.current = controller;

    const [dbRes, sysRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
      apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.health.db, { params: { nocache: 1 }, signal: controller.signal }),
      apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.reports.systemStatus, { params: { nocache: 1 }, signal: controller.signal }),
    ]);

    if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

    const dbData = dbRes.status === 'fulfilled' ? dbRes.value.data : null;
    const sysData = sysRes.status === 'fulfilled' ? sysRes.value.data : null;

    setHealth({
      database: dbData?.database === 'CONNECTED' || dbData?.status === 'CONNECTED' ? 'ONLINE' : 'OFFLINE',
      dbLatencyMs: Number(dbData?.latency_ms) || 0,
      scannersOnline: Number(sysData?.online_count) || 0,
      scannersTotal: Number(sysData?.total_scanners) || 0,
      pushSentToday: Number(sysData?.sent_today ?? sysData?.push_delivered_today) || 0,
      pushPending: Number(sysData?.pending_queue) || 0,
      pushFailed: Number(sysData?.failed_today) || 0,
      lastChecked: new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }),
    });
  }, []);

  const fetchUserActivities = useCallback(async () => {
    logsAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    logsAbortRef.current = controller;

    setLogsLoading(true);
    try {
      const params: Record<string, string | number> = { nocache: 1 };
      const cleanSearch = sanitizeInput(logSearch, 80);
      if (cleanSearch) params.search = cleanSearch;
      if (logActionFilter !== 'ALL') params.action = logActionFilter;
      if (logDateFilter) params.date = logDateFilter;

      const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.accounts.auditLogs, {
        params,
        timeout: 8000,
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

      if (res.data) {
        const rawList = res.data.records || res.data.results || (Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : []);
        setActivityLogs(rawList);
        setIsSuperAdmin(Boolean(res.data.is_admin));
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
        return;
      }
      setActivityLogs([]);
      showAlert({
        title: 'Activity Log Notice',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not load activity logs.'),
        type: 'warning',
      });
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setLogsLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, [logSearch, logActionFilter, logDateFilter, showAlert]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    initAbortRef.current = controller;

    const warmSchool = peekApiCache<any>(API_ROUTES.school.settings);
    if (warmSchool) {
      applySchoolPayload(warmSchool);
      setLoading(false);
    }

    const loadInitialData = async () => {
      if (!warmSchool) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const [schoolRes, facultyRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
          apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.school.settings, { timeout: 6000, signal: controller.signal }),
          apiClient
            .get(API_ROUTES.accounts.facultyDropdown, {
              params: { include_all: 'true' },
              timeout: 6000,
              signal: controller.signal,
            })
            .catch(() => apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.accounts.faculty, { timeout: 6000, signal: controller.signal })),
        ]);

        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

        if (schoolRes.status === 'fulfilled' && schoolRes.value.data) {
          applySchoolPayload(schoolRes.value.data);
        }

        if (facultyRes.status === 'fulfilled' && facultyRes.value.data) {
          const fList = Array.isArray(facultyRes.value.data)
            ? facultyRes.value.data
            : facultyRes.value.data?.results || [];
          setFacultyList(fList);
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    void loadInitialData();
    void fetchDiagnostics();

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [applySchoolPayload, fetchDiagnostics]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeSubTab === 'LOGS' || activeSubTab === 'ALL') {
      void fetchUserActivities();
    }
  }, [activeSubTab, fetchUserActivities]);

  const handleFacultyChange = (facultyIdStr: string) => {
    if (!facultyIdStr) {
      setFormData((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        principal_faculty: '',
        principal_name: '',
        principal_title: '',
        principal_photo_url: null,
        principal_employee_id: '',
        principal_department: '',
        principal_contact_number: '',
        principal_email: '',
      }));
      return;
    }

    const fid = Number(facultyIdStr);
    const chosen = facultyList.find((f) => f.id === fid);

    if (chosen) {
      setFormData((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        principal_faculty: fid,
        principal_name: chosen.full_name || `${chosen.first_name} ${chosen.last_name}`.trim(),
        principal_title: chosen.position || 'School Principal',
        principal_photo_url: isSafeImageUrl(chosen.photo_url) ? chosen.photo_url ?? null : null,
        principal_employee_id: chosen.employee_id || '',
        principal_department: chosen.department || 'Administration',
        principal_contact_number: chosen.contact_number || '',
        principal_email: chosen.email || '',
      }));
    }
  };

  const selectedFacultyObj = facultyList.find(
    (f) => String(f.id) === String(formData.principal_faculty)
  );

  const rawPrincipalPhoto = selectedFacultyObj?.photo_url || formData.principal_photo_url || null;
  const activePrincipalPhoto = isSafeImageUrl(rawPrincipalPhoto) ? rawPrincipalPhoto : null;
  const activePrincipalEmpId = selectedFacultyObj?.employee_id || formData.principal_employee_id || '';
  const activePrincipalDept = selectedFacultyObj?.department || formData.principal_department || 'Administration';
  const activePrincipalContact = selectedFacultyObj?.contact_number || formData.principal_contact_number || '';
  const activePrincipalEmail = selectedFacultyObj?.email || formData.principal_email || '';

  const handleLogoUpload = async (
    field: 'school_logo' | 'left_logo' | 'right_logo',
    e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>
  ) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    if (!['image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type)) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Invalid Image Format',
        message: 'Only PNG, JPG, and WebP images are allowed.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    if (file.size > MAX_IMAGE_SIZE_BYTES) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Image File Too Large',
        message: 'Please choose an image under 5 MB.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    const compressed = await compressImageToDataUrl(file, 360, 0.78);
    if (compressed && isSafeImageUrl(compressed)) {
      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: compressed }));
      setFreshLogos((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: true }));
    }
  };

  const runMaintenanceAction = (
    actionKey: string,
    title: string,
    description: string,
    apiCall: () => Promise<any>
  ) => {
    showConfirm({
      title,
      message: `${description} Do you want to proceed?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Run Fix Now',
      isDestructive: false,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setActionLoading(actionKey);
        try {
          const res = await apiCall();
          showAlert({
            title: 'Task Finished Successfully',
            message: res?.data?.message || `${title} completed with zero errors.`,
            type: 'success',
          });
          void fetchDiagnostics();
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Action Notice',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Action could not be completed. Please try again.'),
            type: 'warning',
          });
        } finally {
          setActionLoading(null);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const exportActivityCSV = () => {
    if (activityLogs.length === 0) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Empty Export', message: 'No activity logs available to export.', type: 'warning' });
      return;
    }

    const headers = ['Timestamp', 'User Account', 'Action', 'Module', 'Details', 'IP Address', 'Status'];
    const rows = activityLogs.map((r) => [
      r.timestamp,
      r.user,
      r.action,
      r.module,
      r.details,
      r.ip_address,
      r.status,
    ]);

    exportToCsv(
      `AttendSure_User_Activities_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`,
      headers,
      rows
    );
  };

  const handleSave = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSaving(true);
    setSaveSuccess(false);

    const hasLat = String(formData.latitude).trim() !== '';
    const hasLng = String(formData.longitude).trim() !== '';
    const lat = hasLat ? Number(formData.latitude) : null;
    const lng = hasLng ? Number(formData.longitude) : null;
    const radius = Number(formData.geofence_radius_meters);

    if (lat !== null && (isNaN(lat) || lat < -90 || lat > 90)) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Latitude', message: 'Latitude must be between -90 and 90 degrees.', type: 'error' });
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    if (lng !== null && (isNaN(lng) || lng < -180 || lng > 180)) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Longitude', message: 'Longitude must be between -180 and 180 degrees.', type: 'error' });
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    if (isNaN(radius) || radius < 20 || radius > 5000) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Boundary Radius', message: 'Radius must be between 20 and 5000 meters.', type: 'error' });
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    const validFacultyId =
      formData.principal_faculty && !isNaN(Number(formData.principal_faculty))
        ? Number(formData.principal_faculty)
        : null;

    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
      school_id: sanitizeInput(formData.school_id, 40),
      school_name: sanitizeInput(formData.school_name, 160),
      region: sanitizeInput(formData.region, 80),
      division: sanitizeInput(formData.division, 120),
      district: sanitizeInput(formData.district, 120),
      academic_year: sanitizeInput(formData.academic_year, 20),
      address: sanitizeInput(formData.address, 250),
      contact_number: sanitizeInput(formData.contact_number, 40),
      email: sanitizeInput(formData.email, 150),
      website: sanitizeInput(formData.website, 200),
      principal_faculty: validFacultyId,
      principal_name: sanitizeInput(formData.principal_name, 150),
      principal_title: sanitizeInput(formData.principal_title, 120),
      superintendent_name: sanitizeInput(formData.superintendent_name, 150),
      latitude: lat,
      longitude: lng,
      geofence_radius_meters: radius,
    };

    if (freshLogos.school_logo) payload.school_logo = formData.school_logo;
    if (freshLogos.left_logo) payload.left_logo = formData.left_logo;
    if (freshLogos.right_logo) payload.right_logo = formData.right_logo;

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.put(API_ROUTES.school.settings, payload, { timeout: 15000 });
      updateSchoolInstantly(res.data || payload);
      if (isSafeImageUrl(res.data?.principal_photo_url)) {
        setFormData((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          principal_photo_url: res.data.principal_photo_url,
        }));
      }
      setFreshLogos({ school_logo: false, left_logo: false, right_logo: false });
      setSaveSuccess(true);
      showAlert({
        title: 'Settings Saved',
        message: 'School profile and campus boundary saved to the database.',
        type: 'success',
        autoCloseDuration: 2500,
      });
      if (saveSuccessTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(saveSuccessTimerRef.current);
      saveSuccessTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        setSaveSuccess(false);
        saveSuccessTimerRef.current = null;
      }, 3000);
      await refreshSchool();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Save Failed',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not save school settings. Please check your permissions and inputs.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const cardStyle: React.CSSProperties = {

  if (loading) {

        {/* Navigation Selector */}

          <div
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',

            }}
          >
            {(
              [
                { key: 'MAINTENANCE', label: 'One-Click System Fixes', icon: <Wrench size={14} /> },
                { key: 'SETTINGS', label: 'School Profile & Settings', icon: <Building2 size={14} /> },
                { key: 'LOGS', label: 'User Activity Logs', icon: <History size={14} /> },
                { key: 'ALL', label: 'Show All', icon: <Layers size={14} /> },
              ] as const
            ).map((tab) => (
              <button
                key={tab.key}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setActiveSubTab(tab.key)}
                style={{
                  display: 'inline-flex',

                </p>
                <button

                        style={{
                          width: '100%',
                          height: 90,
                          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                          border: `1px dashed ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                          borderRadius: 8,
                          display: 'flex',
                          alignItems: 'center',
                          justifyContent: 'center',
                          padding: 6,
                          boxSizing: 'border-box',
                        }}
                      >
                        {safeUrl ? (
                          <img
                            src={safeUrl}
                            alt={item.alt}
                            style={{ maxHeight: '100%', maxWidth: '100%', objectFit: 'contain' }}
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>{item.emptyText}</span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, marginTop: 6 }}>
                        <label
                          style={{
                            padding: '5px 10px',
                            backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                            border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                            borderRadius: 6,
                            fontSize: '0.72rem',
                            fontWeight: 700,
                            color: brand.primary,
                            cursor: 'pointer',
                            display: 'inline-flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            gap: 5,
                          }}
                        >
                          <Upload size={12} /> {item.uploadText}
                          <input
                            type="file"
                            accept="image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp"
                            onChange={(e) => void handleLogoUpload(item.field, e)}
                            style={{ display: 'none' }}
                          />
                        </label>
                        {safeUrl && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => {
                              setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, [item.field]: null }));
                              setFreshLogos((p) => ({ ...p, [item.field]: true }));
                            }}
                            style={{
                              padding: '5px 10px',
                              backgroundColor: tokens.dangerLight,
                              border: `1px solid ${brand.danger}`,
                              borderRadius: 6,
                              fontSize: '0.72rem',
                              fontWeight: 700,
                              color: brand.danger,
                              cursor: 'pointer',
                              display: 'inline-flex',
                              alignItems: 'center',
                              gap: 5,
                            }}
                          >
                            <Trash2 size={12} /> Remove
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Save Button Bar */}
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, marginTop: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              {saveSuccess && (
                <span style={{ color: brand.success, fontSize: '0.80rem', fontWeight: 700, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                  <CheckCircle2 size={15} /> Configuration saved successfully.
                </span>
              )}
              <Button
                variant="primary"
                size="md"
                type="submit"
                disabled={saving}
                icon={saving ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={15} /> : <Save size={15} />}
              >
                Save School Configuration
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

const sanitizeSearchText = (raw: string): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 80);

const parseGuardianFields = (name?: string, rel?: string) => {
  const roles = ['MOTHER', 'FATHER', 'AUNT', 'UNCLE', 'GRANDMOTHER', 'GRANDFATHER', 'GUARDIAN'];
  const cleanName = String(name || '').trim();
  const cleanRel = String(rel || '').trim();

  if (roles.includes(cleanName.toUpperCase()) && !roles.includes(cleanRel.toUpperCase())) {
    return { gName: cleanRel, gRel: cleanName };
  }
  return {
    gName: cleanName,
    gRel: cleanRel.toLowerCase() === 'mather' ? 'Mother' : cleanRel,
  };
};

const splitAddressParts = (st: SF1LearnerRow) => {
  const street = st.house_street_sitio || st.house_street || '';
  const brgy = st.barangay || '';
  const city = st.municipality_city || '';
  const prov = st.province || '';

  if (street || brgy || city || prov) {
    return { street, brgy, city, prov };
  }

  const parts = String(st.address || '')
    .split(',')
    .map((p) => p.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);

  return {
    street: parts[0] || '',
    brgy: parts[1] || '',
    city: parts[2] || '',
    prov: parts[3] || '',
  };
};

        setSections(list);

        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {

        });
      } catch (err: unknown) {

          return;
        }

    window.addEventListener('beforeprint', handleBeforePrint);

  const cleanSearch = useMemo(() => sanitizeSearchText(searchQuery).toLowerCase(), [searchQuery]);
