      </tr>
    );
  };

  const schoolName = reportData?.school_name || globalSchool.school_name || '';
  const schoolId = reportData?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id || '';
  const schoolHead = reportData?.school_head || globalSchool.principal_name || '';

  return (
    <div
      className="report-tab-root"

} from '../../utils/reportExporters';

interface SectionOption {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  grade_level_name?: string;
}

export interface SchoolDay {
  dateNumber: number;
  dayOfWeek: 'M' | 'T' | 'W' | 'TH' | 'F';
  fullDate: string;
}

export interface SF2Learner {
  id: number;
  lrn: string;
  name: string;
  sex: 'M' | 'F';
  attendance: Record<number, string | number>;
  total_absent: number;
  total_tardy: number;
  remarks: string;
}

export interface MetricCounts {
  m: number;
  f: number;
  total: number;
}

export interface SF2Metrics {
  enrolment_june: MetricCounts;
  late_enrolment: MetricCounts;
  registered_end: MetricCounts;
  percentage_enrolment: MetricCounts;
  average_daily_attendance: MetricCounts;
  percentage_attendance: MetricCounts;
  consecutive_5_absent_count: MetricCounts;
  consecutive_5?: MetricCounts;
  drop_out: MetricCounts;
  transferred_out: MetricCounts;
  transferred_in: MetricCounts;
}

export interface SF2ReportData {
  school_id: string;
  school_name: string;
  region?: string;
  division: string;
  district: string;
  academic_year: string;
  grade_level: string;
  section_name: string;
  month: string;
  year: number;
  adviser_name: string;
  school_head: string;
  school_address?: string;
  school_contact?: string;
  school_email?: string;
  left_logo?: string | null;
  right_logo?: string | null;
  school_logo?: string | null;
  school_days: SchoolDay[];
  has_enrolled_students?: boolean;
  males: SF2Learner[];
  females: SF2Learner[];
  metrics: SF2Metrics;
}

export interface SF2ReportTabProps {
  sectionId?: number | string;
  activeReportId?: string;
  onSelectReport?: (reportId: string) => void;
}

const MONTH_NAMES = [
  'January',
  'February',
  'March',
  'April',
  'May',
  'June',
  'July',
  'August',
  'September',
  'October',
  'November',
  'December',
];

const PRESENT_STATUSES = new Set(['present', 'late', 'tardy', 'cutting', 'excused']);

const SVG_DIAGONAL_ONLY =
  'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,' +
  encodeURIComponent(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 16" preserveAspectRatio="none"><line x1="0" y1="16" x2="24" y2="0" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.6"/></svg>'
  );

const SVG_ABSENT =
  'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,' +
  encodeURIComponent(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 16" preserveAspectRatio="none"><line x1="0" y1="16" x2="24" y2="0" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.6"/><line x1="4" y1="2" x2="20" y2="14" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="20" y1="2" x2="4" y2="14" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>'
  );

const SVG_TARDY =
  'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,' +
  encodeURIComponent(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 16" preserveAspectRatio="none"><polygon points="0,0 24,0 0,16" fill="#000000"/><line x1="0" y1="16" x2="24" y2="0" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.75"/></svg>'
  );

const SVG_CUTTING =
  'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,' +
  encodeURIComponent(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 16" preserveAspectRatio="none"><polygon points="24,0 24,16 0,16" fill="#000000"/><line x1="0" y1="16" x2="24" y2="0" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.75"/></svg>'
  );

const AttendanceCell: React.FC<{ status?: string | number | null; isSchoolDay?: boolean }> = ({
  status,
  isSchoolDay = true,
}) => {
  if (!isSchoolDay) {
    return <div style={{ width: '100%', height: '16px', backgroundColor: '#ffffff' }} />;
  }

  const s = String(status ?? '').toLowerCase().trim();
  let src = SVG_DIAGONAL_ONLY;
  let alt = 'Present';

  if (s === 'absent' || s === 'x' || s === '1' || s === 'a') {
    src = SVG_ABSENT;
    alt = 'Absent (X)';
  } else if (s === 'tardy' || s === 'late' || s === '2' || s === 't') {
    src = SVG_TARDY;
    alt = 'Late';
  } else if (s === 'cutting' || s === 'cc' || s === '3' || s === 'c') {
    src = SVG_CUTTING;
    alt = 'Cutting Classes';
  }

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        width: '100%',
        height: '16px',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
      }}
    >
      <img
        src={src}
        alt={alt}
        style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', display: 'block', objectFit: 'fill' }}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

const sanitizeSearchText = (raw: string): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 80);

export const SF2ReportTab: React.FC<SF2ReportTabProps> = ({
  sectionId,
  activeReportId = 'sf2',
  onSelectReport,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const { school: globalSchool } = useSchool();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();

  const now = useMemo(() => new Date(), []);
  const yearOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const y = now.getFullYear();
    return [y - 1, y, y + 1];
  }, [now]);

  const cachedSectionsPayload = peekApiCache<any>(API_ROUTES.school.sections, { page_size: 250 });
  const initialSections: SectionOption[] = Array.isArray(cachedSectionsPayload)
    ? cachedSectionsPayload
    : cachedSectionsPayload?.results || [];

  const [sections, setSections] = useState<SectionOption[]>(initialSections);
  const [selectedSectionId, setSelectedSectionId] = useState<string>(
    sectionId ? String(sectionId) : initialSections[0] ? String(initialSections[0].id) : ''
  );
  const [selectedMonth, setSelectedMonth] = useState<string>(
    () => MONTH_NAMES[now.getMonth()] || 'October'
  );
  const [selectedYear, setSelectedYear] = useState<number>(now.getFullYear());
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');

  const [reportData, setReportData] = useState<SF2ReportData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isExportingPdf, setIsExportingPdf] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isPrinting, setIsPrinting] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [auditMeta, setAuditMeta] = useState(() => buildAuditStamp('SF2'));
  const [pageConfig, setPageConfig] = useState<PageSetupConfig>(DEFAULT_DEPED_LANDSCAPE_SETUP);
  const [isPageSetupOpen, setIsPageSetupOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const reportRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const { widthIn: pageWidthInches, heightIn: pageHeightInches } = useMemo(
    () => resolvePaperDimensionsInches(pageConfig),
    [pageConfig]
  );

  const refreshAuditMeta = useCallback(() => {
    const next = buildAuditStamp('SF2', reportData?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id);
    setAuditMeta(next);
    return next;
  }, [reportData?.school_id, globalSchool.school_id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (sectionId) {
      setSelectedSectionId(String(sectionId));
    }
  }, [sectionId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    apiClient
      .get(API_ROUTES.school.sections, {
        params: { page_size: 250 },
        signal: controller.signal,
      })
      .then((res) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const list: SectionOption[] = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : res.data?.results || [];
        setSections(list);
        if (list.length > 0) {
          setSelectedSectionId((prev) => prev || String(list[0].id));
        } else {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load class sections.'));
        setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  const fetchSF2 = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      if (!selectedSectionId) return;

      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      const endpoint = `${API_ROUTES.reports.sf2}${encodeURIComponent(selectedSectionId)}/`;
      const baseParams = { month: selectedMonth, year: selectedYear };
      const warmHit = !bypassCache ? peekApiCache<SF2ReportData>(endpoint, baseParams) : undefined;

      if (warmHit) {
        setReportData(warmHit);
        setLoading(false);
        if (silent) setRefreshing(true);
      } else if (!silent) {
        setLoading(true);
      } else {
        setRefreshing(true);
      }
      setError(null);

      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<SF2ReportData>(endpoint, {
          params: bypassCache ? { ...baseParams, nocache: 1 } : baseParams,
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        setReportData(res.data);
        const stamp = buildAuditStamp('SF2', res.data?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id);
        setAuditMeta(stamp);
        void logOfficialReportAudit({
          reportName: 'SF2',
          trackingId: stamp.trackingId,
          printedAt: stamp.printedAt,
          action: 'VIEW',
          sectionId: selectedSectionId,
        });
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        if (!silent) {
          setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not generate DepEd SF2 Daily Attendance Report.'));
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [selectedSectionId, selectedMonth, selectedYear, globalSchool.school_id]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchSF2(false, false);
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchSF2]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleBeforePrint = () => {
      refreshAuditMeta();
      setIsPrinting(true);
    };
    const handleAfterPrint = () => {
      setIsPrinting(false);
    };
    window.addEventListener('beforeprint', handleBeforePrint);
    window.addEventListener('afterprint', handleAfterPrint);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('beforeprint', handleBeforePrint);
      window.removeEventListener('afterprint', handleAfterPrint);
    };
  }, [refreshAuditMeta]);

  const cleanSearch = useMemo(() => sanitizeSearchText(searchQuery).toLowerCase(), [searchQuery]);

  const males = useMemo(() => {
    const list = Array.isArray(reportData?.males) ? reportData!.males : [];
    if (!cleanSearch) return list;
    return list.filter(
      (m) => m.name.toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch) || m.lrn.toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch)
    );
  }, [reportData, cleanSearch]);

  const females = useMemo(() => {
    const list = Array.isArray(reportData?.females) ? reportData!.females : [];
    if (!cleanSearch) return list;
    return list.filter(
      (f) => f.name.toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch) || f.lrn.toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch)
    );
  }, [reportData, cleanSearch]);

  const dailyAttendanceTotals = useMemo(() => {
    const maxCols = 25;
    const malesCount: number[] = new Array(maxCols).fill(0);
    const femalesCount: number[] = new Array(maxCols).fill(0);
    const combinedCount: number[] = new Array(maxCols).fill(0);

    if (!reportData?.school_days) {
      return { males: malesCount, females: femalesCount, combined: combinedCount };
    }

    reportData.school_days.forEach((day, idx) => {
      if (idx >= maxCols) return;
      let mPresent = 0;
      let fPresent = 0;

      males.forEach((m) => {
        const st = String(m.attendance?.[day.dateNumber] ?? '').toLowerCase().trim();
        if (PRESENT_STATUSES.has(st)) mPresent++;
      });

      females.forEach((f) => {
        const st = String(f.attendance?.[day.dateNumber] ?? '').toLowerCase().trim();
        if (PRESENT_STATUSES.has(st)) fPresent++;
      });

      malesCount[idx] = mPresent;
      femalesCount[idx] = fPresent;
      combinedCount[idx] = mPresent + fPresent;
    });

    return { males: malesCount, females: femalesCount, combined: combinedCount };
  }, [reportData, males, females]);

  const fitsOnSinglePage = useMemo(() => {
    if (pageConfig.layoutMode === 'pageless') return true;
    const printableHeight =
      pageHeightInches - (pageConfig.margins.top || 0.25) - (pageConfig.margins.bottom || 0.25);
    const totalRows = males.length + females.length;
    return 5.4 + totalRows * 0.17 <= printableHeight;
  }, [pageConfig, males.length, females.length, pageHeightInches]);

  const getBaseFilename = () => {
    const secClean = (reportData?.section_name || 'Section').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');
    return `DepEd_SF2_${secClean}_${reportData?.month || selectedMonth}_${selectedYear}`;
  };

  const handleDirectPrint = () => {
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    void logOfficialReportAudit({
      reportName: 'SF2',
      trackingId: meta.trackingId,
      printedAt: meta.printedAt,
      action: 'PRINT',
      sectionId: selectedSectionId,
    });
    setIsPrinting(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      window.print();
      setTimeout(() => setIsPrinting(false), 400);
    }, 180);
  };

  const handleExportPdf = async (usePicker = false) => {
    if (!reportData || !reportRef.current) return;
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    void logOfficialReportAudit({
      reportName: 'SF2',
      trackingId: meta.trackingId,
      printedAt: meta.printedAt,
      action: 'PDF',
      sectionId: selectedSectionId,
    });

    setIsExportingPdf(true);
    setIsPrinting(true);
    try {
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150));
      await exportElementToLocalPdf({
        element: reportRef.current,
        filename: `${getBaseFilename()}.pdf`,
        pageWidthInches,
        pageHeightInches,
        orientation: pageConfig.orientation,
        pageColor: pageConfig.pageColor,
        pageless: pageConfig.layoutMode === 'pageless',
        usePicker,
      });
    } catch {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Opening Print Dialog',
        message: 'Choose "Save as PDF" in your browser print dialog.',
        type: 'info',
      });
      handleDirectPrint();
    } finally {
      setIsPrinting(false);
      setIsExportingPdf(false);
    }
  };

  const buildCsvData = () => {
    if (!reportData) return { headers: [] as string[], rows: [] as Array<Array<string | number>> };
    const schoolDays = Array.isArray(reportData.school_days) ? reportData.school_days : [];
    const dayHeaders = schoolDays.map((d) => `${d.dateNumber} (${d.dayOfWeek})`);
    const headers = ['LRN', 'Learner Name', 'Sex', ...dayHeaders, 'Total Absent', 'Total Tardy', 'Remarks'];

    const rows = [...males, ...females].map((st) => [
      st.lrn,
      st.name,
      st.sex,
      ...schoolDays.map((d) => st.attendance?.[d.dateNumber] || ''),
      st.total_absent || 0,
      st.total_tardy || 0,
      st.remarks || '',
    ]);
    return { headers, rows };
  };

  const handleExportCsv = async (usePicker = false) => {
    if (!reportData) return;
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    void logOfficialReportAudit({
      reportName: 'SF2',
      trackingId: meta.trackingId,
      printedAt: meta.printedAt,
      action: 'CSV',
      sectionId: selectedSectionId,
    });
    const { headers, rows } = buildCsvData();
    const filename = `${getBaseFilename()}.csv`;

    if (usePicker) {
      const escapeCell = (val: unknown) => `"${String(val ?? '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
      const csvString =
        '\uFEFF' + [headers.map(escapeCell).join(','), ...rows.map((r) => r.map(escapeCell).join(','))].join('\r\n');
      const blob = new Blob([csvString], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
      await saveBlobWithOptionalPicker(blob, filename, 'text/csv', 'csv', 'CSV Spreadsheet (*.csv)');
    } else {
      exportToCsv(filename, headers, rows);
    }
  };

  const handleExportExcel = async (usePicker = false) => {
    if (!reportData || !reportRef.current) return;
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    void logOfficialReportAudit({
      reportName: 'SF2',
      trackingId: meta.trackingId,
      printedAt: meta.printedAt,
      action: 'EXCEL',
      sectionId: selectedSectionId,
    });
    await exportElementToExcel(reportRef.current, getBaseFilename(), meta, usePicker);
  };

  const handleExportWord = async (usePicker = false) => {
    if (!reportData || !reportRef.current) return;
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    void logOfficialReportAudit({
      reportName: 'SF2',
      trackingId: meta.trackingId,
      printedAt: meta.printedAt,
      action: 'WORD',
      sectionId: selectedSectionId,
    });
    await exportElementToWord(reportRef.current, getBaseFilename(), meta, usePicker);
  };

  const handleExportJson = async (usePicker = false) => {
    if (!reportData) return;
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    void logOfficialReportAudit({
      reportName: 'SF2',
      trackingId: meta.trackingId,
      printedAt: meta.printedAt,
      action: 'JSON',
      sectionId: selectedSectionId,
    });
    await exportReportJson(getBaseFilename(), meta, reportData, usePicker);
  };

  const schoolDays = Array.isArray(reportData?.school_days) ? reportData!.school_days : [];
  const isListEmpty = males.length === 0 && females.length === 0;
  const schoolHead = reportData?.school_head || globalSchool.principal_name || '';

  const renderTableHeader = () => (
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th rowSpan={2} style={{ width: '2.0%', ...thCell }}>#</th>
        <th rowSpan={2} style={{ width: '16.5%', ...thCell }}>
          LEARNER&apos;S NAME<br />
          <span style={{ fontSize: '4.4pt', fontWeight: 400, fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
            (Last Name, First Name, Middle Name)
          </span>
        </th>
        <th colSpan={25} style={{ width: '61.25%', ...thCell, fontSize: '4.9pt' }}>
          (1st row for date, 2nd row for Day: M, T, W, TH, F)
        </th>
        <th colSpan={2} style={{ width: '5.5%', ...thCell }}>Total for the<br />Month</th>
        <th rowSpan={2} style={{ width: '14.75%', ...thCell, fontSize: '4.6pt', lineHeight: 1.12 }}>
          REMARK/S (If DROPPED OUT, state reason; if TRANSFERRED IN/OUT, write name of School)
        </th>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        {Array.from({ length: 25 }).map((_, i) => {
          const day = schoolDays[i];
          return (
            <th key={`day-col-${i}`} style={{ width: '2.45%', ...thDateCell }}>
              <div>{day ? day.dateNumber : ''}</div>
              <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: '4.2pt' }}>{day ? day.dayOfWeek : ''}</div>
            </th>
          );
        })}
        <th style={{ width: '2.75%', ...thCell, fontSize: '4.5pt' }}>ABSENT</th>
        <th style={{ width: '2.75%', ...thCell, fontSize: '4.5pt' }}>TARDY</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
  );

  const renderSummaryFooter = () => {
    const m = reportData?.metrics;
    return (
      <div style={{ marginTop: 8, width: '100%' }}>
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'grid',
            gridTemplateColumns: '38% 34% 26%',
            gap: '1%',
            alignItems: 'start',
            fontSize: '5.5pt',
            lineHeight: 1.18,
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ border: '1px solid #000', padding: '4px 6px' }}>
            <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, marginBottom: 2 }}>GUIDELINES:</div>
            <div>1. The attendance shall be accomplished daily. Refer to the codes for checking learners&apos; attendance.</div>
            <div>2. Dates shall be written in the columns beside Learner&apos;s Name.</div>
            <div>3. Compute the following at the end of the month:</div>
            <div style={{ paddingLeft: 6 }}>
              <strong>a. % of Enrolment = </strong> (Registered Learners end of month / Enrolment 1st Friday of June) x 100
            </div>
            <div style={{ paddingLeft: 6 }}>
              <strong>b. Average Daily Attendance = </strong> Total Daily Attendance / Number of School Days in month
            </div>
            <div style={{ paddingLeft: 6 }}>

                        {Array.from({ length: 25 }).map((_, i) => (

                            {schoolDays[i] ? dailyAttendanceTotals.females[i] : ''}
                          </td>
                        ))}
                        <td style={{ ...tdCenter, fontWeight: 800 }}>{females.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.total_absent || 0), 0)}</td>
                        <td style={{ ...tdCenter, fontWeight: 800 }}>{females.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.total_tardy || 0), 0)}</td>
                        <td style={tdCenter} />
                      </tr>

                      <tr style={{ ...subtotalRowStyle, backgroundColor: '#e2e8f0' }}>
                        <td colSpan={2} style={{ ...tdLeft, fontWeight: 900 }}>Combined TOTAL PER DAY</td>
                        {Array.from({ length: 25 }).map((_, i) => (
                          <td key={`cp2-tot-${i}`} style={{ ...tdCenter, fontWeight: 900 }}>
                            {schoolDays[i] ? dailyAttendanceTotals.combined[i] : ''}
                          </td>
                        ))}
                        <td style={{ ...tdCenter, fontWeight: 900 }}>
                          {males.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.total_absent || 0), 0) +
                            females.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.total_absent || 0), 0)}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ ...tdCenter, fontWeight: 900 }}>
                          {males.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.total_tardy || 0), 0) +
                            females.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.total_tardy || 0), 0)}
                        </td>
                        <td style={tdCenter} />
                      </tr>
                    </tbody>
                  </table>

                  {renderSummaryFooter()}
                </div>

                <div style={auditFooterStyle}>
                  <span>School Form 2 (SF2) — Page 2 of 2</span>
                  <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                    PRINTED: {auditMeta.printedAt} &nbsp;|&nbsp; TRACKING ID: {auditMeta.trackingId}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          ))}
      </ReportViewerShell>

      <PageSetupModal
        isOpen={isPageSetupOpen}
        currentConfig={pageConfig}
        onLiveChange={setPageConfig}
        onApply={(cfg) => setPageConfig(cfg)}
        onClose={() => setIsPageSetupOpen(false)}
        reportTitle="SF2 Daily Attendance"
      />
    </div>
  );
};

const MONTH_NAMES = [
  'January',
  'February',
  'March',
  'April',
  'May',
  'June',
  'July',
  'August',
  'September',
  'October',

  'December',

const getDynamicSchoolYear = (): string => {
  const now = new Date();
  const y = now.getFullYear();
  return now.getMonth() >= 5 ? `${y}-${y + 1}` : `${y - 1}-${y}`;
};

const sanitizeSearchText = (raw: string): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 80);

export const SF4ReportTab: React.FC<SF4ReportTabProps> = ({
  activeReportId = 'sf4',
  onSelectReport,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const { school: globalSchool } = useSchool();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();

  const now = useMemo(() => new Date(), []);
  const yearOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const cur = now.getFullYear();
    return [cur - 1, cur, cur + 1];
  }, [now]);

  const [schoolYearOptions, setSchoolYearOptions] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [selectedAcademicYear, setSelectedAcademicYear] = useState<string>(
    () => globalSchool.academic_year || getDynamicSchoolYear()
  );
  const [selectedMonth, setSelectedMonth] = useState<string>(
    () => MONTH_NAMES[now.getMonth()] || 'October'
  );
  const [selectedYear, setSelectedYear] = useState<number>(now.getFullYear());
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');

  const [reportData, setReportData] = useState<SF4ReportData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isExportingPdf, setIsExportingPdf] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isPrinting, setIsPrinting] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [auditMeta, setAuditMeta] = useState(() => buildAuditStamp('SF4'));
  const [pageConfig, setPageConfig] = useState<PageSetupConfig>(DEFAULT_DEPED_LANDSCAPE_SETUP);
  const [isPageSetupOpen, setIsPageSetupOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const reportRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const { widthIn: pageWidthInches, heightIn: pageHeightInches } = useMemo(
    () => resolvePaperDimensionsInches(pageConfig),
    [pageConfig]
  );

  const refreshAuditMeta = useCallback(() => {
    const next = buildAuditStamp('SF4', reportData?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id);
    setAuditMeta(next);
    return next;
  }, [reportData?.school_id, globalSchool.school_id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    apiClient
      .get(API_ROUTES.school.schoolYears, { signal: controller.signal })
      .then((res) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const list = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : res.data?.results || [];
        const codes = list
          .map((item: any) => (typeof item === 'string' ? item : item?.code || item?.name || ''))
          .filter(Boolean);
        setSchoolYearOptions(codes);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, []);

  const availableSchoolYears = useMemo(
    () =>
      Array.from(
        new Set(
          [
            ...schoolYearOptions,
            reportData?.school_year,
            globalSchool.academic_year,
            selectedAcademicYear,
            getDynamicSchoolYear(),
          ].filter(Boolean)
        )
      ) as string[],
    [schoolYearOptions, reportData?.school_year, globalSchool.academic_year, selectedAcademicYear]
  );

  const fetchSF4 = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      const baseParams = {
        month: selectedMonth,
        year: selectedYear,
        school_year: selectedAcademicYear,
      };
      const warmHit = !bypassCache
        ? peekApiCache<SF4ReportData>(API_ROUTES.reports.sf4, baseParams)
        : undefined;

      if (warmHit) {
        setReportData(warmHit);
        setLoading(false);
        if (silent) setRefreshing(true);
      } else if (!silent) {
        setLoading(true);
      } else {
        setRefreshing(true);
      }
      setError(null);

      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<SF4ReportData>(API_ROUTES.reports.sf4, {
          params: bypassCache ? { ...baseParams, nocache: 1 } : baseParams,
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        setReportData(res.data);
        const stamp = buildAuditStamp('SF4', res.data?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id);
        setAuditMeta(stamp);
        void logOfficialReportAudit({
          reportName: 'SF4',
          trackingId: stamp.trackingId,
          printedAt: stamp.printedAt,
          action: 'VIEW',
        });
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        if (!silent) {
          setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load DepEd SF4 School Summary Report.'));
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [selectedMonth, selectedYear, selectedAcademicYear, globalSchool.school_id]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchSF4(false, false);
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchSF4]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleBeforePrint = () => {
      refreshAuditMeta();
      setIsPrinting(true);
    };
    const handleAfterPrint = () => {
      setIsPrinting(false);
    };
    window.addEventListener('beforeprint', handleBeforePrint);
    window.addEventListener('afterprint', handleAfterPrint);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('beforeprint', handleBeforePrint);
      window.removeEventListener('afterprint', handleAfterPrint);
    };
  }, [refreshAuditMeta]);

  const filteredGradeGroups = useMemo(() => {
    const groups = Array.isArray(reportData?.grade_groups) ? reportData!.grade_groups : [];
    const q = sanitizeSearchText(searchQuery).toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return groups;

    return groups
      .map((g) => ({
        ...g,
        sections: (g.sections || []).filter(
          (s) =>
            s.section_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            s.adviser_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            s.grade_level.toLowerCase().includes(q)
        ),
      }))
      .filter((g) => g.sections.length > 0 || g.grade_level.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  }, [reportData, searchQuery]);

  const paginatedPages = useMemo<SF4PageChunk[]>(() => {
    if (pageConfig.layoutMode === 'pageless' || filteredGradeGroups.length === 0) {
      return [{ pageNumber: 1, totalPages: 1, groups: filteredGradeGroups, isFinalPage: true }];
    }

    const printableHeight = Math.max(
      3.5,
      pageHeightInches - (pageConfig.margins.top || 0.25) - (pageConfig.margins.bottom || 0.25)
    );
    const rowH = 0.22;
    const totalRows = filteredGradeGroups.reduce(
      (acc, g) => acc + (g.sections.length > 0 ? g.sections.length + 1 : 1),
      3
    );

    if (totalRows * rowH + 3.6 <= printableHeight) {
      return [{ pageNumber: 1, totalPages: 1, groups: filteredGradeGroups, isFinalPage: true }];
    }

    const rawPages: Array<{ groups: SF4GradeGroup[] }> = [];
    let currentGroups: SF4GradeGroup[] = [];
    let currentRows = 0;

    filteredGradeGroups.forEach((grp) => {
      const grpRows = grp.sections.length > 0 ? grp.sections.length + 1 : 1;
      const cap = rawPages.length === 0 ? 18 : 26;
      if (currentRows + grpRows <= cap || currentGroups.length === 0) {
        currentGroups.push(grp);
        currentRows += grpRows;
      } else {
        rawPages.push({ groups: currentGroups });
        currentGroups = [grp];
        currentRows = grpRows;
      }
    });

    if (currentGroups.length > 0) {
      rawPages.push({ groups: currentGroups });
    }

    const total = rawPages.length;
    return rawPages.map((p, idx) => ({
      pageNumber: idx + 1,
      totalPages: total,
      groups: p.groups,
      isFinalPage: idx === total - 1,
    }));
  }, [filteredGradeGroups, pageConfig, pageHeightInches]);

  const getBaseFilename = () => `DepEd_SF4_${reportData?.month || selectedMonth}_${selectedYear}`;

  const handleDirectPrint = () => {
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    void logOfficialReportAudit({
      reportName: 'SF4',
      trackingId: meta.trackingId,

    setIsPrinting(true);

    }, 180);
  };

  const handleExportPdf = async (usePicker = false) => {

    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();

      setIsExportingPdf(false);
    }
  };

  const buildCsvData = () => {
    if (!reportData) return { headers: [] as string[], rows: [] as Array<Array<string | number>> };
    const headers = [
      'Name of Adviser',
      'Grade Level',
      'Section',
      'Registered End M',
      'Registered End F',
      'Registered End T',
      'Daily Avg M',
      'Daily Avg F',

      'Attendance % T',
      'Dropped Out Cum T',
      'Transferred Out Cum T',
      'Transferred In Cum T',
    ];
    const rows: Array<Array<string | number>> = [];
    filteredGradeGroups.forEach((grp) => {
      grp.sections.forEach((s) => {
        rows.push([
          s.adviser_name,
          s.grade_level,
          s.section_name,
          s.registered_end.m,
          s.registered_end.f,
          s.registered_end.total,
          s.daily_average.m,
          s.daily_average.f,
          s.daily_average.total,
          s.attendance_percentage.m,
          s.attendance_percentage.f,
          s.attendance_percentage.total,
          s.dropped_out_cumulative.total,
          s.transferred_out_cumulative.total,
          s.transferred_in_cumulative.total,
        ]);
      });
    });
    return { headers, rows };
  };

  const handleExportCsv = async (usePicker = false) => {
    if (!reportData) return;
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    void logOfficialReportAudit({

    if (usePicker) {
      const escapeCell = (val: unknown) => `"${String(val ?? '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
      const csvString =

    <>

      <td style={tdNum}>{triplet ? triplet.f : 0}</td>

    </>
  );

  const renderSectionMetricCols = (rec?: SF4SectionRecord | null) => (

      {renderTripletCells(rec?.registered_end)}

  const schoolId = reportData?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id || '';

  return (

type ModalFormTab = 'BASIC' | 'ADDRESS' | 'PARENTS' | 'DEPED';

const sanitizeInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 150): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);

const maskQrToken = (token?: string): string => {
  const clean = String(token || '').trim();
  if (!clean) return '';
  return clean.length <= 4 ? 'Linked' : `••••${clean.slice(-4)}`;
};

    birthdate: '2012-01-01',
    grade_level_id: '',
    section_id: '',
    qr_token: '',
    photo: null as string | null,
    house_street_sitio: '',
    barangay: '',
    municipality_city: '',
    province: '',
    father_name: '',
    mother_maiden_name: '',
    guardian_name: '',
    guardian_relationship: 'Mother',
    parent_contact: '',
    mother_tongue: '',
    ethnic_group: '',
    religion: '',
  });

  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const metricsAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const copyTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const isInteracting = useRef<boolean>(false);
  isInteracting.current = isModalOpen || isImportModalOpen || Boolean(badgeStudent);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setDebouncedSearch(sanitizeInput(searchQuery, 60));
      setCurrentPage(1);
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [searchQuery]);

  const loadAcademicLookups = useCallback((signal?: AbortSignal) => {
    Promise.allSettled([
      apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.school.gradeLevels, { params: { page_size: 200, nocache: 1 }, signal }),
      apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.school.sections, { params: { page_size: 300, nocache: 1 }, signal }),
    ]).then(([glRes, secRes]) => {
      if (signal?.aborted) return;
      if (glRes.status === 'fulfilled' && glRes.value?.data) {
        setGradeLevels(Array.isArray(glRes.value.data) ? glRes.value.data : glRes.value.data?.results || []);
      }
      if (secRes.status === 'fulfilled' && secRes.value?.data) {
        setSections(Array.isArray(secRes.value.data) ? secRes.value.data : secRes.value.data?.results || []);
      }
    });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    loadAcademicLookups(controller.signal);
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [loadAcademicLookups]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      metricsAbortRef.current?.abort();
      if (copyTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(copyTimerRef.current);
        copyTimerRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, []);

  const loadMetrics = useCallback(async (bypassCache = false) => {
    metricsAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    metricsAbortRef.current = controller;

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.students.metrics, {
        params: bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : undefined,
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
      if (res.data) {
        setMetrics({
          total: Number(res.data.total ?? res.data.total_students ?? 0),
          active: Number(res.data.active ?? res.data.total_students ?? 0),
          paired: Number(res.data.paired ?? 0),
          total_sections: Number(res.data.total_sections ?? 0),
        });
      }
    } catch {
      // Keep existing metrics if offline or canceled
    }
  }, []);

  const loadStudents = useCallback(
    async (page: number, size: number, silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      const isAll = size >= ALL_ROWS_SIZE;
      const baseParams: Record<string, string | number> = {
        page: isAll ? 1 : page,
        page_size: isAll ? 'ALL' : size,
      };
      if (debouncedSearch) baseParams.search = debouncedSearch;
      if (selectedSectionFilter !== 'ALL') baseParams.section_id = selectedSectionFilter;

      const cached = !bypassCache ? peekApiCache<any>(API_ROUTES.students.list, baseParams) : undefined;
      if (cached) {
        if ('results' in cached) {
          setStudents(cached.results || []);
          setTotalCount(Number(cached.count) || 0);
        } else if (Array.isArray(cached)) {
          setStudents(cached);
          setTotalCount(cached.length);
        }
        setLoading(false);
      } else if (!silent) {
        setLoading(true);
      }
      setError(null);

      try {
        const params: Record<string, string | number> = { ...baseParams };
        if (bypassCache) params.nocache = 1;

        const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.students.list, {
          params,
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

        if (res.data && 'results' in res.data) {
          setStudents(res.data.results);
          setTotalCount(Number(res.data.count) || 0);
        } else if (Array.isArray(res.data)) {
          setStudents(res.data);
          setTotalCount(res.data.length);
        }
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        if (!silent) setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load student directory.'));
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted && !silent) setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [debouncedSearch, selectedSectionFilter]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadMetrics(false);
  }, [loadMetrics]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadStudents(currentPage, pageSize, false, false);
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [currentPage, pageSize, loadStudents]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isInteracting.current && document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        void loadStudents(currentPage, pageSize, true, true);
        void loadMetrics(true);
      }
    }, 20000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [currentPage, pageSize, loadStudents, loadMetrics]);

  const modalAvailableSections = useMemo(() => {
    if (!formData.grade_level_id) return sections;
    return sections.filter((sec) => {
      const glId =
        typeof sec.grade_level === 'object' && sec.grade_level !== null ? sec.grade_level.id : sec.grade_level;
      return String(glId) === String(formData.grade_level_id);
    });
  }, [sections, formData.grade_level_id]);

  const handleCopy = async (val: string) => {
    if (!val) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(val);
      setCopiedValue(val);
      if (copyTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(copyTimerRef.current);
      copyTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        setCopiedValue((prev) => (prev === val ? null : prev));
        copyTimerRef.current = null;
      }, 2000);
    } catch {
      // Ignore clipboard failure
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadCsvTemplate = () => {
    exportToCsv(
      'AttendSure_ClassList_Import_Template.csv',
      [
        'lrn',
        'first_name',
        'middle_name',
        'last_name',
        'suffix',
        'sex',
        'birthdate',
        'section_name',
        'grade_level',
        'parent_contact',
        'barangay',
        'municipality_city',
        'province',
      ],
      [
        [
          '128936000001',
          'FirstName',
          'MiddleName',
          'LastName',
          '',
          'Male',
          '2012-06-15',
          sections[0]?.name || 'SectionA',
          sections[0]?.grade_level_name || 'Grade 7',
          '09170000000',
          'BarangayName',
          'CityName',
          'ProvinceName',
        ],
      ]
    );
  };

  const handleOpenCsvImport = () => {
    setCsvFile(null);
    setImportSummary(null);
    setImportError(null);
    setImportDefaultSectionId(selectedSectionFilter !== 'ALL' ? selectedSectionFilter : '');
    setAutoCreateSections(true);
    setIsImportModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleRunCsvImport = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setImportError(null);
    setImportSummary(null);

    if (!csvFile) {
      setImportError('Please select a .csv class list file first.');
      return;
    }
    if (!csvFile.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv')) {
      setImportError('Only .csv spreadsheet files are accepted.');
      return;
    }
    if (csvFile.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      setImportError('CSV file must be 5 MB or smaller.');
      return;
    }

    setImportingCsv(true);
    try {
      const payload = new FormData();
      payload.append('file', csvFile);
      if (importDefaultSectionId) {
        payload.append('section_id', importDefaultSectionId);
      }
      payload.append('auto_create_sections', String(autoCreateSections));

      const res = await apiClient.post<CsvImportSummary>(API_ROUTES.students.bulkImport, payload, {
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' },
      });
      setImportSummary(res.data);
      loadAcademicLookups();
      await loadMetrics(true);
      await loadStudents(1, pageSize, false, true);
      setCurrentPage(1);
    } catch (err) {
      setImportError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not import CSV class list.'));
    } finally {
      setImportingCsv(false);
    }
  };

  const handleExportCsv = async () => {
    setIsExporting(true);
    try {
      const params: Record<string, string | number> = { page_size: 'ALL' };
      if (debouncedSearch) params.search = debouncedSearch;
      if (selectedSectionFilter !== 'ALL') params.section_id = selectedSectionFilter;

      const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.students.list, { params });
      const list: Student[] = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : res.data?.results || [];

      exportToCsv(
        `AttendSure_Students_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`,
        [
          'LRN',
          'Full Name',
          'Sex',
          'Birthdate',
          'Class Section',
          'QR Card Status',
          'Parent Contact',
          'Father Name',
          'Mother Maiden Name',
          'Barangay',
          'Municipality / City',
          'Status',
        ],
        list.map((s) => [
          s.lrn,
          s.full_name || `${s.last_name}, ${s.first_name}`,
          s.sex || '',
          s.birthdate || '',
          s.current_section || 'Unassigned',
          s.qr_token ? 'Linked' : 'Not Linked',
          s.parent_contact || '',
          s.father_name || '',
          s.mother_maiden_name || '',
          s.barangay || '',
          s.municipality_city || '',
          s.is_active ? 'ACTIVE' : 'INACTIVE',
        ])
      );
    } catch (err) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Export Failed', message: extractApiError(err), type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePhotoUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type)) {
      setFormError('Please upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP photo.');
      return;
    }
    if (file.size > 2.5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      setFormError('Photo size must be 2.5 MB or smaller.');
      return;
    }
    setFormError(null);
    setPhotoRemoved(false);
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      const result = typeof reader.result === 'string' ? reader.result : '';
      if (!isSafeImageUrl(result)) {
        setFormError('Selected file is not a valid image.');
        return;
      }
      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, photo: result }));
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleOpenCreate = () => {
    setEditingStudent(null);
    setFormError(null);
    setPhotoRemoved(false);
    setFormTab('BASIC');
    setFormData({
      lrn: '',
      first_name: '',
      middle_name: '',
      last_name: '',
      suffix: '',
      sex: 'Male',
      birthdate: '2012-01-01',
      grade_level_id: gradeLevels[0] ? String(gradeLevels[0].id) : '',
      section_id: '',
      qr_token: '',
      photo: null,
      house_street_sitio: '',
      barangay: '',
      municipality_city: '',
      province: '',
      father_name: '',
      mother_maiden_name: '',
      guardian_name: '',
      guardian_relationship: 'Mother',
      parent_contact: '',
      mother_tongue: '',
      ethnic_group: '',
      religion: '',
    });
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (st: Student) => {
    setEditingStudent(st);
    setFormError(null);
    setPhotoRemoved(false);
    setFormTab('BASIC');

    const exactSecId = st.current_section_id ?? st.section_id;
    const matchedSec =
      (exactSecId ? sections.find((s) => s.id === exactSecId) : undefined) ||
      sections.find((s) => s.name === st.current_section);
    const glVal =
      matchedSec && typeof matchedSec.grade_level === 'object' && matchedSec.grade_level !== null
        ? matchedSec.grade_level.id
        : matchedSec?.grade_level;

    setFormData({
      lrn: st.lrn || '',
      first_name: st.first_name || '',
      middle_name: st.middle_name || '',
      last_name: st.last_name || '',
      suffix: st.suffix || '',
      sex: st.sex === 'Female' || st.sex === 'F' ? 'Female' : 'Male',
      birthdate: st.birthdate || '2012-01-01',
      grade_level_id: glVal ? String(glVal) : gradeLevels[0] ? String(gradeLevels[0].id) : '',
      section_id: exactSecId ? String(exactSecId) : matchedSec ? String(matchedSec.id) : '',
      qr_token: '',
      photo: isSafeImageUrl(st.photo_url || st.photo) ? st.photo_url || st.photo || null : null,
      house_street_sitio: st.house_street_sitio || '',
      barangay: st.barangay || '',
      municipality_city: st.municipality_city || '',
      province: st.province || '',
      father_name: st.father_name || '',
      mother_maiden_name: st.mother_maiden_name || '',
      guardian_name: st.guardian_name || '',
      guardian_relationship: st.guardian_relationship || 'Mother',
      parent_contact: st.parent_contact || '',
      mother_tongue: st.mother_tongue || '',
      ethnic_group: st.ethnic_group || '',
      religion: st.religion || '',
    });
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFormError(null);

    if (formData.lrn.trim().length !== 12) {
      setFormError('LRN must be 12 digits.');
      setFormTab('BASIC');
      return;
    }
    if (!formData.first_name.trim() || !formData.last_name.trim()) {
      setFormError('First name and last name are required.');
      setFormTab('BASIC');
      return;
    }
    if (!formData.section_id) {
      setFormError('Please select a class section.');
      setFormTab('BASIC');
      return;
    }

    const cleanParentPhone = formData.parent_contact.trim().replace(/[\s-]/g, '');
    if (!cleanParentPhone) {
      setFormError('Parent mobile number is required in the "3. Guardian" tab.');
      setFormTab('PARENTS');
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
        lrn: formData.lrn.trim(),
        first_name: sanitizeInput(formData.first_name, 100),
        middle_name: sanitizeInput(formData.middle_name, 100),
        last_name: sanitizeInput(formData.last_name, 100),
        suffix: sanitizeInput(formData.suffix, 20),
        sex: formData.sex,
        birthdate: formData.birthdate,
        mother_tongue: sanitizeInput(formData.mother_tongue, 80),
        ethnic_group: sanitizeInput(formData.ethnic_group, 80),
        religion: sanitizeInput(formData.religion, 80),
        house_street_sitio: sanitizeInput(formData.house_street_sitio, 150),
        barangay: sanitizeInput(formData.barangay, 100),
        municipality_city: sanitizeInput(formData.municipality_city, 100),
        province: sanitizeInput(formData.province, 100),
        father_name: sanitizeInput(formData.father_name, 150),
        mother_maiden_name: sanitizeInput(formData.mother_maiden_name, 150),
        guardian_name: sanitizeInput(formData.guardian_name, 150),
        guardian_relationship: sanitizeInput(formData.guardian_relationship, 60),
        parent_contact: sanitizeInput(cleanParentPhone, 20),
        section_id: Number(formData.section_id),
      };

      if (formData.photo && formData.photo.startsWith('data:image/') && isSafeImageUrl(formData.photo)) {
        payload.photo = formData.photo;
      } else if (photoRemoved && editingStudent) {
        payload.photo = null;
        payload.remove_photo = true;
      }

      if (editingStudent) {
        await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.students.list}${editingStudent.id}/`, payload);
        showAlert({ title: 'Student Updated', message: 'Student profile saved.', type: 'success' });
      } else {
        await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.students.list, payload);
        showAlert({ title: 'Student Enrolled', message: 'New student enrolled successfully.', type: 'success' });
      }

      setIsModalOpen(false);
      await loadMetrics(true);
      await loadStudents(currentPage, pageSize, false, true);
    } catch (err) {
      setFormError(extractApiError(err, 'Failed to save student record.'));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = (st: Student) => {
    showConfirm({
      title: 'Delete Student Record',
      message: `Permanently delete ${st.full_name} (LRN: ${st.lrn})?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Delete Student',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await apiClient.delete(`${API_ROUTES.students.list}${st.id}/`);
          showAlert({ title: 'Student Removed', message: `${st.full_name} was removed from the class list.`, type: 'info' });
          await loadMetrics(true);
          await loadStudents(currentPage, pageSize, true, true);
        } catch (err) {
          showAlert({ title: 'Delete Failed', message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not delete student record.'), type: 'error' });
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const totalPages = pageSize >= ALL_ROWS_SIZE ? 1 : Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalCount / pageSize));
  const activeSchoolName = school.school_name || 'Official Student Pass';

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16, padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px)' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 210px), 1fr))', gap: 12 }}>
        <StatsCard
          label="REGISTERED STUDENTS"
          value={metrics.total.toLocaleString()}
          helpText="Students in your accessible scope"
          badge={<GraduationCap size={18} color={brand.primary} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="ACTIVE CLASS LIST"
          value={metrics.active.toLocaleString()}
          valueColor={brand.success}
          helpText="Cleared for classroom QR scanning"
          badge={<User size={18} color={brand.success} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="QR CARDS LINKED"
          value={`${metrics.paired.toLocaleString()} / ${metrics.active.toLocaleString()}`}
          valueColor={brand.primary}
          helpText="Active signed QR tokens"
          badge={<CreditCard size={18} color={brand.primary} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="CLASS SECTIONS"
          value={metrics.total_sections.toLocaleString()}
          valueColor={brand.secondary}
          helpText="Assigned active sections"
          badge={<BookOpen size={18} color={brand.secondary} />}
        />
      </div>

      <div
        style={{
          ...ui.card,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: 12,
          padding: '12px 16px',
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <select
            aria-label="Filter by class section"
            value={selectedSectionFilter}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setSelectedSectionFilter(e.target.value);
              setCurrentPage(1);
            }}
            style={{ ...ui.input, width: 'auto', minWidth: 220, fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer' }}
          >
            <option value="ALL">All Class Sections</option>
            {sections.map((sec) => (
              <option key={sec.id} value={sec.id}>
                {sec.grade_level_name ? `${sec.grade_level_name} - ` : ''}
                {sec.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>

          <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: 250 }}>
            <Search
              size={14}
              color={tokens.textMuted}
              style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 10, top: '50%', transform: 'translateY(-50%)' }}
            />
            <input
              type="text"
              maxLength={60}
              placeholder="Search student name or LRN..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              style={{ ...ui.input, paddingLeft: 32 }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleExportCsv}
            disabled={isExporting || totalCount === 0}
            style={ui.btnSecondary}
          >
            {isExporting ? <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <Download size={14} />}
            <span>Export CSV ({totalCount.toLocaleString()})</span>
          </button>

          {canManageStudents && (
            <>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleOpenCsvImport}
                style={ui.btnSecondary}
              >
                <Upload size={14} color={brand.primary} />
                <span>Import CSV Class List</span>
              </button>

              <button type="button" onClick={handleOpenCreate} style={ui.btnPrimary}>
                <Plus size={15} />
                <span>Add Student</span>
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ ...ui.card, padding: 0, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        {error && (
          <div
            style={{
              ...ui.subtleBox,
              margin: 14,
              backgroundColor: tokens.dangerLight,
              borderColor: brand.danger,
              color: brand.danger,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 8,
              fontWeight: 600,
            }}
          >
            <AlertCircle size={16} />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {loading ? (
          <div style={{ padding: 48, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
            <Loader2 size={26} className="animate-spin" color={brand.primary} style={{ margin: '0 auto 8px', display: 'block' }} />
            <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.base, fontWeight: 600 }}>Loading student records...</span>
          </div>
        ) : students.length === 0 ? (
          <div style={{ padding: 48, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
            <User size={36} style={{ margin: '0 auto 8px', display: 'block' }} />
            <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>No Students Found</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, marginTop: 2 }}>No student records match your current filter.</div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
            <table style={{ width: '100%', minWidth: 740, borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left' }}>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th style={ui.th}>Student</th>
                  <th style={ui.th}>LRN</th>
                  <th style={ui.th}>Class Section</th>
                  <th style={ui.th}>QR ID Card</th>
                  <th style={ui.th}>Parent Contact</th>
                  <th style={ui.th}>Status</th>
                  <th style={{ ...ui.th, textAlign: 'right' }}>Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {students.map((row) => {
                  const fullName = row.full_name || `${row.first_name} ${row.last_name}`;
                  return (
                    <tr key={row.id}>
                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                          <ProfileAvatar photoUrl={row.photo_url || row.photo} name={fullName} size={36} iconSize={17} />
                          <div>
                            <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{fullName}</div>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                              {row.sex}
                              {row.grade_level_name ? ` • ${row.grade_level_name}` : ''}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        <div
                          style={{
                            display: 'inline-flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            gap: 6,
                            padding: '3px 8px',
                            backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                            borderWidth: 1,
                            borderStyle: 'solid',
                            borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
                            borderRadius: 6,
                            fontFamily: fonts.mono,
                            fontSize: fonts.size.sm,
                            fontWeight: 700,
                          }}
                        >
                          <span>{row.lrn}</span>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleCopy(row.lrn)}
                            title="Copy LRN"
                            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 0, display: 'flex' }}
                          >
                            {copiedValue === row.lrn ? (
                              <Check size={12} color={brand.success} />
                            ) : (
                              <Copy size={12} color={tokens.textMuted} />
                            )}
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                          <BookOpen size={14} color={brand.primary} />
                          <span>{row.current_section || 'Unassigned'}</span>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        {row.qr_token ? (
                          <span
                            style={{
                              display: 'inline-flex',
                              alignItems: 'center',
                              gap: 5,
                              fontWeight: 700,
                              color: brand.success,
                              fontFamily: fonts.mono,
                              fontSize: fonts.size.sm,
                            }}
                          >
                            <CreditCard size={13} /> {maskQrToken(row.qr_token)}
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, color: tokens.textMuted, fontSize: fonts.size.sm }}>
                            <CreditCard size={13} /> Not Linked
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, fontSize: fonts.size.sm, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                          <Phone size={13} color={tokens.textMuted} /> {row.parent_contact || '—'}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        <span style={ui.badge(row.is_active ? tokens.successLight : tokens.dangerLight, row.is_active ? brand.success : brand.danger)}>
                          {row.is_active ? 'ACTIVE' : 'INACTIVE'}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td style={{ ...ui.td, textAlign: 'right' }}>
                        <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', gap: 6 }}>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setBadgeStudent(row)}
                            title="View / Print Student QR ID"
                            style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, padding: '6px 8px' }}
                          >
                            <QrCode size={14} color={brand.primary} />
                          </button>

                          {canManageStudents && (
                            <>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => handleOpenEdit(row)}
                                title="Edit Student"
                                style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, padding: '6px 8px' }}
                              >
                                <Pencil size={14} color={brand.primary} />
                              </button>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => handleDelete(row)}
                                title="Delete Student"
                                style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, padding: '6px 8px', color: brand.danger }}
                              >
                                <Trash2 size={14} />
                              </button>
                            </>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

        <Pagination
          currentPage={currentPage}
          totalPages={totalPages}
          totalCount={totalCount}
          pageSize={pageSize}
          onPageChange={setCurrentPage}
          onPageSizeChange={(nextSize) => {
            setPageSize(nextSize);
            setCurrentPage(1);
          }}
          itemLabel="students"
          style={{ backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, borderTop: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Bulk CSV Class List Import Modal */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isImportModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsImportModalOpen(false)}
        title="Bulk Import CSV Class List"
      >
        <form onSubmit={handleRunCsvImport} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
          <div
            style={{
              ...ui.subtleBox,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              flexWrap: 'wrap',
              gap: 10,
            }}
          >
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
              <FileSpreadsheet size={20} color={brand.primary} />
              <div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>

              <span>Download Sample CSV Template</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {importError && (
            <div
              style={{
                ...ui.subtleBox,
                backgroundColor: tokens.dangerLight,
                borderColor: brand.danger,
                color: brand.danger,
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 8,
                fontWeight: 600,
              }}
            >
              <AlertCircle size={15} />
              <span>{importError}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          <div>
            <label style={ui.label}>Select CSV File *</label>
            <input
              type="file"
              accept=".csv,text/csv"
              onChange={(e) => {
                setCsvFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null);
                setImportSummary(null);
                setImportError(null);
              }}
              style={ui.input}
            />
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 200px), 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Fallback Section (If row has no section_name)</label>
              <select
                value={importDefaultSectionId}
                onChange={(e) => setImportDefaultSectionId(e.target.value)}

              >
                <option value="">-- Use section_name from CSV --</option>
                {sections.map((sec) => (
                  <option key={sec.id} value={sec.id}>
                    {sec.grade_level_name ? `${sec.grade_level_name} - ` : ''}
                    {sec.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', paddingTop: 18 }}>
              <label style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, fontSize: fonts.size.sm, fontWeight: 600, color: tokens.textPrimary, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={autoCreateSections}
                  onChange={(e) => setAutoCreateSections(e.target.checked)}
                  style={{ accentColor: brand.primary }}
                />
                Auto-create new sections from CSV
              </label>
            </div>
          </div>

          {importSummary && (
            <div
              style={{
                ...ui.subtleBox,
                backgroundColor: tokens.successLight,
                borderColor: brand.success,
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                gap: 8,
              }}
            >
              <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, color: brand.success, fontSize: fonts.size.sm }}>
                Import Complete: {importSummary.created_count} Created &bull; {importSummary.updated_count} Updated &bull; {importSummary.skipped_count} Skipped
              </div>
              {importSummary.errors.length > 0 && (
                <div

                    overflowY: 'auto',
                    backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,

          )}

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 6 }}>
            <Button variant="secondary" type="button" onClick={() => setIsImportModalOpen(false)}>
              Close
            </Button>
            <Button variant="primary" type="submit" loading={importingCsv} disabled={!csvFile}>
              Upload &amp; Import Class List
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Modal>

      <Modal
        isOpen={isModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}
        title={editingStudent ? `Edit Student: ${editingStudent.full_name}` : 'Enroll New Student (DepEd SF1)'}
      >
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
          {formError && (
            <div
              style={{
                ...ui.subtleBox,
                backgroundColor: tokens.dangerLight,
                borderColor: brand.danger,
                color: brand.danger,
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 8,

              <AlertCircle size={15} /> <span>{formError}</span>

                <ProfileAvatar photoUrl={formData.photo} name={formData.first_name || 'Student'} size={50} iconSize={22} />
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center' }}>

                  {formData.photo && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, photo: null }));
                        setPhotoRemoved(true);
                      }}
                      style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, color: brand.danger }}
                    >
                      <X size={13} /> Remove
                    </button>

              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 180px), 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>

                  <label style={ui.label}>12-Digit LRN *</label>
                  <input
                    maxLength={12}
                    value={formData.lrn}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, lrn: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '') })}
                    style={ui.input}
                    placeholder="Enter 12-digit LRN"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={ui.label}>Birthdate *</label>
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={formData.birthdate}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, birthdate: e.target.value })}
                    style={ui.input}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 180px), 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={ui.label}>First Name *</label>
                  <input maxLength={100} value={formData.first_name} onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, first_name: e.target.value })} style={ui.input} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={ui.label}>Last Name *</label>
                  <input maxLength={100} value={formData.last_name} onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, last_name: e.target.value })} style={ui.input} />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 140px), 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={ui.label}>Middle Name</label>
                  <input maxLength={100} value={formData.middle_name} onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, middle_name: e.target.value })} style={ui.input} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={ui.label}>Suffix</label>
                  <select value={formData.suffix} onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, suffix: e.target.value })} style={ui.input}>
                    <option value="">None</option>
                    <option value="Jr.">Jr.</option>
                    <option value="Sr.">Sr.</option>
                    <option value="II">II</option>
                    <option value="III">III</option>
                    <option value="IV">IV</option>
                    <option value="V">V</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={ui.label}>Sex *</label>
                  <select value={formData.sex} onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, sex: e.target.value })} style={ui.input}>
                    <option value="Male">Male</option>
                    <option value="Female">Female</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 180px), 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={ui.label}>Grade Level *</label>
                  <select
                    value={formData.grade_level_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, grade_level_id: e.target.value, section_id: '' })}
                    style={ui.input}
                  >
                    <option value="">-- Select Grade --</option>
                    {gradeLevels.map((gl) => (
                      <option key={gl.id} value={gl.id}>
                        {gl.name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={ui.label}>Class Section *</label>
                  <select
                    value={formData.section_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, section_id: e.target.value })}
                    style={ui.input}
                  >
                    <option value="">-- Select Section --</option>
                    {modalAvailableSections.map((sec) => (
                      <option key={sec.id} value={sec.id}>
                        {sec.name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {formTab === 'ADDRESS' && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10 }}>
              <div>
                <label style={ui.label}>House # / Street / Sitio</label>
                <input maxLength={150} value={formData.house_street_sitio} onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, house_street_sitio: e.target.value })} style={ui.input} />
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 180px), 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
