/**
 * AttendSure - Theme Context & CSS Variable Engine
 * File: web/src/context/ThemeContext.tsx
 */

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  THEME_PALETTES,
  BRAND_COLORS,
  FONTS,
  RADIUS,
  createStyles,
  type ThemeMode,
  type ThemeTokens,
} from '../theme/tokens';

interface ThemeContextValue {
  mode: ThemeMode;
  setThemeMode: (mode: ThemeMode) => void;
  toggleTheme: () => void;
  tokens: ThemeTokens;
  brand: typeof BRAND_COLORS.light;
  fonts: typeof FONTS;
  radius: typeof RADIUS;
  ui: ReturnType<typeof createStyles>;
}

const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextValue | undefined>(undefined);
const STORAGE_KEY = 'attendsure_theme_mode';

export const ThemeProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<ThemeMode>(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) as ThemeMode;
    return saved && THEME_PALETTES[saved] ? saved : 'light';
  });

  const setThemeMode = useCallback((nextMode: ThemeMode) => {
    setMode(nextMode);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, nextMode);
    } catch {
      // Ignore storage quota errors
    }
  }, []);

  const toggleTheme = useCallback(() => {
    setMode((prev) => {
      const order: ThemeMode[] = ['light', 'dark', 'high-contrast'];
      const next = order[(order.indexOf(prev) + 1) % order.length];
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, next);
      } catch {
        // Ignore storage quota errors
      }
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const tokens = THEME_PALETTES[mode];
  const brand = BRAND_COLORS[mode];
  const ui = useMemo(() => createStyles(tokens, brand), [tokens, brand]);

  // Sync CSS variables onto <html> so CSS files and common components automatically change color
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', mode);
    root.style.setProperty('--bg-app', tokens.bgApp);
    root.style.setProperty('--bg-canvas', tokens.bgCanvas);
    root.style.setProperty('--bg-surface', tokens.bgSurface);
    root.style.setProperty('--bg-surface-subtle', tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle);
    root.style.setProperty('--bg-input', tokens.bgInput);
    root.style.setProperty('--text-primary', tokens.textPrimary);
    root.style.setProperty('--text-secondary', tokens.textSecondary);
    root.style.setProperty('--text-muted', tokens.textMuted);
    root.style.setProperty('--border-subtle', tokens.borderSubtle);
    root.style.setProperty('--border-input', tokens.borderInput);
    root.style.setProperty('--border-strong', tokens.borderStrong);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-primary', brand.primary);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-button-bg', brand.buttonBg);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-success', brand.success);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-warning', brand.warning);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-danger', brand.danger);
    root.style.setProperty('--success', tokens.success);
    root.style.setProperty('--danger', tokens.danger);
    root.style.setProperty('--danger-bg', tokens.dangerBg);
    root.style.setProperty('--card-shadow', tokens.cardShadow);
    root.style.setProperty('--font-sans', FONTS.sans);
  }, [mode, tokens, brand]);

  // Keyboard shortcut: Alt + T cycles color themes
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.altKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 't') {
        e.preventDefault();
        toggleTheme();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [toggleTheme]);

  const contextValue = useMemo<ThemeContextValue>(
    () => ({ mode, setThemeMode, toggleTheme, tokens, brand, fonts: FONTS, radius: RADIUS, ui }),
    [mode, setThemeMode, toggleTheme, tokens, brand, ui]
  );

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useTheme = (): ThemeContextValue => {
  const ctx = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useTheme must be used inside ThemeProvider');
  return ctx;
};

/**
 * AttendSure - Zero-Lag SWR Data Hook (Instant Cache Hydration + Keep-Previous-Data)
 * File: web/src/hooks/useApiResource.ts
 */

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import apiClient, { peekApiCache, subscribeApiCache } from '../api/client';
import { extractApiError } from '../api/routes';

export function useApiResource<T>(
  endpoint: string,
  initialValue: T,
  params?: Record<string, unknown>
) {
  const paramsKey = JSON.stringify(params || {});
  const stableParams = useMemo<Record<string, unknown> | undefined>(
    () => (paramsKey === '{}' ? undefined : JSON.parse(paramsKey)),
    [paramsKey]
  );

  const initialCached = useMemo(
    () => peekApiCache<T>(endpoint, stableParams),
    [endpoint, stableParams]
  );

  const [data, setData] = useState<T>(() =>
    initialCached !== undefined ? initialCached : initialValue
  );
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => initialCached === undefined);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const hasDataRef = useRef<boolean>(initialCached !== undefined);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return subscribeApiCache(endpoint, stableParams, (freshPayload) => {
      hasDataRef.current = true;
      setData(freshPayload as T);
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    });
  }, [endpoint, stableParams]);

  const reload = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      const warmHit = !bypassCache ? peekApiCache<T>(endpoint, stableParams) : undefined;
      if (warmHit !== undefined) {
        hasDataRef.current = true;
        setData(warmHit);
        setLoading(false);
      } else if (!silent && !hasDataRef.current) {
        setLoading(true);
      } else {
        setRefreshing(true);
      }

      setError(null);

      try {
        const reqParams = bypassCache
          ? { ...(stableParams || {}), nocache: 1 }
          : stableParams;
        const res = await apiClient.get<T>(endpoint, {
          params: reqParams,
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        hasDataRef.current = true;
        setData(res.data);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') return;
        setError(extractApiError(err, 'Unable to load records.'));
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [endpoint, stableParams]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void reload(hasDataRef.current, false);
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [reload]);

  return { data, setData, loading, refreshing, error, reload };
}

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP, MARGIN_PRESETS, PAPER_SIZES } from '../types/pageSetup';
import type {
  HeaderRepeatMode,
  LayoutMode,
  MarginPresetKey,
  PageOrientation,
  PageSetupConfig,
  PaperSizeKey,
} from '../types/pageSetup';

const GLOBAL_DEFAULT_KEY = 'attendsure_page_setup_default';
const HEX_COLOR_RE = /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/;

const clampMargin = (val: unknown, fallback: number): number => {
  const num = Number(val);
  if (!Number.isFinite(num) || num < 0 || num > 4) return fallback;
  return num;
};

const sanitizePageSetup = (raw: unknown): PageSetupConfig => {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') return DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP;
  const r = raw as Partial<PageSetupConfig>;

  const layoutMode: LayoutMode =
    r.layoutMode === 'pages' || r.layoutMode === 'pageless'
      ? r.layoutMode
      : DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.layoutMode;

  const orientation: PageOrientation =
    r.orientation === 'portrait' || r.orientation === 'landscape'
      ? r.orientation
      : DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.orientation;

  const paperSize: PaperSizeKey =
    r.paperSize && r.paperSize in PAPER_SIZES
      ? r.paperSize
      : DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.paperSize;

  const marginPreset: MarginPresetKey =
    r.marginPreset && r.marginPreset in MARGIN_PRESETS
      ? r.marginPreset
      : DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.marginPreset;

  const headerRepeat: HeaderRepeatMode =
    r.headerRepeat === 'all_pages' || r.headerRepeat === 'first_page_only'
      ? r.headerRepeat
      : DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.headerRepeat;

  const pageColor =
    typeof r.pageColor === 'string' && HEX_COLOR_RE.test(r.pageColor.trim())
      ? r.pageColor.trim()
      : DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.pageColor;

  const rawMargins = r.margins || DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.margins;
  const margins = {
    top: clampMargin(rawMargins.top, DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.margins.top),
    bottom: clampMargin(rawMargins.bottom, DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.margins.bottom),
    left: clampMargin(rawMargins.left, DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.margins.left),
    right: clampMargin(rawMargins.right, DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.margins.right),
  };

  return {
    layoutMode,
    orientation,
    paperSize,
    pageColor,
    marginPreset,
    margins,
    headerRepeat,
  };
};

export const usePageSetup = (reportKey: string = 'general') => {
  const specificKey = `attendsure_page_setup_${reportKey}`;

  const loadInitial = useCallback((): PageSetupConfig => {
    try {
      const specific = localStorage.getItem(specificKey);
      if (specific) return sanitizePageSetup(JSON.parse(specific));

      const globalDefault = localStorage.getItem(GLOBAL_DEFAULT_KEY);
      if (globalDefault) return sanitizePageSetup(JSON.parse(globalDefault));
    } catch {
      // Ignore malformed storage values
    }
    return DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP;
  }, [specificKey]);

  const [config, setConfig] = useState<PageSetupConfig>(loadInitial);

  // Sync state if localStorage changes from another tab/window
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleStorage = (e: StorageEvent) => {
      if (e.key === specificKey || e.key === GLOBAL_DEFAULT_KEY) {
        setConfig(loadInitial());
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
  }, [specificKey, loadInitial]);

  const saveConfig = useCallback(
    (newConfig: PageSetupConfig, setAsGlobalDefault: boolean = false) => {
      const safe = sanitizePageSetup(newConfig);
      setConfig(safe);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(specificKey, JSON.stringify(safe));
        if (setAsGlobalDefault) {
          localStorage.setItem(GLOBAL_DEFAULT_KEY, JSON.stringify(safe));
        }
      } catch {
        // Ignore storage quota issues
      }
    },
    [specificKey]
  );

  return { config, saveConfig };
};

const SAFE_RASTER_DATA_URI = /^data:image\/(png|jpeg|jpg|webp|gif);base64,/i;

export const isSafeImageUrl = (url?: string | null): boolean => {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return false;
  const trimmed = url.trim();
  const clean = trimmed.toLowerCase();
  if (!clean || clean === 'null' || clean === 'undefined' || clean === 'none') return false;
  if (
    clean.startsWith('javascript:') ||
    clean.startsWith('vbscript:') ||
    clean.startsWith('file:') ||
    clean.startsWith('data:image/svg')
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  if (clean.startsWith('data:')) {
    return SAFE_RASTER_DATA_URI.test(trimmed);
  }
  if (clean.startsWith('/')) {
    return !clean.startsWith('//');
  }
  return clean.startsWith('http://') || clean.startsWith('https://') || clean.startsWith('blob:');
};

export const sanitizeText = (text: string, maxLength = 150): string => {
  return String(text || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);
};

/**
 * AttendSure - Offline-Proof Local PDF, Word, Excel, JSON & Audit Export Helpers
 * File: web/src/utils/reportExporters.ts

import apiClient from '../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, escapeHtml } from '../api/routes';
import type { PageOrientation } from '../types/pageSetup';

export interface AuditStampMeta {
  printedAt: string;
  trackingId: string;
}

export const buildAuditStamp = (formCode: string, schoolId?: string): AuditStampMeta => {
  const now = new Date();
  const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  const dateFormatted = now.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    day: 'numeric',
  });
  const timeFormatted = now.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
    second: '2-digit',
    hour12: true,
  });
  const dateStamp = `${now.getFullYear()}${pad(now.getMonth() + 1)}${pad(now.getDate())}`;
  const timeCode = `${pad(now.getHours())}${pad(now.getMinutes())}${pad(now.getSeconds())}`;
  return {
    printedAt: `${dateFormatted} at ${timeFormatted}`,
    trackingId: `DOC-${formCode.toUpperCase()}-${schoolId || 'SCH'}-${dateStamp}-${timeCode}`,
  };
};

export const logOfficialReportAudit = async (params: {
  reportName: string;
  trackingId: string;
  printedAt: string;
  action: 'VIEW' | 'PRINT' | 'PDF' | 'EXCEL' | 'WORD' | 'CSV' | 'JSON';
  sectionId?: string | number;
}): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.reports.auditLogs, {
      report_name: params.reportName,
      document_tracking_id: params.trackingId,
      section_id: params.sectionId || undefined,
      action: params.action,
      printed_at: params.printedAt,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    });
  } catch {
    // Non-blocking when offline
  }
};

export const triggerBlobDownload = (blob: Blob, filename: string): void => {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = url;
  link.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
};

export const saveBlobWithOptionalPicker = async (
  blob: Blob,
  suggestedName: string,
  mimeType: string,
  extension: string,
  description: string
): Promise<void> => {
  if ('showSaveFilePicker' in window) {
    try {
      const picker = (
        window as unknown as {
          showSaveFilePicker: (opts: unknown) => Promise<{
            createWritable: () => Promise<{
              write: (b: Blob) => Promise<void>;
              close: () => Promise<void>;
            }>;
          }>;
        }
      ).showSaveFilePicker;
      const handle = await picker({
        suggestedName,
        types: [{ description, accept: { [mimeType]: [`.${extension}`] } }],
      });
      const writable = await handle.createWritable();
      await writable.write(blob);
      await writable.close();
      return;
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if ((err as { name?: string })?.name === 'AbortError') return;
    }
  }
  triggerBlobDownload(blob, suggestedName);
};

export const exportElementToLocalPdf = async (opts: {
  element: HTMLElement;
  filename: string;
  pageWidthInches: number;
  pageHeightInches: number;
  orientation: PageOrientation;
  pageColor?: string;
  pageless?: boolean;
  marginsInches?: [number, number, number, number];
  usePicker?: boolean;
}): Promise<void> => {
  const mod = await import('html2pdf.js');
  const html2pdf = mod.default;

  const finalName = opts.filename.endsWith('.pdf') ? opts.filename : `${opts.filename}.pdf`;
  const marginTuple: [number, number, number, number] = opts.marginsInches || [0, 0, 0, 0];
  const formatTuple: [number, number] = [opts.pageWidthInches, opts.pageHeightInches];

  const workerOptions = {
    margin: marginTuple,
    filename: finalName,
    image: { type: 'jpeg' as const, quality: 0.98 },
    html2canvas: {
      scale: 2,
      useCORS: true,
      logging: false,
      scrollX: 0,
      scrollY: 0,
      backgroundColor: opts.pageColor || '#ffffff',
    },
    jsPDF: {
      unit: 'in' as const,
      format: formatTuple,
      orientation: opts.orientation,
    },
    pagebreak: opts.pageless
      ? { mode: [] as string[] }
      : { mode: ['css', 'legacy'] },
  };

  if (opts.usePicker) {
    const pdfBlob = (await html2pdf()
      .set(workerOptions)
      .from(opts.element)
      .outputPdf('blob')) as unknown as Blob;
    await saveBlobWithOptionalPicker(
      pdfBlob,
      finalName,
      'application/pdf',
      'pdf',
      'PDF Document (*.pdf)'
    );
  } else {
    await html2pdf().set(workerOptions).from(opts.element).save();
  }
};

export const exportElementToExcel = async (
  element: HTMLElement,
  baseFilename: string,
  audit: AuditStampMeta,
  usePicker = false
): Promise<void> => {
  const html = `<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"></head><body>${element.innerHTML}<br/><p style="font-size:7pt;font-family:Arial;"><strong>DOCUMENT TRACKING ID:</strong> ${escapeHtml(audit.trackingId)} &bull; <strong>PRINTED:</strong> ${escapeHtml(audit.printedAt)}</p></body></html>`;
  const blob = new Blob([html], { type: 'application/vnd.ms-excel;charset=utf-8;' });
  const name = `${baseFilename}.xls`;
  if (usePicker) {
    await saveBlobWithOptionalPicker(
      blob,
      name,
      'application/vnd.ms-excel',
      'xls',
      'Excel Worksheet (*.xls)'
    );
  } else {
    triggerBlobDownload(blob, name);
  }
};

export const exportReportJson = async (
  baseFilename: string,
  audit: AuditStampMeta,
  reportData: unknown,
  usePicker = false
): Promise<void> => {
  const payload = {
    tracking_id: audit.trackingId,
    date_and_time_printed: audit.printedAt,
    report_data: reportData,
  };
  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
  const name = `${baseFilename}.json`;
  if (usePicker) {
    await saveBlobWithOptionalPicker(
      blob,
      name,
      'application/json',
      'json',
      'JSON Document (*.json)'
    );
  } else {
    triggerBlobDownload(blob, name);
  }
};

      case 'push':
        void loadPush();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.messaging.notifications, { page_size: 100 });
        break;
      case 'reports':
        void loadSf1();
        void loadSf2();
        if (isLeader) {
          void loadSf4();
        }
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.school.sections);
        break;
      case 'settings':
        void loadSettings();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.school.settings);
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  }, 120);
};

const SubtleSkeletonFallback: React.FC = () => {
  const { tokens } = useTheme();
  return (
    <div style={{ padding: 20, display: 'grid', gap: 12 }}>
      <div style={{ height: 48, borderRadius: 12, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, opacity: 0.65 }} />
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr))', gap: 12 }}>
        {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((n) => (
          <div key={n} style={{ height: 84, borderRadius: 12, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, opacity: 0.65 }} />
        ))}
      </div>
      <div style={{ height: 280, borderRadius: 14, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, opacity: 0.65 }} />
    </div>
  );
};

const AppContent: React.FC = () => {
  const { school, loading: isSchoolLoading, refreshSchool } = useSchool();
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const { term } = useCompliance();
  const [showStaffLogin, setShowStaffLogin] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [session, setSession] = useState<UserSession | null>(() => {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_token') || localStorage.getItem('attendsure_access');
    if (!token) return null;
    const username = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_username') || '';
    return {
      user_id: Number(localStorage.getItem('attendsure_user_id') || 0),
      token,
      username,
      faculty_name: localStorage.getItem('attendsure_faculty_name') || username || 'Staff User',
      role: localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || 'FACULTY',
    };
  });

  const [userPhoto, setUserPhoto] = useState<string | null>(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_user_photo');
    return isSafeImageUrl(saved) ? saved : null;
  });
  const [canTeach, setCanTeach] = useState<boolean>(() => localStorage.getItem('attendsure_can_teach') === 'true');
  const [isCompleteProfileModalOpen, setIsCompleteProfileModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isProfileModalOpen, setIsProfileModalOpen] = useState(false);

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<NavItemKey>('dashboard');
  const [selectedReport, setSelectedReport] = useState<'sf1' | 'sf2' | 'sf4'>('sf1');
  const [isSidebarCollapsed, setIsSidebarCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [isServerOnline, setIsServerOnline] = useState(true);
  const [isCheckingServer, setIsCheckingServer] = useState(false);

  const userRole = (session?.role || '').toUpperCase();
  const canViewSf4 = LEADERSHIP_ROLES.has(userRole);
  const effectiveReport: 'sf1' | 'sf2' | 'sf4' =
    !canViewSf4 && selectedReport === 'sf4' ? 'sf1' : selectedReport;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!canViewSf4 && selectedReport === 'sf4') {
      setSelectedReport('sf1');
    }
  }, [canViewSf4, selectedReport]);

  const allowedTabs = useMemo<NavItemKey[]>(() => {
    if (!userRole) return [];
    const tabs = [...(BASE_ROLE_PERMISSIONS[userRole] || BASE_ROLE_PERMISSIONS.FACULTY)];
    if (canTeach) {
      (['my-classes', 'classroom-scanner', 'advisory-monitor', 'messages'] as NavItemKey[]).forEach((t) => {
        if (!tabs.includes(t)) tabs.push(t);
      });
    }
    return tabs;
  }, [userRole, canTeach]);

  const isAllowed = allowedTabs.includes(activeTab);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!session?.token || !userRole) return;
    warmupRoleEndpoints(userRole, canTeach);
    const chunkTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      void loadMyClasses();
      void loadScanner();
      void loadStudents();
      void loadDtr();
    }, 800);
    return () => clearTimeout(chunkTimer);
  }, [session?.token, userRole, canTeach]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (hoverPrefetchTimer) {
        clearTimeout(hoverPrefetchTimer);
        hoverPrefetchTimer = null;
      }
    };
  }, []);

  const handleAuthExpired = useCallback(() => {
    if (hoverPrefetchTimer) {
      clearTimeout(hoverPrefetchTimer);
      hoverPrefetchTimer = null;
    }
    const keys = [
      'attendsure_access',
      'attendsure_refresh',
      'attendsure_token',
      'auth_token',
      'token',
      'attendsure_username',
      'attendsure_faculty_name',
      'attendsure_role',
      'attendsure_user_id',
      'attendsure_user_photo',
      'attendsure_can_teach',
    ];
    keys.forEach((k) => localStorage.removeItem(k));
    clearApiClientCache();
    setSession(null);
    setUserPhoto(null);
    setCanTeach(false);
    setSelectedReport('sf1');
    setIsCompleteProfileModalOpen(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    window.addEventListener('attendsure:auth-expired', handleAuthExpired);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('attendsure:auth-expired', handleAuthExpired);
  }, [handleAuthExpired]);

  const handleTabSelection = useCallback(
    (tab: NavItemKey) => {
      if (!allowedTabs.includes(tab)) return;
      startTransition(() => {
        setActiveTab(tab);
      });
    },
    [allowedTabs]
  );

  const handleSafeReportSelection = useCallback(
    (reportId: string) => {
      if (!['sf1', 'sf2', 'sf4'].includes(reportId)) return;
      const safeTarget = reportId === 'sf4' && !canViewSf4 ? 'sf1' : (reportId as 'sf1' | 'sf2' | 'sf4');
      startTransition(() => {
        setSelectedReport(safeTarget);
      });
    },
    [canViewSf4]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const onNavigate = (e: Event) => {
      const detail = (e as CustomEvent<string | { tab: string; report?: string }>).detail;
      if (!detail) return;
      if (typeof detail === 'string') {
        handleTabSelection(detail as NavItemKey);
      } else if (detail.tab) {
        handleTabSelection(detail.tab as NavItemKey);
        if (detail.report) {
          handleSafeReportSelection(detail.report);
        }
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('attendsure:navigate', onNavigate);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('attendsure:navigate', onNavigate);
  }, [handleTabSelection, handleSafeReportSelection]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!session?.token) return;
    let active = true;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    void refreshSchool();
    apiClient
      .get(API_ROUTES.accounts.me, { params: { nocache: 1 }, signal: controller.signal })
      .then((res) => {
        if (!active || controller.signal.aborted || !res.data) return;
        setIsServerOnline(true);
        const d = res.data;
        const rawPhoto = d.photo_url || d.photo || null;
        const photo = isSafeImageUrl(rawPhoto) ? rawPhoto : null;
        const name = String(d.full_name || d.username || '').trim();
        const role = String(d.role || d.system_role || session.role || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase();
        const userId = Number(d.id || d.user_id || 0);
        const teachFlag = Boolean(d.can_teach || d.is_teaching || d.assigned_class_count > 0 || role === 'FACULTY');

        setUserPhoto(photo);
        if (photo) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_photo', photo);
        else localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_user_photo');

        if (name) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_faculty_name', name);
        localStorage.setItem('attendsure_role', role);
        if (userId) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_id', String(userId));
        setCanTeach(teachFlag);
        localStorage.setItem('attendsure_can_teach', String(teachFlag));

        if (!LEADERSHIP_ROLES.has(role)) {
          setSelectedReport((prev) => (prev === 'sf4' ? 'sf1' : prev));
        }

        if (d.is_profile_completed === false) setIsCompleteProfileModalOpen(true);

        setSession((prev) =>
          prev ? { ...prev, user_id: userId || prev.user_id, faculty_name: name || prev.faculty_name, role } : null
        );
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        if (!active || controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string; response?: { status?: number } };
        if (anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        if (!anyErr?.response) setIsServerOnline(false);
        else if (anyErr.response?.status === 401) handleAuthExpired();
      });

    return () => {
      active = false;
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [session?.token, handleAuthExpired, refreshSchool]);

  const retryConnection = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsCheckingServer(true);
    try {
      await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.health.db, { params: { nocache: 1 } });
      setIsServerOnline(true);
    } catch {
      setIsServerOnline(false);
    } finally {
      setIsCheckingServer(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const pageTitle = useMemo((): string => {
    if (!isAllowed) return 'Access Restricted';
    const prefix = school.school_name ? `${school.school_name} • ` : '';
    switch (activeTab) {
      case 'dashboard':
        return `${prefix}Dashboard`;
      case 'impact':
        return term(
          'UN SDG Impact, Dropout Early-Warning & Campus Safety',
          'UN SDG Impact, SARDO Early-Warning & Campus Safety'
        );
      case 'classroom-scanner':
        return 'Classroom QR Attendance Scanner';
      case 'my-classes':
        return 'My Classes & Class Lists';
      case 'advisory-monitor':
        return 'Advisory Attendance & Cutting Matrix';
      case 'students':
        return 'Student Directory & QR Cards';
      case 'facultys':
        return 'Faculty & Staff Directory';
      case 'users':
        return 'User Accounts & Roles';
      case 'gate-passes':
        return 'Campus Exit Passes';
      case 'schedules':
        return 'Sections & Class Schedules';
      case 'dtr':
        return term('Verified Staff Timesheets (GPS)', 'Monthly Time Records (CSC Form 48)');
      case 'geofence':
        return 'Campus GPS Boundary';
      case 'messages':
        return 'Parent & Faculty Direct Chat';
      case 'push':
        return 'Mobile Push Alerts';
      case 'reports':
        return effectiveReport === 'sf1'
          ? term('Master Student Register (Ed-Fi / SF1)', 'DepEd School Form 1 (Register)')
          : effectiveReport === 'sf2'
            ? term('Daily Attendance Register (Ed-Fi / SF2)', 'DepEd School Form 2 (Daily Attendance)')
            : term('Consolidated Enrollment & Attendance (SF4)', 'DepEd School Form 4 (Monthly Movement)');
      case 'settings':
        return 'School Settings & Audit Logs';
      default:
        return 'AttendSure Portal';
    }
  }, [activeTab, isAllowed, school.school_name, effectiveReport, term]);

  const renderTab = () => {
    if (!isAllowed) {
      return (
        <div style={{ padding: 48, textAlign: 'center' }}>
          <ShieldAlert size={36} color={brand.danger} style={{ margin: '0 auto 12px', display: 'block' }} />
          <h2 style={{ margin: '0 0 6px', color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Access Restricted</h2>
          <p style={{ color: tokens.textMuted, fontSize: '0.84rem' }}>Your role ({userRole}) cannot view this module.</p>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleTabSelection(allowedTabs[0] || 'dashboard')}
            style={{
              marginTop: 14,
              padding: '8px 16px',
              backgroundColor: brand.buttonBg,
              color: '#fff',
              border: 'none',
              borderRadius: 8,
              fontWeight: 700,
              cursor: 'pointer',
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 6,
            }}
          >
            <ArrowLeft size={14} /> Back to Dashboard
          </button>
        </div>
      );
    }

    switch (activeTab) {
      case 'dashboard':
        return (
          <DashboardView
            isServerOnline={isServerOnline}
            userRole={userRole}
            onManualRefresh={retryConnection}
            onNavigateTab={(tab, report) => {
              handleTabSelection(tab as NavItemKey);
              if (report) {
                handleSafeReportSelection(report);
              }
            }}
          />
        );
      case 'impact':
        return (
          <div style={{ padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px)', maxWidth: 1380, margin: '0 auto' }}>
            <EnterpriseSDGWidget />
          </div>
        );
      case 'classroom-scanner':
        return (
          <div style={{ padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px)' }}>
            <ClassroomScanner />
          </div>
        );
      case 'my-classes':
        return <MyAssignedClassesTab />;
      case 'advisory-monitor':
        return (
          <div style={{ padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px)' }}>
            <AdvisorySubjectMonitor />
          </div>
        );
      case 'students':
        return <StudentsTab />;
      case 'facultys':
        return <FacultyTab />;
      case 'users':
        return <UsersTab />;
      case 'gate-passes':
        return <GatePassesTab />;
      case 'schedules':
        return <SchedulesTab />;
      case 'dtr':
        return <DTRTab />;
      case 'geofence':
        return <GeofenceTab />;
      case 'messages':
        return <ParentChatTab />;
      case 'push':
        return <PushNotificationsTab />;
      case 'reports':
        return (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', height: '100%', width: '100%', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
            {effectiveReport === 'sf1' && (
              <SF1ReportTab activeReportId="sf1" onSelectReport={handleSafeReportSelection} />
            )}
            {effectiveReport === 'sf2' && (
              <SF2ReportTab activeReportId="sf2" onSelectReport={handleSafeReportSelection} />
            )}
            {effectiveReport === 'sf4' && canViewSf4 && (
              <SF4ReportTab activeReportId="sf4" onSelectReport={handleSafeReportSelection} />
            )}
          </div>
        );
      case 'settings':
        return <SettingsTab />;
      default:
        return <DashboardView isServerOnline={isServerOnline} onManualRefresh={retryConnection} />;
    }
  };

  const resolvedSchoolLogo = school.school_logo || school.left_logo || null;

  return (
    <>
      <SplashScreen loading={isSchoolLoading} minDurationMs={0} />

      {!session ? (
        showStaffLogin ? (
          <LoginView
            onBackToShowcase={() => setShowStaffLogin(false)}
            onLoginSuccess={(nextSession) => {
              clearApiClientCache();
              setSession(nextSession);
              setActiveTab('dashboard');
              setSelectedReport('sf1');
            }}
          />
        ) : (
          <StartupShowcasePage
            onOpenSignIn={() => setShowStaffLogin(true)}
            onDemoLoginSuccess={(nextSession, targetTab = 'dashboard') => {
              clearApiClientCache();
              setSession(nextSession);
              setActiveTab(targetTab);
              setSelectedReport('sf1');
            }}
          />
        )
      ) : (
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            height: '100vh',
            width: '100%',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            backgroundColor: tokens.bgApp,
            padding: 'clamp(6px, 1vw, 12px)',
            gap: 'clamp(6px, 1vw, 12px)',
            boxSizing: 'border-box',
          }}
        >
          <div
            style={{
              height: '100%',
              borderRadius: 16,
              overflow: 'hidden',
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderStyle: 'solid',
              borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
              boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
              flexShrink: 0,
            }}
          >
            <Sidebar
              activeTab={activeTab}
              onSelectTab={handleTabSelection}
              onPrefetchTab={prefetchTabResources}
              session={session}
              userPhoto={userPhoto}
              isCollapsed={isSidebarCollapsed}
              onToggleCollapse={() => setIsSidebarCollapsed((p) => !p)}
              schoolName={school.school_name}
              schoolId={school.school_id}
              schoolLogo={resolvedSchoolLogo}
              canTeach={canTeach}
              allowedTabs={allowedTabs}
            />
          </div>

          <div
            style={{
              flex: 1,
              minWidth: 0,
              height: '100%',
              borderRadius: 16,
              backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderStyle: 'solid',
              borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
              boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              overflow: 'hidden',
            }}
          >
            <Header
              title={pageTitle}
              isSystemOnline={isServerOnline}
              session={session}
              userPhoto={userPhoto}
              schoolName={school.school_name}
              schoolId={school.school_id}
              schoolLogo={resolvedSchoolLogo}
              onLogout={handleAuthExpired}
              onNavigateTab={handleTabSelection}
              onOpenProfile={() => setIsProfileModalOpen(true)}
            />

            <main
              style={{
                flex: 1,
                minHeight: 0,
                overflowY: activeTab === 'dashboard' || activeTab === 'reports' ? 'hidden' : 'auto',
                overflowX: 'hidden',
                position: 'relative',
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
              }}
            >
              <ErrorBoundary featureName={pageTitle} resetKeys={[activeTab, effectiveReport]}>
                <Suspense fallback={<SubtleSkeletonFallback />}>{renderTab()}</Suspense>
              </ErrorBoundary>

              {!isServerOnline && (
                <div
                  onClick={retryConnection}
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    inset: 0,
                    zIndex: 35,
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(15,23,42,0.68)',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  <div
                    style={{
                      display: 'inline-flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      gap: 10,
                      padding: '10px 20px',
                      borderRadius: 9999,
                      backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
                      color: '#f8fafc',
                      fontWeight: 700,
                      fontSize: '0.82rem',
                    }}
                  >
                    <WifiOff size={16} color="#38bdf8" />
                    {isCheckingServer ? 'Reconnecting...' : 'Server offline. Click to reconnect.'}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </main>

            <Footer
              schoolName={school.school_name}
              schoolId={school.school_id}
              divisionOrCity={school.division}
              isDatabaseConnected={isServerOnline}
              isGateSystemOnline={isServerOnline}
            />
          </div>

          <ProfileModal
            isOpen={isProfileModalOpen}
            onClose={() => setIsProfileModalOpen(false)}
            onProfileUpdated={(updated: ProfileUpdatePayload) => {
              const name =
                typeof updated.full_name === 'string' && updated.full_name.trim()
                  ? updated.full_name.trim()
                  : undefined;
              if (name) {
                localStorage.setItem('attendsure_faculty_name', name);
                setSession((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, faculty_name: name } : null));
              }
              if (updated.photo !== undefined || updated.photo_url !== undefined) {
                const candidate = (updated.photo_url as string | null) ?? updated.photo ?? null;
                const nextPhoto = isSafeImageUrl(candidate) ? candidate : null;
                setUserPhoto(nextPhoto);
                if (nextPhoto) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_photo', nextPhoto);
                else localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_user_photo');
              }
            }}
          />

          <CompleteProfileModal
            isOpen={isCompleteProfileModalOpen}
            onCompleted={(updatedUser: CompletedProfileUser) => {
              setIsCompleteProfileModalOpen(false);
              const name = String(updatedUser.full_name || updatedUser.username || '').trim();
              const rawPhoto =
                (typeof updatedUser.photo_url === 'string' && updatedUser.photo_url) ||
                (typeof updatedUser.photo === 'string' && updatedUser.photo) ||
                null;
              const photo = isSafeImageUrl(rawPhoto) ? rawPhoto : null;
              if (name) {
                localStorage.setItem('attendsure_faculty_name', name);
                setSession((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, faculty_name: name } : null));
              }
              if (photo) {
                setUserPhoto(photo);
                localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_photo', photo);
              }
            }}
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export const App: React.FC = () => (
  <ThemeProvider>
    <ComplianceProvider>
      <SchoolProvider>
        <AlertProvider>
          <AppContent />
        </AlertProvider>
      </SchoolProvider>
    </ComplianceProvider>
  </ThemeProvider>
);

export default App;

/**
 * AttendSure - Instant-Mount Application Entry Point
 * File: web/src/main.tsx
 */

import React from 'react';
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom/client';
import App from './App';
import './index.css';
import { BRAND_ASSETS } from './components/branding/BrandAssets';

// Mount React immediately on Frame 1 before running optional favicon work
const rootElement = document.getElementById('root');
if (rootElement) {
  ReactDOM.createRoot(rootElement).render(
    <React.StrictMode>
      <App />
    </React.StrictMode>
  );
}

// Generate circular high-contrast favicon only when main thread is idle
const applyAppFavicon = () => {
  try {
    const img = new Image();
    img.decoding = 'async';
    img.src = BRAND_ASSETS.attendsureLogo;
    img.onload = () => {
      try {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width = 64;
        canvas.height = 64;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        if (!ctx) return;

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(32, 32, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#e2e8f0';
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.drawImage(img, 10, 10, 44, 44);

        const pngDataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
        document.querySelectorAll("link[rel*='icon']").forEach((el) => el.remove());

        const link = document.createElement('link');
        link.type = 'image/png';
        link.rel = 'icon';
        link.href = pngDataUrl;
        document.head.appendChild(link);
      } catch {
        // Keep inline SVG icon from index.html
      }
    };
  } catch {
    // Non-blocking fallback
  }
};

if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  const idle = (window as unknown as { requestIdleCallback?: (cb: () => void) => void }).requestIdleCallback;
  if (idle) idle(applyAppFavicon);
  else setTimeout(applyAppFavicon, 600);
}

# React + TypeScript + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)

## React Compiler

The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).

## Expanding the ESLint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend updating the configuration to enable type-aware lint rules:

```js
export default defineConfig([
  globalIgnores(['dist']),
  {
    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],
    extends: [
      // Other configs...

      // Remove tseslint.configs.recommended and replace with this
      tseslint.configs.recommendedTypeChecked,
      // Alternatively, use this for stricter rules
      tseslint.configs.strictTypeChecked,
      // Optionally, add this for stylistic rules
      tseslint.configs.stylisticTypeChecked,

      // Other configs...
    ],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: {
        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,
      },
      // other options...
    },
  },
])

```

You can also install [eslint-plugin-react-x](https://npmx.dev/package/eslint-plugin-react-x) and [eslint-plugin-react-dom](https://npmx.dev/package/eslint-plugin-react-dom) for React-specific lint rules:

```js
// eslint.config.js
import reactX from 'eslint-plugin-react-x'
import reactDom from 'eslint-plugin-react-dom'

export default defineConfig([
  globalIgnores(['dist']),
  {
    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],
    extends: [
      // Other configs...
      // Enable lint rules for React
      reactX.configs['recommended-typescript'],
      // Enable lint rules for React DOM
      reactDom.configs.recommended,
    ],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: {
        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,
      },
      // other options...
    },
  },
])

```

// File: web/vite.config.ts

import { defineConfig } from 'vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import path from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';
import type { ServerResponse } from 'http';

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react()],
  resolve: {
    alias: {
      '@': path.resolve(__dirname, './src'),
    },
  },
  server: {
    port: 80, // Default HTTP port
    host: true, // Listen on all network interfaces (0.0.0.0)
    strictPort: true,
    // Protect against host-header injection and unauthorized tunnels
    allowedHosts: [
      '.attendsure.com.ph',
      '.trycloudflare.com',
      'localhost',
      '127.0.0.1',
    ],
    fs: {
      allow: [path.resolve(__dirname, '..')],
    },
    proxy: {
      '/api': {
        target: 'http://127.0.0.1:8000',
        changeOrigin: true,
        secure: false,
        timeout: 10000,
        configure: (proxy) => {
          proxy.on('error', (_err, _req, res) => {
            // Verify res is an HTTP response before writing headers
            if (res && 'writeHead' in res && typeof res.writeHead === 'function') {
              const httpRes = res as ServerResponse;
              if (!httpRes.headersSent) {
                httpRes.writeHead(502, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                httpRes.end(
                  JSON.stringify({
                    error: 'The school server is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.',
                  })
                );
              }
            }
          });
        },
      },
      '/media': {
        target: 'http://127.0.0.1:8000',
        changeOrigin: true,
        secure: false,
      },
    },
  },
  build: {
    chunkSizeWarningLimit: 1200,
    sourcemap: false, // Cybersecurity: prevent source code leaks in production
    rollupOptions: {
      output: {
        // Universal function syntax compatible with all Vite and Rollup releases
        manualChunks(id: string) {
          if (id.includes('node_modules')) {
            if (id.includes('react') || id.includes('react-dom')) {
              return 'vendor-react';
            }
            if (id.includes('lucide-react')) {
              return 'vendor-icons';
            }
            if (id.includes('axios')) {
              return 'vendor-network';
            }
          }
        },
      },
    },
  },
});

# AttendSure v3.1 — Zero-Hardware Campus Attendance, Safety & Dropout Early-Warning OS

> **Every Student Accounted For. Zero Gate Hardware Required.**  
> Pure-software school attendance, 30-day AI dropout early-warning, emergency campus evacuation roll-call, parent safety alerts, and dual regulatory compliance (**Ed-Fi Data Standard v6.0 + GDPR** alongside **DepEd Philippines SF1 / SF2 / SF4 / CSC Form 48**).

## Why AttendSure Exists

Over **85% of public schools globally** cannot afford legacy RFID turnstiles (\$5,500–\$18,000+ upfront CapEx per campus) or recurring SMS parent-notification gateways. As a result, schools rely on paper registers that conceal chronic absenteeism, period-by-period cutting classes, and invisible dropout trajectories until it is too late.

**AttendSure eliminates 100% of gate hardware CapEx** by turning existing teacher laptops, webcams, \$15 USB QR readers, and staff smartphones into an encrypted, offline-capable campus operating system.

| Capability | Legacy RFID Turnstiles | AttendSure v3.1 |
|---|---|---|
| **Upfront Gate Hardware Cost** | \$5,500 – \$18,000+ / school | **\$0** (Pure Software) |
| **Parent Alert Cost** | \$0.02 – \$0.05 / SMS | **\$0** (Mobile Push + Offline Queue) |
| **Classroom / Period Cutting Detection** | Gate-only blind spot | **Per-period HMAC-signed QR scans** |
| **Faculty Presence Verification** | Wall biometric clock (proxy risk) | **Hardware-bound GPS + Mock-GPS detection** |
| **Global Data Interoperability** | Proprietary lock-in | **Ed-Fi v6.0 JSON + GDPR Art. 25 Pseudonymization** |
| **National Statutory Forms** | Manual re-encoding | **Auto-generated DepEd SF1, SF2, SF4 & CSC Form 48** |
| **Emergency Disaster Safety** | Paper binders | **1-Click Live Emergency Campus Roll-Call** |

---

## Core Modules & International Competition Features

1. **UN SDG Impact & Safety Command Center** (`Impact & Safety` tab):
   - Live PostgreSQL metrics for **SDG 4** (Quality Education), **SDG 5 & 10** (Gender Attendance Parity Index & Social Aid/CCT monitoring), **SDG 8** (Teacher hours reclaimed & CapEx avoided), **SDG 12 & 13** (Paper & gate e-waste CO2e reduction), and **SDG 16** (Hardware-verified faculty GPS & tamper-evident audit logs).
   - **30-Day Dropout Early-Warning Engine** scoring absences, period cutting, and morning tardiness into `CRITICAL_SARDO` and `EARLY_WARNING` intervention rosters.
   - **SDG 11 Emergency Evacuation Campus Roll-Call**: Instant live headcount checklist of all students and faculty verified inside the campus today.
2. **Dual Compliance Mode + Multi-Language UI (`EN` / `FIL` / `ES` / `FR`)**:
   - Instant top-bar toggle between **Global Ed-Fi v6.0** terminology/USD metrics and **DepEd Philippines** statutory workflows (`SF1`, `SF2`, `SF4`, `CSC Form 48`).
   - One-click **Ed-Fi Data Standard v6.0 JSON Export** (`/api/v1/reports/edfi-export/?days=30&anonymize=1`) with deterministic SHA-256 GDPR Art. 25 pseudonymization.
3. **1-Click Judge Demo Mode (Environment-Gated)**:
   - Public Product Showcase landing page with instant role launchers (**System Admin**, **School Principal**, **Class Adviser**) backed by real database records.
   - Strictly disabled (`HTTP 404`) in production whenever `DEBUG=False` and `ENABLE_JUDGE_DEMO=False`.
4. **Offline-First Classroom Scanner & Mobile App**:
   - HMAC-SHA256 signed QR cards (`common/qr_signer.py`) prevent forged badges.
   - Automatic client-side offline queue syncs batch scans and telemetry heartbeats upon reconnection.

## Repository Structure

```text
AttendSure_V3/
├── backend/                     # Django 6 + DRF + SimpleJWT + Celery + Redis + PostgreSQL
│   ├── apps/
│   │   ├── accounts/            # RBAC, device lock, audit logs, DemoLoginView, tests.py
│   │   ├── school/              # School settings, sections, schedules, seed_competition_demo
│   │   ├── students/            # Student directory, enrollments, signed QR cards, parent portal
│   │   ├── attendance/          # Signed QR scan, offline batch sync, adviser matrix, exit passes
│   │   ├── campus/              # Haversine geofencing, mock-GPS defense, DTR, emergency roll-call
│   │   ├── messaging/           # Expo push worker, announcements, parent-teacher direct chat
│   │   └── reports/             # SF1, SF2, SF4, DTR, SDG Impact, Dropout Risk, Ed-Fi v6.0 engine
│   ├── common/                  # Audit middleware, GPS math, E.164 phone, HMAC QR signer
│   ├── config/                  # settings.py, urls.py, legacy_urls.py, wsgi.py, asgi.py, celery.py
│   ├── Dockerfile               # Non-root Python 3.12 production container
│   └── gunicorn.conf.py         # Blue/Green/Standalone Gunicorn config
├── web/                         # React 19 + TypeScript + Vite executive & faculty web portal
│   └── src/
│       ├── components/showcase/ # Public competition showcase & 1-Click Judge Demo launcher
│       ├── components/dashboard/# Live Dashboard + UN SDG Impact & Early-Warning Command Center
│       ├── components/tabs/     # Scanner, Students, Faculty, Schedules, Geofence, SF1/SF2/SF4/DTR
│       └── context/             # ThemeContext (Light/Dark/High-Contrast) + ComplianceContext (Global/DepEd + i18n)
├── mobile/                      # React Native / Expo companion app (Faculty GPS + Parent Portal)
├── deploy/                      # Nginx reverse proxy + Blue-Green zero-downtime switch scripts
├── docs/
│   ├── COMPETITION_PITCH_PACK.md    # 10-slide pitch deck blueprint, TAM/SAM/SOM & 3-min demo script
│   └── ARCHITECTURE_AND_SECURITY.md # Mermaid architecture, GDPR/FERPA/RA 10173 & Ed-Fi v6.0 spec
└── docker-compose.yml           # PostgreSQL 16 + Redis 7 + Blue/Green Web + Nginx + Celery
```

## 5-Minute Quickstart (Local Competition Demo)

### 1. Backend Setup & Competition Demo Seeder

```bash
cd backend
python -m venv venv
# Windows PowerShell:
.\venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
# macOS / Linux:
# source venv/bin/activate

pip install -r requirements.txt
python manage.py migrate
python manage.py seed_competition_demo
python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000
```

> **Seeded Demo Accounts** (password: `AttendSure2026!`):  
> `demo_admin` (Admin) · `demo_principal` (Principal) · `demo_teacher` (Class Adviser) · `demo_parent` (Parent Mobile)  
> 1-Click Judge Demo buttons work automatically when `DEBUG=True` or `ENABLE_JUDGE_DEMO=True`.

### 2. Web Portal

```bash
cd web
npm install
npm run dev
```

Open `http://localhost:5173` to view the **Public Startup Showcase & 1-Click Judge Demo Launcher**.

### 3. Production Zero-Downtime Docker Deployment (Blue-Green)

```bash
cp backend/.env.example backend/.env   # Set SECRET_KEY, DB_PASSWORD, REDIS_PASSWORD, DEBUG=False
docker compose up -d --build
docker compose exec web_blue python manage.py migrate --noinput
docker compose exec web_blue python manage.py collectstatic --noinput

# Subsequent zero-downtime releases:
# Linux/macOS: ./deploy/switch.sh
# Windows:     .\deploy\switch.ps1
```

### 4. Automated Test Suite

```bash
cd backend
python manage.py check
python manage.py test apps.accounts.tests --verbosity=2
```
